21-seasoning-salute-vinaigrette.description:
Trader Joe’s 21 Seasoning Salute and Organic Red Wine Vinegar make a veritably versatile combination for a variety of your vinaigrette needs. Dress your leafy greens and pasta salads with a couple tablespoons or use it as a zesty marinade for fish or chicken.

Pro-tip: for fewer dishes and a built-in serving and storage vessel, combine all ingredients in a lidded mason jar and shake to emulsify.
ingredients: 3 tablespoons TJ’s Organic Red Wine Vinegar
2 tablespoons grated TJ’s Pecorino Romano and Parmesan Blend
1/3 cup TJ’s Extra Virgin Olive Oil

steps.text: In a small bowl, combine vinegar, 21 seasoning salute, honey, grated cheese, salt, and pepper. Slowly whisk in oil until emulsified. Taste and adjust seasoning, as desired.

21-seasoning-salute-vinaigrette.title: 21 Seasoning Salute Vinaigrette

Chile-Lime-Mango-Sticky-Rice-Pudding-Pop.description:
The 2026 Trader Joe’s Chile Lime Customer Recipe Contest was a truly heated affair. From exquisite appetizers and enticing entrees to between-meal munchies and desserts with a kick, our customers’ culinary creativity assumed endless forms.

We spent hours upon hours tasting and testing (tough gig, right?) and in the end, a few fire-forged Chile Lime champions emerged... including these Chile Lime & Mango Sticky Rice Pudding Pops, which earned customer Meg Mezeske an enthusiastic Honerable Mention! Chefs’ hats off to our winners, and many thanks to all who participated. The entries were truly applause-worthy.
ingredients: 1 package TJ’s Rice Pudding (4 - 3.53 oz. cups)
Juice from ½ of a fresh TJ’s Lime
¾ cup fresh ripe TJ’s Mango, diced into ¼-inch pieces
1 teaspoon TJ’s Chile Lime Seasoning Blend, plus more for serving

steps.text: Have ready a 10-cavity ice pop mold (about 3 fl. oz. per cavity)
In a medium bowl, combine rice pudding and coconut milk. Add sugar and mix until well combined.
In a small bowl, combine mango, lime juice, and 1 teaspoon Chile Lime Seasoning. Stir until mango is well coated.
Fold the seasoned mango into the rice pudding mixture.
Pour final mixture into the ice pop mold, distributing evenly. Freeze for about 1 hour before inserting sticks, then continue freezing until solid (at least 8 hours).
When ready to serve, place additional Chile Lime Seasoning in a small bowl. Remove pops from mold one at a time, “dip” each one in Seasoning, and serve immediately. Enjoy!

Chile-Lime-Mango-Sticky-Rice-Pudding-Pop.title: Chile Lime & Mango Sticky Rice Pudding Pops

Chile-Lime-Shrimp-grits.description:
The 2026 Trader Joe’s Chile Lime Customer Recipe Contest was a truly heated affair. From exquisite appetizers and enticing entrees to between-meal munchies and desserts with a kick, our customers’ culinary creativity assumed endless forms.

We spent hours upon hours tasting and testing (tough gig, right?) and in the end, a few fire-forged Chile Lime champions emerged... including these Street Corn-Inspired Chile Lime Shrimp & Grits by customers Remya & Suhas Rao, our 1st Runners Up! Chefs’ hats off to our winners, and many thanks to all who participated. The entries were truly applause-worthy.
ingredients: ½ package TJ’s Wild Argentinian Red Shrimp
3 ½ tablespoons TJ’s Chile Lime Seasoning Blend
1 package TJ’s Organic Polenta, cut into roughly 1-inch cubes
6 ½ tablespoons TJ’s Organic Unsalted Butter
TJ’s Organic Ground Black Pepper, to taste
½ package TJ’s Frozen Roasted Corn

steps.text: Thaw shrimp overnight in the refrigerator. Pat dry, then add to a medium bowl with 1 tablespoon olive oil and 2 tablespoons Chile Lime Seasoning. Toss until shrimp is evenly coated and let stand for about 10 minutes, while you make your grits.
steps.title: Prepare the shrimp:

steps.text: Add cubed polenta to a saucepan filled with about ½ inch of water. Heat on medium. Once simmering, mash polenta to fully break up lumps and whisk until runny, adding water as needed. Add 4 ounces of the crumbled cotija cheese and continue to whisk. Once cheese is incorporated and polenta is thick and creamy, turn off heat and stir in 2 tablespoons of butter. Add salt and pepper to taste.
steps.title: Make the grits:

steps.text: Heat a cast iron skillet over medium-high heat and melt about 1 tablespoon of butter. Add shrimp to skillet and sear for about 2 minutes per side, until cooked through. Remove shrimp from the skillet and set aside.
steps.title: Cook the shrimp:

steps.text: Add the frozen corn and a bit of butter (roughly ½ tablespoon) to the skillet and cook until corn is heated through. Remove from heat and stir in ½ tablespoon of Chile Lime Seasoning and the remaining 2 ounces of crumbled cotija.
steps.title: Cook the corn:

steps.text: Heat 3 tablespoons of butter in a small pan over medium heat. Grate in 2 cloves of garlic and cook until raw garlic aroma begins to dissipate. Add 1 tablespoon Chile Lime Seasoning to mixture and remove from heat. Strain, if desired.
steps.title: Make the chile lime garlic butter:

steps.text: Spoon grits onto a plate. Top grits with shrimp and corn, then drizzle with Chile Lime garlic butter and garnish with cilantro. Enjoy!
steps.title: Assemble:

Chile-Lime-Shrimp-grits.title: Street Corn-Inspired Chile Lime Shrimp & Grits

Chile-Lime-Sunrise-Huevos-Rancheros.description:
The 2026 Trader Joe’s Chile Lime Customer Recipe Contest was a truly heated affair. From exquisite appetizers and enticing entrees to between-meal munchies and desserts with a kick, our customers’ culinary creativity assumed endless forms.

We spent hours upon hours tasting and testing (tough gig, right?) and in the end, a few fire-forged Chile Lime champions emerged... including these Chile Lime Sunrise Huevos Rancheros by customer Zulma Cordero, our 2nd Runner Up! Chefs’ hats off to our winners, and many thanks to all who participated. The entries were truly applause-worthy.
ingredients: 3 tablespoons TJ’s Plain Whole Milk Greek Yogurt
¼ teaspoon TJ’s Chile Lime Seasoning Blend
1 teaspoon fresh juice from 1 TJ’s Lime
TJ’s Olive Oil (for pan, about 1-2 tablespoons)
TJ’s Chile Lime Seasoning Blend, to taste
TJ’s Chile Lime Seasoning Blend, to taste

steps.text: In a small bowl, combine yogurt, ¼ teaspoon Chile Lime Seasoning, and lime juice. Mix well and set aside.
steps.title: Make the crema:

steps.text: Heat about 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add eggs and cook sunny side up, until whites are set and yolks remain soft. Lightly sprinkle with Chile Lime Seasoning.
steps.title: Cook the eggs:

steps.text: Heat a drizzle of olive in a skillet over medium heat. Add the tortillas and warm for about 30 seconds per side, until soft and lightly toasted.
steps.title: Warm the tortillas:

steps.text: Add the Cowboy Caviar to the same skillet and heat briefly, just until warm.
steps.title: Warm the Cowboy Caviar:

steps.text: Place tortillas on a plate. Top with eggs, then add Cowboy Caviar. Spoon crema over the top, sprinkle with Cotija cheese, and add a lime wedge. Finish with a drizzle of olive oil and additional Chile Lime Seasoning, as desired. Serve immediately and enjoy!
steps.title: Assemble:

Chile-Lime-Sunrise-Huevos-Rancheros.title: Chile Lime Sunrise Huevos Rancheros

abj-banana-bark-boats.description:
Some things in this world are all bark and no bite. Trader Joe’s Dark Chocolate Bark with Almond, Pretzel, & Sea Salt, on the other hand, is all bark and just begging for a bite! Each bag contains super snackable pieces of rich dark chocolate, studded with crunchy roasted almond and pretzel pieces and topped with a sufficient sprinkling of sea salt.

Packed in a resealable bag that makes it a particularly swell on-the-go snack or sweet treat on its own, it elevates customary camping desserts like s’mores or these Almond Butter and Raspberry Preserve-drizzled Banana Boats with ease!
ingredients: TJ’s Salted Almond Butter, for drizzling
TJ’s Organic Raspberry Preserves, for drizzling
1 bag TJ’s Dark Chocolate Bark with Almond, Pretzel, & Sea Salt, broken into smaller pieces

steps.text: Lay a square of parchment paper over a larger square of heavy-duty aluminum and place a banana, still in its peel, on top, then slice halfway through bananas lengthwise, without cutting through the bottom peel. Pry the banana open and drizzle almond butter and preserves into each. Then evenly distribute a few pieces of chocolate bark in the crevice.

Wrap the banana with the parchment and foil to create a little sealed pouch that you can easily open from the top. Place on grill grates, over indirect heat. Alternatively, you can cook over a camp stove or a home stove, by carefully hovering the Banana Bark Boat over the flame with tongs. Cook until the bananas have softened, and the chocolate is completely melted, about 10-15 minutes, depending on the strength of your heat source.

Carefully remove from heat and let banana packs cool before opening with an oven mitt or kitchen town. Open foil and drizzle with more almond butter and preserves. Grab a utensil and eat your Banana Bark Boat right out of the peel!

abj-banana-bark-boats.title: AB&J Banana Bark Boats

acai-smoothie-bowl.description:
The açaí berry trend shows no signs of slowing down-and why should it? With its subtle hints of cacao and powerful berry tang, açaí's rich, complex flavor profile is refreshingly irresistible. On-the-go cafés and juiceries have devoted entire sections of their menus to energizing smoothies and filling breakfast bowls made with this brilliant berry of the Amazon. These menu offerings, however, are typically packed with sugar and are often quite expensive.     

So this is us, taking matters into our own hands. And our own bowls. Got a few minutes and a blender? Then grab a packet of Trader Joe's Organic Unsweetened Açaí Purée and give this tantalizingly tropical, easy-peasy recipe a try. Your body-and your wallet-will thank you.
ingredients: 1 TJ's Organic Unsweetened Açaí Purée packet
1/2 cup TJ's Frozen Organic Mixed Berry Blend
1-2 tablespoons TJ's Unsweetened Vanilla Almond Milk
1 scoop of your favorite protein powder (optional)

steps.text: Add Açaí packet, berry blend, almond milk, and half of the banana to blender (and protein, if using). Blend until smooth (adjust almond milk if needed). Scrape smoothie mixture into bowl. Top with remaining banana slices, granola and dates. Grab a spoon and dig in.

acai-smoothie-bowl.title: Açaí Smoothie Bowl

aglio-olio-bread-dip.description:
Aglio e olio (that’s Italian for “garlic and oil”) is a classic Neapolitan dish, consisting of long pasta (often spaghetti) tossed in a sauce of pantry staples, including olive oil, plenty of thinly sliced garlic, and chili flakes. It’s also the inspiration behind Trader Joe’s Aglio Olio Garlicky & Spicy Seasoning Blend. Packed into a shakeable glass jar, this Blend combines the beloved Italian flavor components of the dish in dried form, along with parsley flakes and sea salt—no more slicing slippery garlic cloves!

Pasta aside, you can highlight this Seasoning Blend’s Garlicky goodness in a quick-to-assemble, downright delightful dip for toasted Focaccia Bread with Roasted Tomato & Parmesan.
ingredients: ¼ cup of your favorite TJ’s Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 tablespoons TJ’s Aglio Olio Garlicky & Spicy Seasoning Blend
TJ’s Focaccia Bread with Roasted Tomato & Parmesan, toasted, for dipping

steps.text: In a shallow bowl, add olive oil, seasoning blend, and grated cheese and stir to combine. Serve with toasted focaccia bread for dipping.

aglio-olio-bread-dip.title: Aglio Olio Bread Dip

almond-butter-dipping-sauce.description: Flexing versatility, Trader Joe’s Creamy Salted Almond Butter can be used for both sweet and savory applications. It makes a mean AB&J sandwich with your favorite jelly or preserves, a terrific topping for oatmeal, and when mixed with a few pantry staples, a delightful dipping sauce for crudité and chicken skewers.
ingredients: 1/2 cup TJ's Creamy Salted Almond Butter
2 tablespoons juice from a TJ’s Lime
1 ½ tablespoons TJ’s Organic Blue Agave Syrup
¼-½ teaspoon TJ’s Organic Crushed Red Pepper

steps.text: In a small bowl, combine almond butter, coconut aminos, lime juice, agave, and crushed red pepper, and stir to combine. The mixture will be thick. Slowly stir in water, one tablespoon at a time, until the mixture loosens and becomes smooth. Drizzle with abandon!

almond-butter-dipping-sauce.title: Almond Butter Dipping Sauce

almost-empty-mustard-jar-dressing.description:
When there isn’t quite enough Trader Joe’s Aioli Garlic Mustard Sauce left to spread on a sandwich, use the rest (and the jar) to make an all-purpose salad dressing! Toss this tangy dressing with your favorite TJ’s lettuce mix, over a grain bowl, or roasted veggies to easily wake up those weeknight meals.

The more mustard sauce in the jar, the zippier it’ll be. Mixing the dressing in the jar cuts down on dishes, too. Win-win!
ingredients: An almost empty jar of TJ’s Aioli Garlic Mustard Sauce (about two tablespoons)
¼ cup of your favorite TJ’s Olive Oil
2 tablespoons of TJ’s Rice Vinegar (or whatever TJ’s vinegar you have on hand)
1 teaspoon of your favorite TJ’s honey

steps.text: To your almost empty jar of aioli, add all ingredients. Top with lid and shake until emulsified.

almost-empty-mustard-jar-dressing.title: Almost-Empty Mustard-Jar Dressing

amatriciana.description: Trader Joe’s Diced Uncured Pancetta is made from pork belly that’s imported from Italy. It’s minimally processed and Uncured, meaning it’s produced with no added nitrates or nitrites—except those naturally occurring in sea salt and cultured celery powder. What's more, it’s ready to use in a variety of dishes, like this weeknight-friendly take on the classic Roman pasta, Amatriciana. Instead of the traditional and difficult-to-find guanciale, Pancetta is crisped up then simmered into a savory, satisfying sauce made with TJ’s Super Sweet Marzanino Tomatoes to make the sauce. This recipe easily feeds two for dinner, but it can be doubled to feed more or serve as leftovers.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon of your favorite TJ’s Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 can TJ’s Super Sweet Marzanino Tomatoes
½ package (8 ounces) TJ’s Spaghetti, cooked according to package instructions (1/2 cup pasta water reserved)
¼ cup TJ’s Grated Pecorino Romano, plus more for serving
A few cranks of TJ’s Black Peppercorns
A pinch TJ’s Organic Crushed Red Pepper

steps.text: Heat a large sauté pan over medium heat and add olive oil.

Add the pancetta and cook for 3 minutes, just until it begins to brown. Add the chopped shallot and sauté, stirring occasionally, for another 3-5 minutes, until the shallot softens and the pancetta is crisp.

Add the tomatoes and use the back of a large spoon or spatula to crush them in the pan. Stir to incorporate. Bring to a simmer, then lower heat to medium low and cook for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add cooked pasta to the sauce and stir to combine. Add a splash of pasta water as needed and stir until the sauce evenly coats the noodles. Remove from heat.
Add grated Romano and stir to combine. Season with pepper and crushed red pepper. Sprinkle with more Romano and serve immediately.

amatriciana.title: Amatriciana

antipasti-bowl.description: These hearty bowls are a cinch to assemble and scale up for a large group. You can lay the ingredients out for guests so they can build bowls to their liking, while you relax and enjoy the party.
ingredients: 1/3 cup TJ's Balsamic Vinaigrette, plus more for serving
1 jar TJ's Fire Roasted Red Peppers, sliced
1/2 jar TJ's Pitted Greek Kalamata Olives
1 container TJ's Ciliegene Whole Milk Fresh Mozzarella
1 package of your favorite TJ's Salame

steps.text: Add farro and 3 cups water to a saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover pan and simmer 10 minutes. Drain farro into a colander and rinse under cold water for 1 minute. Add farro and vinaigrette to a medium bowl and stir to combine. Set aside.
Divide butter lettuce among serving bowls and top each with a scoop of farro. Top each bowl with peppers, artichoke halves, olives, mozzarella and salame and serve immediately.

antipasti-bowl.title: Antipasti Bowl

antipasto-chopped-salad.description: Trader Joe’s Chopped Salad Blend is made with a mix of finely chopped bits of peppery escarole, earthy endive, crunchy red cabbage, lightly spicy radicchio, and slightly sweet carrot. This expertly balanced Blend works wonderfully as a base for an array of easy side salads on any given weeknight. Need a little inspiration? Salty salami, creamy Fontina, and TJ’s Marinated Artichokes are equally as awesome on an appetizer board as they are in this salad.
ingredients: 1/3 block TJ’s Fontina, chopped into cubes
4 slices TJ’s Uncured Salame di Parma Mild Salami, cut into thin, bite-sized strips
1/3 jar TJ’s Marinated Artichokes, drained and chopped into bite-sized pieces
¼ cup TJ’s Organic Italian Dressing

steps.text: In a large bowl, combine salad blend, Fontina, salami, and artichoke hearts. Add dressing and toss to combine.

antipasto-chopped-salad.title: Antipasto Chopped Salad

antipasto-pasta-salad.description: Combine Trader Joe’s Chickpea Fusilli Pasta (offering an impressive 11 grams of protein and six grams of fiber per serving) with TJ’s Balsamic Vinaigrette, and you have a solid base to build upon which an array of pasta salads all summer long. Your neighborhood Trader Joe’s offers all manners of mix-ins to create the pasta salad of your dreams… like this one that transforms the ingredients of a classic antipasto platter into a picnic-ready dish.
ingredients: 1 box TJ’s Chickepea Fusilli Pasta, cooked according to package instructions
1 jar TJ’s Marinated Grilled Artichoke Halves, drained
1 cup diced TJ’s Red Bell Pepper
1 cup TJ’s Jumbo Pitted Greek Kalamata Olive, sliced
1 package (seven sticks) TJ’s Prosciutto Wrapped Fresh Mozzarella Cheese sticks, chopped into bite-sized pieces
½-3/4 cups TJ’s Balsamic Vinaigrette, divided

steps.text: Combine cooked pasta, artichokes, bell pepper, olives, and chopped prosciutto and cheese sticks in a large bowl.

To serve, add ½ cup vinaigrette and toss to coat.

Note: the pasta will soak up the dressing as it sits. Reserve additional ¼ cup of dressing to redress the salad, if needed.

antipasto-pasta-salad.title: Antipasto Pasta Salad

apple-caramel-hand-pies.description: Give a hand to Trader Joe's Pie Crusts for making this recipe possible!
ingredients: 2 rolls (1 pkg) TJ's Pie Crust, defrosted in fridge overnight
4 small TJ's Gala Apples, peeled, cored & diced
1 tsp TJ's Unbleached All Purpose Flour, plus more for rolling dough
3 Tbsp Fleur de Sel Caramel Sauce (or more, to taste)
1 large TJ's Egg, beaten with 1 tsp Water
1/4 cup TJ's Turbinado Sugar (optional for sanding tops)
*You will also need a wide-mouthed jar or circular cookie cutter (3.5 in diameter = about 7 hand pies)

steps.text: Remove both pie crust rolls from refrigerator and let soften on counter (about 15 minutes). Place diced apples in a medium bowl, cover with lemon juice and set aside.

Working in two batches, unroll softened dough and smooth together any cracks with your hands. Remove plastic film and place dough onto a floured surface. Cut out 7 circles from one roll and 7 circles from the other (it could be more or less, depending on the size of your cookie cutter, just make sure you end up with an even number). Place all dough circles onto two baking trays lined with parchment paper and place back in refrigerator to chill.
Add cinnamon, flour, sea salt and caramel sauce to bowl of diced apples. Stir and set aside. Prepare egg wash by whisking egg with water in a small bowl. Set aside.

Remove dough from refrigerator and place a spoonful of the apple-caramel mix onto 7 of the dough circles, making sure not to overfill or touch the edges of the dough. Brush egg wash around the perimeter of each filled dough circle. Place the remaining 7 dough circles on top of the mounds, then crimp the edges of the dough with a fork to seal each pie. Place prepared pies back in refrigerator to chill another 10 minutes before baking.

Preheat oven to 375 degrees. Once oven is heated, remove tray of pies from refrigerator and brush tops generously with egg wash. With a sharp knife, cut a slit or a small design on the top of each pie to help steam release while baking. Optional: for added texture, sprinkle turbinado sugar over the top of each pie.
Bake pies in center rack for 20-25 minutes, or until the juices start bubbling and the pastry is golden brown. For even baking, rotate sheet halfway though. Transfer to a cooling rack and serve warm.

apple-caramel-hand-pies.title: Apple-Caramel Hand Pies

apricot-jubilees.description: This recipe celebrates the hotly anticipated arrival of fresh apricots during the early summer months—get them while you can!
ingredients: 1 (4.5 oz.) tub TJ's Goat's Milk Creamy Cheese or 1 (5 oz.) log TJ's Chèvre with Honey, warmed to room temperature
3 Tablespoons TJ's Sliced Honey Roasted Almonds

steps.text: Halve the apricots, remove seeds and place the hollow side facing skywards on a platter
In a small bowl, mix together the goat cheese and almonds
Using a knife, cut off the bottoms of the coconut macaroons
Place a generous dollop of the goat cheese mixture on each apricot half
Crown goat cheese mounds with the top portions of the macaroons
Dot the blueberries with a small amount of goat cheese, then gingerly place atop the point of each macaroon
Serve immediately, ideally with Trader Joe's English Breakfast Tea
Recipe Credit: Trader Joe's 2015 Strut Your Stuffed Recipe Contest Winner - Jessica Volz of Denver, CO

apricot-jubilees.title: Apricot Jubilees

aromatic-garlic-ginger-rice.description: Trader Joe’s Chicken Broth Concentrate is one of the handiest tools in a cook’s toolkit. It adds an ineffable depth of flavor to soups and casseroles; it deglazes a pan most deliciously; it’s an indispensable ingredient in all manner of sauces and gravies. It’s championed for bolstering dishes like these quickly and with low effort, making it an especially handy tool for weeknight dinners. Two packets of Concentrate, along with fresh garlic and ginger, easily enhance a cup of rice in nearly the same amount of time it takes to boil a pot of plain rice.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons finely chopped TJ’s Fresh Garlic
1 tablespoon finely chopped TJ’s Fresh Ginger
1 TJ’s Green Onion, thinly sliced on a bias

steps.text: In a medium-sized, lidded pot, melt butter over medium-high heat. Add garlic and ginger and sauté until aromatic, about 2 minutes.
Add rice, water, and broth concentrate and stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, cover, then lower heat to low and cook for 15 minutes, until liquid is absorbed.
Removed from heat, fluff with fork, and top with green onion to serve.

aromatic-garlic-ginger-rice.title: Aromatic Garlic Ginger Rice

artichoke-jalapeno-stuffed-mushrooms.description:
During the holidays, appetizers are the key to party success—a bounty of small bites to fuel guests before the big meal. Or how about an entire meal of only appetizers? Yes, please! And what makes for fun(gi) finger food, you ask? Trader Joe's Organic Crimini Mushrooms stuffed with TJ's Artichoke & Jalapeño Dip! 

Note: Not sure what to do with those leftover mushroom stems? Chop them up and add them to the dip for the filling to double down on the mushroom and eliminate waste!
ingredients: 2 teaspoons finely chopped TJ’s Fresh Thyme
2 packages TJ’s Crimini Mushrooms, stems removed from caps (*for no waste: finely chop mushroom stems and add to dip)

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F and prepare a large, foil-lined baking sheet.
To a small skillet over medium heat, melt the butter and toast the breadcrumbs until they become golden, about 5 minutes. Add the finely chopped thyme and toss to combine.
Optional: Combine finely chopped mushroom stems with Artichoke & Jalapeño Dip. (see pro-tip above)
Fill each mushroom cap with a spoonful of the dip, then sprinkle with the seasoned breadcrumbs to coat the filling.
Arrange stuffed mushrooms on prepared baking sheet and bake for 30 minutes.
Let cool for 5 minutes before serving.

artichoke-jalapeno-stuffed-mushrooms.title: Artichoke & Jalapeño-Stuffed Mushrooms

avocado-crema.description: This creamy green sauce is perfect for drizzling atop burgers or Fish Tacos.

steps.text: Add all ingredients to the bowl of a blender or food processor.
Blend for 1-2 minutes until smooth.
Pour into a small serving bowl or squeeze bottle and drizzle atop eggs, burritos, tacos, salads, fajitas, burgers...

avocado-crema.title: Avocado Crema

baby-beets-atop-a-cloud-of-ricotta.description: True to their name, Trader Joe’s Steamed & Peeled Baby Beets are terrific time-savers. They are Peeled and cooked—Steamed in a sealed pouch, specifically, to retain their starry nutritional profile—ready to enjoy right out of the package. Whether you serve them warmed or straight out of the fridge, they make an impressive (and easy to assemble) appetizer paired with a thick swoosh of creamy TJ’s Traditional Whole Milk Ricotta Cheese and a generous sprinkle of vibrant green, crunchy TJ’s Raw Pistachios.
ingredients: 1 cup TJ’s Traditional Whole Milk Ricotta Cheese
1 package TJ’s Steamed & Peeled Baby Beets, warmed according to package instructions, if desired, and sliced into thin rounds
A handful TJ’s Raw Pistachio Nutmeats, roughly chopped
Your favorite TJ’s Extra Virgin Olive Oil, for drizzling

steps.text: To a large serving plate with a rim, spread the ricotta over the surface using the back of a large spoon.
Shingle the beet slices atop the ricotta.
Top with pistachios, a sprinkle of sea salt, and a few cranks of black pepper.
Generously drizzle the entire dish with extra virgin olive oil to serve.

baby-beets-atop-a-cloud-of-ricotta.title: Baby Beets Atop a Cloud of Ricotta

baby-corn-feta-salad.description: Salty, tangy, creamy, and oh-so convenient, a sprinkle of Trader Joe’s Crumbled Feta can easily enhance an array of dishes, like this no-cook salad. Calling on TJ’s Baby Corn instead of traditional kernels from the cob and quick-macerated red onions in lime juice, this salad is light and bright, with pleasant pops of Feta flavor throughout.
ingredients: ½ cup diced TJ’s Red Onion
2 packages TJ’s Baby Corn, chopped into thirds
1 pint TJ’s Organic Heirloom Medley Cherry Tomatoes, sliced in half
¼ cup chopped TJ’s Organic Cilantro
A few cranks TJ’s Black Peppercorns
½ - ¾ container TJ’s Crumbled Feta

steps.text: Combine diced onion and lime juice in a small bowl. Let sit 5-10 minutes, while you prepare the salad.
To your serving bowl, add chopped Baby Corn, sliced tomatoes, diced avocado, chopped cilantro. Pour the macerated onion, along with the lime juice, over the salad and toss to combine.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Top with Crumbled Feta and a sprinkle of paprika to serve.

baby-corn-feta-salad.title: Baby Corn & Feta Salad

bacon-apple-brie-panini.description: Trader Joe’s Ciabatta Demi-Baguette combines the best of both bread worlds: Baguette’s classic shape with Ciabatta’s thin crust and light crumb. Its mild flavor makes it an exceptional vehicle for a variety of sandwiches, (we're looking at you, bacon, apple, and brie!) and noteworthily, stands up impressively well to the heat and pressure of a panini press. What’s more, it’s Demi nature  is ideal for savoring a solo meal, or sharing with a friend alongside a hearty bowl of chili or soup.
ingredients: 1 TJ’s Ciabatta Demi-Baguette, sliced in half lengthwise, then cut in half widthwise, on a bias, to make two sandwiches
1 wedge TJ’s Triple Creme Brie, cut into 8 slices
4 slices of your favorite TJ’s Bacon, cooked according to package instructions
8 slices of your favorite TJ’s Apple

steps.text: Heat grill pan or panini press to medium-high.

Place brie slices in a single layer on the bottom half of each sandwich. Place thinly sliced apple atop the brie, then top with bacon. Close each sandwich with the top haves of the baguette, then place on panini press and close, or in a grill pan and press down. Grill until brie has melted and bread is browned and crisp on both sides, 3-5 minutes per side. Serve immediately.

bacon-apple-brie-panini.title: Bacon, Apple, and Brie Panini

bacon-apple-sweet-potato-hash.description: Trader Joe's Organic Sweet Potatoes are an extremely versatile vegetable. They can be baked, roasted, fried, grilled, boiled, mashed or grated. In this recipe, we used them to hash out breakfast by roasting them and mixing them with apples, onions, kale, egg and crispy bacon. Rooted in sweet and savory deliciousness, it's a righteous and easy way to start any day.
ingredients: 4 TJ's Organic Sweet Potatoes, peeled and diced
1/4 cup TJ's Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 package TJ's Uncured Apple Smoked Bacon (or your favorite TJ's Bacon), chopped
2 TJ's Gala Apples or TJ's Granny Smith Apples, diced

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400ºF.
Toss sweet potatoes with olive oil and sea salt. Place in roasting pan and bake for 20 minutes.

In a large oven-safe skillet, cook bacon over medium heat. Add onions once the bacon has cooked for five minutes and has begun to render fat. Cook until bacon begins to become crisp and onions appear translucent.

Add apples and cook for an additional two minutes. Add roasted sweet potatoes to the mixture and cook for approximately five minutes or until potatoes begin to soften. Mix in kale and cook for another two minutes.
Create four spaces in the hash mixture where you want to place the eggs and carefully crack one egg in each space.
Place skillet in oven and cook for 7 - 10 minutes, or until eggs are fully cooked.
Remove from oven, toss with maple syrup and serve.

bacon-apple-sweet-potato-hash.title: Bacon Apple Sweet Potato Hash

baked-apple-cinnamon-french-toast.description:
A true taste of fall baked into a single slice of bread. A flour-filled fantasy? Well, dream no more! We’ve cracked the code and harnessed this whimsy into a reality with this sweet (but not too sweet), moist cinnamon-forward loaf— introducing Trader Joe’s Sliced Apple Cinnamon Sourdough Bread! Each loaf begins with a long and gentle fermentation process to maximize texture and flavor. Following this starter step, the dough is folded with diced apples, brown sugar, and cinnamon. The result is a Bread with a characteristic sourdough tang, chewy crust, and light open crumb that’s swirled with rich brown sugar, pungent cinnamon, and tender apple pieces.

Toast and slather with TJ's Cultured Salted Butter as part of a breakfast sweet treat or snack. Try it in a savory but unique grilled cheese sandwich with TJ's Unexpected Cheddar Cheese. Or start your weekend with this fall-nomenal baked French toast that’s finished with a heavy drizzle of Fleur de Sel Caramel Sauce. Yum!
ingredients: 2 tablespoons TJ’s Unsalted Butter, for greasing pan
1 pint TJ’s Brown Sugar Oat Creamer
1 loaf TJ’s Sliced Apple Cinnamon Sourdough Bread, each slice cut in half widthwise
TJ’s Fleur de Sel Caramel Sauce, for drizzling

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F. Prepare a 9x13 baking dish by greasing with butter and set aside.
In a large bowl, whisk eggs and brown sugar oat creamer until combined.

Dip each piece of bread into the egg mixture, then place in baking dish at a slight angle, leaning the first slice against one wall of the pan. Repeat with remaining slices of brioche, laying them against one another at an angle, so they are neither completely flat nor standing straight.
Add the chopped apple to the egg mixture, then pour the mixture over the slices of bread.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, until cooked and the tops of bread are golden.
Remove from oven and drizzle with caramel sauce to serve.

baked-apple-cinnamon-french-toast.title: Baked Apple Cinnamon French Toast

baked-bejeweled-tahchin.description:
For a showstopping main or side dish, consider the Persian rice dish, Tahchin. Combine Trader Joe’s Basmati Rice with TJ’s Spanish Saffron, along with a few other everyday staples, like yogurt and eggs, and the result is an aromatic, golden-hued rice fit for any celebration-worthy occasion. 

Along with the saffron rice, the filling is bejewled with savory caramelized onion, nutty pistachios, tart TJ’s No Sugar Added Cranberries, and herby dill to really pack a punch of flavors. To successfully achieve the iconic golden, crispy exterior crust of the dish (called tahdig), opt for a generously buttered baking dish and the oven instead of the traditional stovetop method. Since that makes over half of the total recipe time hands-off (yes!), you need not wait for a special occasion to get in the kitchen and make this impressive dish. 

Don’t forget to save a bit of the caramelized onion filling to crown the top of your tahchin!
ingredients: 2 cups TJ's Basmati Rice, rinsed and drained
12 tablespoons TJ's Unsalted Butter, divided, plus more for greasing the baking dish
2 medium-sized TJ's Yellow Onions, thinly sliced
2 thinly sliced cloves of TJ's Fresh Garlic
1 cup TJ's No Sugar Added Dried Craberries
2 tablespoons chopped TJ's Fresh Dill, plus more for garnish
1 cup European Style Organic Plain Whole Milk Yogurt

steps.text:
Bring a large pot of water to a boil and add a generous amount of salt. Add Basmati rice and cook for 5-8 minutes, until al dente. Drain.

Pro-tip: Heavily salting the water will help season the entire dish.
steps.title: Parboil the Rice

steps.text:
In a large sauté pan, heat 4 tablespoons butter and oil until foaming over medium heat, add the onions and cook until they just begin to color. Add garlic. Continue to cook until the onions and garlic are deeply golden, 10-15 minutes. Stir in the pistachios and cranberries and cook for a few more minutes until the pistachios sizzle and the cranberries plump. Turn off the heat. Add the chopped dill, and season to taste with salt and pepper. Scoop out about ¾ cup for garnish and set aside.

Pro-tip: To speed up the time it takes to cook the onions and help prevent burning, add two tablespoons of water over any dark spots in the pan during the cooking process.
steps.title: Prepare the Onion Mixture

steps.text:
In a mortar and pestle or small bowl, crush the saffron with the pestle or the back of a spoon to a rough powder. Add saffron to a large bowl, then pour in 2 tablespoons warm water. Allow to sit for 3-5, until the water turns bright yellow. Melt remaining 8 tablespoons butter, then add melted butter, egg yolks and yogurt to the bloomed saffron water. Whisk to combine. 

Add the rice and use a rubber spatula to thoroughly combine. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
steps.title: Season the Rice

steps.text:
Preheat oven to 350°F.

Generously grease the bottom and sides of a 9-inch casserole dish or non-stick pot with lid.

Lightly pack about ⅓ of the rice into the bottom and up the sides of the pot.

Combine the onion mixture with the remaining rice. Use the back of a spoon to gently press and smooth the top.

Cover and bake for 1 hour.

Remove lid and bake for 15-20 minutes more.

Remove from oven and let to sit for 10 minutes.
steps.title: The Bake

steps.text: Place a plate or platter (larger than the diameter of the pot or baking dish), on top of the tahchin. Using both hands, hold both the pot and the platter, and carefully flip the tahchin onto the platter.
steps.title: The Flip

steps.text:
Top with remaining onion mixture.

Garnish with pomegranate seeds and dill to serve.
steps.title: Bejewel and Serve

baked-bejeweled-tahchin.title: Baked & Bejeweled Tahchin

baked-brie-en-croute.description:
Trader Joe’s Double Cream Brie contains a minimum of 60% butterfat, guaranteeing a rich and creamy result in every bite. Made in the traditional French style by a respected Wisconsin cheesemaker, its bloomy rind envelops a smooth, rich, creamy cheese, delivering exactly what you want from a classic Brie.

Double down on that deliciousness by topping the mini wheel with honey, nuts, and herbs, wrapping it in TJ’s Organic Crescent Rolls, and baking it until it’s awesomely ooey... irresistibly gooey... and oh-so-delicious! It makes an excellent appetizer for parties or an elegant appetizer for two!
ingredients: 1 tablespoon TJ’s Fresh Thyme, destemmed and chopped
1 tablespoon of your favorite TJ’s Honey, plus more for drizzling
Your favorite TJ's crackers or a TJ's Organic Baguette, for serving

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Unwrap brie and, using a knife, score the top with a large, shallow “X.”
In a small bowl, combine walnuts, thyme, and honey.

Unroll crescent dough and carefully separate the 8 triangles along the perforated seams. Arrange triangles on a parchment-lined baking sheet in a “star” shape, with the shortest sides of the triangles just slightly overlapping, so that the parchment at the center of the star is exposed. Place Brie at center, top with nut mixture, and wrap the triangles up and over the Brie. Bake for 30 minutes, until the top and bottom of the crescent dough becomes golden.
Drizzle with more honey and serve with your favorite TJ's crackers or a warmed baguette!

baked-brie-en-croute.title: Baked Brie en Croûte

baked-lemon-peper-chicken-wings.description:
Trader Joe’s Lemon Pepper Seasoning Blend is a straightforward blend of black pepper, lemon peel, sea salt, citric acid, garlic, onion, and lemon oil. It’s definitely Lemon Pepper forward, with just enough other elements added to heighten the flavors and really make them pop. Try it with roasted vegetables, easily elevate a humble bowl of popcorn, or as a rub for all kinds of meat and seafood. Lemon Pepper chicken wings, anyone? Game on! 

Pro-tip: To achieve the party wing aesthetic, our whole Wings can be separated into three pieces: the drumettes, flats, and tips. Use a sharp knife and carefully slice through the joint and skin to separate drumette (the section that looks like a mini drumstick) from the rest of the wing. If you wish to remove the tip from the flat (the center part of the wing), carefully slice through the joint where they meet at an angle.
ingredients: 2 packages TJ’s All Natural Chicken Wings, patted dry
2 tablespoons TJ’s Lemon Pepper Seasoning Blend, plus more for serving

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 425°F.

In a large bowl, add chicken wings, avocado oil, sea salt, baking powder, and lemon pepper seasoning. Toss to evenly coat. Place on a foil-lined baking sheet and bake for 45-55 minutes, until deep golden in color and the internal temperature reaches 165°F. Remove from oven and sprinkle with a bit more lemon pepper seasoning to serve.

baked-lemon-peper-chicken-wings.title: Baked Lemon Pepper Chicken Wings

balsamic-lentil-saute.description: Double the recipe and you can enjoy hearty grain bowls for lunch all week long.
ingredients: 1 pouch TJ's Frozen Organic Brown Rice, heated
2 large handfuls of TJ's Baby Spinach
2 tablespoon TJ's Sundried Tomatoes in Olive Oil
2 medium TJ's Garlic Cloves, peeled and diced
1 tablespoons TJ's Extra Virgin Olive Oil

steps.text: Add onions to a large skillet on medium heat then stir in olive oil and garlic. Add spinach and bell pepper and cook until spinach begins to wilt. Empty half the package of lentils into the mix and then add sundried tomatoes. Heat and stir another two minutes and then mix in the parsley and glaze. Divide brown rice onto individual plates and ladle sauté over each serving.

balsamic-lentil-saute.title: Balsamic Lentil Sauté

banana-cold-brew-smoothie.description: This recipe combines the creaminess and convenience of Trader Joe’s Banana & Almond Butter Protein Smoothie Beverage with the caffeinated kick of Cold Brew Concentrate. For an extra icy indulgence on a hot summer morning, freeze the Cold Brew Concentrate into ice cube molds the night before.
ingredients: 1 bottle TJ’s Banana & Almond Butter Protein Smoothie Beverage
5 to 6 ounces TJ’s Cold Brew Coffee Concentrate (do not dilute)
1 ripe TJ’s Banana, peeled and frozen
Handful TJ’s Dark Chocolate Covered Espresso Beans, crushed

steps.text: Add smoothie beverage, cold brew concentrate, and frozen banana to a blender.
Blend on low for 10 seconds, switch speed to high and blend 20 seconds more, until no chunks remain.
Pour into a glass, top with crushed chocolate covered espresso beans (if using) and enjoy.

banana-cold-brew-smoothie.title: Banana Cold Brew Smoothie

bared-bacon-cheddar-cornbread-cake.description: Bacon, Sharp Cheddar, and Cornbread – showcasing Uncured Apple Smoked Bacon, this savory cake makes a fine side for chili or BBQ pork chops. Stick a candle in it and make a cornbread-lover's birthday wish come true!
ingredients: 2 cups TJ’s Sharp Cheddar Cheese, shredded
1 pkg TJ’s Fully Cooked Uncured Applewood Smoked Bacon

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.

Use bottom of cake pan to measure/trace 2 circles on parchment paper; cut out the circles and set aside. Spray the inside of the cake pans with canola oil. Place parchment circles in the pan bottoms and spray over top with butter flavored oil. Set aside.
steps.title: Prepare 2 Cake Pans (8"x8"x2"):

steps.text: In a large mixing bowl, beat eggs, sunflower oil, and milk. Add cornbread mix and stir until moistened, being careful not to overmix. Fold in shredded Cheddar. Divide batter between prepared cake pans. Place on center rack of oven and bake. At 35 minutes, test centers with a toothpick; when toothpicks come out clean, remove cornbread to cool (in pans) for 10 minutes. After 10 minutes, run a knife around the inside of the pans, flip pans upside down and ease cornbread out onto a cooling rack to cool completely, about 40-50 minutes.
steps.title: Prepare & Bake Cakes:

steps.text: While cornbread is cooling, prepare bacon according to package stove top directions. Let rest on paper towels to cool completely. Once cooled, chop bacon into ½ inch pieces. Set aside.
steps.title: Prepare Bacon:

steps.text: Add mascarpone, crème fraiche and Dijon mustard to the mixer bowl. Using an electric mixer with whip attachment, start mixing on low setting; gradually increase speed to medium and whip to stiff peaks, about 2 minutes or less.
steps.title: Prepare Frosting:

steps.text: Place a dollop of frosting onto cake plate to anchor. Place 1 cornbread cake, top side down, on top and center on plate. Frost and sprinkle with 1/4 of chopped bacon. Top with second cornbread cake and lightly frost sides the entire cake. Frost cornbread top with what remains, and pile on remainder of bacon, as decoratively as you like!
steps.title: Assemble Cake:

bared-bacon-cheddar-cornbread-cake.title: Bared Bacon Cheddar Cornbread Cake

basic-breakfast-sandwich.description: You probably know how to assemble a sandwich-but you may not know that cooking bacon on a sheet pan eases sandwich assembly (and cleanup!), giving you time to focus on frying eggs like a pro.
ingredients: 1 package TJ's Sliced Aged Swiss Cheese
TJ's Gluten Free Whole Grain or Multigrain Bread (toasted or untoasted, your call!)
6-8 TJ's Large Eggs (1 egg per sandwich)

steps.text: Preheat oven to 375°F. Place a wire rack on top of a large rimmed baking sheet. Arrange bacon slices evenly on rack. Bake on center rack of oven for 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool 5 minutes.
Pre-assemble sandwiches: layer a handful of arugula, 2-3 slices bacon, 1 slice cheese, and tomato atop one slice of bread. Repeat for each sandwich.

Fry the eggs: melt 1 tablespoon butter in a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Crack 3-4 eggs into skillet and sprinkle with salt & pepper. Cook 1 minute, until whites are slightly opaque. Reduce heat to low, cover skillet with lid and cook 4-6 minutes more, to desired level of yolk doneness.

Using a spatula, carefully lift eggs out of skillet and slide onto prepared sandwich halves. Top with second slice of bread. Cook remaining eggs following steps above and assemble remaining sandwiches. Serve immediately.

basic-breakfast-sandwich.title: Basic Breakfast Sandwich

bbq-baked-beans.description: This BBQ buffet mainstay gets its signature smoky-sweet flavor from Trader Joe's Organic Brown Sugar BBQ Sauce & Marinade.
ingredients: 1 cup chopped your favorite TJ's Bacon
3 cloves TJ's Premium Peeled Garlic, chopped
1/2 cup TJ's Organic Brown Sugar BBQ Sauce & Marinade

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400ºF. Heat a large skillet over medium flame, add bacon and brown. Remove bacon and set aside. Pour off bacon fat; add onion to pan and sauté until translucent. Add garlic and stir for 1 minute longer.

Pour beans into a 9x13-inch casserole dish. Add bacon, onion, garlic, mustard, brown sugar and bbq sauce. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Place dish in oven and bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour, or until beans are bubbly, caramelized around the edges and slightly browned on top. Garnish with cilantro, chives or parsley. Enjoy!

bbq-baked-beans.title: BBQ Baked Beans

bbqd-onion-blossom.description: A member of the allium family (along with garlic, leeks, scallion, and chives), Trader Joe’s Yellow Onions are an essential supporting ingredient in an array of dishes—but in this grill-friendly recipe, they play a starring role! Not only does slathering the prepared onion blossom in TJ’s Garlic Spread Dip double down on the allium flavor, it also helps the umami-rich crust adhere to the “petals” before throwing it on the grill (or grill pan). It’s done when the softened “petals” easily pull apart from the blossom. Serve as an appetizer for an al fresco dinner party, or as an awesome snack for your next game night.
ingredients: 3 tablespoons TJ’s Garlic Spread Dip, plus more for dipping
2 teaspoons TJ’s Mushroom & Company Multipurpose Umami Seasoning Blend

steps.text: Cut the stem end of the onion off, then peel off the skin and discard.

Place onion cut side down, root side up, and make four equal cuts through the core, keeping the root intact, (north, south, east, west). Cut between each initial cut to make 8 intact “petals.” Repeat once more, cutting between each petal so you have 16 equal, intact onion petals.
Flip onion so the root is now at the bottom, allowing it to fan open. Use a grill brush to slather Garlic Dip Spread all over and within the onion.
In a small bowl, combine Nutritional Yeast and Umami Seasoning. In a medium-sized bowl, add onion, root side down, and sprinkle seasoning blend all oven the onion, until it is thoroughly coated.

Heat your grill or grill pan to medium heat. Place onion on grill and cover with a piece of aluminum foil for 10 minutes. Remove foil and cook an additional 5-10 minutes, or until onion becomes translucent and just begins to char at the tips (the tips are not likely to char with a grill pan. Remove from heat to serve.

bbqd-onion-blossom.title: BBQ'd Onion Blossom

beer-cheese-dip.description: The superb snack-ability of Trader Joe’s Soft Pretzel Stick cannot be denied. It has a pleasantly chewy, soft crumb with a classic dark-brown-pretzel exterior, and its bun shape makes it ideal for cutting into slices or cubes for dunking into an array of dips. Paired with your favorite Trader Joe’s mustard? Of course. Slathered with a swoop of soft butter? Definitely. Served alongside a bowl of warm beer cheese that’s ready in 10 minutes? You bet!
ingredients: 2 teaspoons TJ's Extra Virgin Olive Oil
4 cups TJ's Shredded Sharp Cheddar Cheese
1 block TJ's Cream Cheese, cut into cubes
TJ's Sea Salt & Black Pepper, to taste
2-3 TJ's Soft Pretzel Sticks, sliced or torn into pieces

steps.text: In a medium saucepan, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add shallots and cook until translucent, about 2-3 minutes. Add beer, garlic powder, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil.
Lower heat and add cream cheese, a few cubes at a time, whisking to incorporate. Slowly add shredded cheeses and whisk until melted.
Pour dip into serving bowl and top with chopped parsley. Serve with pretzel stick bread.

beer-cheese-dip.title: Beer Cheese Dip

berry-crazy-sundae.description: Made with super-sweet Thai strawberries enrobed in luscious dark chocolate, Trader Joe's Gone Berry Crazy Chocolate Covered Strawberry Slices capture the sweetness of summer in bite-size treat form. Ready to eat right out of the box (you don't even need to defrost them!), there's nothing standing between you and dessert. And if you somehow manage not  to eat the whole box on your way home from the store, we recommend using them to top a sundae with TJ's Super Premium French Vanilla Ice Cream and Belgian Butter Waffle Cookies.
ingredients: TJ's Super Premium French Vanilla Ice Cream
TJ's Gone Berry Crazy Chocolate Covered Strawberry Slices
TJ's Organic Midnight Moo Chocolate Flavored Syrup

steps.text: Scoop your desired amount of ice cream into a bowl. Top with chocolate covered strawberry slices, drizzle generously with midnight moo, and garnish with waffle cookies. Enjoy!

berry-crazy-sundae.title: Berry Crazy Sundae

berry-yogurt-pops.description: Beat the summer heat with this cool, crafty dessert.
ingredients: 1 large tub (32 oz) TJ's Honey Greek Yogurt (or four 8 oz tubs)
1 (12 oz) package TJ's Frozen Organic Blueberries
You will also need 10 wooden craft sticks and 10 small paper cups to use as molds

steps.text: Slice the tops off 15-20 strawberries and toss into a blender with 1/2 cup of yogurt and 6 mint leaves. Blend.

Distribute the "red"strawberry mixture into 10 paper cups about 1/3 of the way high. Place cups on a tray and pop in the freezer. If you want clean and distinct layers, it's best to wait another hour or so until you add the next layer. For faster prep, just leave the cups in the freezer to firm up a bit while you prepare the remaining ingredients.
Rinse your blender, then add half the bag of blueberries with 1/2 cup of yogurt. Blend. For more texture, stir in the other half of the bag of blueberries without blending.
Remove pops from the freezer and carefully spoon in the "white"second layer, the honey yogurt until each cup is about 2/3 full.
Lastly, pour the third "blue"layer, the blueberry mixture over the top of the plain honey yogurt, filling each cup almost to the top.
Cover each cup with foil and puncture with a popsicle stick down the center. Stick the pops in the freezer for about six hours. Peel the paper away and enjoy!

berry-yogurt-pops.title: Berry Yogurt Pops

biscuits-maple-turkey-gravy.description: This lighter take on biscuits in gravy calls for ground turkey in place of pork.
ingredients: 4 Fresh Sage leaves, chopped (plus more for garnish)

steps.text: Cook biscuits according to package directions. In a large skillet over medium-high heat, add ghee and melt to coat pan. Add ground turkey to pan, breaking it into pieces with a spoon as it cooks, about 8-10 minutes. When the turkey reaches 165ºF and is no longer pink, reduce heat to medium. Sprinkle half of the flour over the turkey and stir to combine. Add remaining flour and stir to combine. Add one cup of milk to the pan and stir. Continue to add milk as the gravy thickens, one cup at a time.

Add syrup and chopped sage to gravy and stir to combine. Cook gravy 5 minutes more, stirring occasionally. Season with salt and pepper to taste. To serve, place biscuits in a shallow bowl and top with gravy and chopped sage. Serve immediately.

biscuits-maple-turkey-gravy.title: Biscuits & Maple Turkey Gravy

black-bean-corn-cilantro-pasta-salad.description:
Soaking and cooking dry black beans is an hours-long process unbefitting busy weeknight cooking, but with Trader Joe’s Black Beans in your pantry, this cost-conscious legume goes from the can to your plate in minutes.

Aside from a just-right amount of salt, our Black Beans are unseasoned, giving you the ideal canvas for an array of dishes, like this crowd-pleasing pasta salad that can be served at room temperature or straight from the fridge.

Pro-Tip: Reserve a ½ cup of Trader Joe's Cilantro Salad Dressing to redress the salad if the pasta soaks up too much of the dressing while it sits.
ingredients: ½ cup diced TJ’s Red Onion
1 16-ounce bag TJ’s Farfalle Pasta, cooked according to package instructions, then rinse with cold water
2 cans TJ’s Black Beans, drained and rinsed
1 bag TJ’s Organic Super Sweet Cut Corn, thawed from frozen

steps.text: Combine diced onion and lime juice in a small bowl. Let sit 5-10 minutes while you prepare the salad.

To a large serving bowl, add pasta, black beans, corn, cotija, diced onions and lime juice, 1 cup of dressing, and toss everything together to combine. Season with salt to taste. Garnish with cilantro to serve. If serving cold, refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.

black-bean-corn-cilantro-pasta-salad.title: Black Bean, Corn, & Cilantro Pasta Salad

blarney-toast.description: Trader Joe's Blarney Scone is a super-dense, scone-shaped hunk of traditional Irish Soda Bread, made with real buttermilk and real butter and studded with raisins and caraway seeds throughout. It's sweet, but not too sweet, and tastes divine fried in a skillet and slathered with a bit of Kerrygold® Irish Butter and jam, or topped with slices of TJ's Corned Beef. Weighing in at nearly two pounds, it's a hefty hunk o' Scone, perfectly suitable for sharing.

steps.text: Using a large serrated knife, gently slice the scone into 6 thick slices; set aside. Pour enough sunflower oil to create a thin layer in the bottom of a skillet and heat over medium-high.

When oil is hot, add two scone slices to the pan and fry 30-40 seconds per side, until browned. Transfer to a plate and repeat with remaining slices, adding more oil as necessary to coat the bottom of the pan.
Generously slather scone slices with butter and marmalade, and enjoy immediately.

blarney-toast.title: Blarney Toast

blistered-tomato-spinach-feta-frittata.description:
Satisfying without being heavy, this customizable, feed-a-crowd frittata is a fantastic alternative to bread-based egg casseroles, and allows the flavors of the featured ingredients to truly shine. Making a twofold appearance (both as a filling and topping), Trader Joe’s Feta offers an intriguing counterpoint to the array of tender veggies and aromatic herbs baked into the eggy foundation. If you’re in search of a framework for a dependably delicious frittata, this is it! 

Pro-tip: This frittata can be prepared in advance and refrigerated until you’re ready to serve. If you don’t plan on serving the frittata right away, reserve the dressed tomatoes and herbs until you’re ready to serve. To reheat the frittata, preheat the oven to 350°F and bake for 10-15 minutes, until heated through.
ingredients: 3 tablespoons of your favorite TJ’s Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 ½ cup TJ’s Organic Sugar Plum Tomatoes, divided
A combined ¾ cup of chopped TJ’s Fresh Chives, Basil, Dill, & Parsley, divided
1 teaspoon TJ’s Sea Salt, plus more to taste
½ teaspoon TJ’s Ground Black Pepper
1 block TJ’s Feta Cheese, crumbled and divided

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Heat 2 tablespoons olive oil over high heat in a large skillet, until shimmering. Add the onion and garlic.  Stir occasionally, until the onions begin to soften, about 3-5 minutes.
Add 1 cup of the tomatoes. Toss until the tomatoes begin to blister and pop, about 5 minutes.

Add the spinach and cover pan with a lid.  The pan will be very full, but in a few minutes the spinach will cook down and wilt. Remove the lid and stir spinach every few minutes until most of the spinach is wilted, then remove from heat.
Add ½ cup of the herbs to the pan.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, sour cream, salt, and pepper, then fold in ½ of the feta cheese.
Grease a nine-inch casserole dish with ½ tablespoon of olive oil.
Add spinach mixture to casserole dish.
Pour the egg mixture over the spinach mixture, and stir gently with a spatula. Sprinkle the remaining feta cheese over the top.
Bake for about 20 minutes or until the frittata is set in the center.
Cut the remaining sugar plum tomatoes in half; drizzle with remaining ½ tablespoon olive oil and season with salt and pepper, then add the remaining ¼ cup of herbs.
Garnish the frittata with the dressed tomatoes & herbs to serve.

blistered-tomato-spinach-feta-frittata.title: Blistered Tomato, Spinach, & Feta Frittata

blood-orange-fennel-feta-salad.description:
Trader Joe's Balsamic Vinaigrette offers from-scratch flavor without the hassle that tends to accompany from-scratch preparation. Its subtle, sophisticated flavor pairs particularly well with bright TJ’s Blood Oranges, delicate TJ’s Fennel, and salty Crumbled Feta in this ready-in-under-10-minutes salad recipe.

Pro-tip: Blood Oranges are available from winter through spring. To enjoy this salad all year long, swap in your favorite TJ's Orange when Blood Oranges are unavailable.
ingredients: 2 TJ’s Blood Oranges, peeled and sliced into thin rounds
1 TJ’s Avocado, skin removed and sliced
1/2 cup TJ’s Roasted & Salted Pecan Halves, roughly chopped

steps.text: To a large, shallow serving platter, layer lettuce with blood orange slices, fennel, avocado, chopped pecans, and feta.
Drizzle the dressing atop to serve.

blood-orange-fennel-feta-salad.title: Blood Orange, Fennel, & Feta Salad

blue-cheese-stuffed-dates.description:
Known for their large size, chewy texture, and superlatively sweet flavor, Trader Joe's Medjool Dates are considered a premiere variety of the date family. While we appreciate Medjool Dates for all of those reasons, it’s their ability to shine across recipes both sweet & savory that makes them a holiday must-have. Here, the sweetness of the Dates pairs particularly well with the pleasant funk of a creamy blue cheese.

Don't forget to remove the Date pits before slicing and stuffing with cheese!
ingredients: 1 tablespoon of your favorite TJ’s Olive Oil
2 sprigs of TJ’s Sage, leaves removed
1 wedge TJ’s Cambozola Triple Cream Soft Ripened Cheese

steps.text: Add oil to a small skillet over medium heat. When oil is hot, carefully add sage leaves. When they no longer bubble in the oil, about 3 minutes, remove them from the oil using tongs or a fork. Place fried leaves on paper towel to drain of any excess oil.
Gently open each date and remove the pit. Stuff each crevice with a small slice of blue cheese. Arrange them on a plate, drizzle with Glaze, and top with fried sage leaves to serve.

blue-cheese-stuffed-dates.title: Blue Cheese-Stuffed Dates

blueberry-corn-cake.description:
Trader Joe’s Cornbread Mix bakes up to a cake-y, crumbly texture, with a sweet profile that’s amplified by the addition of corn kernels in the mix. It's equally excellent with a bowl of chili as it is alongside the rest of your Thanksgiving spread.

To easily send this cake into breakfast and snacking territory, simply add TJ's Frozen Organic Blueberries and generously slather with whipped honey butter or TJ's Butter with Brown Sugar & Maple Syrup. Mmmm!
ingredients: 1/2 cup TJ's Canola Oil, plus more for greasing pan, if using
3/4 cup TJ's Whole Milk Greek Yogurt
1 1/2 cups TJ's Frozen Organic Blueberries, divided
TJ's Butter with Brown Sugar & Maple Syrup, for serving

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease an 8-inch circular baking pan with canola oil or line with parchment paper; set aside.
In a large bowl, whisk Greek yogurt, oil, milk, and egg until smooth. Add cornbread mix and 1/2 cup blueberries and stir gently to combine; do not overmix.
Scrape cornbread batter into prepared baking pan, spreading batter evenly to sides of pan. Cover surface of batter with remaining blueberries.
Place baking pan on center rack of oven and bake 40-45 minutes, until cake is golden and edges pull away from sides of pan. Remove from oven and let cool 15 minutes before slicing.
Pro-tip: During the fall months, serve with a pat of TJ's Butter with Brown Sugar & Maple Syrup for an extra special treat!

blueberry-corn-cake.title: Blueberry Corn Cake

blueberry-lemon-hand-pies.description: Give a hand to Trader Joe's Pie Crusts for making this recipe possible!
ingredients: 2 rolls (1 box) TJ's Pie Crust, defrosted in fridge overnight
1 bag (1 1/2 cups) TJ's Frozen Wild Boreal Blueberries
1 tsp TJ's Unbleached All Purpose Flour, plus more for rolling dough
1 large TJ's Egg, beaten with 1 tsp Water
1/4 cup TJ's Turbinado Sugar (optional for sanding tops)
*You will also need a wide-mouthed jar or circular cookie cutter (3.5 in diameter = about 7 hand pies)

steps.text: Remove both pie crust rolls from refrigerator and soften to room temperature. Pour bag of frozen blueberries in a strainer and rinse with water to defrost. Set aside.

Once dough is softened, working in two batches, unroll and smooth together any cracks with your hands over the top of the plastic film of the dough. Remove plastic film and place dough onto a floured surface. Cut out 7 circles from one roll and 7 circles from the other (it could be more or less depending on the size of your cookie cutter, just make sure you end up with an even number). Place all dough circles onto two baking trays lined with parchment paper and place back in refrigerator to chill.
In a medium bowl, combine strained blueberries, lemon zest, lemon curd and flour. Stir and set aside. Prepare egg wash by whisking egg with water in a small bowl. Set aside.

Remove dough from refrigerator and place a spoonful of the lemon-blueberry mix onto 7 of the dough circles, making sure not to overfill or touch the edges of the dough. Brush egg wash around the perimeter of each filled dough circle. Place the remaining 7 dough circles on top of the mounds, then crimp the edges of the dough with a fork to seal each pie. Place prepared pies back in refrigerator to chill another 10 minutes before baking.

Preheat oven to 375°F. Remove pies from refrigerator and brush tops generously with egg wash. With a sharp knife, cut a slit or a small design on the top of each pie to help steam release while baking. Sprinkle turbinado sugar over the top of each pie, if using. Bake pies on center rack of oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the blueberry juices start bubbling and the pastry is golden brown. For even baking, rotate sheet halfway though. Transfer to a cooling rack and serve warm.

blueberry-lemon-hand-pies.title: Blueberry-Lemon Hand Pies

blueberry-oat-smoothie.description: If you’re looking to start your day sans dairy, look no further than Trader Joe’s Non-Dairy Oat Beverage! It’s smooth, thick, and slightly sweet, making it a spectacular addition to coffee, cereal, or an oatally refreshing smoothie made with frozen blueberries, fresh spinach, and raw cashews.
ingredients: ¼ cup TJ’s Raw Whole Cashews
1 teaspoon TJ’s Organic Blue Agave Syrup

steps.text: Add all ingredients to a blender. Cover and blend on high until thoroughly combined. Pour into two glasses and enjoy!

blueberry-oat-smoothie.title: Blueberry Oat Smoothie

blueberry-protein-pancakes.description:
Made with simple, hearty ingredients like whole wheat flour, whole grain oat flour, whey protein concentrate, and buttermilk powder, Trader Joe's Buttermilk Protein Pancake Mix isn't just good for a purposefully protein-y product; it's good, period. It's also a cinch to prepare-no muscle required. Just combine equal parts Mix and water, and you're on your way to fluffy, satisfying Pancakes that are packed with Protein (ten grams per two-pancake serving) but free from that dreaded chalky, protein powder-y aftertaste.     

Further the bolster batter with your favorite fruit for a filling, no sugar added breakfast-we especially like Trader Joe's Organic Wild Blueberries here.
ingredients: 2 cups TJ's Buttermilk Protein Pancake Mix
1 bag TJ's Organic Wild Blueberries, thawed and divided

steps.text: Add pancake mix and water to a medium bowl. Whisk just until combined. Gently fold in half of the blueberries. Let batter sit 10 minutes prior to cooking.
Add remaining blueberries to a microwave safe bowl. Microwave on 30 second intervals, stirring in between, until hot. Set aside.

Preheat a greased skillet or griddle over medium. Pour approximately 1/4 cup batter per pancake. Cook 2 to 3 minutes per side, flipping when pancake edges are dry. Repeat until all batter is used. Serve hot pancakes immediately, with warmed berries on top.

blueberry-protein-pancakes.title: Blueberry Protein Pancakes

braised-chicken.description: This family style, braised chicken recipe is perfect for blustery days and chilly nights.
ingredients: 1 TJ's Six Piece Organic Chicken Family Pack
2 tablespoons TJ's Spanish Extra Virgin Olive Oil
2 large TJ's Sweet White Onions, roughly sliced (about 4 cups)
1 jar TJ's Spanish Manzanilla Olives with Pemento Paste
2 tablespoons Baker Joseph's All Purpose White Flour
1/2 bag TJ's Jasmine White Rice, cooked

steps.text: Rinse and thoroughly pat dry the chicken parts. Sprinkle them liberally with salt and fresh ground pepper. In a large sauté pan, over medium-high flame, combine butter and olive oil and heat until butter has melted. Brown the chicken in two separate batches. Remove chicken from the pan. Lower flame to medium and add sliced onion and ginger. Saute for 8 minutes, stirring frequently. Chop 20 olives and add to the onion and ginger mixture. Saute for 1 minute. Add flour, cumin, cayenne pepper and cinnamon and cook for another minute, stirring constantly. Add the chicken broth, lemon juice and dates, scraping the pan to loosen browned bits. Bring to a slow boil and return the browned chicken to the pan. Cover and reduce heat to a simmer. Continue cooking for another 45 minutes and serve over prepared rice.

braised-chicken.title: Braised Chicken

branzino-al-cartoccio.description: European Sea Bass (another name for Branzino) is a white fish that is characteristically light, flaky, and sweet. Its mild flavor makes it the ideal backdrop for this Mediterranean-inspired main dish, allowing the tender couscous, tangy tomatoes, and briny olives to truly shine. Roasting Trader Joe's Branzino Fillets al cartoccio (in a paper wrapper) ensures a moist, tender result every time, and thawing the fish while you prep the other ingredients means there’s no need to remember to thaw overnight. If you like things on the hotter side, finish with a dollop of TJ's Bomba or Harissa.
ingredients: 3 tablespoons plus 1 teaspoon TJ’s Extra Virgin Olive Oil, divided
1 package (10 oz.) TJ’s Organic Cherry Tomatoes, halved
3 TJ’s Green Onions, thinly sliced (white & light green parts only)
10 TJ’s Organic Kalamata Olives, roughly chopped
2 tablespoons juice from a TJ’s Lemon (reserve 4 lemon wedges for serving)
You will also need 4 pieces of parchment paper (12” by 18”) and 2 baking sheets

steps.text: Thaw the Branzino: (If you’ve already thawed your fish, skip to the next step.) Remove fish from packaging and place in a non-porous bag and seal. Place in a bowl of cold water for 30 minutes. Set aside.

Prepare the couscous: Bring 1 ¾ cups water to a boil in a small saucepan. In a 2-quart saucepan with lid, sauté couscous with 1 tablespoon olive oil over medium heat until couscous is slightly browned, about 5 minutes. Slowly add the boiling water to couscous and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low and cover. Simmer 12 minutes or until liquid is absorbed. Remove from heat and set aside.
Prepare the vegetables: Add cooked couscous, 1 tablespoon olive oil, tomatoes, green onions, kalamata olives, and lemon juice to a large bowl and gently combine. Set aside.

Build the parchment packets: Arrange oven racks in thirds and preheat oven to 400F.

Remove thawed fish from bag. Place thawed fish on a clean work surface and pat dry. Season with salt & pepper.

Fold each piece of parchment in half crosswise. Spoon one-quarter of couscous mixture onto one side of each piece of parchment. Top each with a branzino fillet, skin-side up. Drizzle each fillet with 1 teaspoon of olive oil and top with a sprig of thyme.

Starting at the short side of the parchment, tightly roll and pinch the edges with your fingers until you’ve created a sealed, half-moon-shaped packet. Carefully transfer 2 packets to each baking sheet.

Roast & serve: Place the baking sheets on the upper and lower oven racks. Roast 15 minutes, rotating sheets halfway through. Remove from oven, leaving parchment packets intact.

Serve parchment packets on plates with lemon wedges alongside. Allow guests to tear open their packets and add a squeeze of lemon before they dig in.

branzino-al-cartoccio.title: Branzino Al Cartoccio

breaded-bbq-chicken-sandwich.description:
Trader Joe’s Breaded Chicken Tenderloin Breasts might just be the ultimate TJ's dinner hack. These fully cooked Tenderloins take just 25 minutes in the oven to deliver that quintessential crunch you crave from Breaded Chicken, minus the time-consuming breading and frying stations. Keep a bag of these in your freezer and you are well on your way to myriad magnificent meals, like Chicken and Waffles, Chicken Parmesan, and this BBQ Chicken Sandwich. 

Pro-tip: TJ’s Sour Cream & Onion Flavored Rings Lentil & Rice Snacks – like a marvelous meetup of umami-rich onion rings and crunchy snack chips – make outstanding sandwich toppers here! They're in our snack section.
ingredients: 1 package TJ’s Breaded Chicken Tenderloin Breasts
TJ’s Organic Kansas City Style BBQ Sauce
TJ’s Sour Cream Onion Flavored Rings Lentil & Rice Snacks

steps.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Arrange chicken in a single layer on a foil-lined baking sheet. Bake for 25 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 165°F.
On a separate baking sheet, arrange buns cut-side up in a single layer. Toast in oven for 5 minutes, or until lightly golden.

To assemble, spoon some BBQ sauce on the bottom bun, add a handful of cole slaw, and top with a few pickles. Add a piece of chicken and top with more BBQ sauce. Finish with a few crunchy Sour Cream Onion Flavored Rings and the top bun to serve.

breaded-bbq-chicken-sandwich.title: Breaded BBQ Chicken Sandwich

breakfast-tacos.description:
Whether or not you're a meat eater has nothing to do with whether you'll enjoy the spiciness of Trader Joe's Soy Chorizo. Carnivores and herbivores alike sing the praises of this meatless wonder-one bite, and it's easy to see why.   

This soy protein-based -izo iteration delivers complexly kicking spices! Once you remove it from its plastic casing (please, please do not eat the plastic; it's inedible!), you have an entire world of dishes at your fingertips. Burritos, rice, chili, potato hash, chile con queso, or this big-enough-to-feed-a-crowd recipe for breakfast tacos...
ingredients: 1 bag TJ's Roasted Potatoes with Peppers & Onions
1 package TJ's Soy Chorizo, removed from casing
2 packages TJ's Corn & Wheat Tortillas, or your favorite TJ's tortillas
TJ's Mild or Hot Pico de Gallo Salsa

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F. Spread potatoes, peppers & onions on a very large (or 2 medium-sized) rimmed baking sheet. Place sheet on center rack of oven and bake 20-25 minutes, until potatoes are crisp and golden. Remove from oven and transfer to a serving dish.

While potatoes roast, prepare soy chorizo: Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add soy chorizo and sauté 5-8 minutes, until slightly browned and temperature reaches 165°F. Transfer to a serving bowl and cover to keep warm (wipe skillet with a paper towel; you'll use it to scramble the eggs).
If desired, warm tortillas in a clean, dry skillet (or use tongs if warming directly over the burner); cover and keep warm for serving.

In a large bowl, beat eggs and season with salt and pepper. Melt remaining oil in skillet over medium-high heat. Pour egg mixture into center of pan and stir slowly. When curds start to form, reduce heat to low and gently fold eggs over. Cook 2-3 minutes more, then transfer eggs to a plate and let rest 1 minute to finish cooking.

Assembly: Fill a tortilla with soy chorizo, roasted potatoes, and scrambled eggs. Garnish with cheese, salsa, and avocado. Alternatively, lay the ingredients out buffet-style, and let your guests be the captains of their own breakfast taco ships. Enjoy!

breakfast-tacos.title: Breakfast Tacos

brie-lieve-it-or-not.description: Few culinary combos have the power to create crowds at a buffet like crunchy chips and hot cheese dip...

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F. Unwrap brie and place in the center of a small baking dish (there should be room for the cheese to spread and fill the dish as it melts). Place on center rack of oven and bake 10-15 minutes or until gently bubbling (watch closely after the 10 minute mark to avoid burned cheese!). Remove from oven and let cool 5 minutes. If desired, stir in a spoonful of pumpkin butter, then grab some Pumpkin Tortilla Chips and dig in!

brie-lieve-it-or-not.title: Brie-lieve it or not

brooklyn-babka-ice-cream-pie.description:
It’s no secret that our Crew is comprised of some of the most culinarily creative folks around, so we challenged our stores across the country to a Recipe Contest, inviting them to create a delicious recipe, using no more than five Trader Joe’s ingredients.

This winning recipe comes from Store #209 in Woodland Hills, CA! Our judges were positively WOW-ed by this decadent dessert and we think you will be, too!
ingredients: 1 TJ’s Chocolate Brooklyn Babka, chopped into bite-sized pieces
1 tablespoon TJ’s Organic Powdered Cane Sugar
1/2 bag TJ’s Double Chocolate Wafer Cookies, crushed, plus a few whole cookies to garnish

steps.text: Remove ice cream from freezer and allow to soften while you prepare the crust.
Add speculoos cookies to a resealable bag and finely crush with a rolling pin. Combine crushed cookies with melted butter, then form into a crust in a 9-inch pie pan. Freeze for 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine softened ice cream and babka pieces. Spoon into pie crust and smooth the surface. Freeze pie while you prepare the toppings.

Whisk cream in a chilled glass or metal bowl with an electric mixer until frothy. Add powdered sugar and continue to beat until soft peaks form, about 4-5 minutes. Add whipped cream to a piping bag or resealable bag with a cut at the bottom corner. Sprinkle crushed chocolate wafer cookies over the surface of the pie, then pipe the whipped cream, as you'd like, and top with whole wafer cookies.
Return pie to the freezer for at least two hours, then remove 10 minutes before serving.

brooklyn-babka-ice-cream-pie.title: Brooklyn Babka Ice Cream Pie

brunchfast-burritos.description:
You can put almost anything in a breakfast burrito (or brunchfast burrito, if you're not feeling bright-eyed and bushy-tailed until late morning), but two ingredients are absolute musts: eggs and tortillas. You scramble your eggs, you wrap them in a tortilla, and if you’re not feeling very adventurous, you could be done. 

We tend toward the adventurous, so we suggest all kinds of inclusions; importantly, we suggest you always include Trader Joe's Hashbrowns and Uncured Fully Cooked Bacon for savory crunch. (Trust us here.)
ingredients: 1 package TJ's Dry Rubbed Bacon OR Uncured Fully Cooked Bacon
Your favorite TJ's Hot Sauce, Salsa, or Sriracha

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F. Arrange oven racks in upper and lower thirds of oven. Place a wire rack on a large rimmed baking sheet. Arrange hash browns on rack and bake on upper rack of oven for 10 minutes.

If using dry dubbed bacon: While hash browns are baking, line a second baking sheet with parchment paper and place a wire rack on the baking sheet. Arrange bacon evenly on wire rack. Place sheet on lower rack of oven. Bake hash browns and bacon 20 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool slightly.
If using fully cooked bacon: microwave bacon according to package directions; set aside.

In a large bowl, thoroughly whisk eggs and milk, set aside. Melt butter in a large nonstick skillet over high heat. Pour egg mixture into center of pan and stir slowly. When curds start to form, reduce heat to low and gently fold eggs over. Cook 2-3 minutes more, then transfer eggs to a plate and let rest 1 minute to finish cooking.

Assemble burritos: Lay tortilla on a flat work surface. Place 1/6th of scrambled eggs in the center of the tortilla. Layer a hash brown and 2 slices of bacon atop eggs. Top with 1/4 cup shredded cheese, sliced avocado, and a drizzle of hot sauce. Pull half of the tortilla closest to you up to meet the top half, then pull the tortilla and fillings back toward you. Fold in the left and right sides of the tortilla, then roll tightly until closed. Repeat burrito assembly with remaining ingredients. Enjoy!

brunchfast-burritos.title: Brunchfast Burritos

buffalo-chicken-nachos.description: Trader Joe’s Spicy Buffalo Cheddar combines the savory splendor and majestic meltability of a classic Cheddar with the satisfying spice of Buffalo wing sauce. Melt a slice on a burger, shred over a baked potato, or follow the recipe below to add a flavorful kick of heat to nachos!
ingredients: 1 bag TJ’s Truly Tortilla Chips White Corn
1 block TJ’s Spicy Buffalo Cheddar, grated
2 cups TJ’s Grilled Chicken Strips, cut into cubes
½ cup TJ’s Hot & Sweet Jalapeños, drained
½ TJ’s Red Onion, thinly sliced
½ cup TJ’s Cotija Cheese, crumbled
A handful of TJ’s Cilantro leaves, to garnish

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F. To a medium-sized baking sheet or dish, add an even layer of chips, followed by a layer of Spicy Buffalo Cheddar. Next, add chicken and top with, jalapeños, onion cotija, and one more layer of Buffalo Cheddar. Top with another layer of chips and repeat the layers.
Bake in oven for 10-12 minutes, until cheese is melted and begins to brown. Sprinkle with cilantro and dig in!

buffalo-chicken-nachos.title: Buffalo Chicken Nachos

buffalo-chicken-pasta-salad.description: Trader Joe’s Buffalo Style Chicken Dip is bringing the heat to your next picnic or barbecue. With the help of starchy pasta water, the dip transforms into a luscious, piquant pasta sauce, and we’ve added diced celery, a complementary companion to buffalo’s spice, for cooling crunch whether it’s served room temperature or chilled. Pro-tip: reserve extra pasta water if you intend to refrigerate the pasta salad ahead of time, as the sauce will thicken as it cools.
ingredients: 1 pound TJ’s Farfalle, cooked according to the package instructions; reserve ½ cup pasta water
1 container TJ’s Buffalo Style Chicken Dip
1 cup diced TJ’s Celery, plus leaves for garnish

steps.text: Strain the cooked pasta and run under cold water for a few seconds to cool the noodles down. Strain well.
Add strained noodles to a large bowl.

Using a spatula, fold buffalo dip into the pasta, slowly adding pasta water, a few tablespoons at a time, until the dip becomes a smooth and creamy sauce that evenly coats the noodles. (You may not need to use all the pasta water to achieve the desired consistency.)
Add the celery to the bowl and toss to combine.
Add celery leaves as garnish and serve.

buffalo-chicken-pasta-salad.title: Buffalo Chicken Pasta Salad

bulgogi-beef-fried-rice.description: With minimal prep (just a combined five minutes in the microwave or a few minutes in a hot skillet will do the trick), our Korean-inspired Bulgogi Beef Fried Rice becomes a delightfully savory side dish or basis for a wide variety of rice bowls. Here we've paired it with scrambled eggs and a spoonful of Trader Joe's Crunchy Chili Onion for a no-fuss fried rice recipe.
ingredients: 1 bag TJ's Korean Inspired Bulgogi Beef Fried Rice with Kimchi
TJ's Green Onions (green parts only) thinly sliced

steps.text: Heat a skillet over medium high heat. Add fried rice and sauté 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Add beaten eggs and continue sauteing and stirring, a few minutes more, until egg is scrambled and cooked through.
Divide fried rice among two bowls. Top with green onions and a dollop of chili onion crunch, and enjoy.

bulgogi-beef-fried-rice.title: Bulgogi Beef Fried Rice

bulgogi-lettuce-cups.description:
