The result of cross-breeding between romaine and butter varietals, Little Gem has all the crisp, satisfying bite of romaine, with all the tenderness and mild, sweet flavor of butter lettuce. This best-of- both-worlds combo makes it a real rarity among leafy greens—a hidden Gem, if you will—and opens it up to a remarkably wide range of uses in the kitchen. 

Trader Joe's Little Gem Lettuce makes a tip-top burger topping. As a salad, its toothsome texture and delicate flavor interacts wonderfully with all kinds of dressings. The leaves are also hearty enough to act as lettuce cups for various proteins and fillings, like TJ’s Beef Bulgogi.
ingredients: ½ package TJ’s Frozen Beef Bulgogi, heated according to package instructions, reserve 1 tablespoon of juices after heating
1 head TJ’s Little Gem Lettuce, cored, leaves washed and dried
1 bag TJ’s Frozen Jasmine Rice, heated according to package instructions

steps.text: To make the gochujang sauce, combine gochujang and reserved bulgogi liquid in a small bowl, and whisk to combine. Set aside.
To each lettuce “cup,” add a spoonful of cooked rice, top with a few pieces of cooked bulgogi, kimchi, and drizzle with gochujang sauce. Repeat with remaining lettuce leaves.

bulgogi-lettuce-cups.title: Bulgogi Lettuce Cups

butter-toffee-pretzel-bark.description: Combining the sweetness of sugary toffee with the saltiness of oh-so-snackable mini-pretzels (and elevating them to the power of their combined crunchiness), Trader Joe's Butter Toffee Pretzels are the star of the show in this recipe for chocolate marshmallow bark. Make a batch for the neighbors and one for yourself-you'll be happy you did.
ingredients: 1 bar TJ's Pound Plus Milk Chocolate, broken into chunks
1 1/2 cups TJ's Butter Toffee Pretzels (seasonal), divided

steps.text: Line a quarter-sheet rimmed baking pan with parchment paper. Spread 1 cup pretzels and 1 cup marshmallows in an even layer in pan, set aside.

Fill a sauce pot half-full with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to allow the water to simmer. Rest a large stainless bowl over the top of the pan, making sure that the bottom of the bowl does not touch the water. Add chocolate to the top bowl and stir occasionally as chocolate melts, until it becomes smooth. Turn off heat.

Pour melted chocolate over lined pan, using a spatula to smooth it evenly across pretzels and marshmallows. Top melted chocolate with remaining pretzels and marshmallows. Refrigerate for 2 hours or until firm. Remove from refrigerator and let sit 15 minutes before slicing.

butter-toffee-pretzel-bark.title: Butter Toffee Pretzel Bark

buttermilk-drumsticks.description: Trader Joe's Buttermilk helps tenderize chicken without adding toughness, keeping these drumsticks moist as they cook.
ingredients: 2 Tbsp TJ's Extra Virgin Olive Oil

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in a resealable bag. Place in refrigerator to marinate for at least 4 hours (preferably overnight). Remove chicken and excess marinade and let drumsticks come to room temperature. Grill drumsticks on medium-high heat for about 30 minutes, flipping every 5 minutes until juices run clear or until internal temperature reaches 165. Let rest 10 minutes before serving. Enjoy! Serving suggestion: Serve with TJ's Green Beans and Buttermilk Biscuits.

buttermilk-drumsticks.title: Buttermilk Drumsticks

butternut-squash-hummus.description: Trader Joe's Organic Tahini adds loads of savory flavor to this fall-inspired hummus.
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon Paprika, plus more for garnish
1/4 cup Trader Joe's Avocado Oil, plus more for garnish
Your favorite chips or veggies for dipping (we like Organic Blue Corn Tortilla Chips)

steps.text: Add all ingredients, except avocado oil, to food processor or blender. Turn on food processor/ blender and slowly drizzle oil into the mixture, about 30-45 seconds.

Once the oil has been added, turn off the machine and scrape down sides of bowl. Blend for another 30 seconds to 1 minute. Spoon into serving dish. using spoon to create a well in the center of hummus.
Garnish with olive oil and paprika. Serve with chips or veggies for dipping, or dig in with a spoon!

butternut-squash-hummus.title: Butternut Squash Hummus

buttery-baked-cod.description: Caught in the wild using longline fishing to help minimize bycatch, Trader Joe’s Wild Caught Cod Fillets arrive in the package boneless and skinless for ease of cooking. Firm yet remarkably flaky, with a mild, delicately sweet flavor profile, this veritably versatile fish is equally delicious whether it’s baked, blackened, steamed, or sautéed. This sublimely simple Baked Cod recipe delivers an impressive, comforting result in under 30 minutes.
ingredients: 1 package TJ’s Wild Caught Cod Fillets, about 1 to 1 ½ pounds
8 tablespoons TJ’s Unsalted Butter, melted and divided
1 sleeve TJ’s Golden Rounds Crackers, crushed
1 ½ tablespoons TJ’s Aglio Olio Garlicky & Spicy Seasoning Blend

steps.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.

Remove cod from package, pat dry, then lay each fillet flat in a small baking or casserole dish. Season lightly with salt, then drizzle 2 tablespoons butter on top. Flip fillets once to coat completely.
In a medium bowl, add crushed crackers, aglio olio seasoning, and remaining 6 tablespoons of butter, and stir to evenly combine.
Mound the cracker mixture evenly atop the fillets. Bake until the fish reach an internal temperature of 145°F, about 8-15 minutes, depending on the thickness of the fillets.
Serve with lemon wedges.

buttery-baked-cod.title: Buttery Baked Cod

cacio-e-pepe-orzotto.description: Trader Joe’s Orzo is a unique pasta that’s made with traditional pasta ingredients, like durum wheat semolina, but shaped like rice. It’s often cooked in boiling water and used as a base for pasta salads, soups, and stuffed peppers. Or you can skip the water altogether and cook it in TJ’s Cacio e Pepe Sauce in this cozy, fall-inspired riff on a risotto, where the orzo makes a spectacular, time-saving stand-in for traditional Arborio rice.
ingredients: 1 carton (4 cups) TJ’s Organic Hearty Vegetable Broth
1 package (20 ounces) TJ’s Cut Butternut Squash
1 jar TJ’s Cacio e Pepe Pasta Sauce
2 tablespoons TJ’s Organic Raw Apple Cider Vinegar

steps.text: Add broth to a medium pot and bring to a boil over medium heat. Remove from heat and set aside. Alternatively, pour broth into a microwave safe-cup and heat for 2-3 minutes.
In a large sauté pan or Dutch oven over medium-high heat, add 2 tablespoons butter over medium heat. Once melted, add orzo and toast until golden, 2-3 minutes.

Slowly and carefully pour hot broth into Dutch oven. Then add cut butternut squash, cacio e pepe sauce, and stir to combine. Bring to a boil, then lower temperature to low and simmer for 15 minutes, until the orzo and butternut squash become tender, stirring occasionally.
When most of the liquid has been absorbed by the orzo, remove from heat, and add the apple cider vinegar before serving.

cacio-e-pepe-orzotto.title: Cacio e Pepe Orzotto

caesar-pasta-salad.description: Trader Joe’s Shredded Parmesan Cheese is made with raw cow’s milk and aged for a minimum of 10 months. It’s savory and tart, with a discrete umami tang. And because it’s pre-Shredded, it’s especially convenient for sprinkling over an array of dishes like this Caesar Pasta Salad. It’s simply superb for a picnic at the park, a BBQ in the backyard, or a day out at the beach!
ingredients: ½ bag (8 ounces) TJ’s Penne Rigate, cooked according to package instructions, rinsed with cold water and set aside to cool
1 TJ’s Organic Romaine Heart, chopped, core discarded
½ - 1 bag TJ’s Rosemary Croissant Croutons
½ cup - 1 cup TJ’s Vegan Caesar Dressing
TJ’s Sea Salt & TJ's Black Peppercorns, to taste

steps.text: In a large serving bowl, add pasta, kale, romaine, croutons, Parmesan, and ½ cup of dressing, and toss to combine. Add more dressing, if desired, and season with salt and pepper to serve.

caesar-pasta-salad.title: Caesar Pasta Salad

calabrian-chili-double-cheese-pizza.description: The Calabrian chili hot sauce emulsified in the classic tomato base of Trader Joe’s Calabrian Chili Spicy Pasta Sauce makes for a seriously savory, pleasantly spicy slice when slathered over a Trader Joe’s Pizza Crust. Choose whatever toppings tickle your fancy, but we recommend two types of cheese: Sliced Provolone Cheese melts magnificently and Whole Milk Ricotta Cheese adds creaminess and a subtle sweetness. This duo makes for a dynamic and extremely enjoyable eating experience.
ingredients: 2 TJ’s Sweet Italian Pork Sausages, casings removed
½ cup TJ’s Calabrian Chili Spicy Pasta Sauce
½ cup TJ’s Whole Milk Ricotta Cheese

steps.text: Preheat oven to 425° F.
In a medium-sized, nonstick frying pan over medium high heat, crumble sausage and fry until cooked through.
Place crust on a large sheet pan. Spread pasta sauce over the crust, leaving a half-inch border unsauced. Add provolone, top with cooked sausage, followed by dollops of ricotta evenly distributed.
Bake for 12 minutes or until provolone is melted and begins to brown. For a crisper crust, bake directly on oven rack. Carefully remove from oven, let cool slightly then slice.

calabrian-chili-double-cheese-pizza.title: Calabrian Chili & Double-Cheese Pizza

caprese-blt.description:
Beautiful, lip-smacking, tantalizing. Brilliant, luscious, toothsome. Bacon, lettuce, tomato!

However you translate the acronym, this recipe mash-up of a favorite summer salad and a lunchtime diner classic is equal parts refreshing and filling, thanks to aromatic basil, tangy balsamic glaze, and savory, crunchy bacon. Cool, creamy Trader Joe's Pre-Sliced Fresh Mozzarella Log gets a starring role in the center of the sandwich, proving once and for all that a caprese doesn't have to be limited to a salad plate.
ingredients: 1 package TJ's Dry Rubbed Bacon OR TJ's Uncured Fully Cooked Bacon
8 slices of your favorite TJ's Bread
1 package TJ's Fresh Pre-Sliced Mozzarella Cheese Log
TJ's Fresh Basil, rinsed and dried

steps.text: If using fully cooked bacon, microwave bacon according to package directions, and skip down to toasting bread.

If using dry rubbed bacon, preheat oven to 400°F. Place a wire rack on a large rimmed baking sheet. Arrange bacon evenly on wire rack. Place sheet on center rack of oven and bake 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool slightly. Tear bacon pieces in half, set aside.

Toast 8 slices of bread to desired doneness. Layer basil and baby lettuce on toasted bread, followed by bacon, mozzarella, and tomato. Drizzle with glaze and top with another piece of toasted bread. Repeat steps to build 3 more sandwiches. Enjoy immediately!

caprese-blt.title: Caprese BLT

caramel-apple-nachos.description: While we love the choose-your-own-adventure nature of savory nachos, we’ve given this classic snack a sweet makeover in this recipe and dressed it for dessert. Crisp, sliced apples and gooey caramel sauce stand in for the crunchy chips and melty cheese, while garnishes of crushed Trader Joe’s Graham Crackers and chopped peanuts provide the perfect balance of sweet and salty flavors in every bite.
ingredients: 2 TJ’s Granny Smith Apples, thinly sliced
3 generous spoonfuls of TJ’s Fleur de Sel Caramel Sauce
1/3 cup TJ’s Roasted & Unsalted Peanuts, chopped
TJ’s Organic Ground Cinnamon, for dusting

steps.text: Arrange apple slices on a serving dish, in a circular formation, with the slices slightly overlapping.
Drizzle caramel over the apples.
Garnish with crushed graham crackers and peanuts on top. Dust with cinnamon and serve.

caramel-apple-nachos.title: Caramel Apple Nachos

caramelized-onion-double-smash-burgers.description:
As the name suggests, a smash burger is a thin burger patty that's been smashed with a spatula during the cooking process. The edges become crispy while the middle remains satisfyingly succulent, thanks to the 80/20 lean-to-fat ratio of Trader Joe’s Ground Beef Patties. Each package comes with four portioned Patties, so you can make four burgers… or you can double down on that smash-burger goodness as we’ve suggested below. 

Pro-tip: For smash-burger success, ensure your cook surface is non-stick or seasoned so the burgers don’t stick when it’s time to flip. To prevent sticking to the spatula, lightly oil the bottom before you smash!
ingredients: 3 tablespoons, plus 1/2 teaspoon TJ’s Avocado Oil, divided
4 TJ’s Ground Beef Patties 80% Lean/20% Fat

steps.text: Add 3 tablespoons of oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat. Add onion, then cover with lid, and cook for 10-15 minute, stirring occasionally, until the onions become golden in color. Remove from heat and season with 1/2 teaspoon of salt and pepper. Set aside.
steps.title: Prepare the Caramelized Onions

steps.text: Return pan to medium-high heat and place buns, cut-side down in the pan. Toast for 2-3 minutes, until golden. Remove from pan.
steps.title: Toast Buns

steps.text:
Season each patty with salt and pepper. Heat a large non-stick skillet or flattop grill pan over high heat. While the pan is heating, brush the bottom-side of a spatula with reserved oil. Add 2 burger patties to hot pan, then use the oiled spatula to smash each patty until the edges are thin, but still intact with the rest of the patty. Cook for 2-3 minutes until underside becomes crispy. Flip each patty and cook for another 2-3 minutes until cooked through.

Repeat with remaining patties. Before removing these patties from the pan, add a slice of cheese on top. Let sit for 1 minute to melt.
steps.title: Cook Burgers

steps.text: Add ketchup to the bottom bun. Top with a patty, add a spoonful of caramelized onion, top with a second patty, then top another spoonful of caramelized onion, then add the top bun. Repeat with second burger.
steps.title: Assemble

caramelized-onion-double-smash-burgers.title: Caramelized Onion Double Smash Burgers

carne-asada-ensalada.description:
Then this hearty salad is exceptionally well seasoned, offering a contrast of textures, temperatures, and flavors in every bite. And thanks to timesaving Trader Joe’s products like marinated, quick-cooking TJ’s Carne Asada Ranchera, frozen TJ’s Roasted Corn, and herbaceous and creamy, ready-to-pour Trader Joe’s Cilantro Dressing, this recipe comes together in under an hour. 

Pro-tip: Instead of serving in one large bowl, divide the ingredients into smaller, lidded containers for meal-prepped lunches! Pack the Cilantro Dressing in a separate container and dress just before serving.
ingredients: 1 bag TJ’s Roasted Corn, prepared according to package instructions
1 cup halved TJ’s Mini Grape Tomatoes
¼ TJ’s Red Onion, thinly sliced
½ to ⅔ cup TJ’s Cilantro Dressing

steps.text: Heat grill or grill pan over medium-high heat. Add carne asada and cook until the meat temperature reaches your preferred doneness. Remove from heat.

To a large bowl, add the lettuce, then top with sliced carne asada, roasted corn,  tomatoes, red onion, cotija, and avocado. Season with salt and a big squeeze of lime juice. Drizzle with cilantro dressing to serve.

carne-asada-ensalada.title: Carne Asada Ensalada

carnitas-bowl.description: With a recipe that's more than 50% jalapeños, Trader Joe's Jalapeño Sauce is hot without being overwhelmingly spicy, and smooth and creamy without any dairy (in fact, it's vegan!). Drizzle it over eggs for breakfast. Employ it as a replacement for traditional enchilada sauce in an enchilada bake at dinnertime. Or, use it to add some verve to your favorite grilled protein or veggie bowl.
ingredients: 1 package TJ's Fully Cooked Traditional Carnitas
2 bags TJ's Frozen Organic Jasmine Rice
1 can TJ's Organic Black Beans, rinsed and drained
TJ's Fresh Cilantro, sliced Jalapeno, and sliced Lime, for garnish (optional)

steps.text: Microwave carnitas according to package directions. Shred with forks, set aside.

Microwave rice according to package directions. Divide among four serving bowls. Top bowls with carnitas, black beans, pico de gallo, and guacamole.  Drizzle generously with jalapeño sauce. Garnish with fresh cilantro, sliced jalapeño, and a squeeze of lime, if using. Enjoy!

carnitas-bowl.title: Carnitas Bowl

carolina-gold-slaw.description: This cool, crunchy summer slaw pairs perfectly with BBQ chicken or grilled shrimp skewers.
ingredients: 2 bags TJ's Organic Shredded Green & Red Cabbage with Orange Carrots
4-5 Tbsp TJ's Carolina Gold BBQ Sauce (seasonal)
2 Tbsp TJ's Real Mayonnaise (or TJ's Greek Yogurt)
1/4 teaspoon TJ's Sea Salt, or to taste
1/4 teaspoon TJ's Ground Black Pepper, or to taste

steps.text: To make the dressing, combine BBQ sauce and mayonnaise in a small bowl, mixing a few tablespoons at a time until you reach the desired flavor. Sprinkle dressing with salt and pepper. Combine the remaining ingredients in a medium bowl and toss with the dressing. Chill 30 minutes prior to serving.

carolina-gold-slaw.title: Carolina Gold Slaw

cashew-chicken-lettuce-wraps.description: Inspired by a favorite dish at a nearby Chinese restaurant, this combination of sesame stir-fried ground chicken, crunchy cashews, warm ginger, et al. really pops when portioned out atop cool, crisp (not to mention naturally low-carb) lettuce leaves. Not cooking for five? No problem! This recipe has Sunday night #mealprep written all over it.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon TJ's Organic Toasted Sesame Oil
1 package TJ's Chile & Garlic Cashews, chopped

steps.text: Combine olive & sesame oils and heat in large skillet. Add chicken and cook over medium-high heat until chicken is cooked through, about 8 minutes, or until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Add diced onions, stir to combine, and cook for about 5 minutes or until onion is soft and translucent. Stir occasionally.
Add Soyaki, soy sauce, rice vinegar, ginger, cashews, chives, salt and pepper. Cook for another 5 minutes or until fragrant.
Remove from heat and let cool slightly.
Rise head of lettuce, pat dry, and pull off desired leaves. Spoon about 1/4 cup of the mixture into each of the lettuce leaves to serve. Enjoy!

cashew-chicken-lettuce-wraps.title: Cashew Chicken Lettuce Wraps

chameleon-cooler.description: Each Trader Joe's Absolutely Acerola Juice Shot contains the cold-pressed juice of 12 acerola cherries. That's it! And just a single, two fluid-ounce serving (one bottle) contains 1010% of your daily recommend amount of vitamin C. (Just to be clear, we did not accidentally add an extra zero. It really is over 1000%!) Jumpstart your day with a straight shot, or add to smoothies and mixed drinks for a tangy zip of bright flavor.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons crumbled TJ's Freeze Dried Strawberries
TJ's Lime wedge and fresh Mint, for garnish (optional)

steps.text: Add chia seeds and acerola shot to a tall glass. Cover and let sit 15 minutes.
Fill glass with ice. Top with mango nectar and coconut beverage and stir.
Top with freeze dried strawberries and stir. Garnish with lime wedge and mint (if desired) and enjoy.

chameleon-cooler.title: Chameleon Cooler

channa-masala-pasties.description:
The national dish of Cornwall, England, the pasty (PASS-tee) is a hand-held, sturdy pastry crust wrapped around a hearty filling. It's portable, edible packaging and the fact that utensils weren't required to enjoy it made it the meal of choice for Cornish tin miners.     

While it's traditionally filled with meat & potatoes, the pasty filling is limited only by your imagination-roasted veggies, chicken and green chile, sweet pumpkin, stewed cinnamon apples... This particular recipe embraces a less than traditional filling, in the form of Trader Joe's Channa Masala. Moderately spicy and ready to heat and eat, it makes savory pasty preparation easy as pie.
ingredients: 1 package TJ's Pie Crusts, thawed according to package directions
2 trays TJs Channa Masala, microwaved according to package directions

steps.text: Preheat oven to 375°F. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper; set aside.

Working in two batches, unroll softened dough and smooth together any cracks with your hands. Remove top layer of plastic film and cut dough into quarters. Place a piece of dough on lined baking sheet and top with 1/4 cup channa masala. Starting at one corner and working around the edge of the dough, gently pull dough up toward center, pinching and folding edges to create a dumpling. Repeat with remaining dough and filling (you'll end up with 8 pasties on the baking sheet).

In a small bowl, thoroughly whisk the egg. Using a pastry brush, evenly brush the tops of the pasties with whisked egg. Place baking sheet on center rack of oven and bake for 30 minutes, until crust is golden. Allow to cool 5 minutes. Enjoy on the go, or at the table with mixed greens and Cumin-y Riced Cauliflower on the side.

Wrap leftover pasties in cling wrap and toss in the freezer. To reheat, remove cling wrap and place pasty on a microwave safe dish. Heat at 50% power for 1 minute, then at full power for 1 minute. Allow to cool slightly before serving.
steps.title: Freezing/Reheating Instructions:

channa-masala-pasties.title: Channa Masala Pasties

channa-masala-tomato-soup.description: A veteran of our line of frozen Indian entrées, Trader Joe's Channa Masala is moderately spicy, belly-warming, and undeniably comforting-basically everything you're looking for when it comes to cold weather cuisine. Paired with full-flavored Organic Roasted Tomato & Red Pepper Soup, it's ready before you can ask "What's for lunch?" (Well, almost.) Don't forget to warm up Trader Joe's Tandoori Naan for dipping!
ingredients: 1 package TJ's Organic Tomato & Roasted Red Pepper Soup
TJ's Greek Yogurt or Sour Cream and chopped parsley, for garnish (optional)
TJ's Tandoori Naan, cooked according to package directions, for dipping (optional)

steps.text: Add soup to a medium saucepan. Heat over medium-low, stirring occasionally.
While soup heats, microwave channa masala according to package directions; stir.
Divide soup among 4 shallow serving bowls. Divide channa masala and gently spoon atop center of soup. Garnish with a dollop of yogurt and a sprinkle of chopped parsley. Enjoy!

channa-masala-tomato-soup.title: Channa Masala Tomato Soup

charlottes-chocolate-bread-pudding.description: Trader Joe's Semi-Sweet Chocolate Chips are a sweet baking essential that can be added to all manner of desserts for a boost of chocolatey goodness. With a rich, smooth flavor falling somewhere between milk and dark chocolate, they really shine in this delectable chocolate bread pudding recipe, forming a creamy chocolate custard which is used to soak pieces of crisp French baguette, and then the whole thing is baked to gooey perfection. This unbelievably easy recipe is sure to up your dessert game and impress anyone who takes a bite. Topping the finished pudding with whipped cream is not required (but highly encouraged).
ingredients: TJ's Unsalted Butter, to grease pan
1/2 cup plus 2 tablespoons TJ's Organic Cane Sugar
1 teaspoon TJ's Organic Pure Bourbon Vanilla Extract
4 cups cubed TJ's French Baguette (about half of a baguette)

steps.text: Preheat oven to 325°F. Grease an 8-inch square baking pan with butter, set aside.

Add cream and 1/2 cup sugar to a heavy-bottomed saucepan and bring to a gentle simmer, stirring until sugar dissolves.  Remove from heat and whisk in 1 cup chocolate chips until melted and smooth, set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk egg and vanilla.  Gradually whisk in cooled chocolate mixture. Let chocolate custard mixture cool for 10 minutes, stirring often.
Fold bread cubes and remaining chocolate chips into chocolate custard.  Transfer mixture to baking pan and sprinkle with remaining sugar.
Bake pan on center rack of oven for 50 minutes, until custard thickens and center is set. Remove from oven and let cool slightly. Serve warm with whipped cream, if desired.

charlottes-chocolate-bread-pudding.title: Charlotte's Chocolate Bread Pudding

cheeseburger-pizza.description: Can't decide between burgers and pizza for dinner? With this recipe from a Crew Member's home kitchen, you don't have to!
ingredients: TJ's All-Purpose Flour, for work surface
2 teaspoons TJ's Olive Oil, plus more for brushing pizza crust
1 package (1 pound) TJ's Organic Grass Fed Ground Beef
1 cup TJ's Mild Shredded Cheddar Cheese
TJ's Organic Sweet Bread & Butter Pickles
TJ's Organic Ketchup & Yellow Mustard, for garnish

steps.text: Gently remove dough from bag, place on a lightly floured work surface and let sit at room temperature for 30 minutes.

Add olive oil and onion to a skillet over medium heat. Sauté about 5 minutes, until translucent. Add ground beef to skillet and cook until meat is no longer pink and reaches 160°F. Drain, loosely cover and set aside.

Preheat oven to 475°F. Stretch dough by hand or rolling pin into a circle 12 inches in diameter. Place on a lightly oiled pizza pan or baking sheet. Spread sauce evenly over crust to within half an inch of the edges, and top with ground beef mixture and cheese. Brush edges of dough with olive oil.

Place pan on center rack of oven and bake for about 25 minutes, or until cheese is golden and bubbly around the edges and the bottom of the crust is a light golden brown. Remove pan from oven and let cool slightly. Top pizza with pickles, drizzle with ketchup & mustard and serve.

cheeseburger-pizza.title: Cheeseburger Pizza

cheesy-chivey-biscuits.description: Trader Joe’s Cotswold® Double Gloucester with Chive and Onion is a variation on classic Double Gloucester (pronounced GLAW-stir) cheese that has been imbued with chopped onions and chives for added flavor. It begins its life as a pasteurized whole milk cheese, golden yellow, and semi-firm with a flavor that’s reminiscent to Cheddar, but slightly sweeter and more buttery. While the “Double” in the name denotes that it’s aged longer than a “single” Gloucester, we like to think it signifies that it’s doubly delicious. With the added onions and chives, each bite of our captivating Cotswold® has an herby, extra-savory zing guaranteed to satisfy, whether served on its own, added to burgers, pizzas, and macaroni and cheese, or a batch of these impressively easy-to-prepare, cheesy, chive-y biscuits.
ingredients: 1 cup finely shredded TJ’s Cotswold® Double Gloucester with Chive and Onion

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350° F. Place biscuits one inch apart on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Sprinkle 2 tablespoons of cheese over each biscuit.
Bake 16-18 minutes until golden brown.
Top with chives to serve.

cheesy-chivey-biscuits.title: Cheesy Chive-y Biscuits

cheesy-cowboy-cornbread-muffins.description: Trader Joe's Cornbread Mix is the stuff of legends in our baking mix section, a tried-and-true tribute to one of our favorite foods: corn! Here we've gilded the grain-lily with the addition of spicy salsa and pepper jack cheese, and baked the Mix into muffins (pro-tip: TJ's Avocado Spray Oil ensures the muffins can be removed from the tin with the greatest of ease!). Eat them alone, or slather with TJ's Cultured Butter for a marvelous appetizer or accompaniment to a main dish.
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups TJ's Shredded Pepper Jack Cheese, divided

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease two muffin tins with avocado spray oil, set aside.
Beat egg, oil and milk in large mixing bowl. Stir in cornbread mix, salsa and 1 cup cheese just until combined-do not overmix.
Spoon batter into prepared muffin tin cups, 2/3 full. Sprinkle with remaining cheese.
Bake muffins 25-30 minutes, rotating pans halfway through cooking. Remove from oven and let cool 5 minutes.
Use a butter knife to gently lift muffins out of tin. Serve warm, or store in an airtight container and enjoy within two days.

cheesy-cowboy-cornbread-muffins.title: Cheesy Cowboy Cornbread Muffins

cheesy-hash-brown-casserole.description: Trader Joe's Thanksgiving Stuffing Seasoned Kettle Chips begin with thickly sliced, premium potatoes that are slow cooked in small batches. Once perfectly crispy, they're seasoned with classically aromatic herbs and spices you’d associate with Thanksgiving stuffing. Snack on them straight from the bag, serve them with sour cream for a simple appetizer, or use them as a crunchy,  superlatively savory casserole topping. YUM!
ingredients: 1 bag TJ's Shredded Hash Browns, thawed
1 carton TJ's Condensed Cream of Portabella Mushroom Soup
1/2 package (6 ounces) TJ's Shredded Sharp Cheddar
6 slices TJ's Fully Cooked Uncured Bacon, prepared according to package instructions then chopped
1/4 cup TJ's Chives, finely diced, divided
1 bag TJ's Turkey and Stuffing Seasoned Kettle Chips, crushed

steps.text: Pour canola oil in a 9-inch cast iron pan and place in cold oven, then heat oven to 350°F.
While the oven comes to temperature, combine hash browns, condensed soup, shredded cheese, chopped bacon, 3 tablespoons of chives, and salt and pepper, to taste, in a large bowl.
When the oven reaches 350°F, remove the hot cast iron pan and carefully add the hash brown mixture. Spread evenly with a spatula, then top with crushed potato chips.

Bake casserole on center rack of oven until center is heated through and cheese is bubbling, 45-55 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool slightly. Top with remaining chives. Serve with a dollop of sour cream.

cheesy-hash-brown-casserole.title: Cheesy Hash Brown Casserole

cheesy-jalapeno-beer-bread.description:
"Just add beer and butter"-possibly the five best words to be combined in one sentence. It's also the phrase you'll find gracing each box of Trader Joe's Beer Bread Mix.

The flavor of the finished loaf really depends on what kind of beer you use: Go with a lager for a lighter profile, an IPA for a hearty, hoppy taste, or a stout for a rich result with a slightly darker finished product. Or really embrace the DIY ethos and whip up a batch o' bread using a bottle of homebrew.

This recipe calls for a clean, crisp lager to serve as the backdrop to TJ's Hot & Sweet Jalapeños and savory Unexpected Cheddar. Serve generous slices alone or alongside a hearty bowl of soup-or really gild the lily with a swoosh of Trader Joe's Cultured Salted Butter!
ingredients: 1 block TJ's Unexpected Cheddar, grated and divided
1/2 cup TJ's Hot & Sweet Jalapeños, halved, plus more for garnish

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease a 9x5 inch loaf pan with canola oil spray; set aside.

Add beer bread mix to a large bowl and make a well in the center. Pour beer into well and gently stir until a shaggy dough forms (do not overmix). Gently stir in 3/4 of the grated cheese and the halved jalapeños.
Spread dough into greased loaf pan. Top with remaining cheese and a few jalapeño slices for garnish. Pour melted butter evenly over top.

Place a large rimmed baking sheet on the bottom rack of oven to catch any drips. Place the loaf pan on the center rack and bake 55-65 minutes, or until a toothpick placed in center of loaf comes out clean.
Remove pan from oven and let cool 15 minutes before removing loaf from pan. Slice and enjoy!

cheesy-jalapeno-beer-bread.title: Cheesy Jalapeño Beer Bread

cheesy-olive-stuffed-shortbread-bites.description:
When combined with briny, garlic-stuffed olives, Trader Joe’s Cheddar Cheese with Caramelized Onions bolsters the buttery shortbread dough in this recipe into an outsized celebration of salty, snacky goodness. Enjoy the bites on their own, or serve with a spread of savory appetizers and frosty glasses of beer.

Pro-tip: Be sure to drain the olives thoroughly prior to assembly.
ingredients: ½ cup (1 stick) TJ’s Unsalted Butter, at room temperature
2 cups grated TJ’s Cheddar Cheese with Caramelized Onions
1 cup TJ’s Unbleached Enriched All-Purpose Flour
For Paprika-flavored shortbread bites: 1 teaspoon TJ’s Smoked Paprika, plus more for garnish
For Thyme and Black Pepper-flavored shortbread bites: 1 tablespoon chopped TJ’s Fresh Thyme (plus a few sprigs for garnish) and 1 teaspoon TJ’s Organic Ground Black Pepper

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.

In a stand mixer with a paddle attachment, or using a hand mixer, whip butter until soft. Add cheese, flour, and salt, and mix until combined. For smoked paprika-flavored shortbread bites, add smoked paprika. For thyme and black pepper-flavored shortbread bites, omit the paprika and add fresh chopped thyme and black pepper. Mix until well incorporated.

Transfer the dough to a clean work surface and knead a few times by hand. Divide in half and form into two 15-inch logs. Divide each log into 12 equal pieces (24 pieces in total). Roll a piece into a ball, then flatten the ball with the palm of your hand into a disc. Place an olive in the center of the disc, wrap the dough around it, and roll in your hands until smooth. Repeat with remaining dough and olives. Chill stuffed dough balls for 10 minutes.

Depending on what flavor you’re making, garnish dough balls with a sprinkle of smoked paprika or a small sprig of thyme and a sprinkle of black pepper. Bake on center rack of oven for approximately 10 minutes, until golden brown. Serve bites warm and enjoy!

cheesy-olive-stuffed-shortbread-bites.title: Cheesy Olive-Stuffed Shortbread Bites

cheesy-toscano-spread-garlic-toasts.description: For an amped-up side to a bowl of spaghetti or an easy appetizer for a holiday party, we’re giving homemade garlic bread the wine and cheese treatment with the addition of Trader Joe’s Syrah Soaked Toscano Cheese Spread & Dip! This spread is thick with grated Syrah Soaked Toscano Cheese and melts easily atop a garlic scented baguette. Depending on how you wish to serve it, you can make the baguette slices as big or as small as you like.
ingredients: ¼ cup of your favorite TJ’s Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tub TJ’s Syrah Soaked Toscano Cheese Spread & Dip

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400° F.
Cut baguettes into one-inch slices and place them on a large baking sheet, cut side up.
In a small bowl, combine olive oil and chopped garlic. Brush mixture over each bread slice.
Add a dollop of the cheese spread to each slice and use the back of the spoon to spread it evenly.
Bake for 5-7 minutes, until bread begins to become golden on the edges.
Sprinkle with chopped parsley to serve.

cheesy-toscano-spread-garlic-toasts.title: Cheesy Toscano Spread Garlic Toasts

cheesy-tot-breakfast-bake.description: Trader Joe's Unexpected Cheddar, Potato Tots, and savory sausage & eggs-this cheesy casserole is the ultimate in breakfast comfort food.
ingredients: TJ's Canola Spray, to grease pan
3/4 to 1 block TJ's Unexpected Cheddar, shredded and divided (you'll have about 2 cups shredded)
TJ's Trader Potato Tots (roughly half a bag)
3 slices TJ's Fully Cooked Bacon, diced, for garnish (optional)

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease a casserole dish with canola spray; set aside.
Remove sausage from casing and add to a large skillet. Place skillet over medium heat and saute sausage 10-15 minutes until cooked through, stirring occasionally.
Line the bottom of the casserole dish with cooked sausage. Cover with half of the shredded cheese; set aside.
Whisk eggs, milk and 21 seasoning in a large bowl. Pour evenly over sausage and cheese mixture. Arrange potato tots in a single even layer atop mixture (save the rest for later!).

Place dish on center rack of oven and bake for 30 minutes. Remove dish from oven and sprinkle with remaining cheese, to taste. Return dish to oven and bake an additional 25-30 minutes. (Add diced bacon to oven during last 10 minutes of cooking, if desired). Remove dish from oven and let cool slightly before serving.

cheesy-tot-breakfast-bake.title: Cheesy Tot Breakfast Bake

cheesy-truffle-snack-mix.description: Trader Joe's Oven Baked Cheese Bites with Black Summer Truffle pack a real punch of truffle flavor, making them a real treat for true truffle fanatics. In addition to making a great snack, their tangy, cheesy, truffle-y crunch makes them an exceptional addition to this snack mix recipe.
ingredients: 2 packages TJ's Oven Baked Cheese Bites with Black Summer Truffle (seasonal) or TJ's Oven Baked Cheese Bites
2 cups TJ's Organic Popcorn with Organic Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 cup TJ's Dry Roasted Unsalted Almonds
1 cup TJ's Gluten Free Pretzel Twists

steps.text: In a large mixing bowl combine Cheese Bites, Popcorn, Almonds, and Pretzel Twists. Toss together and enjoy!

cheesy-truffle-snack-mix.title: Cheesy Truffle Snack Mix

cherry-citrus-punch.description: Skipping the suds? Opt for sparkling water in place of sparkling wine in this party-ready punch.
ingredients: 3 cups TJ's French Sparkling Limeade, chilled
3 cups TJ's Blanc de Blancs Sparkling wine (or TJ's Plain Sparkling Spring Water), chilled
Sliced lemons and limes, for garnish (optional)

steps.text: Fill a large punch bowl with ice and set aside. Add lemonade and pineapple tidbits to a blender pitcher and blend until smooth. Pour blended mixture into punch bowl. Add limeade and cherry juice, stir to combine.
Top off punch bowl with Blanc de Blancs immediately before serving. Garnish with lemon and lime slices, if desired.

cherry-citrus-punch.title: Cherry Citrus Punch

chewy-chocolate-mochi-cake.description:
Inspired by Hawaii's classic butter mochi, Trader Joe's Mochi Cake Mix starts with a base of sweet rice flour. This glutinous flour is the key to creating that delightfully chewy, almost bouncy texture that mochi admirers know and love, while the addition of sugar and coconut milk powder add delightful sweetness.     

Prepare this Mochi Cake Mix per the box directions, and you'll be rewarded with a gluten free, sweet, buttery, golden yellow treat, with notes of vanilla and a satisfying chew. Motivated to experiment with your Mochi Cake? Add some matcha powder or a handful of blueberries to the Mix. Use Coconut Milk in place of the water and garnish the batter with shredded coconut before baking. Or go for the ultimate in chocolaty goodness as we've done here, with TJ's Unsweetened Cocoa Powder and plenty of Semi-Sweet Chocolate Chips...

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease an 8-inch square baking pan with canola oil spray, set aside.
In a large bowl, whisk cake mix and water until smooth. Add butter, eggs, and cocoa powder, whisk until smooth. Stir in chocolate chips.

Pour batter into greased pan. Bake on center rack of oven for 45-50 minutes, or until the cake begins to pull away from the sides of the pan. Remove from oven and place on cooling rack for 15-20 minutes prior to slicing.

chewy-chocolate-mochi-cake.title: Chewy Chocolate Mochi Cake

chewy-salted-caramel-cookies.description: Trader Joe’s Caramel Sea Salt Baking Chips are sweet, buttery, lightly salted morsels of caramel, perfect for mixing into cookie dough, pancake batter, or any other sweet treat that could use a little something extra. Kick off fall baking season on a sweet-salty note and try them in this recipe that yields delightfully chewy cookies with a hint of cocoa.
ingredients: 1 teaspoon TJ’s Sea Salt, plus more for garnish
1 cup (2 sticks) TJ’s Unsalted Butter, room temperature
3/4 cup TJ’s Organic Cane Granulated Sugar
1 1/4 cup lightly packed TJ’s Organic Brown Sugar
2 teaspoons TJ’s Organic Pure Bourbon Vanilla Extract
1 bag TJ’s Caramel Sea Salt Baking Chips

steps.text: In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, cocoa powder, baking soda, and salt, set aside.

Using a hand mixer or stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment, beat the butter and sugars on medium-high speed until light and fluffy. Add eggs and vanilla and beat on medium high-speed until well blended, scraping down the sides of the bowl as needed.
Add half of the dry ingredients and mix on low speed just until combined. Repeat with remaining dry ingredients. Fold in caramel chips. Cover and refrigerate dough 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 375ºF. Line 2 cookie sheets with parchment paper or silicone baking mats. Using a spoon or cookie scoop, drop dough by rounded tablespoons on baking sheet, 2 inches apart.

Bake cookies on center rack of oven for 7-8 minutes—do not overbake! Remove from oven, sprinkle cookies with sea salt, and let cool 5 minutes on the baking sheet before transferring to a wire cooling rack.

Makes 48 small cookies or 24 large ones (adjust bake time for larger size). Store in an airtight container with a slice of bread for up to 5 days to retain chewy texture (if they last that long).

chewy-salted-caramel-cookies.title: Chewy Salted Caramel Cookies

chicken-dumplings-soup.description:
Boost your soups, stews, and sauces with rich, simmered-for-hours flavor—minus the simmered-for-hours work—with Trader Joe’s Organic Free Range Chicken Broth. Combined with TJ’s BBQ Teriyaki Chicken and TJ’s Organic Biscuits, they are the time-saving trifecta that makes this cozy Chicken & Dumplings Soup ready to serve in 30 minutes!

Note: For a lighter, equally satisfying soup, skip the cream. Craving a little more comfort? Double the amount.
ingredients: ¼ cup TJ’s Unbleached Enriched All-Purpose Flour
1 can TJ’s Organic Biscuits, cut into quarters
1 package TJ’s BBQ Teriyaki Chicken, sauce reserved for another use
1 carton TJ’s Organic Free Range Chicken Broth

steps.text: To a shallow bowl, add flour. Roll each dough quarter between your palms into a ball, toss in flour to coat, then set aside.
In a medium-sized Dutch oven or pot, heat butter over medium-high heat. Add mirepoix and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.

Add chicken and broth and bring to a boil. Add biscuits, stir into broth, then cover with lid and reduce heat to a simmer on medium-low. Cook for 15 minutes, until dumplings are cooked through. Check for doneness by piercing a dumpling with a toothpick or knife. It will come out clean when ready.
Remove from heat, stir in heavy cream to serve.

chicken-dumplings-soup.title: Chicken & Dumplings Soup

chicken-fajita-bowls.description:
When corn’s on the menu, we’re all ears. One of our absolute favorites is fire-roasted corn. Something about that faintly smoky flavor combined with the corn’s natural sweetness, plus that slight bit of charring on the edges of each kernel… It’s a savory, sensational experience that can’t be beat. That’s why we’re elated to have Trader Joe’s Roasted Corn in our freezers all year round.

Our Roasted Corn is a time-saving champion and can be used in an array of recipes that call for fresh corn kernels. This recipe calls for other TJ’s frozen staples, like TJ’s Grilled Chicken Strips, Fire Roasted Peppers and Onions, and Organic Jasmine Rice, that offer a ton of flavor, with minimal prep, so you can have dinner on the table in 30 minutes (or meal-prepped lunches for the week!)
ingredients: 1 bag TJ’s Fire Roasted Peppers & Onions
2-3 pouches TJ’s Frozen Organic Jasmine Rice, prepared according to package instructions
1 can TJ’s Black Beans, drained and rinsed

steps.text: Heat a large nonstick skillet over high heat, then add frozen peppers and onions and cook for 5 minutes until heated through. Remove peppers and onions from pan and into a bowl, then lower heat to medium.
Add chicken strips to pan. Add 2 tablespoons of water, and cover. Heat for 6-8 minutes until heated through. Remove chicken from pan and into a bowl.
Spray pan with oil, then add corn and cook 4-5 minutes until heated through.
To each bowl, add cooked rice, an even mix of peppers and onions, corn, black beans, and slices of chicken. Top with avocado slices, and a lime wedge to serve.
steps.title: Assembly

chicken-fajita-bowls.title: Chicken Fajita Bowls

chicken-parm-ioli.description: Bursting with umami-rich roasted garlic throughout its classic tomato base, a jar of Trader Joe’s Roasted Garlic Marinara Sauce has the power to amplify an array of dishes. In addition to upgrading a classic penne or spaghetti, it adds serious oomph layered in lasagna or a homemade chicken parmesan. You could choose which one to try first, or you can combine them into one epic pasta bake! This four-ingredient recipe requires only three steps—assemble, bake, eat!
ingredients: 1 jar TJ’s Roasted Garlic Marinara Sauce
1 package of your favorite TJ’s refrigerated ravioli
1 package TJ’s Fresh Mozzarella Cheese Log

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350° F.
Add ½ cup marinara sauce to the empty 9x9 (or similar in size) baking dish. Spread it out evenly so the entire base is covered.
Next, evenly distribute half of the ravioli on top of the sauce base. Then add another layer of ½ cup sauce and spread over the ravioli.
Top the sauced ravioli with the entire package of chicken nuggets and repeat with another ½ cup marinara sauce and spread it evenly over the chicken nuggets.
Add remaining ravioli into an even layer, spread the remaining 1 cup of marinara sauce over the ravioli, and top with mozzarella slices.
Place in oven for 25 minutes, until heated through. For a bubbling cheesy top, broil for an additional 5 minutes. Let cool 5 minutes before serving.

chicken-parm-ioli.title: Chicken Parm-ioli

chicken-sausage-lentil-soup.description: This humble, Tuscan-inspired soup is deceivingly simple and decidedly delicious, calling upon Trader Joe’s Small Whole Green Lentils as the hearty base. Earthy, nutty, and robust in flavor, these Lentils hold their shape well and require no soaking prior to cooking, saving you precious meal prep time. Trader Joe’s Fully Cooked Roasted Garlic Chicken Sausage—another time-saving ingredient—helps build flavor quickly, so the soup is ready to serve in under an hour.
ingredients: 2 TJ’s Zucchini, sliced into half moons
1 can TJ’s Diced & No Salt Added Organic Tomatoes
1 package TJ’s Fully Cooked Roasted Garlic Chicken Sausage, sliced into coins
1 cup TJ’s Small Whole Green Lentils, rinsed and drained
1 carton TJ’s Organic Free Range Chicken Broth
TJ’s Sea Salt & Black Pepper, to taste
TJ's Grated Parmesan, a TJ's Lemon, cut into wedges, & TJ's Fresh Thyme, to garnish

steps.text: In a medium-large pot, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add onion and zucchini, and sauté until onion is translucent, about 5-8 minutes.

Add tomatoes, chicken sausage, lentils, chicken stock, and 1 cup water to pot and stir to combine. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and cover. Simmer for 15-20 minutes, until lentils are cooked through.
Season soup to taste with salt and pepper. Ladle into bowls and garnish with Parmesan, a squeeze of lemon, and fresh thyme to serve.

chicken-sausage-lentil-soup.title: Chicken Sausage & Lentil Soup

chicken-waffles-spicy-honey-butter.description: What could be better than a hot plate of chicken & waffles on a lazy weekend morning? How about chicken & waffles covered in spicy honey butter made with Trader Joe's Spicy Honey Sauce? Leftover honey butter (if you have any leftover, that is) can be stored in the refrigerator for up to one month.
ingredients: 8 pieces TJ’s Breaded Chicken Tenderloin Breasts
2 sticks TJ’s Salted Butter, softened to room temperature
¼ cup TJ’s Spicy Honey Sauce, plus more for drizzling

steps.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Place frozen chicken tenders in a single layer on a foil-lined baking sheet. Bake 25 minutes or until internal temperature reaches 165°F. Remove from oven and let cool slightly.

While chicken bakes, prep the spicy honey butter: In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment (or using a hand mixer), whip the butter with the Spicy Honey Sauce until light and fluffy. Set aside.
Toast waffles to your preference. Slather with spicy honey butter. Top each waffle with 2 pieces of chicken and additional butter if desired. Drizzle with Spicy Honey Sauce and serve.

chicken-waffles-spicy-honey-butter.title: Chicken & Waffles With Spicy Honey Butter

chickenless-pineapple-salad.description: One of the best things about Trader Joe's Chicken-less Mandarin Orange Morsels is that if you didn't know they weren't chicken, you'd probably think they were chicken. They're as tender and juicy as can be, and once you coat them in that beloved orange sauce (which comes in a separate packet), you'll taste nothing but citrusy, gingery, garlicky goodness. Plate them atop sautéed Cruciferous Crunch and you'll have a meatless meal on the table in under 15 minutes.
ingredients: 1 bag TJ's Chickenless Mandarin Orange Morsels
scant 1/3 cup TJ's Pineapple Tidbits, defrosted

steps.text: Divide cruciferous crunch between two plates, set aside. Heat oil in a nonstick pan over medium heat. Add morsels to pan and cook 6-8 minutes, turning regularly to avoid browning. Add mandarin orange sauce packet and pineapple to pan and cook 2 minutes, stirring to coat. Remove pan from heat. Divide morsels and pineapple among prepared plates and serve immediately.

chickenless-pineapple-salad.title: Chicken-less Pineapple Salad

chile-lime-botana-bowl.description:
The 2026 Trader Joe’s Chile Lime Customer Recipe Contest was a truly heated affair. From exquisite appetizers and enticing entrees to between-meal munchies and desserts with a kick, our customers’ culinary creativity assumed endless forms.

We spent hours upon hours tasting and testing (tough gig, right?) and in the end, a few fire-forged Chile Lime champions emerged... including this Chile Lime Botana Bowl by customer Andrea Linage, our Grand Prize Winner! Chefs’ hats off to our winners, and many thanks to all who participated. The entries were truly applause-worthy.
ingredients: ½ cup TJ’s Dry Roasted Unsalted Peanuts
1 bag TJ’s Chili & Lime Flavored Rolled Corn Tortilla Chips
1–2 teaspoons TJ’s Chile Lime Seasoning Blend

steps.text: Lightly crush chips, leaving some larger pieces for texture.
In a large bowl, combine diced cucumbers and shredded carrots.
Add crushed chips and peanuts.
Add fresh lime juice and sprinkle with Chile Lime Seasoning.
Add pomegranate seeds.
Mix well until evenly combined.
Serve immediately. Enjoy!

chile-lime-botana-bowl.title: Chile Lime Botana Bowl

chimichurri-fettuccine.description: Available in our refrigerated section, Trader Joe’s Gluten Free Egg Fettuccine Pasta is made with brown rice flour, potato starch, tapioca starch, and egg. Each package only takes three minutes to cook, making it a terrific weeknight dinner option when prep time is tight. Toss the Fettuccine with your favorite TJ’s pasta sauce, or veer into the realm of the pleasantly unexpected by pairing these noodles with savory, herbaceous, and richly aromatic TJ’s Chimichurri Sauce and quick, pan-seared shrimp. Mmmm.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons of your favorite TJ’s Olive Oil
1 bag (or 1 pound) TJ’s Raw Uncooked Argentinian Red Shrimp, thawed according to package instructions and patted dry
1 package TJ’s Gluten Free Egg Fettucine Pasta, cooked according to package instructions

steps.text: In a large, non-stick sauté pan, add 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat. Add shrimp and cook 2-3 minutes per side.
Reduce heat to medium and add chimichurri sauce and the cooked pasta to the pan. Sauté until evenly coated, about 2 minutes. Serve.

chimichurri-fettuccine.title: Chimichurri Fettuccine

chocolate-almond-crescent-cookies.description:
Almond paste is a key ingredient in an array of baking and candy recipes, like princess cakes, amaretti cookies, and marzipan. Trader Joe’s Almond Paste contains 40% ground almonds and is sweetened until it’s just sweet enough to deliver maximum nuttiness and depth to your baked goods and confections! 

Thanks to our Almond Paste, these Chocolate Almond Crescent Cookies are exceptionally Almond-y in flavor with a delightfully chewy texture. Gilded with melted chocolate, they lend elegance to a cookie platter or dessert buffet, and are superb served with a cup of coffee or mug of tea.

Pro-tip: To speed up the chocolate drying process, stick your tray of chocolate-dipped cookies in the freezer for 5 minutes.
ingredients: 1 7-ounce tube of TJ’s Almond Paste, broken up into pieces
1 teaspoon TJ’s Organic Pure Bourbon Vanilla Extract
½ cup TJ’s Raw Sliced Almonds
½ cup TJ’s Dark Chocolate, chopped and melted

steps.text: Preheat oven to 375°F. Line a large sheet pan with parchment and set aside.

To the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment, add almond paste, almond flour, sugar, and sea salt and mix on low until the mixture resembles, wet, clumpy sand. Add egg white and vanilla extract and continue to mix until dough comes together.
With damp hands, divide dough into 8 equal portions, and roll into balls, about the size of a rounded tablespoon. Roll each ball into a log, about 3 inches long.
Add sliced almonds to a shallow bowl. Roll each dough log in the sliced almonds, then shape into a crescent. Space on prepared baking sheet. Repeat with remaining dough.
Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until they just begin turning golden brown. Remove from oven and let cool completely, about 25 minutes.
After the cookies have cooled, carefully dip the ends of each crescent into the melted chocolate. Place cookies back on sheet pan and allow chocolate to dry before serving.

chocolate-almond-crescent-cookies.title: Chocolate Almond Crescent Cookies

chocolate-dipped-raspberry-stars.description: What better way to enjoy tender, crumbly shortbread cookies than uniting them with a layer of sweet, seedless raspberry jam? In all honesty, we haven't encountered a shortbread cookie as delightful as our Raspberry Stars. That is, until we decided to dip said Stars in chocolate.
ingredients: 1 box TJ's Raspberry Stars Shortbread Cookies (seasonal)
1 TJ's 72% Dark Chocolate Pound Plus Bar, broken into small pieces

steps.text: Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper, set aside. Add half of the chocolate pieces to a medium microwave-safe bowl. Microwave on half-power for 1 minute intervals, stirring in between, until chocolate is melted.

Dip cookies in melted chocolate and place on prepared baking sheet. Place sheet in refrigerator for 10 minutes to set chocolate (cookies will set even faster in the freezer, if you're on a time-crunch). Repeat process with remaining cookies and chocolate.
Use a spatula to transfer cookies to a serving plate, and enjoy!

chocolate-dipped-raspberry-stars.title: Chocolate Dipped Raspberry Stars

chocolate-peanut-nachos.description: While we love the choose-your-own-adventure nature of savory nachos, we’ve given this classic snack a sweet makeover in this recipe and dressed it for dessert. Crisp, sliced apples and gooey peanut butter stand in for the crunchy chips and melty cheese, while garnishes of crushed Trader Joe’s Graham Crackers and chopped dark chocolate provide the perfect balance of sweet and salty flavors in every bite.
ingredients: 3 generous spoonfuls of TJ’s Creamy Salted Peanut Butter
1 bar of TJ’s 3 pack Dark Chocolate (or 1/4 cup of your favorite TJ’s chocolate), chopped

steps.text: Arrange apple slices on a serving dish, in a circular formation, with the slices slightly overlapping.
Drizzle peanut butter over the apples.
Garnish with crushed graham crackers and chopped chocolate. Enjoy!

chocolate-peanut-nachos.title: Chocolate Peanut Nachos

chocolate-truffles.description: Cookies, berries, and coffee-oh, my! Which Trader Joe's provisions will you pulverize for your Chocolate Truffles? We rolled ours in finely ground Joe-Joe's, pistachios, TJ's Freeze Dried Strawberries, and Instant Coffee Packets All Dressed Up with Creamer & Sugar, but you're more than welcome to improvise... Let this easy-peasy Truffle recipe be your guide!
ingredients: 1/2 bar TJ's Pound Plus Dark Chocolate or TJ's Pound Plus 72% Cacao Dark Chocolate
1 teaspoon TJ's Organic Pure Bourbon Vanilla Extract
2 packets TJ's Instant Coffee Packets All Dressed Up with Creamer & Sugar
1/2 bag TJ’s Dry Roasted & Salted Nutmeats or TJ's Dry Roasted & Salted Pistachios, shelled
10 of your favorite TJ's Joe-Joe's Cookies

steps.text: Chop the chocolate finely with a sharp, serrated knife. Place in a small, heatproof mixing bowl.

Heat the cream in a small saucepan, just until it starts to boil. Remove from heat immediately and pour over the chopped chocolate. Let the mixture sit for 30 seconds, then add vanilla extract and carefully whisk together until the chocolate is completely melted. *
Set aside in the fridge for one hour, or until chocolate mixture is solid but still easy to scoop.

One at a time, crush dried strawberries, pistachios, and Joe-Joe's in a food processor (separately, not together) until each topping reaches a finely ground, powdered consistency. Place the three different powders in separate piles on a flat surface, with some space between them. Open the instant coffee packets and pour powdered contents into a pile on the same flat surface.
With a melon baller, scoop round balls of the chilled chocolate mixture onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper
Roll each dollop of chocolate in hands to make a smooth, round ball.
Roll each ball of chocolate in the finely ground topping of your choice; depending on the size of your truffles, you will have enough for either four, five, or six of each flavor.
Serve at room temperature and enjoy.
*Note: If chocolate does not completely melt, place bowl in the microwave in 15-second increments, stirring in between, until chocolate is fully melted.

chocolate-truffles.title: Chocolate Truffles

chunky-salsa-with-cream-cheese.description:
Made with big chunks of organic diced tomatoes, organic tomato paste, organic onions, and organic jalapeños, then spiced with organic cayenne pepper and organic dehydrated garlic, Trader Joe's Organic Thick & Chunky Salsa is fresh and flavorful, packing just the right amount of medium-level heat. And, boy, is this Salsa versatile.     

Sure, you can use it as you would any other-in burritos, tacos, and quesadillas, with tortilla chips, etc. But you can also use it in less expected ways. Spoon it atop baked chicken or fish. Pour a few jars into a slow cooker with TJ's Bone-In Skin-On Chicken Thighs and vegetables. Use it as the sauce on a tasty Mexican-inspired pizza. Or, simply pour it over rich cream cheese for a lightning-fast appetizer, and dig in with your favorite TJ's Tortilla Chips!
ingredients: 1  1/2 cups TJ's Organic Thick & Chunky Salsa

steps.text: Unwrap cream cheese and arrange on serving plate or in wide shallow bowl. Top with salsa. Grab your favorite Trader Joe's Tortilla Chips and dig in!

chunky-salsa-with-cream-cheese.title: Chunky Salsa with Cream Cheese

chvre-with-honey-brioche-toasts.description: Trader Joe's Chèvre with Honey Goat's Milk Cheese combines the sweet goodness of honey with the tangy temptation of goat cheese. Slather it on Brioche Toasts and pair with your favorite rosé for a simple, slightly sweet appetizer or afternoon snack.
ingredients: 2 packages TJ's Chevre With Honey Goat's Milk Cheese

steps.text: Slather brioche toasts with goat cheese and garnish with blueberries. Enjoy!

chvre-with-honey-brioche-toasts.title: Chèvre With Honey Brioche Toasts

cilantro-crema.description: This creamy sauce is perfect for drizzling atop fajitas or Carnitas Tacos.

steps.text: Add all ingredients to the bowl of a blender or food processor.
Blend for 1-2 minutes until smooth. Pour into a bowl or squeeze bottle and drizzle atop eggs, burritos, tacos, salads, fajitas, burgers...

cilantro-crema.title: Cilantro Crema

cilantro-lentil-tacos.description: Thanks to a can of Trader Joe's Lentils, these meat-free tacos come together quickly and are packed with protein. They're spiced with TJ's Taco Seasoning Mix to offer a subtle heat that's balanced by the cooling notes of TJ's Cilantro Salad Dressing and fresh diced bell pepper. Dig in!
ingredients: 1 tablespoon of your favorite TJ’s Olive Oil
1 cup diced TJ’s Bell Peppers, one color or an array)
A handful of TJ’s Fresh Cilantro leaves, for garnish

steps.text: Heat a large sauté pan over medium heat. Add oil, and once it begins to shimmer, add lentils and taco seasoning, and stir to evenly season the lentils. Cook for about 5 minutes, until the lentils are heated through. Spoon lentils into a bowl and set aside.
Return pan to medium-high heat, and warm the tortillas, about 30 seconds each side, allowing them to brown slightly.

To assemble the tacos, divide the lentils among the tortillas, top each with diced bell peppers, drizzle a large spoonful of cilantro dressing, and finish with a sprig of cilantro. Serve with a wedge of lime.

cilantro-lentil-tacos.title: Cilantro Lentil Tacos

ingredients: 2 slices of your favorite TJ's Bread
1/4 teaspoon TJ's Organic Pure Bourbon Vanilla Extract

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Place two slices of bread on a cookie sheet and begin baking for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, in a small bowl, add 1 1/2 tablespoons of clarified butter, 1 tablespoon of sugar, 1 teaspoon cinnamon, a couple dashes of nutmeg and 1/4 teaspoon of vanilla extract. Stir until combined.
Remove bread slices from oven, flip the slices over, then spread the cinnamon-sugar mix atop each slice, smoothing the mixture all the way to the edges.
Place bread slices back into the oven for 7 more minutes, until the cinnamon-sugar topping bubbles slightly.
Remove the cinnamon toast from the oven and rest on the cookie sheet to finish toasting and cool slightly, about 2 minutes.

Slice the banana into medallions, place two "ears"and a "nose"atop each slice. Slice the bottom tips off of the strawberries, then slice the tips in half from top to bottom. Arrange the strawberry slices along the bottom edge of the toast to form a red "bow-tie". Finally, place the raisins atop the toast to form the "eyes"the tip of the "nose". Enjoy!

cinnamon-bear-toast.title: Cinnamon Bear Toast

cinnamon-chai-shake.description: Trader Joe’s Cinnamon Graham Crackers are groovier than the average graham. Decidedly sturdy and dusted with a delectable cinnamon sugar topping, they’re excellent for dipping into sweet spreads, upgrading classic campfire s’mores, or blending with Super Premium French Vanilla Ice Cream and a splash of Spiced Chai Black Tea Concentrate for a cinnamon-y spin on a cookies and cream milkshake. The contrast of warm spices and cool ice cream against the backdrop of this temptingly thick shake is nothing short of extraordinary…
ingredients: 1 cup TJ’s Super Premium French Vanilla Ice Cream
2 TJ’s Cinnamon Graham Crackers, broken into smaller pieces
¼ cup TJ’s Spiced Chai Black Tea Concentrate

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in a blender, cover, and blend until thoroughly mixed. Pour into a glass to serve.

cinnamon-chai-shake.title: Cinnamon Chai Shake

citrus-garlic-chicken-tacos.description: Trader Joe's Cuban Style Citrus Garlic Bowl is packed with marinated chicken thigh meat served over turmeric-seasoned rice, black beans, chopped plantains, peppers, and onions, tossed in a bright, citrus & garlic, mojo criollo sauce. Outside of the bowl, it just so happens to make a zesty and flavorful base for chicken tacos with a Cuban twist - perfect when you're running low on time and want a quick meal!
ingredients: 1 package TJ's Cuban Style Citrus Garlic Bowl

steps.text: Remove outer packaging of Cuban Style Citrus Garlic Bowl and pierce film. Microwave on high 4 to 5 minutes or until heated through. Stir and set aside.
Fill tortillas with warmed Cuban Style Citrus Garlic Bowl. Garnish with salsa, sliced jalapeños, and cilantro.
Enjoy!

citrus-garlic-chicken-tacos.title: Citrus Garlic Chicken Tacos

citrus-sprinkled-ricotta-cookies.description:
Cheese is not a typical ingredient for cookies, but Trader Joe’s Whole Milk Ricotta Cheese yields a light and pillowy-soft texture that will certainly change your mind. These Ricotta Cookies are scented with lemon and vanilla, topped with a thick vanilla glaze, and sprinkled with a colorful blend of aromatic citrus zest. This recipe makes enough cookies to serve at a party or even give as gifts. And they go delightfully well with a hot mug of tea.

Pro-tip: Make the citrus sprinkles while the cookie dough rests. It will allow enough time for the zest to dry slightly, making it easier to sprinkle.
ingredients: 4 cups TJ’s Unbleached Enriched All Purpose Flour
1 cup (2 sticks) TJ’s Unsalted Butter, softened to room temperature
2 1/2 teaspoons TJ’s Organic Pure Bourbon Vanilla Extract
1 container TJ’s Whole Milk Ricotta Cheese

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper and set aside.
In a medium bowl whisk together, flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Set aside.
Using a hand or stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment, beat the butter with the granulated sugar on medium-high speed until light and fluffy, about 10 minutes.
Add eggs one at a time, mixing between additions.
Add 2 teaspoons vanilla, lemon juice, lemon zest, and ricotta. Beat on medium speed until well blended, scraping down the sides of the bowl as needed.
On low speed, add the dry ingredients and mix until just combined. Cover bowl and refrigerate dough for 1 hour.
Using a spoon or cookie scoop, roll rounded tablespoons of dough between your palms to form dough balls.
Place dough balls on prepared cookie sheets, two inches apart. Bake 12-15 minutes until bottoms are golden. Repeat with remaining dough.
Let cookies rest 10 minutes before decorating.
Make the citrus zest "sprinkles": While the cookie dough rests, zest the citrus, and let dry slightly on a piece of parchment paper.
Make glaze: Combine powdered sugar, milk, and remaining 1/2 teaspoon vanilla in medium bowl and whisk to combine. It will initially be clumpy but continue to whisk until it becomes smooth.
Decorate cookies: Dip the top of each cookie in the glaze then top with a sprinkle of zest. Let the glaze dry for 10 minutes.

citrus-sprinkled-ricotta-cookies.title: Citrus-Sprinkled Ricotta Cookies

citrusy-baked-oatmeal.description: This bright, warming baked oatmeal combines Trader Joe's Rolled Oats and tangy citrus for a morning meal that's sure to please any day of the week. The addition of egg and honey helps hold everything together, while the trek mix lends textural crunch. Fancy enough to bring to Sunday brunch, yet simple enough to prep on a weekday morning and bake while you get ready for the day ahead? Yes please!
ingredients: 3 TJ's Cara Cara Oranges (if unavailable, Navels or Valencias will work just fine)
1 1/2 cups TJ's Unsweetened Vanilla Almond Milk
1/4 cup of your favorite TJ's Honey
1 cup TJ's Go Raw Trek Mix (or Oh My! Omega Trek Mix)

steps.text: In a medium bowl, add oats, 1 cup almond milk and the juice of 2 Cara Cara oranges and stir. Let sit for 20 minutes, allowing oats to soak in liquid.

Preheat oven to 375°F. Grease a 9-inch pie dish with 1 tablespoon ghee and set aside. In a large bowl, combine egg, honey, remaining ghee, and almond milk. Add soaked oats, Trek Mix, baking powder, salt and cinnamon and stir gently until combined.

Pour the oat mixture into the greased pie dish. Thinly slice the remaining Cara Cara orange and layer slices atop mixture. Sprinkle with sugar, if desired, and bake for 30 minutes, until the center is set. Turn the oven to broil (low) and cook until orange slices are caramelized, about 3 minutes. Let cool 10 minutes prior to serving.

citrusy-baked-oatmeal.title: Citrusy Baked Oatmeal

citrusy-roasted-chicken-thighs-fennel.description:
Also known in some corners of the world as sweet anise, Fennel has an aromatic, distinctly licorice-like flavor that mellows into subtle sweetness when cooked. It has layers like an onion, a crisp texture, and fine, frilly leaves that resemble dill. In this recipe, Trader Joe’s Fresh Fennel is used in multiple ways. The bulb is thickly sliced and roasted with TJ’s Natural Bone-In Skin-On Chicken Thighs and lemon and orange slices, while the citrusy-flavored fronds are reserved, chopped, and used as garnish.  

Pro-tip: Keep the garlic cloves in their skins while roasting. After the roasting pan comes out of the oven, carefully pop the cloves out of their skin to reveal soft, sweet, roasted garlic!
ingredients: Your favorite TJ’s Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 TJ’s Fresh Fennel bulb, cut into thick slices, reserve the fronds
1 TJ’s Lemon, sliced into thick rounds
1 TJ’s Orange, sliced into thick rounds
6 cloves TJ’s Fresh Garlic, skin on
4 TJ’s All Natural Bone-In Skin-On Chicken Thighs

steps.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. To a roasting pan or sheet pan, drizzle with olive oil.
To a large bowl, add the fennel, orange, lemon, and garlic cloves in their skin. Coat with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Add to prepared pan in a single layer.
Add chicken thighs to the bowl, drizzle with olive oil, and season with salt and pepper. Arrange seasoned chicken in pan, atop the citrus and vegetables.
Roast for about 25-30 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F and the juices run clear when pierced.
Carefully pop the roasted garlic out of their skins. Squeeze citrus over the chicken and fennel, and sprinkle with fennel fronds to serve.

citrusy-roasted-chicken-thighs-fennel.title: Citrusy Roasted Chicken Thighs & Fennel

citrusy-salmon-shishitos-sheet-pan.description:
We’re just going to say it—the sheet pan is the unsung superstar in your kitchen—and this recipe is a one pan wonder! It offers a double dose of bright citrus—thanks to Trader Joe’s Cuban Style Citrusy Garlic Seasoning Blend and roasted lemon wedges—and is full of different textured veggies that a sheet pan can easily accommodate. Pair with BBQ Cut Fresh Atlantic Salmon, not only because it makes a filling, flavorful meal, but because the entire sheet pan is ready at the same time—a welcomed option for weeknight meals when time is tight, and your culinary enthusiasm may be low. And don’t forget a hefty drizzle of Chimichurri Sauce to really make this sheet pan sing!

Need another reason to celebrate the sheet pan? Perhaps the most compelling attraction of sheet pan meals is that they won’t leave you with a sink full of dishes. Hooray!

Note: the size of each salmon fillet varies and can feed 1 to 2 people, depending on size.
ingredients: 13" x 18" sheet pan, lined with aluminum foil
1 package TJ’s BBQ Cut Fresh Atlantic Salmon (2 fillets)
1 ½ teaspoons TJ’s Cuban Style Citrusy Garlic Seasoning Blend
1 TJ’s Fennel Bulb, cored and sliced
10 TJ’s Baby Red Potatoes, sliced into thin rounds
½ bag TJ’s Shishito Peppers, stems removed

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.

To a foil-lined sheet pan, add sliced fennel, sliced potatoes, stemmed shishito peppers and lemon wedges. Drizzle with two tablespoons oil and sprinkle with ½ teaspoon of salt, and ½ teaspoon citrusy blend. Remove shishitos from sheet pan. (They will be added back to sheet pan during the roasting.) Toss remaining ingredients to evenly combine.
Pat salmon dry and coat each fillet with a 1 ½ teaspoons of oil, a pinch of salt and ½ teaspoon citrusy seasoning blend. Place in the center of the sheet pan.

Roast for 15 minutes, then add shishitos to pan. After about 5 minutes, or when the shishitos begin to blister, probe the salmon using an instant-read thermometer. The sheet pan can be removed from the oven when the salmon reaches an internal temperature of 145°F.
To serve, drizzle chimichurri sauce over salmon and veggies with a squeeze of roasted lemon. Enjoy!

citrusy-salmon-shishitos-sheet-pan.title: Citrusy Salmon & Shishitos Sheet Pan

classic-cobb-salad.description: Trader Joe's Cage-Free Hard-Cooked Eggs, Fullly Cooked Uncured Bacon, and Blue Cheese Crumbles contribute to this quick, uncomplicated yet filling salad that's loaded with toppings-which is always the best part of a salad, anyway.
ingredients: 5 food storage containers for daily meal prep

steps.text: Microwave bacon according to package directions. Chop bacon into bite sized pieces. Line up your food storage containers and lay a bed of romaine at the bottom of each. Divide bacon, tomatoes, eggs, and chicken evenly among containers. Top each salad with 2 tablespoons blue cheese. Measure 2 tablespoons dressing into each sauce container. Cover and refrigerate until ready to eat. Save avocado and slice fresh each day.
When ready to eat, slice 1/3 of an avocado atop salad and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!

classic-cobb-salad.title: Classic Cobb Salad

classic-cranberry-chestnut-stuffing.description: Need a no-stress side for your holiday meal? For a supremely savory stuffing, with classic fall flavors of chestnut and cranberry, we’re using Trader Joe's Cornbread Stuffing Mix, Organic Peeled & Cooked Chestnuts, and Mirepoix to sidestep all the time-consuming prep—leaving you with more time to relax and enjoy!
ingredients: 3 cups TJ's Organic Turkey Bone Broth or Organic Free Range Chicken Broth
2 packages TJ's Organic Peeled & Cooked Chestnuts, coarsely chopped

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Combine cranberries with one cup of broth and set aside. Add butter to skillet and melt.
Add veggies and sauté until soft; about 10 to 15 minutes.
Place bread cubes from stuffing mix in medium-large bowl.
Add cooked veggies to bowl; add broth with cranberries; add chopped chestnuts and mix well.
Add the remaining broth, one cup at a time, and continue to mix until all bread is moist.
Add contents of seasoning packet, to taste, and mix until well combined. Place in a 9" x 13" (approx. 4 qt.) casserole dish and bake for 35 to 45 minutes.

classic-cranberry-chestnut-stuffing.title: Classic Cranberry Chestnut Stuffing

classic-turkey-pot-pie.description: What are leftovers for, if not for pot pie?
ingredients: 1 lb leftover cooked TJ's Turkey, diced
1 carton TJ's Condensed Cream of Portabella Mushroom Soup (seasonal)
1 cup (or more) TJ's Organic Low Sodium Chicken Broth
1 box TJ's Pie Crusts, both crusts defrosted
1-2 Tbsp TJ's Olive Oil for sautéing

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place one pie crust in the bottom of a pie dish and par-bake until lightly golden, about 10-12 minutes. Set aside.
In a medium-sized bowl, mix condensed mushroom soup and 1 cup broth (adding up to 1/2 cup more broth as needed until desired thickness is reached). Set aside.

In a large pan over medium heat, add oil. When heated, add mirepoix, corn and edamame and sauté until fragrant and onions turn translucent, about 3 minutes. Add soup mixture and turkey to pan and cook, stirring often, until filling is heated through and begins to simmer. Remove from heat.

Pour filling into pre-baked bottom crust, then cover with remaining unbaked crust. Cut a slit or design in top crust to allow venting. Place pie in center rack of oven and bake at 350°F for 30-40 minutes until crust turns golden brown. Let cool slightly before serving.

classic-turkey-pot-pie.title: Classic Turkey Pot Pie

cobb-salad-stuffed-eggs.description: For a quick source of protein without the prep, Trader Joe's Hard Cooked Eggs can't be beat.
ingredients: 2 strips of TJ's Grilled Chicken Breast Strips, diced
4 pieces TJ's Fully Cooked Uncured Bacon, crumbled

steps.text: Slice eggs in half lengthwise and scoop yolks into a bowl.
Mash yolks and stir in guacamole and diced chicken.
Spoon yolk mixture into egg halves.
Layer lettuce leaves on a platter and arrange stuffed eggs on top.
Sprinkle diced grape tomatoes and crumbled bacon on top of eggs.
Serve chilled.

cobb-salad-stuffed-eggs.title: Cobb Salad Stuffed Eggs

cocoa-almond-banana-stuffed-french-toast.description: Dessert for breakfast? Maybe. Unbelievably delicious? You bet.
ingredients: 6 thick slices TJ's Artisan Bread (we used the Rustic variety)
4-5 TJ's Strawberries, sliced into heart shapes

steps.text: Make a deep cut into each slice of bread to create a pocket, and stuff generously with cocoa almond spread and bananas. Whisk milk, eggs and cinnamon together in a medium dish. Melt butter in a large, heavy skillet over medium heat. While skillet is heating, dip each side of the stuffed bread pocket into the egg mixture then fry in batches until golden brown on both sides. Top each slice with another layer of cocoa almond spread, sliced bananas and syrup. Garnish the plate with fresh strawberries and enjoy!

cocoa-almond-banana-stuffed-french-toast.title: Cocoa Almond & Banana Stuffed French Toast

cocoa-peanut-butter-bacon-bagel.description: Yes, bacon. Don't be afraid of this bold combo - one bite and this sandwich's sweet-savory flavors will have you sold.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons TJ's Creamy Salted Peanut Butter
2 slices TJ's Uncured Dry Rubbed Sliced Bacon, cooked

steps.text: Slice bagel in half and toast until warm.
Spread Cocoa Almond Spread over one side of bagel and peanut butter over the other.
Cut slices of bacon in half and arrange on one side of bagel.
Sandwich the sides together and cut in half.
Serve immediately.

cocoa-peanut-butter-bacon-bagel.title: Cocoa Peanut Butter Bacon Bagel

cocoa-stuffed-snowflakes.description:
For a festive dessert or decadent breakfast that looks like a winter wonderland, we’ve taken Trader Joe’s Puff Pastry Sheets and made them in to unique (and easy to make!) puff pastry “snowflakes,” then filled them with Trader Joe’s Cocoa Almond Spread. They’re finished with a dusting of powdered sugar for full snow effect.

Pro-tip: While you’re working with one sheet, keep the other in the refrigerator until ready to use. Chilled puff pastry is easier to work with than room temperature puff pastry.
ingredients: TJ’s Unbleached Enriched All-Purpose Flour, for dusting
1 box TJ’s All Butter Puff Pastry Sheets, thawed according to package instruction
1 cup TJ’s Cocoa Almond Spread, divided
TJ’s Organic Powdered Sugar, for dusting

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400° F. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper and set aside.
Lightly dust your work surface with flour and unroll one thawed sheet of puff pastry.
Using a rolling pin, roll the sheet out to a 10-inch square.
Using a knife, cut each puff pastry sheet into four equal squares.
Working with one square at a time, use a sharp knife to cut 1-inch slits along the bottom edge of the square, 1/2-inch apart.
Spread two tablespoons of cocoa spread along the top of the square, leaving a half inch border of pastry around the sides.

To shape the dough: start with the top edge of the square (with the cocoa almonds spread) and roll the dough toward the bottom edge, into a log. Bring the ends of the log together to form a donut shape, and pinch to seal.
Transfer rings to prepared baking sheet and refrigerate.
Repeat steps with second sheet of puff pastry.
Remove baking sheet from refrigerator and bake 20 minutes, or until golden. Cool for 10 minutes before sprinkling with powdered sugar to serve.

cocoa-stuffed-snowflakes.title: Cocoa-Stuffed Snowflakes

cocoa-sugar-shells.description:
Trader Joe’s Toaster Waffles aren’t just for breakfast—here, they’re flattened and baked into a crispy shell to house TJ’s Fleur de Sel Caramel Sauce and TJ’s French Vanilla Ice Cream, then coated with pecans and a delicate chocolate shell. How to achieve a chocolate shell, you ask? Simply melt Trader Joe’s Semi-Sweet Chocolate Chips with TJ’s Organic Virgin Coconut Oil. Wow!

This recipe was a runner-up in the 2026 Store Recipe Contest and was created by the Crew at Store #788 in Crestview Hills, KY!
ingredients: 1 jar TJ’s Fleur de Sel Caramel Sauce
1 quart TJ’s French Vanilla Ice Cream, softened
3 tablespoons TJ’s Organic Virgin Coconut Oil
1 cup TJ’s Unsalted Dry Toasted Pecan Pieces

steps.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Warm waffles in the toaster on the lowest heat setting.

Use a rolling pin to flatten the waffles. Flip a cupcake tin upside down to use as a mold. Fold waffles in half and gently wedge between raised ridges of the upside-down cups to hold their "U" shape. Bake for 13-15 minutes until crispy. Let shells cool.
Add a thin layer of caramel sauce to the inside of each waffle. Fill with softened ice cream, then return to the cupcake tin and freeze for 30 minutes.

Add chocolate chips and coconut oil to a medium-sized, microwave-safe bowl. Microwave in 15-second intervals, stirring well between each interval, until fully melted. Allow sauce to cool, about five minutes.
