Place pecans on a plate and dip the top of each taco into the pecans, pressing them into ice cream. Then roll tops of tacos in cooled chocolate. Return to freezer for 30 minutes,or until set.

cocoa-sugar-shells.title: Cocoa Sugar Shells

coconut-cold-brew-ice-pops.description: Cool off and caffeinate with these dairy-free ice pops. Shredded Coconut and Non-Dairy Coconut Beverage create a just-sweet-enough tropical foil when paired with the fruity, nuanced flavors of our Cold Brew.
ingredients: 6 Tablespoons TJ’s Organic Flake Coconut, divided
1 3/4 cup TJ’s Non-Dairy Coconut Beverage (Vanilla Flavor), divided
1 1/2 cups TJ’s Coconut Cold Brew Coffee Concentrate (or original TJ's Cold Brew Coffee Concentrate)
You will also need 12 wooden craft sticks, 12 small square pieces of foil and 12 small paper cups to use as molds

steps.text: Arrange 12 paper cups on a small tray. Sprinkle 1/2 tablespoon of shredded coconut in the bottom of each cup. Pour 1 Tablespoon of coconut milk into each cup and swish until the shredded coconut is completely saturated. Place tray of cups in the freezer for at least 1.5 hours or until layer solidifies.
Meanwhile, in a small pitcher combine remaining 1 cup of coconut milk, 1.5 cups of cold brew and 3 teaspoons of sugar. Stir, cover and set aside.

Once the coconut milk layers are solid, remove tray from freezer and add about 3 tablespoons of your cold brew mixture to each cup. Cover each cup with foil and puncture with a wooden craft stick down the center. Stick the pops in the freezer for about six hours. Peel the paper away and enjoy!

coconut-cold-brew-ice-pops.title: Coconut Cold Brew Ice Pops

coconut-lime-quinoa.description: When developing Trader Joe’s Coconut Milk, we had three goals. One, we wanted a coconut milk that was certified organic. Two, we wanted a product that had no gums added to it. And three, above all, we wanted a coconut milk that tasted great. Trader Joe’s Organic Coconut Milk scores on all three counts! It’s superb in smoothies, excellent in curries, and adds new dimensions of flavor and creaminess to Trader Joe’s Organic White Quinoa when used as the cooking liquid in place of water.
ingredients: 1 can (about 2 cups) TJ’s Organic Coconut Milk
Zest from 1 TJ’s Lime, plus half a lime reserved

steps.text: Add quinoa and coconut milk to a medium-sized saucepan and bring to a boil over medium high heat. Reduce to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes, until all the coconut milk has been absorbed.
Remove from heat and fluff with a fork. Add a squeeze of lime, and season with salt, to taste. Top with lime zest and cilantro, to serve.

coconut-lime-quinoa.title: Coconut Lime Quinoa

coconut-water-smoothie.description: Refresh, rehydrate, and recharge with this coconut water-based smoothie, boasting sweet strawberries, bright pineapple, and tangy Trader Joe's Greek Yogurt.
ingredients: 1 cup (about 12) TJ's Organic Cut and Peeled Carrots

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in a blender and pulse until smooth.

coconut-water-smoothie.title: Coconut Water Smoothie

coffee-garlic-seasoned-pork-chops.description:
Trader Joe's BBQ Rub and Seasoning with Coffee & Garlic balances the bold flavors of Coffee, Garlic and paprika with sweet brown sugar, just the right amount of salt, and a touch of dried mandarin orange peel to create a singular rub that rises above the rest. It's noteworthily versatile and superbly suited to being sprinkled on TJ’s Boneless Center-Cut Pork Loin Chops, as it is on steaks and poultry. It makes a swell seasoning for roasted potatoes and grilled vegetables, too. 

Pro-tip: To allow the flavors to better permeate the chops, refrigerate them for an hour after seasoning.
ingredients: 3 TJ’s Boneless Center-Cut Pork Loin Chops
TJ’s BBQ Rub & Seasoning with Coffee & Garlic

steps.text: Place pork chops on a plate and sprinkle enough seasoning to coat both side of each pork chop. (If refrigerating, cover with plastic wrap and chill for one hour.)
Heat a cast iron pan over medium-high heat and add enough canola oil to coat the bottom of the pan.

Add pork chops to the pan and cook for about 5 minutes to build a crust. Flip and cook for another 5 minutes. Continue cooking until the internal temperature reaches 145°F when probed with a thermometer, up to 5 additional minutes.
Remove from pan and let rest 5 minutes before serving.

coffee-garlic-seasoned-pork-chops.title: Coffee & Garlic-Seasoned Pork Chops

cookie-butter-bacon-stuffed-french-toast.description: There's French toast, and then there's stuffed French toast.
ingredients: TJ's Organic Midnight Moo Chocolate Flavored Syrup, to taste

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400 degrees.
Place bacon on foil lined baking sheet and bake 12 minutes or until desired crispness.
While the bacon cooks, carefully slice the croissants ALMOST all of the way through. Remove some of the breading from the inside to create shallow cavities for filling.
Remove bacon to a plate and let cool. Once cool enough to handle, crumble or cut to desired size.

Spread 1 tablespoon of cookie butter into the cavity of each cut side of the croissants. Sprinkle bacon pieces evenly among the croissants (or more in your own if no one is looking). Press the 2 sides back together.
In a large skillet over medium heat, melt butter.
In a shallow dish, beat the eggs and milk together. Dip each croissant in the mixture, ensuring an even coating on all sides.
Add the croissants to the skillet, working in batches, if necessary. Cook about 2 minutes on each side until desired darkness, watching carefully to make sure they don't burn.

Finished croissants can be held in the warm oven while the others cook if working in batches. Serve warm and drizzled with Midnight Moo chocolate syrup. 

*Recipe Credit: Trader Joe's 2015 Strut Your Stuffed Recipe Contest 1st Runner-Up - Jeannette Powers of Canton, MI

cookie-butter-bacon-stuffed-french-toast.title: Cookie Butter & Bacon Stuffed French Toast

cookie-butter-coffee-ice-cream-cake.description:
If you’re a connoisseur of Cookie Butter in any conformation, you’ll find it impossible to resist the siren song of this ice cream cake. Anchored by a crust of crumbled Trader Joe’s Speculoos Cookies, each layer raises the stakes on the one before it, culminating in an irresistible ice cream cake with sweetly epic proportions, made for serious dessert devotees. This is how the cookie crumbles, folks—and it’s oh so good.

Pro-tips: Take care not to overpress the crust layer into the pan, or it will be too difficult to slice once frozen. To ensure a firm set on the ice cream layers, this cake is best prepared the day before you plan to enjoy it.
ingredients: 1 quart TJ’s Coffee Bean Blast Ice Cream
1 ½ jars TJ’s Speculoos Cookie Butter
1 jar TJ’s Fleur de Sel Caramel Sauce
3 cups TJ’s Speculoos Cookie Butter Ice Cream

steps.text: Crush 1 package of Speculoos Cookies into fine crumbs (by hand or with a food processor—your call). Add to a medium bowl with melted butter and stir to combine. Gently press mixture into the bottom of a nonstick springform cake pan. (Pro-tip: use the back of a spoon to round the crust edges, this will make for easier slicing.) Refrigerate at least 30 minutes. Place ice creams in the fridge to thaw while crust sets.

Remove crust and coffee bean blast ice cream from the fridge, and using an ice cream scoop, scoop the ice cream evenly onto the cookie crust. Smooth with a spatula or back of a spoon, making sure that you leave no gaps or holes. Freeze for 10 minutes.

While the coffee ice cream layer sets, prepare the cookie butter whipped cream: Using an electric hand mixer or stand mixer, add the heavy cream and cookie butter to a bowl and whip for about 3 minutes until thick and fluffy (start on low speed for 30 seconds to reduce splatter, and increase speed to high as mixture emulsifies). Transfer half of the mixture into a piping bag with a star tip OR to a separate bowl, cover and reserve in the refrigerator.
Roughly crush the remaining package of Speculoos cookies (reserve ¼ cup for garnish) and fold into the remaining half of the cookie butter whipped cream.

Remove ice cream cake from freezer. Layer cookie butter-speculoos cookie whipped cream mixture atop the coffee ice cream and smooth with a spatula. Drizzle with ½ of the Fleur de Sel Caramel Sauce, reserving the remaining ½ jar for garnish. Freeze cake for 10 minutes.

Remove ice cream cake from freezer and cookie butter ice cream from refrigerator. Using an ice cream scoop, scoop the cookie butter ice cream evenly onto the whipped cream layer (be sure to break any large chunks of cookie butter to ensure easy slicing). Smooth with a spatula or back of a spoon, making sure that you leave no gaps or holes. Freeze until firm, at least 1 hour.

Using a swirling motion, pipe the remaining cookie butter and whipped cream mixture into rosettes around the edge of the cake—if you’re not using a piping bag, simply use a spoon to spread evenly over the top. Sprinkle with remaining crushed cookies. Freeze for at least 6 hours, or preferably overnight, before slicing.
Just before serving, drizzle ice cream cake with the remaining Fleur de Sel Caramel Sauce. Run a knife under hot water to ensure ease of slicing and serve.

cookie-butter-coffee-ice-cream-cake.title: Cookie Butter & Coffee Ice Cream Cake

cookie-butter-dessert-sandwich.description:
Not yet on the Trader Joe's Cookie Butter bandwagon? May we do our best to convince you to jump on board?  Speculoos cookies are classic Belgian biscuits with great crunch, and a slightly caramelized, almost-but-not-quite-gingerbread flavor. After the cookies are baked to a fabulous finish, they're crushed and mixed with vegetable oils and turned into a spread.   

Spread it on bagels or waffles. Use it as a dip for pretzels or apple slices. Melt in the microwave and pour it over ice cream. Or turn the classic peanut butter & jelly on its head, by swapping the p.b. for Cookie Butter and the jelly for tart Raspberry Preserves. Trader Joe's Sliced French Brioche bread turns this into an especially soft treat of a sandwich.

steps.text: Slather once slice of brioche with cookie butter.
Slather the other slice of brioche with raspberry preserves.
Arranged sliced bananas atop cookie butter and close sandwich.
Enjoy!

cookie-butter-dessert-sandwich.title: Cookie Butter Sandwich

corn-chip-dipper-chili-pie.description:
If you're wondering why Trader Joe's Organic Corn Chip Dippers made our not-scientific-but-still-pretty-accurate list of Crew Member Favorites, you probably haven't tried these delightfully crunchy, dippable chips-something you should change very soon. They're made with a mere three ingredients: organic corn, organic sunflower oil, and salt. That's it!     

On top of their simple ingredient list and captivating crunch, they function perfectly as the edible little corn version of a spoon. Dip them into queso, salsa, or guac. Or use the bag as a bowl of sorts, and top these Dippers with warmed chili, shredded cheese and TJ's Hot & Sweet Jalapeños for comforting, cold weather fare that's ready in mere minutes!
ingredients: 1 bag TJ's Organic Corn Chip Dippers
1 can TJ's Organic Vegetarian Chili, heated according to package directions
TJ's Shredded Three Cheese Mexican Blend

steps.text: Spread corn chip dippers in a shallow layer on a serving platter. Top with warmed chili, cheese, and jalapeños. Enjoy!
steps.title: To serve on a platter:

steps.text:
Lay the closed bag of corn chip dippers flat on a clean work surface. Using a sharp pair of scissors, cut the corn chip dipper bag in half crosswise, so that each half of the bag contains dippers (even the portions out if necessary). Roll the cut edges of each side down to create "bowls."   

Top the dippers with warmed chili, cheese, and jalapeños to taste. Dig in!
steps.title: To serve in bag "bowls":

corn-chip-dipper-chili-pie.title: Corn Chip Dipper Chili Pie

corn-salsa-salad.description: With creamy avocado, kicky salsa, and snappy sugar plum tomatoes, this side salad can pull double duty as a chunky dip for your favorite Trader Joe's Tortilla Chips.
ingredients: 1 jar TJ's Corn and Chile Tomato-less Salsa
1 can TJ's Black Beans, drained and rinsed
1/2 container TJ's fresh Sugar Plum Tomatoes, halved
1/4 teaspoon TJ's Sea Salt, or to taste
1/4 teaspoon TJ's Ground Black Pepper, or to taste

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in a bowl and toss with dressing.
Add salt and pepper, to taste.
Refrigerate for at least one hour to marry flavors.

corn-salsa-salad.title: Corn Salsa Salad

cornbread-ed-fish-tacos.description:
Celebrated for its cake-y, crumbly texture when baked, and its sweet flavor profile that’s amplified by the addition of actual corn kernels in the mix, Trader Joe's Cornbread Mix demonstrates its versatility as an unexpected (and awesome) bread coating. With this revelatory information, let's make fish tacos with TJ's Cod Fillets! 

These tacos are further enhanced with a quick Elote Lime Crema, that's not only a flavorful serving sauce, it's used as part of the dredging process (doubly awesome!)

Pro-tip: To ensure a crispy exterior, make sure the oil is hot before adding the breaded fish to the pan; and once you place the fish in the pan, leave them undisturbed until you're ready to flip.
ingredients: 1 cup TJ's Plain Whole Milk Greek Yogurt
3 tablespoons juice & 1 teaspoon zest from 1 TJ's Lime, plus 1 more lime, sliced into wedges
6 tablespoons TJ's Everything But the Elote Seasoning, divided
2 tablespoons chopped TJ's Fresh Cilantro, plus more to garnish
1 1/4- 1 1/2 pounds TJ's Cod Fillets, cut into one-inch thick strips
1/4 cup TJ's Japanese Style Panko Breadcrumbs or TJ's Organic Bread Crumbs
1 cup TJ's Organic Cole Slaw Mix

steps.text:
In a medium-sized bowl, combine Greek yogurt, lime juice and zest, three tablespoons Everything But the Elote Seasoning, cilantro, and a half teaspoon salt.

Pour half of the crema into into a smaller bowl, cover, and refrigerate until ready to serve. Leave the remaining half in the medium-sized bowl to coat the fish.
steps.title: Make Elote Lime Crema

steps.text:
Lightly season cod with salt, then add to the medium-sized bowl of crema. Toss to coat. 

In a separate bowl, whisk cornbread mix, breadcrumbs, and remaining three tablespoons of Everything But the Elote Seasoning until thoroughly combined.

Toss a piece of cod in the cornbread mixture, patting to thoroughly coat. Then place on a plate and repeat with remaining fish.
steps.title: Bread the Fish

steps.text: Preheat a large sauté pan over medium heat and add enough oil to coat the bottom of the pan. When the oil is hot, add a few pieces of fish at a time, and cook 2-3 minutes per side, until crisp and golden brown.
steps.title: Fry the Fish

steps.text: Add about 1/4 cup of slaw atop each warmed tortilla. Top with a piece of fish and drizzle with reserved crema. Serve with cilantro and wedge of lime.
steps.title: Build Your Fish Tacos

cornbread-ed-fish-tacos.title: Cornbread-ed Fish Tacos

cottage-cheesy-lemon-freezy.description:
Breakfast. Snack. Dip. Pasta sauce. Eggs. Pancakes. Casseroles. Lasagna. Is there anything Trader Joe's Small Curd Cottage Cheese can’t do? Made from grade-A pasteurized whole milk, our Cottage Cheese is thick and creamy, with a tangy, slightly sweet flavor profile that’s tasty enough to be enjoyed on its own, and mild enough to pair up with all kinds of other foods—savory or sweet.

This cottage cheesy-treat takes the sweet route, combined with TJ's Lemon Curd, Meyer Lemon Cookie Thins, and Dry Roasted and Salted Almonds. With the help of a food processor (a blender works, too!), the base comes together in under twenty minutes!
ingredients: 1 quart TJ’s Small Curd Cottage Cheese
1 sleeve TJ’s Meyer Lemon Cookie Thins, gently crushed into irregular-sized pieces
1 cup TJ’s Dry Roasted & Salted Almonds, roughly chopped

steps.text: Empty the jar of lemon curd into a large bowl. Stir with a spatula to smooth out.
Add cottage cheese to the bowl of a food processor. Blend until smooth, scraping down the bowl intermittently to ensure a uniformly smooth texture.
Transfer the smooth cottage cheese to the bowl, and gently fold into the lemon curd, leaving some ribbons of lemon curd throughout.
Add the crushed cookies and chopped almonds into the mixture and fold to combine.
Pour into a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan or any freezer-safe container, cover, and freeze until firm, about 4 hours.

cottage-cheesy-lemon-freezy.title: Cottage Cheesy Lemon Freezy

cowboy-quinoa-bake.description: After ten years, you’d expect some products to be riding off into the sunset—but not Trader Joe’s Cowboy Caviar Salsa! It’s loosely based on a legendary cult classic developed in the 1930s, which included black-eyed peas and pickled onions. In our version, we’ve wrangled the likes of yellow corn, black beans, red bell peppers, onions, and jalapeños to create a chunky, flavorful base. These legumes & veggies are pickled with chipotle peppers in lime juice and a tangy adobo sauce that includes vinegar, tomato purée, onion, garlic, savory spices, and just a touch of cane sugar to round out the flavor. Our Cowboy Caviar Salsa is an outstanding dip for chips, and it’s equally excellent as the base of this Southwestern-style, meat-free casserole.
ingredients: 1 cup Trader Joe's Organic Tricolor Quinoa, dry
1 can TJ's Organic Diced & Fire Roasted Tomatoes
1 1/2 cups TJ's Mexican Blend Shredded Cheese, divided
Organic Extra Virgin Olive Oil Spray, to grease pan
1 TJ’s Avocado, pitted, peeled, and chopped

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F. Add quinoa and 2 cups water to a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil and reduce to a simmer. Cover and cook for 15 minutes, until water is completely absorbed. Turn off heat and fluff quinoa with a fork.

In a large bowl, fold together cooked quinoa, Cowboy Caviar, diced tomatoes and 1 cup of the shredded cheese, just until mixed. Grease an 8-inch square baking pan with olive oil spray and spread mixture into pan. Top with remaining ½ cup cheese and bake for 25 minutes, then turn broiler on high and cook 5 more minutes, until cheese begins to brown. Remove from oven and let cool 5 minutes.
Top with chopped avocado and cilantro. Serve each portion with a dollop of sour cream and a lime wedge.

cowboy-quinoa-bake.title: Cowboy Quinoa Bake

cozy-tortellini-soup.description:
Trader Joe's Spinach Tortellini are like little pasta pockets stuffed with a flavorful mix of spinach, ricotta, mozzarella and Parmesan. And because they are fresh, not dried, they cook in 2-3 minutes. Yes!

Our Spinach Tortellini are spectacular in soups—brothy or creamy—and this recipe is a little bit of both. By blending the cooked vegetables with the heated broth, the result is thicker than your typical broth-based soup, without the addition of any cream.

Pro-tip: Save your Parmesan rinds! After you’ve grated the very last bit of your favorite Trader Joe’s Parmesan block, you can use the rind to enhance soups and sauces. If you won’t be cooking with it right away, seal it and freeze until needed.
ingredients: 1 carton TJ’s Organic Free Range Chicken Broth
1 cheese rind from a block of your favorite TJ’s Parmesan, optional
A few cranks of TJ’s Sea Salt
A handful of chopped TJ's Fresh Parsley, for ganish
A drizzle of your favorite TJ's Extra Virgin Olive Oil

steps.text: To a large pot, add mirepoix, garlic, broth and Parmesan rind (if using) over high heat. When it reaches a boil, lower the heat to medium low and simmer until the vegetables become tender, about 20 minutes. Discard Parmesan rind. Remove soup from heat.
Carefully blend the broth with the vegetables using an immersion blender in the pot, or by pouring the contents into a stand blender and blending until smooth. Pour contents back into pot.
Return pot to medium-high heat and bring to a boil. And tortellini to the pot and cook for two minutes. Remove pot from heat, then season with salt.
Divide among bowls. Sprinkle with cheese, garnish with chopped parsley, and drizzle with olive oil to serve.

cozy-tortellini-soup.title: Cozy Tortellini Soup

cranberry-baked-camembert-cheese.description: Interested in a soft-ripened cheese with a little more oomph? Le Rustique Camembert fits the bill. Native to Normandy, France, this Camembert is a holiday staple in the Trader Joe's cheese canon. Similar to Brie (but from a different native region of France), this creamy, pleasantly tangy, full-flavored cheese makes a fabulously fancy & festive appetizer when baked and topped with tangy Trader Joe's Cranberry Orange Relish.
ingredients: TJ's Walnuts and Fresh Rosemary, for garnish (optional)

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F. Unwrap camembert and place in the center of a small cast iron skillet or ceramic baking dish. Place on center rack of oven and bake 5-15 minutes (check every 5 minutes or so and remove from oven when cheese is oozing to your desired preference).
Top cheese with cranberry relish*. Let cool slightly and garnish with walnuts and rosemary. Serve with water crackers for dipping.
*You can add the cranberry relish prior to baking, if desired; the color and tanginess of the relish will be somewhat subdued if you go this route.

cranberry-baked-camembert-cheese.title: Cranberry Baked Camembert Cheese

cranberry-chevre-bites.description: When Trader Joe’s Cranberry Chevre makes its appearance in our cheese section, it’s a sign the holidays have arrived. Each log of creamy, tart goat cheese is rolled in sweetened, dried cranberries—a revelatory combination of flavors that’s wonderful served right out of the package with crisp crackers, and equally irresistible when baked atop a square of TJ’s Puff Pastry. This recipe is low lift with high reward—just remember to give yourself time to thaw the puff pastry beforehand!
ingredients: 1 box TJ’s Puff Pastry (two sheets), thawed according to package instructions
1 log TJ’s Cranberry Chevre Goat Cheese
A couple sprigs of TJ’s Thyme, to garnish

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F and prepare a large baking sheet with parchment paper or a reusable silicone baking mat.
Lay each puff pastry sheet flat on your work surface. Cut each sheet into 12 squares.
Top each square with a thin slice of Cranberry Chevre, then gently arrange on the baking sheet.
Crack egg into a small bowl and whisk. Using a pastry brush or tines of a fork, brush the exposed puff pastry with the egg.
Bake for 10-12 minutes, until puffed and golden.
Remove leaves from thyme stem, and sprinkle over Cranberry Chevre Bites to serve.

cranberry-chevre-bites.title: Cranberry Chevre Bites

cranberry-endives.description: Pair with a glass of chilled sparkling wine for a simple yet sophisticated appetizer.
ingredients: 1 pkg TJ's Red & White Belgian Endives
1 log TJ's Cranberry Chevre (seasonal), softened to room temperature

steps.text: Separate whole endive leaves from the base, rinse and pat dry.
Spread cheese evenly on the individual endive leaves, then sprinkle with sliced almonds for garnish and a little crunch.

cranberry-endives.title: Cranberry Endives

cranberry-orange-cornbread.description: Trader Joe's Gluten Free Cornbread Mix has the same classically moist & grainy texture, and sweet, buttery, corn flavor as our traditional cornbread mix—but without gluten (brown rice flour substitutes for wheat flour in this version). We've pumped it up by adding orange zest and fresh cranberries to bring a tangy-tart flair.
ingredients: 1 package TJ's Gluten Free Cornbread Mix (seasonal)
1 cup halved TJ's Organic Fresh Cranberries (seasonal)

steps.text: Preheat oven to 375°F. Grease a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan, set aside.
Add egg, oil and milk to a large mixing bowl and beat. Add cornbread mix and mix well for 2 to 3 minutes. Add orange zest and cranberries and mix until combine.
Pour batter into prepared loaf pan.
Bake on the center rack of oven for 40 - 50 minutes or until golden brown and a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Remove from oven and let cool. Enjoy.

cranberry-orange-cornbread.title: Cranberry Orange Cornbread

cranberry-pistachio-cheese-balls.description:
This easy appetizer recipe imbues the classic holiday cheese ball with jubilant pops of red & green and a Trader Joe’s twist: tangy Cranberry Chevre!

Plan accordingly—the cheese mixture requires two hours of resting time in the fridge before assembly!
ingredients: 1 teaspoon juice from a TJ’s Lemon
3/4 cup TJ’s Dry Roasted & Salted Pistachio Nutmeats, crushed into small pieces
1/4 cup TJ’s Dried Cranberries, very finely diced

steps.text: Add cheeses, lemon juice, and salt to food processor bowl. Pulse to bring mixture together, scraping down sides of bowl as needed. Continue to process until mixture is smooth, 1-2 minutes.

Lay a square of cling wrap large enough to cover cheese ball on work surface. Scoop cheese mixture into center of wrap, then gather wrap up on all sides, gently shaping the mixture into a ball. Twist the ends of the cling wrap tightly and refrigerate 2 hours or overnight.
Arrange pistachios and cranberries on a clean work surface. Remove cheese ball from fridge and unwrap.
Scoop a heaping teaspoon of cheese mixture and gently roll into a ball shape. Coat with pistachios and cranberries. Repeat with remaining ingredients. Refrigerate cheese balls until ready to serve.
Serve as-is, with toothpicks, or even pretzel sticks!

cranberry-pistachio-cheese-balls.title: Cranberry Pistachio Cheese Balls

creamy-chicken-gnocchi-soup.description: This recipe for Creamy Chicken Gnocchi Soup comes straight from a Crew Member's kitchen. Simmer Trader Joe's Kettle Cooked Chicken Soup with a package of shelf-stable Gnocchi and a container of shelf-stable Whipping Cream (shout out to pantry essentials!), and you could be serving it in your kitchen in 10 minutes-yes, you read that right. Serving Trader Joe's Organic French Rolls with a bowl of this creamy, chicken dumpling-esque soup isn't required, but it's absolutely recommended.
ingredients: 2 tubs TJ's Kettle Cooked Chicken Soup

steps.text: Easy Peasy: Add all ingredients to a medium saucepan. Heat over medium and bring to a simmer. Simmer 10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Garnish with fresh thyme and serve.

creamy-chicken-gnocchi-soup.title: Creamy Chicken Gnocchi Soup

creamy-dreamy-hummus-with-roasted-baby-b.description: Elevating a side of roasted Baby Broccoli is as simple as serving it atop a generous swoosh of Trader Joe’s Creamy Dreamy Hummus. This tahini-forward hummus boasts a texture so thick, rich, and exquisitely Creamy that it’s simply Dreamy.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon of your favorite TJ’s Extra Virgin Olive Oil
Juice of ½ a TJ’s Lemon
¼ cup TJ’s Crumbled Feta Cheese with Mediterranean Herbs

steps.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Arrange baby broccoli on a sheet pan and toss with olive oil. Season with salt. Roast in the oven for 15-20 minutes, or until it softens and begins to char. Remove from oven and drizzle with lemon juice.
On a large plate, spoon an even, thick layer of hummus. Top with roasted broccoli, a pinch of crushed red pepper, and sprinkle with feta cheese to serve.

creamy-dreamy-hummus-with-roasted-baby-b.title: Creamy Dreamy Hummus with Roasted Baby Broccoli

creamy-dreamy-whipped-ricotta-toast.description:
What, exactly, makes Trader Joe’s Creamy Dreamy Whipped Ricotta Cheese so Creamy and so Dreamy? Could it be the rich, full-flavored, whole milk with which the Ricotta is made? Could it be its light, airy, cloud-like consistency? Could it be the ease with which it spreads over toast? The answer, of course, is a resounding, triumphant “all of the above”! 

Consider this recipe, then follow your heart! Use it as inspiration to create an array of Dreamy Ricotta toast combinations: In an extra sweet mood? Try TJ’s Braided & Sliced Brioche instead of Sourdough. How about Organic Apricot Preserves instead of Raspberry? Yum! Prefer Walnuts? Go nuts! If you have a bottle of TJ’s 100% Pure Maple Syrup in your refrigerator, drizzle away!
ingredients: 4 slices from your favorite TJ’s Sourdough Bread

steps.text: Melt butter in a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Add bread and cook 1-2 minutes per side, until golden. Transfer toast to a plate.
Slather ¼ cup of ricotta over each slice of toast. Add a dollop of raspberry preserves, or a handful of pistachios and a drizzle of honey to serve.

creamy-dreamy-whipped-ricotta-toast.title: Creamy Dreamy Whipped Ricotta Toast

creamy-mango-chutney-dip-crispy-shallots.description:
Trader Joe’s Sri Lankan Organic Mango Chutney is made with chunks of organic mango in a thick, yet smooth and spreadable base of organic cane sugar and organic coconut sap vinegar, seasoned with a suite of awesomely aromatic (and organic!) spices and seasonings that includes cinnamon, cardamom, chili powder, and garlic. Every taste of this Chutney is simultaneously sweet, spicy, and tangy, and brings a captivatingly complex hit of flavor to everything from curries and charcuterie boards, to sandwiches and samosas, to roti wraps and roasted meats.

For a cool and creamy, downright easy dip, add a big spoonful to your favorite plain TJ’s yogurt. For a little textural variety, top with a handful umami-rich, ultra-crispy fried shallots, and serve with your favorite TJ’s flatbread or TJ’s Mini Vegetable Samosas!
ingredients: 1 TJ’s Shallot, sliced into thin rings
1 cup of your favorite plain TJ’s Yogurt
½ cup TJ’s Sri Lankan Organic Mango Chutney

steps.text: In a small saucepan, heat oil over medium heat. Add sliced shallot and cook, stirring often, until they become golden, about 7-10 minutes. Using a fine mesh strainer or a slotted spoon, strain shallots from oil. They will crisp as they cool. Reserve oil for another use.
On a large plate, spread yogurt across the surface. Top with chutney, and sprinkle with crispy shallots, to serve.

creamy-mango-chutney-dip-crispy-shallots.title: Creamy Mango Chutney Dip with Crispy Shallots

creamy-pesto-chicken--broccoli-bow-tie-p.description: You might be dining in your jammies tonight (#JOEMO!), but this classy entrée brings the bow ties anyway! Don't let elegant neckwear fool you, though-this Creamy Pesto Chicken & Broccoli Bow Tie Pasta is seriously a cinch to whip up.
ingredients: 1 cup TJ's Roasted & Salted Pecan Halves
1/2 package TJ's Organic Broccoli Florets (fresh not frozen)

steps.text: Bring a medium pot of salted water to a boil. Add pasta to boiling water. Cook uncovered, stirring occasionally for about 7-10 minutes. Remove pasta and drain thoroughly. Place back in empty pot.
Cook broccoli according to package instructions. Chop broccoli and chicken into bite-sized pieces; chop or smash pecans into smaller pieces.

Add pesto, mascarpone, broccoli, chicken, pecans, and salt to pasta and mix until thoroughly combined. If needed, place pot back on burner and mix over low heat instead. (Heat will soften the mascarpone, making it easier to work with.)
Serve and enjoy!

creamy-pesto-chicken--broccoli-bow-tie-p.title: Creamy Pesto Chicken & Broccoli Bow Tie Pasta

crispy-garlic-adorned-bok-choy.description: With Trader Joe’s Crispy Garlic, you can enjoy the delicately fried, crunchy-yet-melt-in-your-mouth quality of fried garlic, without the slicing and frying that’s usually required to prepare them from scratch. All you need to do is open the bag! Sprinkle them on an array of dishes, from pizzas, pasta, and scrambled eggs, to stir-fries, salads, and these seared and steamed TJ’s Baby Shanghai Bok Choy.
ingredients: 1 package TJ’s Baby Shanghai Bok Choy, washed and sliced in half lengthwise

steps.text: Heat a grill pan or cast-iron over medium-high heat, then add oil. Once the oil is hot, add the bok choy, cut side down, and sear for 2-3 minutes.
Add water and coconut aminos, cover pan with lid and reduce heat to medium low. Steam until the bok choy becomes tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove lid and continue to cook until almost all of the liquid has evaporated, another minute or two.
Using tongs, remove bok choy from pan, onto a platter. Drizzle with toasted sesame oil and top with crispy garlic to serve.

crispy-garlic-adorned-bok-choy.title: Crispy Garlic-Adorned Bok Choy

crispy-prosciutto-crostini.description:
When appetizers are in order, Trader Joe’s Sliced Prosciutto is nothing short of a lifesaver. It's made for us by a well-known, award-winning salumeria here in the States, who starts with high quality hams, cures them, then allows them to age slowly for 10-12 months. As the hams age, their flavor intensifies and their character builds, resulting in an umami-rich Prosciutto that is then cut into thin slices, ready for an array of edible applications.

For an easy appetizer, bake the Prosciutto slices until they crisp and use them to top these easy-peasy crostini for a crowd.
ingredients: 2 packages TJ’s Chevre Fine Herbs Goat Cheese, sliced into rounds
8-10 TJ’s Figs or TJ’s Organic Turkish Dried Figs, sliced in half

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F. Prepare two large baking sheets. To one, arrange baguette slices so they don’t overlap. To the second baking sheet, lay arrange slices of prosciutto so they don’t overlap.
Bake baguette slices for seven minutes, then remove from the oven. Bake prosciutto for 10 minutes, then remove from the oven.
To arrange the crostini, spread a layer of goat cheese over each warm baguette, add a slice of fig, then top each slice with a piece of crunchy prosciutto to serve.

crispy-prosciutto-crostini.title: Crispy Prosciutto Crostini

crispy-prosciutto-grilled-cheese.description:
The components of this grilled cheese sandwich are sure to elevate your everyday sandwich-eating experience to something truly special. Melty cheddar, crispy prosciutto, and aromatic rosemary are complemented by a generous drizzle of Trader Joe’s Glaze, bringing sweet complexity and balance to every bite.

A note on cooking temperature: While you may feel inclined to increase the temperature to speed up the cooking time, cooking your grilled cheese on medium-low heat will help ensure your bread becomes golden at the same rate that it takes the cheese to melt—we promise it’s worth the wait!
ingredients: 2 slices TJ’s New Zealand Organic Sliced Cheddar Cheese

steps.text: Crisp the prosciutto: Using a medium sized skillet, add prosciutto slices to cold pan and turn on to a medium-low heat. Cook the prosciutto for two minutes each side, then turn off the heat.

Assemble the sandwich: To build the layers of your sandwich, start with a piece of bread on your cutting board. Next, add a slice of cheese, followed by half of the chopped rosemary sprinkled evenly. Add the two slices of crisped prosciutto and sprinkle the remaining rosemary over it. Add the final slice of cheese and top with the remaining slice of bread.

Cook the sandwich: Return the heat to medium low, add half of the butter to the pan, until it melts and begins to bubble. Add the sandwich and cook for 4-5 minutes, until the bread is golden, the cheese begins to melt. Add the remaining butter to the pan and flip the sandwich, cover and cook for another 4-5 minutes.
Drizzle with glaze and cut in half to serve.

crispy-prosciutto-grilled-cheese.title: Crispy Prosciutto Grilled Cheese

croque-monsieur-bread-pudding.description: We challenged Trader Joe's Crew Members across the country to a Recipe Contest, inviting them to create their own delicious dishes using no more than five TJ's ingredients. We were WOW-ed by the submissions! This recipe won Honorable Mention, and was created by Kyra Lewis from Store #627 in Lexington, Kentucky.
ingredients: ½ teaspoon TJ’s Organic Cane Sugar
3 TJ’s Eggs and 2 Egg Yolks, whisked together
1 package TJ’s Cave Aged Switzerland Le Gruyère Cheese, grated
8 slices TJ’s Uncured Black Forest Ham, sliced into ½ inch ribbons

steps.text: Heat oven to 375°F and bake crescent rolls according to package instructions. Let crescent rolls cool and decrease oven heat 350°F.
Combine milk, butter, sugar, and salt in a saucepan and warm over low heat, just until butter melts. Let cool.
While milk cools, cut or tear each crescent roll into 3 or 4 equal pieces and place in an 8x8 baking dish. Add grated cheese and ham ribbons; toss to combine.
Whisk eggs into cooled milk mixture and pour over the baking dish.
Allow to sit and soak for at least 15 minutes, or up to half an hour, then gently fold ingredients so that all contents are coated thoroughly and evenly. Sprinkle with black pepper.
Place in oven and bake for 40-45 minutes, until bread edges are slightly browned.
Serve warm and enjoy! Bon Appétit!

croque-monsieur-bread-pudding.title: Croque Monsieur Bread Pudding

crunchy-air-fried-edamame.description:
Trader Joe’s Edamame with Sea Salt comes pre-cooked and pre-seasoned, so they’re ready to be eaten right out of the package—as a snack, in salads and grain bowls, as a side to sushi… Or if you’re craving some crunch, employ an air fryer!

Pro-tip: Customize air-fried edamame with your favorite TJ’s seasoning blend! Simply add a sprinkle or two and toss in your serving bowl. TJ’s Ranch Seasoning Blend, Nori Komi Furikake, Taco Seasoning Mix… oh, the possibilities!
ingredients: 2 tablespoons of your favorite TJ’s Olive Oil
1 package TJ’s Shelled Edamame with Sea Salt

steps.text: Preheat air fryer to 400°F.
Remove edamame from packaging and onto a dish or paper towel and pat dry. Place in a medium-sized bowl and drizzle with oil. Toss until evenly coated.
Add to air fryer basket and fry for 15 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through.
Pour into a bowl and sprinkle with salt. Serve immediately.

crunchy-air-fried-edamame.title: Crunchy Air-Fried Edamame

crunchy-chili-onion-compound-butter.description:
Made from a smoky, savory mixture of crunchy garlic, onion, peppers and olive oil, Trader Joe’s Crunchy Chili Onion ranks high in the “great on everything” hall of fame. It's equally great when combined with TJ's Unsalted Butter to make this easy yet impressive compound butter that adds a whole lot of complexity to an array of dishes. Spread it over TJ's Dinner Rolls, add a pat to mashed potatoes, and use it to flavor and baste your TJ's All-Natural Turkey for Thanksgiving! 

Pro-tip: Prepare the compound butter up to one week in advance. Once it's been prepped, stick it in the fridge to firm up, then it's ready whenever you need it!

steps.text: To the bowl of a small food processor, add softened butter and Crunchy Chili Onion. Pulse for about 30 seconds until completely combined. Alternatively, add both to a medium-sized bowl and use a spatula to fold the Crunchy Chili Onion into the softened butter until completely combined.

Add butter to the center of a sheet of parchment paper, placing it in a mound. Lift the bottom half of the parchment paper up and over the butter so the mound is now at the bottom of the parchment. Begin at the bottom of the parchment where the butter is, and roll the parchment upward to form it into a log. Twist the ends to the butter is completely enclosed.
Refrigerate until firm.

crunchy-chili-onion-compound-butter.title: Crunchy Chili Onion Compound Butter

crunchy-tacos.description: We asked one of our snack suppliers to channel their masterful masa skills and create Trader Joe's Organic Stone Ground Yellow Corn Taco Shells for us, and they really came through. The classic, hard-shell-taco shape is ideal for filling with ground chicken or beef, shredded cheese & lettuce, salsa, and guacamole to ensure a stellar—or might we say, "shellar"—taco night.
ingredients: 3 teaspoons tablespoon TJ's Canola Oil or Olive Oil
1 lb. TJ's Ground Chicken or Ground Beef
1/2 packet TJ's Taco Seasoning Mix (use the whole packet if you like it really spicy)
1 package TJ's Organic Stone Ground Yellow Corn Taco Shells
1 package TJ's Fancy Shredded Mexican Cheese Blend
1 jar TJ's Organic Thick & Chunky Salsa
1/2 of a TJs Red Onion, diced
2 Ripe TJ's Avocados, peeled and cubed

steps.text: Heat oil in a heavy saucepan over medium-high heat. Add the ground chicken and taco seasoning mix. Sauté for 7-10 minutes, until chicken is cooked through.
Fill taco shells with chicken, and top with cheese, sour cream, salsa, onion, avocado, and jalapeños. Repeat until satisfied.

crunchy-tacos.title: Crunchy Tacos

cuban-style-roasted-pork-tenderloin.description: Inspired by all the marvelous mojo-marinated meat we've enjoyed over the years, Trader Joe's Cuban Style Citrusy Garlic Seasoning Blend is, as its name would suggest, traditionally tangy, good-n-garlicky, and downright delicious. Rub onto poultry, meat, fish, or tofu and roast to your heart's content. Stir it into a bowl of beans and rice. Or, try your hand at this marinade recipe for a tangy twist on a roast pork tenderloin.
ingredients: 3 teaspoons TJ's Cuban Style Citrusy Garlic Seasoning Blend, divided
3/4 cup TJ's Canola Oil or Sunflower Oil
1/2 cup juice from TJ's Fresh Citrus (we used the juice of 1 orange, 1 lemon, and 1 lime)
1 TJ's All Natural Crate Free Pork Tenderloin

steps.text: Combine 1 teaspoon seasoning, canola oil, and citrus juice in a zip-top bag. Add pork to bag, seal, and gently massage in marinade. Refrigerate 4 to 6 hours.
Preheat oven to 375°F. Remove pork from marinade and pat dry with paper towels. Rub pork with remaining seasoning.
Transfer pork to a rimmed baking sheet and bake on center rack of oven for 30-35 minutes, to an internal temperature of 145°F. Let rest 10 minutes prior to slicing.
While pork is cooking, add beans to a saucepan, cover, and warm over low heat, stirring occasionally.
While pork is resting, microwave rice according to package directions. Transfer to a serving bowl and stir in chopped cilantro.
Slice pork into medallions and plate alongside beans and rice. Garnish beans with cheese and serve.

cuban-style-roasted-pork-tenderloin.title: Cuban Style Roasted Pork Tenderloin

cucumber-tea-sandwiches.description:
Trader Joe’s Organic Persian Cucumbers are small, sweet, and seedless, with thin skins that don’t require peeling, making them our cucumber of choice for these diminutive, delicate tea sandwiches. Herby, creamy, and oh-so-cute, these cucumber sandwiches are exceptional for a tea party, picnic, or quick, no-cook snack.

Pro-tip: Don’t discard the crusts! Cut them in half, toss them on a baking sheet with a drizzle of olive oil and a sprinkle of your favorite TJ’s Seasoning Blend, and bake in a 350°F oven for 7-10 minutes for DIY croutons.
ingredients: 2 TJ’s Organic Persian Cucumbers, thinly sliced into coins and patted dry
1 tub (8 ounces) TJ’s Whipped Cream Cheese
A couple cranks of TJ’s Black Peppercorns
8 slices of TJ’s Sliced White Bread, crusts removed

steps.text:
Make the cream cheese spread:
Combine cream cheese with chopped herbs, lemon juice, and black pepper in a medium-sized bowl. Use a spoon to thoroughly mix.

Assemble the sandwiches:
Spread cream cheese over one side of each slice of bread. Lay half of bread on a cutting board, cream cheese side up. Add two layers of cucumbers, then top with remaining slices of bread, cream cheese side down. Cut each sandwich into quarters.

cucumber-tea-sandwiches.title: Cool as a Cucumber Tea Sandwiches

cumin-y-riced-cauliflower.description: Spiced but not spicy, this savory riced cauliflower side dish is excellent alongside falafel or Trader Joe's Chicken Shawarma.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon TJ's Organic Extra Virgin Coconut Oil

steps.text: In a large skillet, heat coconut oil over medium-high heat. Add diced onions and sauté 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add riced cauliflower to skillet and sauté another 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add cumin and sauté another two minutes, until fragrant. Season to taste with salt and serve immediately.

cumin-y-riced-cauliflower.title: Cumin-y Riced Cauliflower

curried-cauliflower-gnocchi.description: As we've said before, any way is a good way to dress up Trader Joe's Cauliflower Gnocchi. With earthy butternut squash, green peas, and zesty, ginger-forward yellow curry sauce, this recipe is likely to gnoc your socks off...
ingredients: 2 tablespoons TJ's Olive Oil or Ghee
Handful TJ's Fresh Basil, chopped, for garnish

steps.text: Add squash and curry sauce to large sauce pot with a lid. Bring to a boil, reduce to a simmer and cover. Cook 10 minutes.
Remove lid, add peas and stir. Cover and simmer 5-10 minutes more, until squash is fork-tender.
While sauce simmers, heat 2 tablespoons oil, butter, or ghee in sauté pan over medium heat. Add gnocchi and heat for 7 to 10 minutes, until golden brown.
Transfer cooked gnocchi to sauce pot and toss to coat.
Divide gnocchi among plates. Garnish with basil and crumbled garlic naan crackers and serve.

curried-cauliflower-gnocchi.title: Curried Cauliflower Gnocchi

curry-chicken-pot-pie.description:
One of the best things about comfort food is, of course, its ability to provide comfort... one of the lesser-discussed benefits is its flexibility. Take chicken pot pie, for example. You may have a favorite version, your best friend may have a different favorite, and yet, they all bring comfort.     

In the spirit of comfort and flexibility, we're quite keen on this Curry Chicken Pot Pie recipe. Chunks of chicken and veggies, bathed in a yellow curry sauce, all enveloped in a flaky, buttery Trader Joe's Pie Crust. It's creamy and savory, with just a smidge of heat. It's classic fare with an international attitude. It's a decidedly Trader Joe's take on tradition. And you know what? That's pretty darn comforting.
ingredients: 1 package TJ's Gourmet Pie Crusts, defrosted in the refrigerator
1 bottle TJ's Thai Yellow Curry Sauce

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400ºF. Unroll crusts, leaving plastic sleeves in place, and smooth together any cracks in the dough. Using a small cereal bowl and juice glass as your guides, cut out 5 small circles and 5 medium circles from the dough. Cut a small vent hole in each of the small circles and place them in refrigerator.

Line each ramekin with with a medium-sized dough circle and place on rimmed baking sheet. Poke holes in the crusts with a sharp knife. Place sheet on center rack of oven and par-bake crusts 10-15 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside.

Remove small pie crust circles from refrigerator. Add organic foursome and onions to a microwave-safe bowl and microwave 1 minute on high. Add chicken and curry sauce to bowl and gently stir to combine. Divide mixture among ramekins and top each with a small pie crust circle.
Return baking sheet to oven and bake 20-30 minutes, or until crusts are golden and filling is bubbling. Remove from oven and let cool 5 minutes prior to serving.
Recipe Credit: Trader Joe's 2011 HiiP Recipe Showdown Winner - Linda Wang.

curry-chicken-pot-pie.title: Curry Chicken Pot Pie

curtido.description: Trader Joe’s Organic Shredded Green & Red Cabbage with Orange Carrots is a colorful, crunchy blend, suitable for making superior slaws—simply add your favorite dressing and toss. If you happen to partake in a little quick-pickling, it makes a great starting point for curtido, the tangy cabbage slaw that’s primarily served atop a pile of pupusas. This Curtido is light and bright with a pleasant, subtle heat, and easily enhances tacos, hamburgers, and hot chicken sandwiches.
ingredients: 1 bag TJ’s Organic Shredded Green & Red Cabbage with Orange Carrots
½ TJ’s Yellow Onion, thinly sliced
¼ cup chopped TJ’s Hot & Sweet Jalapeño Peppers
½ cup TJ’s Raw Apple Cider Vinegar

steps.text: In a large bowl, add shredded cabbage blend, sliced onion, and Hot & Sweet Jalapeños.
In a small bowl, combine apple cider vinegar, oregano, and salt. Stir until salt dissolves.
Pour the vinegar mixture over the cabbage. Use tongs to thoroughly toss.
Let sit 30 minutes to meld the flavors. Alternatively, cover bowl and refrigerate overnight to enhance the flavor and texture.

curtido.title: Curtido

dalgona-coffee.description: Dalgona coffee is the "be-your-own-barista" beverage that's been sweeping social media during this past season of staying home. Stateside, it seemed like this four-ingredient, whipped wonder sprung onto the scene suddenly, but in its native South Korea, dalgona is nothing new. Either way, as it turns out, our super-soluble Trader Joe's Instant Coffee is an ideal ingredient for this cool, creamy, coffee concoction!
ingredients: TJ's Unsweetened Non-Dairy Hemp Beverage (or milk, or your favorite non-dairy beverage)

steps.text: Combine coffee & sugar in a mixing bowl and add hot water. Using a round whisk or an electric hand mixer set on high, whip vigorously until mixture appears light & fluffy (about 2-3 minutes if whipping by hand).
Fill a glass with ice. Add milk or non-dairy beverage until glass is approx. 3/4 full. Fill remainder of glass with fluffy coffee mixture, top with an optional sprinkle of cinnamon, and enjoy!
Here's a fun video showing the process.

dalgona-coffee.title: Dalgona Coffee

dark-chocolate-chip-protein-pancakes.description: Trader Joe’s No Sugar Added Dark Chocolate Chips are made with flavorful dark chocolate from Colombia, as well as sugar-free allulose and rich cocoa butter. They can be used in any recipe or situation that calls for chocolate chips, from dependable desserts like chocolate chip cookies, brownies, blondie bars, muffins, and banana breads, to break-out breakfasts like these quick, no added sugar, protein-packed pancakes made with TJ’s Buttermilk Protein Pancake Mix.
ingredients: 1 cup TJ’s Buttermilk Protein Pancake Mix
½ cup TJ’s No Sugar Added Dark Chocolate Chips
1 cup TJ’s Vegan Heavy Whipping Cream Alternative, whipped according to package instructions, or TJ’s Heavy Whipping Cream whipped to soft peak-stage

steps.text: Combine pancake mix and water in a medium sized bowl, and whisk until just combined. Add chocolate chips and gently fold into batter.

Heat pan or griddle over medium heat. Add about ¼ cup of batter per pancake to pan. Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the edges begin to dry, then flip and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes before removing from pan.
Top with fresh strawberries and a dollop of whipped cream.

dark-chocolate-chip-protein-pancakes.title: Dark Chocolate Chip Protein Pancakes

date-shake.description: Though they never met a blue cheese crumble or roasted almond they didn't like, California-grown Trader Joe's Organic Dried & Pitted Deglet Noors aren’t just for stuffing. Blend them into this decidedly sweet date shake, an ode to the classic dessert found at date farms & ice cream shops dotting Southern California’s Coachella Valley.
ingredients: 1 bag TJ's Organic Dried & Pitted Deglet Noor Dates, roughly chopped
2 cups TJ's Super Premium French Vanilla Ice Cream

steps.text: Add dates and milk to a blender. Cover and pulse ingredients together on low to combine, then blend on high until smooth and uniform. Add ice cream and blend until combined, another minute or so, stopping to scrape the sides of the pitcher as needed. Divide shake between two glasses and enjoy!

date-shake.title: Date Shake

daylight-savings-sundae.description: Trader Joe's Super Premium Pumpkin Ice Cream is thicker and creamier than other ice creams because we don't whip excess air into our product, and we use just the right amount of butterfat to ensure that every spoonful tastes rich and delicious. Top it with crumbled Speculoos Cookies and Candied Pecans for an out-of-this-gourd frozen dessert experience.
ingredients: TJ's Super Premium Pumpkin Ice Cream

steps.text: Crumble a couple of speculoos cookies into a serving bowl.
Scoop ice cream on top of cookies and top with more cookies and handful of candied pecans.
Grab a spoon and dig in!

daylight-savings-sundae.title: Daylight Savings Sundae

delicata-pasta-salad.description: Rich, roasted delicata squash, tangy feta with pomegranate seeds, and al dente pasta set the stage for a hearty meal.
ingredients: 2 TJ's Delicata Squash, halved lenghtwise and de-seeded (or substitute 3 cups of your favorite peeled & cubed squash)
1 package TJ's Organic Brown Rice & Quinoa Fusilli Pasta

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F. Slice squash 3/4 inches thick and toss with olive oil, salt and pepper. Arrange on a large baking sheet and roast for 30-35 minutes until fork tender, tossing halfway through cooking.
While squash cooks, prepare pasta according to package directions. Drain pasta and rinse under cold water to halt the cooking process.

Divide baby lettuce among four plates and top with pasta. Top each salad with crumbled feta and pomegranate seeds. Drizzle vinaigrette atop each salad and serve immediately, with more dressing on the side.

delicata-pasta-salad.title: Delicata Squash Pasta Salad

delightfully-fiery-tofu-sheet-pan.description:
Combining the pleasantly peppery heat of our Gochujang paste with the veritable versatility of our Organic Tofu, you can think of this dish as a stir-fry by other means. It all starts with a spicy, savory, and slightly sweet sauce featuring Gochujang, Honey, Rice Vinegar, and Sesame Oil. After a quick toss with a marvelous medley of chopped Tofu, Eggplant, Onion, and Mushroom, simply spread everything out on a foil-lined sheet, and bake. While the fiery flavors of the sauce and the veggies’ spectrum of tender textures converge in the oven, your hands will be free to whip up a batch of rice or an appetizer to serve on the side.

Aside from being a handy hack for weekend meal prep, each element of this recipe can be endlessly adjusted to fit your personal preferences. If you want a little less or a little more spice, simply use less or more Gochujang. Vying for a different veggie? Try subbing one or more with Baby Corn, Bell Peppers, or Zucchini. It’s that easy!
ingredients: 13" x 18" sheet pan, lined with aluminum foil
1 package TJ’s Organic Firm Tofu, cut into ¼-inch thick strips
½ a TJ’s Eggplant, cut into ½-inch cubes
2 packages TJ’s Shiitake Mushrooms, cut into halves or quarters, depending on size
1 tablespoon TJ’s Organic Toasted Sesame Oil

steps.text: Pre-heat the oven to 400°F.
Add the gochujang, rice vinegar, honey, and sesame oil together in a small bowl. Mix until fully combined.
Add the chopped tofu, eggplant, onion, and mushrooms to a large bowl. Add the gochujang mixture to the bowl and gently mix together until the veggies and tofu are fully coated in the sauce.
On a foil-lined sheet pan, spread the sauced veggies and tofu in single layer, and place in the oven. Bake for 30 minutes.
Remove from the oven and allow to cool for 5 minutes before serving. Garnish with furikake and sliced green onion, and enjoy on its own or over rice.

delightfully-fiery-tofu-sheet-pan.title: Delightfully Fiery Tofu Sheet Pan

double-apple-oatmeal.description: Trader Joe’s Organic Unfiltered Apple Juice is sweet, tangy, and full-flavored, and excellent served served chilled on its own, warmed with a cinnamon stick, and as a mixer in a mocktail or cocktail. It’s also a standout swap-in for water when cooking oatmeal, boosting every bite with Apple flavor. Interested in adding even more Apple-y oomph to your morning oats? Serve with sautéed cinnamon apples and you’re sure to start your day with a round of Apple-ause!
ingredients: 1 ½ cups TJ’s Organic Unfiltered Apple Juice
1 TJ's Apple (your favorite varietal), chopped into small cubes

steps.text: In a medium saucepan, bring apple juice to a boil over medium-high heat. Add the oats, return to a simmer, then decrease temperature to low. Simmer for 3 minutes, then remove pot from heat, and immediately cover. Let sit covered for 5-7 minutes, until all of the liquid has been absorbed by the oatmeal.

While the oatmeal sits, in a medium-sized sauté pan, add butter over medium heat. Once melted, add cinnamon and sugar and stir to combine. Add chopped apples and sauté until softened, about 5-7 minutes. Remove from heat.
Remove lid from oatmeal pot and give it a stir. Divide between bowls, and top with sautéed apples, spooning any remaining cinnamon-sugar butter in the pan over the oatmeal to serve.

double-apple-oatmeal.title: Double-Apple Oatmeal

double-chocolate-crinkle-cookies.description:
These classic crinkle cookies are getting the double-chocolate treatment with cocoa powder in the batter and Trader Joe’s Semi-Sweet Chocolate Chunks studded throughout. Bite into one and you’ll reveal streams of gooey chocolate—yum!

Pro-tip: The key to ensuring your cookies have their signature crinkle look? A double coating of powdered sugar!
ingredients: ¾ cup TJ’s Unsweetened Cocoa Powder
1 stick TJ’s Unsalted Butter, softened to room temperature
½ cup TJ’s Organic Cane Granulated Sugar
½ cup TJ’s Organic Brown Sugar
1 teaspoon TJ’s Organic Pure Bourbon Vanilla Extract
¾ cup TJ’s Organic Powdered Sugar

steps.text: In a medium bowl, whisk together, flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Set aside.
Using a hand mixer or stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment, beat the butter with the granulated and brown sugars on medium-high speed until light and fluffy, about 10 minutes.
Add egg and vanilla and beat on medium speed until well blended, scraping down the sides of the bowl as needed.
On low speed, add the dry ingredients and mix until just combined. Fold in chocolate chunks.
Using a spoon or cookie scoop, roll rounded tablespoons of dough between your palms to form dough balls.
Cover and refrigerate dough 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 325ºF. Line 2 cookie sheets with parchment paper or silicone baking mats.

To a small bowl, add powdered sugar. Toss dough balls in powdered sugar, pressing the sugar into the dough with your hands to help adhere. Repeat step to add an extra layer of powdered sugar. Place on prepared cookie sheets, two inches apart.
Bake cookies on center rack of oven for 13 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool 10 minutes on the baking sheet before transferring to a wire cooling rack.

double-chocolate-crinkle-cookies.title: Double Chocolate Crinkle Cookies

double-dressed-arugula-burrata-salad.description:
Break open a ball of Trader Joe's Burrata, and you'll be delighted to discover soft, stretchy curds comingling with rich cream in its center, greeting you with a slightly sweet, milky aroma. Creamy and almost cloud-like, it's a cheese-lover's dream, with only the simplest accompaniment needed to allow it to shine.

Looking for palatable partners? How about fresh cantaloupe slices and balsamic vinegar? Or maybe on pizza, with tangy tomato sauce? Or perhaps with heirloom tomatoes and arugula in this quick, double-dressed sensational salad…
ingredients: ¼ cup juice TJ's Lemons (about 2 lemons)
¼ cup of your favorite TJ’s Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 container (1 pound) TJ’s Mini Heirloom Tomatoes, sliced in half
1 container or two balls of TJ's Burrata

steps.text: In a medium-sized bowl, combine lemon juice, olive oil, minced garlic, and salt. Whisk until emulsified.

In a large, shallow serving bowl, toss arugula with lemon dressing. Arrange tomato halves atop arugula. Remove cream-filled burrata balls from container, arrange atop arugula and gently break them open with your hands. Drizzle salad with glaze. Serve immediately.

double-dressed-arugula-burrata-salad.title: Double-Dressed Arugula & Burrata Salad

double-elote-crispy-chicken-tenders.description: The only thing better than elote is… Double Elote! We're doubling down on classic street-corn seasonings by combining Trader Joe’s Everything But The Elote Seasoning with our Organic Elote Corn Chip Dippers to create an irresistibly crunchy, outrageously ranch-y, double elote crust for juicy, baked organic chicken tenders. Yum!
ingredients: 1 bag Organic Elote Corn Chip Dippers
1/4 cup TJ's Unbleached Enriched All-Purpose Flour
1/4 cup TJ's Everything But The Elote Seasoning Blend
2 package TJ's Organic Boneless & Skinless Chicken Tenders
Your favorite TJ's sauce for dipping

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F. Coat baking sheet with cooking spray. Set aside.

In a food processor, crush corn dippers and place in a shallow bowl. Set aside. In a second shallow bowl, add flour and elote seasoning and whisk together until evenly mixed. Set aside. In a third shallow bowl, whisk the eggs together. Set aside.

Remove chicken from packaging. One by one, dredge each tender in flour mixture making sure chicken is thoroughly covered. Then dredge in eggs, allowing excess egg to drain. Then dredge in crushed corn dippers, lightly pressing so that chips adhere.
Arrange chicken on baking sheet, making sure to leave some space between pieces.

Place on center rack in oven and bake for 10 minutes. Use tongs to flip chicken tenders and bake for 5-8 more minutes, until internal temperature of chicken reaches 165°F and exterior is a light golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool slightly before serving.
Serve with a side of your favorite TJ's dipping sauce.

double-elote-crispy-chicken-tenders.title: Double Elote Crispy Chicken Tenders

double-peanut-stew.description: This warm, comforting stew gets hit with two delicious doses of peanut: Trader Joe’s Creamy, Salted Peanut Butter lends luscious, creamy texture, while Trader Joe’s 50% Less Salt Roasted & Salted Peanuts offer a satisfying crunch. Serve with rice or your favorite grain for a hearty one-bowl meal.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons peeled and minced TJ’s Organic Fresh Ginger
1 carton or 4 cups TJ’s Low Sodium Vegetable Broth
½ cup TJ’s Creamy Salted Peanut Butter
½ cup TJ’s Half Salt Peanuts, chopped

steps.text: In a medium-sized Dutch oven or soup pot, over medium heat, add the oil. Once hot, add onion, garlic, and ginger to pot, and sauté until softened and aromatic, about 5 minutes. Season with salt, pepper, and cayenne. Add tomato paste and cook for three minutes, until the color darkens and begins to caramelize.

Add half a cup of stock to deglaze the pan, scraping up all the bits that are stuck to the bottom with a wooden spoon or spatula, then add the rest of the stock. Next, add the peanut butter to the pot and use a spatula or whisk to incorporate it evenly into the broth.

Add the sweet potato, increase the heat to medium-high, and bring to a boil. Once it begins to bubble, bring the heat down to medium-low, cover, and simmer for 10-15 minutes, until the sweet potatoes are tender, stirring occasionally.
Remove the lid and add the kale. Stir the kale into the stew, until it turns bright green and begins to wilt, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat, add salt, pepper, and cayenne to taste.
Top with crushed peanuts to serve.

double-peanut-stew.title: Double Peanut Stew

dressed-up-whipped-feta-spread.description: Trader Joe’s Whipped Feta Spread is an ultra-spreadable, mega-dippable concoction that’s whipped just enough to ensure you’ll still find satisfyingly salty chunks of cheese throughout. You can dip and dunk straight out of the tub, or plate and adorn it with an array of toppings for a simple yet showstopping appetizer.
ingredients: 1/3 cup TJ’s Jumbo Pitted Greek Kalamata Olives, drained, and sliced in half lengthwise
¼ cup drained TJ’s Julienne Sliced Sun Dried Tomatoes in Olive Oil, a couple spoonfuls of olive oil reserved
1 wedge of a TJ’s Fresh Lemon
A few sprigs TJ’s Fresh Dill, roughly chopped
TJ’s Baladi Pocket Bread or Pita Bread, warmed

steps.text: Add Whipped Feta Spread to the center of a medium-sized plate. Use the back of the spoon to spread it out over the plate, creating little valleys of dip in which to collect the garnishes. Top with kalamata olives and sundried tomatoes. Drizzle with reserved sun dried tomato oil, squeeze the lemon wedge atop, sprinkle with dill fronds, and finish with a few cranks of black pepper. Serve with warm Baladi Pocket Bread or pita.

dressed-up-whipped-feta-spread.title: Dressed Up Whipped Feta Spread

dumpling-dipping-sauce.description: Trader Joe’s Rice Vinegar is an everyday, unseasoned, white rice vinegar, that’s tart, tangy, and just a touch sweet, with a slightly sharp note for cutting through and brightening other flavors. A bit of our Rice Vinegar will add an extra dimension of flavor to stir-fries, soups, and even just a freshly cooked pot of plain white rice. It’s an ideal ingredient for adding to salad dressings, marinades, and sauces of all kinds… like this quick-to-prepare dipping sauce that pairs phenomenally well with TJ’s array of frozen dumplings.

steps.text: Combine ingredients in a small bowl and carefully whisk until combined.
Serve with your favorite TJ’s dumplings.

dumpling-dipping-sauce.title: Dumpling Dipping Sauce

dutch-baby-berries-lemon-cream.description:
Put the versatility of Trader Joe’s Unbleached Enriched All-Purpose Flour to the test with a fantastically fluffy Dutch baby pancake! Instead of getting griddled on the stove like your standard stack, the batter for this “baby” is poured into a preheated cast iron pan and baked in the oven; the high heat bake causes the pancake to puff up the sides of the pan, leaving a crater-like center that can cradle an array of fillings — like a two-ingredient lemon cream, made from a jar of Trader Joe’s Lemon Curd and freshly whipped cream. It’s extraordinary!

Note: Use a blender to quickly achieve the smooth and thin batter consistency required for the pancake to rise. No blender? No problem! You can achieve the same result with a whisk and a few extra minutes.
ingredients: 2 cups of your favorite TJ’s berries, if using strawberries, slice in half
¼ cup & 1 tablespoon TJ’s Organic Cane Sugar, divided
½ cup TJ’s Unbleached Enriched All-Purpose Flour
TJ’s Organic Fresh Mint, for garnish

steps.text: Prepare the Lemon Cream & Berries: In a medium-sized bowl, use a whisk or electric mixer to whip heavy cream until soft peaks form. Gently fold lemon curd into the whipped cream with a rubber spatula. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve. In a separate medium-sized bowl, add berries,  1/4 cup sugar and lemon juice. Toss to combine and let sit for at least 15 minutes.

Prepare the Dutch Baby Pancake: Place 10-inch cast iron pan in cold oven, then heat your oven to 425° F. Combine milk, eggs, salt, remaining tablespoon of organic cane sugar, and flour in blender and blend on high speed until the mixture is smooth. Carefully remove the hot cast iron pan and place on a flat, heat resistant surface. Add butter to pan and swirl around the bottom and sides of the pan. Quickly and carefully pour the batter into the pan and return the pan to the oven. Bake for 12-15 minutes, until the pancake is golden brown and has puffed up.
To Serve: Top warm Dutch baby pancake with lemon cream and sugared berries. Sprinkle with powdered sugar and mint leaves to garnish.

dutch-baby-berries-lemon-cream.title: Dutch Baby Pancake with Berries & Lemon Cream

dutch-baby-onion-prosciutto-gruyere.description:
Put the versatility of Trader Joe’s Unbleached Enriched All-Purpose Flour to the test with a fantastically fluffy Dutch baby pancake! Instead of getting griddled on the stove like your standard stack, the batter for this “baby” is poured into a preheated cast iron pan and baked in the oven; the high heat bake causes the pancake to puff up the sides of the pan, leaving a crater-like center that can cradle an array of fillings — like creamy, nutty Raw Milk Cave Aged Le Gruyère, rich caramelized onions, and silky slices of savory prosciutto. The superbly sharable structure of this pancake makes it ideal for brunch celebrations large or small—though we wouldn’t mind eating it for breakfast, lunch, or dinner any day of the week!

Note: Use a blender to quickly achieve the smooth and thin batter consistency required for the pancake to rise. No blender? No problem! You can achieve the same result with a whisk and a few extra minutes.
ingredients: 7 tablespoons TJ’s Unsalted Butter Quarters, divided
1 ½ teaspoon TJ’s Sea Salt, divided
A few cranks of TJ’s Black Peppercorns
½ cup TJ’s Unbleached Enriched All-Purpose Flour
½ cup grated TJ’s Raw Milk Cave Aged Le Gruyère

steps.text: Prepare the Caramelized Onions: Melt 3 tablespoons of butter in a large sauté pan over medium-high heat. Add onion and thyme, cover with lid, and cook for 10-15 minute, stirring occasionally, until the onions become golden in color. Remove from heat, discard thyme and season with 1/2 teaspoon of salt and pepper. Set aside.

Prepare the Dutch Baby Pancake: Place 10-inch cast iron pan in cold oven, then heat your oven to 425° F. Combine milk, eggs, 1 teaspoon of salt, and flour in blender and blend on high speed until the mixture is smooth. Carefully remove the hot cast iron pan and place on a flat, heat resistant surface. Add remaining 4 tablespoons of butter to pan and swirl around the bottom and sides of the pan. Quickly and carefully pour the batter into the pan and return the pan to the oven. Bake for 12-15 minutes, until the pancake is golden brown and has puffed up.
To Serve: Evenly distribute the caramelized onions and grated Gruyère over the warm Dutch baby pancake. Top with slices of prosciutto.

dutch-baby-onion-prosciutto-gruyere.title: Dutch Baby Pancake with Caramelized Onion, Prosciutto, and Gruyère

dutch-baby-roasted-veggies-goat-cheese.description:
Put the versatility of Trader Joe’s Unbleached Enriched All-Purpose Flour to the test with a fantastically fluffy Dutch baby pancake! Instead of getting griddled on the stove like your standard stack, the batter for this “baby” is poured into a preheated cast iron pan and baked in the oven; the high heat bake causes the pancake to puff up the sides of the pan, leaving a crater-like center that can cradle an array of fillings— like quick-roasted veggies, creamy chunks of Trader Joe’s Chevre Goat Cheese, and a handful of fresh herbs. The superbly sharable structure of this pancake makes it ideal for brunch celebrations large or small—though we wouldn’t mind eating it for breakfast, lunch, or dinner any day of the week!

Note: Use a blender to quickly achieve the smooth and thin batter consistency required for the pancake to rise. No blender? No problem! You can achieve the same result with a whisk and a few extra minutes.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons of your favorite TJ’s Olive Oil
1 container TJ’s Organic Sugar Plum Grape Tomatoes
1 teaspoon TJ’s Sea Salt, plus more to taste
½ teaspoon TJ’s Black Peppercorns, plus more to taste
½ cup TJ’s Unbleached Enriched All-Purpose Flour
½ cup TJ’s Chevre Goat Cheese Log, crumbled into bite-sized pieces
1 cup of your favorite TJ’s herbs, stems removed

steps.text: Prepare the Roasted Veggies: Place an empty, 10-inch cast iron pan in cold oven, then heat your oven to 425° F. Add tomatoes to baking sheet, drizzle with olive oil, and season with salt and pepper to taste. Roast in oven for 5 minutes, add asparagus to baking sheet and roast for an additional 5-10 minutes, or until the asparagus are tender and the tomatoes begin to soften. Remove baking sheet from oven and set aside.

Prepare the Dutch Baby Pancake: Combine milk, eggs, 1 teaspoon salt, 1/2 teaspoon pepper, and flour in blender and blend on high speed until the mixture is smooth. Carefully remove the hot cast iron pan from oven and place on a flat, heat resistant surface. Add butter to pan and swirl around the bottom and sides of the pan. Quickly and carefully pour the batter into the pan and return the pan to the oven. Bake for 12-15 minutes, until the pancake is golden brown and has puffed up.
To Serve: Top warm Dutch baby pancake with roasted veggies, goat cheese, and sprinkle with herbs.

dutch-baby-roasted-veggies-goat-cheese.title: Dutch Baby Pancake with Roasted Veggies & Goat Cheese

earl-grey-latte-glaze.description: Trader Joe’s Organic Earl Grey Tea is deceptively simple. It’s an Organic blend of bold, full-bodied black Tea from South India, balanced with an invigorating, floral black Tea from Africa combined with oil from organic Italian Bergamot oranges. The Bergamot lends a citrusy, heady aroma (think of Bergamot as the Meyer lemon's warm, spiced cousin) and brightens the flavor of its black Tea counterparts. It makes a fine cuppa, especially with a splash of milk, as well as a particularly aromatic glaze, ideal for zhuzhing up an array of baked goods. Teatime, anyone?
ingredients: 2 tablespoons of your favorite TJ’s Milk or Non-Dairy Beverage
1 bag TJ’s Organic Earl Grey Tea
12 homemade or your favorite TJ's cookies, for glazing

steps.text: Heat milk in the microwave for 30 seconds, until hot.
Cut tea bag open and pour contents into the steaming milk. Stir to combine and steep for 5 minutes.

In a small bowl, add powdered sugar and a pinch of salt. Add 1 tablespoon of the steeped tea latte, including tea grounds, to the bowl. Whisk to combine. Add up to 1 more tablespoon of the latte mixture until you achieve the desired glaze thickness.
Dip cookies in glaze, then top each cookie with lemon zest. Let sit 10 minutes so the glaze can set before serving.

earl-grey-latte-glaze.title: Earl Grey Latte Glaze

easy-as-crispy-corned-beef-hash.description: Whipping up a St. Patrick's Day-inspired brunch is a cinch with TJ's Uncured Corned Beef Brisket leftovers and a bag of Trader Joe's Roasted Potatoes & Onions.
ingredients: 1 bag TJ's Roasted Potatoes with Peppers & Onions
1 pound leftover cooked TJ's Uncured Corned Beef Brisket, cubed to potato size

steps.text: Heat olive oil and butter in a large heavy skillet over medium heat; crowd in the cubed corned beef and potatoes.

Spread evenly in the pan and increase heat to high or medium high. Do not stir the potatoes and corned beef; let them brown until sizzling. Use a spatula to peek underneath to check browning. If there is too much sticking, add a little more oil to the pan. Continue to cook in this manner until the potatoes and the corned beef are browned and crispy on the bottom, about 8 minutes.
Once browned, add water, then cover with a lid and steam until water evaporates (about 2 to 3 minutes). Remove from heat and serve topped with fried or poached eggs.

easy-as-crispy-corned-beef-hash.title: Easy As Crispy Corned Beef Hash

edamame-energy-bowl.description: This kaleidoscopic medley of fresh fruit, crisp veggies, & plant-based protein will fill you up without weighing you down.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons TJ's Extra Virgin California Olive Oil
1/4 teaspoon TJ's Sea Salt, or to taste
1/4 teaspoon TJ's Ground Black Pepper, or to taste

steps.text: In a large bowl, combine salad ingredients and set aside. In a separate bowl combine dressing ingredients. Drizzle dressing into salad and enjoy. If preferred chilled, refrigerate an extra 20 minutes before serving.

edamame-energy-bowl.title: Edamame Energy Bowl

egg-in-a-hole-garlicky-fried-peppers.description: Trader Joe’s Fire Roasted Red Peppers are roasted over an open flame, then packed in a tart brine made with red wine vinegar. They’re simply delicious on their own, and they make a punchy and robust accompaniment to a classic egg-in-a-hole. We’re frying them with thin slices of garlic that adds subtle garlicky flavor throughout the entire dish. The eggs are encased by toasty bread and cooked until the whites are set, and the yolk runs when you cut into it. Use the cut-out circles of bread to scoop up the fried peppers and garlic. And don’t forget to dunk them in the yolk!
ingredients: ½ jar TJ’s Fire Roasted Red Peppers, chopped
2 sliced of your favorite TJ’s Bread, with 2 ½ inch hole cut in the center (reserve the removed bread)

steps.text: To a 12-inch cast iron pan, melt 2 tablespoons butter over medium heat. Add garlic and chopped peppers and sauté until the garlic softens and becomes fragrant, 2-3 minutes.

Push garlic and peppers to one side of the pan and add the remaining two tablespoons of butter to the empty space. Add the bread slices and reserved bread circles to the melted butter and toast until golden on one side, about 2 minutes.
Flip the bread slices and circles, then crack an egg into each hole. Season with salt, and cover pan for 3-5 minutes, until the eggs are cooked through, but the yolks are still runny.
Carefully move each piece of bread to a plate, taking extra care to keep the egg within the bread. Top with the garlic, peppers, and toasted bread circles. Garnish with chopped parsley to serve.

egg-in-a-hole-garlicky-fried-peppers.title: Egg-In-a-Hole with Garlicky Fried Peppers

egg-joemuffin.description:
Made with a hearty base of egg and Swiss cheese, Trader Joe's Egg Frittata has a fluffy texture that belies its protein-packed ingredient list. Earthy cauliflower, fried onions, and the aforementioned cheese create the classic, belly-warming breakfast profile: craveably savory and utterly delicious. To amp up the protein content, our supplier uses egg whites, whole eggs, and whey protein concentrate-add it all up, and you get about 12 grams of protein and 15% of your daily calcium needs, at just 5 grams of carbs per fully-cooked Frittata!

To achieve peak Frittata perfection, simply reheat in the microwave or bake to your heart's (and your schedule's) content. Its plump disc shape makes it just the right size for an egg sandwich on a TJ's British Muffin. On the other hand, if you're going for a lower carb concoction, set one of these Frittatas atop a bed of crisp salad greens dressed in vinaigrette, and you've got a satisfying meal on your hands, with hardly any fuss.
ingredients: 1 package TJ's Egg Frittata, microwaved according to package instructions
4 slices TJ's Fully Cooked Bacon, microwaved according to package instructions

steps.text: Split muffins and toast to desired doneness. Layer arugula, 1 frittata, a couple of tomato slices, and 2 slices of bacon on bottom half of toasted muffin. Drizzle with sriracha sauce and cover with top half of muffin. Repeat steps with remaining ingredients. Serve immediately.

egg-joemuffin.title: Egg JoeMuffin

egg-salad-bagel.description: Soggy sandwich bread, please exit stage left! The dense construction of a bagel's crumb (that's bakery lingo for its doughy insides) is the ideal match for creamy Trader Joe's Egg Salad. And not turning on the stove or oven to get your egg fix? That's just the cream cheese on the bagel, as it were. Balance the velvety egg salad and toasty bagel with a glass of your favorite sparkling water or wine for a quick and tasty brunch.
ingredients: 3 TJ's Everything Bagels, sliced in half
1 tub TJ's Pico de Gallo, hot or mild
TJ's Fresh Chives, chopped, for garnish (optional)

steps.text: Toast bagels per your preference. Top bottom half of bagel with egg salad, pico de gallo, and chopped chives. Cover with top half of bagel and serve immediately.

egg-salad-bagel.title: Egg Salad Bagel

elote.description: Made with a simple mix of California sea salt, chile pepper, red bell pepper, and lime juice, the secret behind Trader Joe’s Chile Lime Seasoning Blend’s success is how beautifully it balances its elements. Spicy, but not too hot, and tangy, but not too puckery, it’s the kind of Seasoning that both brings out the sweetness out of savory fare and provides a savory edge to sweeter treats. Also, rather than a finely ground powder that mixes right in to recipes, it’s designed with a coarser grind that delivers just a bit of texture—a welcomed addition mixed into Organic Mayonnaise and Sour Cream then slathered onto grilled TJ’s Corn on the Cob!
ingredients: 2 teaspoons TJ’s Chile Lime Seasoning Blend, plus more for garnish
4 ears TJ’s Fresh Corn on the Cob, husks and silks removed
Chopped TJ’s Fresh Cilantro, for garnish
1 TJ’s Lime, sliced into wedges for garnish

steps.text: In a medium-sized bowl, combine mayonnaise, sour cream, and chile lime seasoning. Refrigerate until ready to use.
steps.title: Prepare the Chile Lime Crema

steps.text: Preheat a grill to medium-high. Grill corn, turning often, until evenly charred, about 10-15 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool slightly.
