Generously brush each ear of corn with chile lime crema, then sprinkle with cotija cheese, cilantro, and more chile lime seasoning, if desired. Serve with lime wedges on the side.

elote.title: Elote

elote-jalapeno-cornbread-pancakes.description: Our classic Trader Joe's Cornbread Mix finally met its match in Trader Joe's Everything But the Elote Seasoning Blend. It makes perfect sense when you think about it-the components of the Seasoning Blend (Parmesan, chile pepper, chipotle powder, salt, etc.), are literally designed-or at least combined-to be delicious on corn, so *of course* they're just as delicious in cornbread! Toss some jalapeños in the mix, and you've got yourself a sweet n' savory, slightly spicy, and totally Tex-Mexy breakfast.
ingredients: 1 stick (1/2 cup) TJ's Unsalted Butter, melted
3 tablespoons TJ’s Everything but the Elote Seasoning Blend
1 bag TJ’s Fresh Jalapeños, deseeded and diced (use gloves!)

steps.text: In a large mixing bowl, mix together egg, melted butter, and buttermilk. Mix in cornbread mix and seasoning, stirring until moistened. Mix in diced jalapeños until combine. Do not over-mix.

Preheat a large, nonstick pan or griddle over low heat. Working in batches and using about 1/4 cup of batter per pancake as your measure, drop batter into preheated pan. Cook 3-4 minutes, flip pancake, and continue cooking for 2 minutes more.
Serve immediately, garnished with honey and butter if desired. Enjoy!

elote-jalapeno-cornbread-pancakes.title: Elote-Jalapeño Cornbread Pancakes

enchilada-pie.description: Trader Joe's Sweet & Crisp Whole Kernel Corn has been warming our shelves with its bright yellow label for years, making it one of our most recognizable products. In this recipe, we’ve paired these naturally sweet kernels with the savory flavors of an unrolled enchilada. Layers of corn tortillas, cheese, butternut squash, black beans, and hatch chiles round out this meatless dish for a meal that won't disappoint. Top with crunchy green onions and sliced avocado for a satisfying dinner you'll want to add to your weekly rotation after just one bite.
ingredients: 1 Can TJ's Whole Kernel Corn, drained
1 Can TJ's Organic Black Beans, drained
1/2 Can TJ's Hatch Chopped Green Chiles
2 Cups TJ's Shredded Fancy Mexican Style Cheese Blend divided
3 TJ's Green Onions diced, for garnish
1 ripe TJ's Avocado, diced, for garnish

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease a 10-inch pie pan or casserole dish and set aside.
Cut the corner of the bag of squash and microwave, 3 minutes until softened. Let cool slightly and dice.
Combine corn, beans, chile, squash, taco seasoning, a pinch of salt and 1/2 cup enchilada sauce in a bowl and mix until evenly coated.

Pour remaining enchilada sauce on a large plate. Coat both sides of the tortillas in sauce. Place a layer of tortillas on the bottom of the prepared pan, tearing tortillas as needed to fill the gaps. Top with 1/2 of the vegetable mix and 1/2 cup of cheese. Cover with another layer of dipped tortillas, top with the remaining vegetable mix and another 1/2 cup of cheese. Add the final layer of dipped tortillas and the remaining 1 cup of cheese on top.

Place pie on center rack of oven and bake for 30-40 minutes, or until cheese is melted and golden brown, and pie is slightly bubbling. Remove from oven and let cool slightly. Garnish with green onion and avocado and enjoy.

enchilada-pie.title: Enchilada Pie

everything-but-the-bagel-dip.description: Meet the easiest, tastiest recipe for all of your chip-and-dip needs: Trader Joe's Everything but the Bagel Sesame Seasoning Blend with Organic Sour Cream. And don't forget the Ridge Cut Potato Chips!
ingredients: 1 tub (16 ounces) TJ's Organic Sour Cream
1/2 jar TJ's Everything but the Bagel Sesame Seasoning Blend

steps.text: Spoon sour cream into a serving bowl. Fold in seasoning and stir until well mixed. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Garnish with chopped chives, if desired. Serve with potato chips, carrot sticks, pita chips, celery sticks, bell peppers, pretzel slims, cucumbers...

everything-but-the-bagel-dip.title: Everything but the Bagel Dip

everything-but-the-bagel-onion-rings.description: These crunchy, savory onion rings are seasoned with our very own Everything But The Bagel Sesame Seasoning Blend. Enjoy them fresh from the fryer with TJ's Everything but the Bagel Dip, or another one of our many Trader Joe's dipping options.
ingredients: 2 TJ's Jumbo White Onions, sliced in 1/4-inch slices
1 teaspoon TJ's Sea Salt Fine Crystals, plus more to taste
4 tablespoons TJ's Everything but the Bagel Seasoning Blend
TJ's 100% Canola Oil or Organic High-Oleic Sunflower Oil
TJ's Everything but the Bagel Greek Style Yogurt Dip (optional)

steps.text: Mix the buttermilk and salt in a wide, shallow bowl and submerge the sliced onion rings. Let them sit, submerged for 30 minutes. Meanwhile, heat 2 inches of oil to 350°F in a deep pot or tabletop fryer.

Mix the flour and Everything but the Bagel Seasoning in a shallow container large enough to fit approximately ¼ of the onions at a time. Remove the onions from the buttermilk. Toss ¼ of the soaked onions in the flour mixture to coat.
Fry rings until golden and crispy in the hot oil–approximately 4 minutes.
Drain on a cooling rack. Season with salt. Repeat process with the remaining onions. Discard the buttermilk after using.
Serve with Everything but the Bagel Dip or other dip of choice.

everything-but-the-bagel-onion-rings.title: Everything but the Bagel Onion Rings

everything-but-the-leftovers-sheet-pan-d.description:
When it comes to holiday meals, there are certain flavors so iconic, one taste elicits the whole eating experience. Gravy is one of those tastes. So is stuffing. To create Trader Joe's Everything but the Leftovers, we've distilled the essence of a stellar stuffing and a great gravy down to a shake-able-and vegan-Seasoning Blend so you can add these holiday flavors to anything!

Shake this Seasoning on eggs, roasted vegetables, sandwiches, popcorn, or use it to liven up your next sheet pan meal!
ingredients: 1 package (12 oz.) TJ's Cut Butternut Squash
1 package (16 oz.) TJ's Brussels Sprouts, trimmed and halved
1/2 TJ's Red Onion, cut into chunks
4 teaspoons TJ's Everything But The Leftovers Seasoning, divided (seasonal)
1 cup TJ's Japanese Style Panko Breadcrumbs
1 package TJ's Turkey Cutlets (4-5 cutlets), patted dry

steps.text: Arrange oven racks in thirds. Preheat oven to 400°F.
In a large bowl combine vegetables, olive oil and 2 teaspoons seasoning. Spread vegetables on a baking sheet. Roast vegetables in lower rack of oven for 5 minutes while you prep the turkey cutlets.
Mix breadcrumbs with 2 teaspoons seasoning.
Dip turkey cutlet in beaten egg and drain off excess, then coat in breadcrumb mixture. Place on second baking sheet. Repeat with remaining cutlets.
Place cutlets on upper rack of oven. Bake cutlets and vegetables 18-20 minutes, until internal temperature of cutlets reaches 165°F. Remove from oven and let cool slightly before serving.

everything-but-the-leftovers-sheet-pan-d.title: Everything but the Leftovers Sheet Pan Dinner

everything-cream-cheese-crispbreads.description: Top Trader Joe's Gluten Free Crispbreads with Whipped Cream Cheese and Everything But The Bagel Sesame Seasoning Blend for a hearty snack or fancy appetizer that comes together in less than five minutes.
ingredients: TJ's Everything But The Bagel Sesame Seasoning Blend

steps.text: Generously slather a crispbread with cream cheese. Sprinkle liberally with seasoning blend and top with fresh dill. Enjoy!

everything-cream-cheese-crispbreads.title: Everything Cream Cheese Crispbreads

everything-ham-cheese-roll-ups.description: For a classic ham & cheese pastry with a twist, we’re sprinkling Trader Joe’s Organic Crescent Rolls with TJ’s Everything But the Bagel Sesame Seasoning and baking them until golden and oozing. These roll-ups make for a cheesy, tastebud tickling snack or appetizer.
ingredients: 3 tablespoons TJ's Everything But The Bagel Sesame Seasoning Blend
4 slices TJ's Sliced Swiss Cheese, sliced in half
4 slices TJ's Organic Uncured Black Forest Ham, sliced in half

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F. Pour a few tablespoons of seasoning onto a shallow plate, set aside.

Remove crescent roll dough from package and gently separate into 8 triangles. Top a dough triangle with a piece of cheese and a piece of ham. Roll into a crescent shape, then gently roll outside of dough in everything seasoning and place on an ungreased baking sheet. Repeat with remaining ingredients.
Bake rolls on center rack of oven for 12-14 minutes, until rolls are golden brown and cheese is melted. Remove from oven and let cool slightly before serving.

everything-ham-cheese-roll-ups.title: Everything Ham & Cheese Roll-Ups

fall-sparkler.description: This nonalcoholic Sparkler combines favored fall flavors into one bright, bubbly, party-ready beverage.

steps.text: Mix cranberry juice, ginger beer and apple cider in a large pitcher with ice. Pour into glasses, garnish with orange slices and serve.

fall-sparkler.title: Fall Sparkler

fall-turkey-chili-with-pumpkin.description: When the weather starts to cool down, and Trader Joe's Organic Pumpkin cans make their debut in the grocery aisle, you'll know it's time to make this chili. Tender ground turkey, savory seasonings and velvety pumpkin purée make this dish a hearty, stick-to-your-ribs kind of meal.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon TJ's Pure Imported Olive Oil
1 can TJ's Organic Diced & No Salt Added Tomatoes
1 can TJ's Organic Kidney Beans, drained
1/2 can TJ's Whole Kernel Corn, drained

steps.text: In a large saucepan or stockpot, heat olive oil over medium heat.
Add onions and bell peppers and sauté until onions are translucent and fragrant, about 3-4 minutes.
Add garlic and stir for 30 seconds. Add turkey and break up in pan with spoon, sautéing until turkey is browned and cooked through.
Stir in tomatoes, pumpkin, beans, corn and spices. Bring to a boil, and then reduce heat and simmer 20-30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Garnish with sour cream, cheese, avocado and cilantro, and serve.

fall-turkey-chili-with-pumpkin.title: Fall Turkey Chili With Pumpkin

fancy-lemon-farfalle.description:
It's nice to feel fancy. It's even nicer to feel fancy without putting forth too much effort, or forking over too much of your hard-earned money. And that's exactly what you'll get with this Fancy Lemon Farfalle recipe. Fancy without the fuss. Or the price tag.     

This bright, vegetarian meal is creamy without being heavy, and it comes together in under 30 minutes. We've used Trader Joe's Organic Peas in our version, but feel free to experiment with ingredients and add-ons-artichoke hearts, sundried tomatoes, caramelized onions, pre-cooked chicken...the sky is the limit!
ingredients: 4 tablespoons TJ's Extra Virgin Olive Oil, divided
1/2 cup TJ's Japanese Style Panko Breadcrumbs
Zest and juice of 1 TJ's Lemon

steps.text: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. While water boils, add 2 tablespoons oil and panko to a large saucepan over medium heat. Stir to coat panko with oil and sauté for 5 minutes, shaking pan occasionally to ensure even browning. Pour toasted panko into a small bowl and set aside.
Add remaining oil and onions to the pan and sauté over medium heat until lightly browned, about 7 minutes. Turn off heat. Add crème fraîche, lemon zest and juice and stir gently to combine.

While onions are cooking, add pasta to boiling water. Boil 4 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add peas and boil another 4-5 minutes. Drain pasta and add to crème fraîche mixture. Turn heat to high and stir until pasta is well coated and sauce thickens, about 2 minutes.
Turn off heat and add Parmesan to pan, stirring to coat pasta. Season with salt & pepper, to taste. Ladle pasta into bowls, top with toasted panko and serve immediately.

fancy-lemon-farfalle.title: Fancy Lemon Farfalle

farro-chicken-sausage-apples.description: For a comforting grain bowl that will give your kitchen aninviting aroma, pair anise and fennel-spiced Trader Joe’s Sweet Italian Chicken Sausages with sautéed apples and onion, then toss with hearty, nutty Trader Joe's 10 Minute Farro. Filling without being heavy, the leftovers (if you have any) make for an excellent lunch the next day.
ingredients: 1 package TJ’s 10 Minute Farro, cooked according to package instructions
1 package TJ’s Sweet Italian Chicken Sausage, casings removed
TJ’s Organic Ground Black Pepper, to taste
TJ’s Organic Crushed Red Pepper, to taste
TJ’s Grated Parmesan Cheese, to serve

steps.text: In a large nonstick skillet, over high heat, add sausage. Using a wooden spatula, break sausage up into crumbles, and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove sausage from the pan and set aside.
Add butter, and once it melts, add onion, garlic, and apples. Sauté until tender, about 8 minutes.
Add cooked farro and sausage back to the pan, stir to combine, and cook for an addition 2 minutes, until completely warmed through.
Season with salt, pepper, and crushed red pepper to taste.
To serve, sprinkle with grated Parmesan cheese.

farro-chicken-sausage-apples.title: Farro With Chicken Sausage & Apples

fiery-fondue-for-two.description:
Heat seekers and cheese eaters, rejoice! This fondue recipe combines a traditional preparation with an unconventional (and oh-so tasty) assemblage of ingredients. Trader Joe’s Cheddar Cheese with Scotch Bonnet Chili and Red Peppers brings a pleasant dose of spice and a fiery orange hue, while TJ’s Fontina lends its characteristic meltability to help deliver that quintessential fondue cheese pull with every dunk. How about using a delightfully hoppy IPA in place of white wine? We enthusiasically say, yes!

Not sure what to dip? How about a lightly toasted cubes of TJ's Organic Baguette, crisp apple slices, bite-sized roasted potatoes, tangy TJ's Cornichons...
ingredients: 1 clove TJ’s Fresh Garlic, peeled and halved
¼ - ½ cup Boatswain Hazy IPA
1 ½ cups coarsely grated TJ’s Fontina
1 ½ cups coarsely grated TJ’s Cheddar Cheese with Scotch Bonnet Chili and Red Peppers
TJ’s Organic Baguette, cut into chunky cubes, for dipping
Your favorite TJ’s Apple, sliced, for dipping
TJ’s Teeny Tiny Potatoes, roasted or boiled, for dipping

steps.text: Heat a fondue pot, small Dutch oven, or heavy-bottomed pot over medium-low heat.

Carefully rub the inside of the pot with the cut sides of the garlic clove. Discard leftover garlic. (Pro-tip: Alternatively, leave the leftover garlic in the pot, and proceed with recipe. It will be a delicious, garlicky surprise when serving.)

Add ¼ cup of beer and let it come to a gentle simmer. Add ½ cup fontina cheese and whisk to help emulsify the mixture. Add ½ cup scotch bonnet Cheddar once the fontina has melted, and repeat, alternating the addition of ½ cup of each cheese, vigorously whisking after each addition. If the mixture becomes thick, add a splash of reserved beer to return it to a whisk-able texture.
The fondue is ready when you can achieve a “cheese pull” when the whisk is removed up and away from the pot.

Using the pot you cooked the fondue in as the serving vessel, place over a can of chafing fuel (with appropriate safety setup), or a standalone induction burner over low heat. Adjust heat as necessary while you’re digging in!

fiery-fondue-for-two.title: Fiery Fondue for Two

fig-blue-cheese-burgers.description:
Trader Joe’s Angus Chuck, Brisket, & Sirloin 1/3 lb. Beef Patties boast a uniquely flavorful blend of three different cuts of well-marbled Angus Beef. The Brisket and Sirloin each contribute amazingly rich flavor, with their slightly fattier composition, while the ground Chuck brings additional ‘beefiness’ and balance. All that to say, these Patties make a seriously special burger.

So, we’re adorning these burgers accordingly with an elevated array of toppings: sweet TJ’s Fig Butter, savory TJ’s Triple Cream Soft Ripened Cambozola® Blue Cheese, umami-rich caramelized red onions, bright and peppery arugula—all atop a buttery TJ’s Brioche Bun.
ingredients: 3 tablespoons of your favorite TJ’s Olive Oil
1 package TJ’s Angus Chuck, Brisket, & Sirloin 1/3 lb. Beef Patties
1 wedge TJ’s Triple Cream Soft Ripened Cambozola® Blue Cheese, sliced into rectangles

steps.text: Add 3 tablespoons of oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium-low heat. Add onion, then cover with lid and cook for 25-30 minutes, stirring frequently, until the onions soften and darken in color. Remove from heat and season with 1/2 teaspoon of salt. Set aside.
steps.title: Prepare the Caramelized Onions

steps.text: Heat a grill, large nonstick skillet, or grill pan to medium-high. Season burgers with salt, and cook, flipping at least once, until you reach your desired internal temperature. Place two slices of Cambozola® on top of each burger, then remove from heat, and let rest 5 minutes, allowing the cheese to gently melt from the residual heat.
steps.title: Cook Burgers

steps.text: While the burgers rest, place buns cut-side down on the grill or pan. Toast for 2-3 minutes, until golden.
steps.title: Toast Buns

steps.text: Slather each bottom bun with fig jam, then add a handful of arugula. Place the burger on top, then a dollop of fig butter atop the cheese, followed by a spoonful of caramelized red onions. Top with bun to serve.
steps.title: Assemble

fig-blue-cheese-burgers.title: Fig & Blue Cheese Burgers

fig-butter-cream-cheese-bagel.description: Trader Joe's Fig Butter is a favorite ingredient among recipe testers and tasters alike in our test kitchen, and it's easy to see why: it shines in sweet and savory applications, packs a punch of flavor in a compact jar, and it's just downright delicious. Elevate the standard bagel & cream cheese with a healthy dollop of said Fig Butter, followed by chopped walnuts, dried apricots and a generous drizzle of honey. A chilled glass of Trader Joe's Cranberry & Clementine Sparkling Water adds fruity sparkle without further sweetness, making this a sublime breakfast or afternoon snack.
ingredients: 2 TJ's Plain Bagels, sliced in half
1 package TJ's Cream Cheese, quartered and softened

steps.text: Remove lid from fig butter. Microwave on half power for 30-second intervals, stirring in between, until warm. Set aside.

Toast bagels per your preference. Top each half with cream cheese, spreading to cover bagel. Drizzle with warm fig butter. Top with diced apricot and walnuts, followed by a generous drizzle of honey. Enjoy immediately.

fig-butter-cream-cheese-bagel.title: Fig Butter Cream Cheese Bagel

fiveish-layer-dip.description: If you build it, they will dip—"it" being a creamy, Five-ish Layer Dip, of course. Topped with an organic blend of our most popular cheeses (Mozzarella, Monterey Jack and Cheddar), this recipe is a perennial party favorite.
ingredients: 1 can TJ's Organic Salsa Style Refried Black Beans
1 tub (16 oz) TJ's Organic Sour Cream
1/2 bag TJ's Organic Shredded 3 Cheese Blend
TJ's Restaurant Style Tortilla Chips (or your favorite TJ's Tortilla Chips) for dipping
2-quart serving dish (or individual ramekins) for dip assembly

steps.text: In a 2-quart serving dish, use a spatula to spread beans across the bottom of the dish in an even layer. Continue gently layering with guacamole, sour cream, and salsa (rinse your spatula when switching ingredients to keep your layers clean).
Top with cheese, green onions, cilantro, and olives. Dig in with your favorite TJ's tortilla chips.

fiveish-layer-dip.title: Five-ish Layer Dip

franks-blueberry-muffins.description:
The best thing about family recipes - other than eating them, of course - is the history they bring to the table. The recipe for Frank's Blueberry Muffins evolved in a Crew Member's home kitchen, perfected over time by Frank himself, who became locally famous for these mega muffins. They were mainstays at family breakfasts and brunches, made surprise appearances in workplaces and classrooms, and were even offered as incentives for gold medal showings in statewide athletic contests.

Frank always made sure the muffins were delivered warm, and he always advised the addition of butter before eating. He was also good enough to share the recipe, so that future generations can share in the blueberry goodness in every warm, crumbly bite.
ingredients: 1 cup TJ's Organic Sugar, plus more for sprinkling
1 teaspoon TJ's Organic Pure Bourbon Vanilla Extract
2 cups TJ's Frozen Blueberries (do not thaw)
TJ's Cultured Butter, for serving (optional, but encouraged)

steps.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Grease muffin tin with cooking spray; set aside. In a large bowl, mix flour, baking powder, salt and sugar; set aside.

In a large bowl, combine eggs, milk, butter and vanilla. Add one-third of dry mixture to wet ingredients and stir to combine. Repeat addition of dry ingredients until fully incorporated. Gently fold in blueberries.

Scoop muffin batter into greased muffin pan (cups will be very full-almost overflowing-this is ok!). Lightly sprinkle muffin batter with sugar. Place pan on center rack of oven and bake 22-25 minutes, until muffins are golden. Let cool 10 minutes, then gently remove muffins from tin. Enjoy warm, with a generous smear of TJ's Cultured Butter.

franks-blueberry-muffins.title: Frank's Blueberry Muffins

fridge-foraged-fried-rice.description: In search of a dinner adventure? Avoiding a trip to the store to restock? In either case, fridge foraging is the answer. This recipe gives you the basic building blocks for a fantastic fried rice, with plenty of leeway for ingredient substitutions. How much leeway? We tested a version using ketchup & balsamic glaze in place of tangy marinade-and it worked just fine!
ingredients: 1 tablespoon TJ's Soyaki Sauce, Stir Fry Sauce, or other tangy marinade you might have sitting in your fridge
1 tsp TJ's Garlic Powder, if you've got it
1/4 cup TJ's neutral oil (Sunflower, Canola, Grapeseed, etc. will all work here)
1 generous cup any TJ's Vegetables you might have on hand (green/red/yellow onion, bell peppers, carrots, mushrooms, frozen peas/corn/edamame/broccoli), thawed if frozen, and chopped
3 or 4 cups cooked, day-old TJ's Rice

steps.text: In a small bowl, mix soy sauce, marinade and garlic powder, set aside.

Heat oil in large skillet or wok on medium heat. Fry chopped veggies in oil just until tender. Add rice to skillet, breaking up any clumps, and fry a few minutes more. Add eggs and stir until fully cooked. Add soy sauce mixture and stir to coat.
Spoon fried rice into bowls and serve as-is, or top with avocado, sriracha sauce, crumbled bacon pieces, chopped scallions...

fridge-foraged-fried-rice.title: Fridge-Foraged Fried Rice

fried-halloumi-salad.description: Atalanta®  Halloumi is made on the island of Cyprus using sheep's milk. During production, the curds are heated to high temperatures, a process which gives it both its "squeaky" texture and ability to hold its shape when cooked or grilled. Atalanta® 's cheesemakers also include a bit of mint, which adds a slight refreshing counterbalance to Halloumi's natural brininess. Highlight its irresistibly salty flavor further by pan-frying and pairing it with ripe peaches, fermented jalapeños and a spicy-sweet dressing for a salad that sings of summer.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons TJ's Hot & Sweet Jalapeños (plus 3 tablespoons liquid from jar)
3 tablespoons of your favorite TJ's Honey
3 tablespoons of your favorite TJ's Olive Oil, plus more for frying
2 packages TJ's Microgreens OR 1 package TJ's Organic Spring Mix
2 ripe TJ's Peaches, pitted and thinly sliced
1 package Atalanta Halloumi Cheese, drained and sliced ¼-inch thick

steps.text: In a small bowl, mix equal parts liquid from jar of pickled fermented jalapeños, honey and olive oil, set aside.
Arrange greens on a serving platter. Drizzle with desired amount of dressing and toss gently to evenly coat.
Arrange peach slices and jalapeños atop greens, set aside.
Preheat a nonstick skillet to medium high. Pat halloumi slices dry with paper towels. Brush both sides with olive oil.
Fry halloumi 3-4 minutes per side, until golden brown. Remove from heat.
Arrange fried halloumi atop salad. Top with a few grinds of black pepper and serve.

fried-halloumi-salad.title: Fried Halloumi Salad

fried-pickle-chips.description: Trader Joe’s Kosher Dill Pickle Chips are sliced into perfectly sized, crinkle-cut rounds, then cold-packed in a savory, well-seasoned brine, which helps them maintain their delectably crisp structure more than their hot-packed, shelf stable cousins. Beyond their use as a burger, sandwich, or pizza topping, they’re also great for mincing and mixing into appetizer dips, pastas, picnic salads, soups, quiches, and deviled eggs. Or, try our take on pub fare with this recipe for Ranch-coated fried pickle chips!
ingredients: ¾ cup TJ’s Unbleached All-Purpose Flour
1 jar TJ’s Kosher Dill Pickle Chips, drained and pat dry
¼ cup TJ’s Organic Canola Oil
TJ’s Buttermilk Ranch Dressing, for dipping

steps.text: Combine flour and Ranch Seasoning Blend in a medium-sized bowl and stir to combine.
Add a few pickle chips to the bowl and toss until each is evenly coated. Remove from bowl, and place on plate. Repeat with remaining pickle chips in batches.

Heat oil in a medium-sized, non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat. When oil is hot, add pickle chips in small batches and pan fry for about 2-3 minutes per side. Remove from pan and drain excess oil on a cooking rack or paper towels.
Serve with ranch dressing.

fried-pickle-chips.title: Fried Pickle Chips

fried-ranchy-tomatoes.description:
Trader Joe’s Organic Ranch Dressing has a classic Ranch flavor profile, with the likes of garlic and onion purées, ground mustard seed, black pepper, and parsley (all Organic) complementing its velvety, tangy buttermilk base. Herby and rich, it can be enjoyed across an impressively wide range of eating occasions. Drizzle, dress, and dip to your heart’s content. You can even use it, in place of eggs, as a flavor booster in your dredging station for chicken cutlets, cut veggies, or thick rounds of tomatoes.

Pro-tip: If you have slightly underripe tomatoes, use them here! Tomatoes have a high moisture content, and that can make frying a challenge. Thoroughly dry your tomatoes before you begin dredging, and ensure excess Ranch Dressing drips off before dipping into your breadcrumbs.
ingredients: 4 firm TJ’s Heirloom Tomatoes, sliced into thick rounds
½ - 1 cup TJ’s Organic Ranch Dressing
1 - 2 cups TJ’s Japanese Style Panko Breadcrumbs

steps.text: Season both sides of the tomatoes with salt to extract extra moisture. Thoroughly pat dry.
Line up a plate of tomato slices next to a wide bowl of ranch dressing. In another wide bowl, thoroughly season panko breadcrumbs with salt and pepper. Place an empty plate next to breadcrumb bowl.
steps.title: Prepare your dredging station

steps.text: Dip 1 tomato slice in the ranch, thoroughly and evenly coating it. Use a fork to lift it out of the ranch and let the excess drip back into the bowl, then carefully add the tomato to the panko bowl. Use another fork to gently flip medallion until thoroughly and evenly coated, and carefully transfer to the empty plate. Repeat with remaining tomato slices, replenishing Ranch and breadcrumbs as needed.

In a medium frying pan, add enough oil to cover the bottom. Heat over medium-high. When the oil is hot, add as many breaded tomato slices that will fit without crowding the pan. Fry until golden on one side, 4-5 minutes. Carefully flip and cook until the second side is golden. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate or cooling rack. Repeat with remaining tomatoes.
Serve fried tomatoes on their own, over a salad, with a fried egg, in an epic BLT sandwich…

fried-ranchy-tomatoes.title: Fried Ranch-y Tomatoes

fried-ravioli-with-creamy-marinara.description: Transform any TJ's fresh ravioli into a snack or appetizer. With a crunchy, golden, breadcrumb crust and an ooey gooey cheesy center, they're perfect for dipping into a bowl of hot marinara.
ingredients: 2 pkgs TJ’s Fresh Ravioli (we used our Beef Bolognese variety)
1 tsp TJ’s Ground Black Pepper, divided
1/2 jar TJ’s Creamy Tomato Basil Pasta Sauce
1/4 cup freshly grated TJ’s Parmesan Cheese

steps.text: In a deep frying pan or pot, empty the container of canola oil. Save the container for easy disposal. Heat the oil on medium-high heat until it reaches 340-360 degrees on a deep-fry thermometer or until a pinch of breadcrumbs drops down the middle of the oil and quickly bobs to the top, turning golden brown.

Set up three dipping stations. In the first dish, whisk 5 eggs with 1/2 cup of milk. In a second dish, mix 2 cups of flour and 1/2 teaspoon each of salt and pepper. In a third dish, mix 2 cups of breadcrumbs with 1/2 teaspoon each of salt and pepper.

Dip each ravioli into the eggwash, first one side and then the other. Shake to remove excess. Next, dip the ravioli into the flour, coating all sides evenly then dip into the eggwash again. Finally, coat the ravioli in breadcrumbs. Set aside on a plate.
Begin heating 1/2 jar of pasta sauce in a small saucepan on low heat.

Using a slotted spoon, gently fry 3-4 breaded ravioli at a time. Depending on the temperature of your oil, fry for about 1-2 minutes per side until golden brown. Transfer ravioli to a paper towel-lined baking sheet to drain.
To serve, place marinara in a bowl and arrange fried ravioli on a plate. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and parsley and enjoy right away.
To dispose canola oil, wait until oil cools completely, drain back into the bottle over a trash can. Do not put oil down kitchen sink.

fried-ravioli-with-creamy-marinara.title: Fried Ravioli with Creamy Marinara

frozen-coconut-limeade.description: Trader Joe’s Fresh Squeezed Limeade puts all manner of tart, tropical refreshment easily within reach. Blend it with coconut milk and ice for a cool treat when the mercury rises....
ingredients: 2 handfuls TJ's Organic Unsweetened Coconut Chips

steps.text: Toast Coconut Chips: Add coconut chips to a large nonstick skillet over medium-low heat. Cook, stirring frequently, until light golden brown. Transfer coconut chips to a plate to cool.
Rim The Glasses: Pour sea salt in a shallow bowl that's wide enough to fit your glasses. Wet the rim of each glass and dip the edge in salt.
Blend It Up: Add coconut milk, limeade and ice to a blender. Blend on medium speed until limeade reaches a slushy consistency, then increase speed to high and blend another minute or so.
Serve: Pour frozen limeade into prepared glasses. Garnish with toasted coconut chips and a lime slice and serve.

frozen-coconut-limeade.title: Frozen Coconut Limeade

frozen-guava-daiquiri.description: Trader Joe’s Organic Guava Nectar is sweet, fragrant, and ready for summertime sipping. Enjoy its tropical flavor and vibrant deep-pink hue on its own, in a frosted mug over ice, or as a terrific base for blended mocktails and cocktails. Give it a whirl!
ingredients: ½ cup (4 ounces) TJ’s White Rum of the Gods
2 tablespoons juice from a TJ’s Lime, plus 2 slices for garnish

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in a blender. Blend on medium, unitil desired slushiness is achieved.
Pour into two coupes or shallow cups of your choosing and garnish with a slice of lime to serve.

frozen-guava-daiquiri.title: Frozen Guava Daiquiri

fruity-cuties-cereal-shake.description: Trader Joe's Tiny Fruity Cuties Cereal is made up of crescent moon and flower shapes in an array of four (natually derived) hues, and offers sweet, fruity flavor with lots of crunch. It's outstanding in a bowl with your favorite milk or non-dairy beverage, just as it is by the handful straight out of the box. These Cuties even shine crushed up in a milkshake, performing dual roles, both flavoring the shake and adorning the rim of the glass. Yes!
ingredients: 1 1/4 cup TJ’s Tiny Fruity Cuties, divided
TJ’s Pitted Amarena Cherries with Stems in Syrup (or TJ's Organic Blue Agave Syrup & a TJ's Fresh Cherry during peak cherry season)
1 cup or 3 big scoops TJ’s French Vanilla Ice Cream

steps.text:
Crush ¼ cup Tiny Fruity Cuties into a coarse powder

Flip your serving glass upside down, and drizzle about a tablespoon of amarena cherry syrup or agave over the top third of the outside of your glass. (Place a plate beneath the glass to catch any drips.)

Sprinkle cereal crumbs over the syrup, so it sticks to the glass.

Place glass in freezer while you prepare the milkshake.
steps.title: For the Cereal Rim

steps.text:
Add remaining 1 cup cereal, ice cream and milk in a blender. Blend on medium until thoroughly combined.

Pour into prepared glass, and top with whipped cream. If using a fresh cherry, use a cherry pitter, straw, or chopstick to remove the pit. Finish with a cherry on top to serve.
steps.title: For the Milkshake

fruity-cuties-cereal-shake.title: Fruity Cuties Cereal Shake

fruity-frozen-yogurt-pops.description:
Rain or shine, there’s never a bad time for a frozen yogurt pop! And when they’re this easy to make, there’s really no reason not to keep a batch on hand and at-the-ready for whenever your sweet tooth strikes. Plus, if you think about it, these pops aren’t just for dessert—reach for one at breakfast, snack time, or whenever you’d normally enjoy a TJ’s 4-oz. Whole Milk Yogurt Cup!

This cultured (literally) customer favorite comes in six-packs—and each six-pack features two different flavors. Take your pick from these four fruity combos: Peaches & Cream + Mango & Cream; Raspberries & Cream + Meyer Lemon & Cream; Strawberries & Cream + Bananas & Cream; or Blueberries & Cream + Vanilla & Cream. A big shout-out to Crew Member Tori at Store #164 in Spokane, WA for this great idea!
ingredients: 1 six-pack of TJ’s 4 oz. Whole Milk Yogurt Cups

steps.text: Using a sharp knife, cut a small slit in the center of each yogurt lid. Slits should be no bigger than your craft sticks.
Without removing their lids, insert sticks all the way into the yogurt cups.
Place yogurt in freezer and freeze until solid, about 5 hours.
Remove yogurt cups from freezer. Using your sharp knife, pierce bottom of each cup. (This makes it easier to free the pops from the cups.)
Remove yogurt pops from the container and serve immediately.

fruity-frozen-yogurt-pops.title: Fruity Frozen Yogurt Pops

full-of-fusilli-veggie-soup.description:
Double down on comfort when you fill your bowl with homemade vegetable soup combined with Trader Joe’s Organic Fusilli Corti Bucati. These noodles can take the heat and hold up beautifully bathed in broth. In this recipe, the pasta is cooked separately and added to the soup at the very end to keep the integrity of its delicate chew intact. 

Tip: if you’re short on prep time, substitute Trader Joe’s Mirepoix for the carrots, celery, and onion.
ingredients: ½ package TJ’s Organic Fusilli Corti Bucati
2 tablespoons of your favorite TJ’s Olive Oil
1 small TJ’s Yellow Onion, finely chopped
4 cloves TJ’s Garlic, peeled and finely chopped
5 TJ’s Whole Carrots, peeled and medium chopped
½ jar TJ’s Fire Roasted Bell Peppers, drained and medium chopped
1 carton TJ’s Organic Low Sodium Vegetable Broth

steps.text: Prepare the pasta according to the package directions, cooking to al dente. Set aside.
In a medium-sized pot, over medium heat, add the olive oil. When small bubbles begin to form, add the onion and garlic and sauté until both become soft and fragrant, about 5 minutes.

Add carrots, celery, and fire roasted bell peppers to the pan, and sauté for another 2 minutes. Add broth and bring to a boil. Lower temperature and simmer for 15-20 minutes until veggies are fork tender.
Add cooked pasta to the pot and stir to combine.
Remove from heat, and season with salt, pepper, and a squeeze of lemon to serve.

full-of-fusilli-veggie-soup.title: Full of Fusilli Veggie Soup

garden-caprese-pasta-salad.description: Getting dinner on the table doesn’t have to be a drag, thanks to Trader Joe’s Organic Mafalda Corta Pasta. This pasta shape (also known as Manfredine, or reginette), resembles miniature lasagna ribbons, and cooks up to a delightful al dente texture that easily transitions from lunch to dinner, and from hot, to cold, and even warm preparations. Mafalda Corta’s visual grandeur, fantastic forkability, and tender bite elevate the classic Caprese salad base of this recipe from appealing appetizer to totally enticing entrée.
ingredients: 1 package TJ’s Organic Mafalda Corta Pasta, cooked according to package instructions
1 tablespoon of your favorite TJ’s Olive Oil
1 ½ cup trimmed and cut fresh TJ’s Asparagus (chopped into thirds)
1 container TJ’s Ciliegine Whole Milk Fresh Mozzarella, drained
A couple cranks of TJ’s Black Peppercorns
½ cup chopped TJ’s Fresh Basil, for garnish

steps.text: Over medium-high heat, add oil to a large frying pan. Add asparagus and cook until tender, about 10 minutes, tossing occasionally.
To a serving bowl, combine pasta, Bruschetta Sauce, Ciliegine Mozzarella, and asparagus. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Top with basil and serve.

garden-caprese-pasta-salad.title: Garden Caprese Pasta Salad

garlic-potato-pizza.description: This herby Potato Pizza eschews traditional sauce in favor of rich, roasted garlic and bright Spanish Extra Virgin Olive Oil. Pair it with a crisp Sauvignon Blanc and let happy hour commence.
ingredients: 1 package TJ's Garlic & Herb Pizza Dough
TJ's Spanish Extra Virgin Olive Oil

steps.text: Place a pizza stone or baking sheet on the center rack of oven and preheat to 450°F. Peel away the loose skin of the garlic, leaving the heads intact. Trim 1/4 inch off the top of the garlic heads and place in small squares of aluminum foil. Drizzle exposed garlic cloves with olive oil and wrap tightly with foil. Bake about 30 minutes, remove from oven and set aside.

While garlic cooks, gently remove dough from bag, halve and place on a lightly floured work surface; let sit at room temperature for 30 minutes. Add 1 tablespoon olive oil and onions to a skillet over medium-low heat. Sauté about 20 minutes until golden brown. Remove from heat and set aside. Slice potatoes very thinly with a sharp knife or on a mandoline and set aside. Unwrap garlic heads and squeeze roasted cloves into a small bowl. Mash with a fork and set aside.

Stretch one piece of dough by hand or rolling pin to 8 inches in diameter. Place on a lightly floured pizza peel or cutting board. Brush dough with olive oil cover with half of the roasted garlic. Top with half of the potatoes and onions. Strip rosemary from stems and sprinkle half atop pizza.

Gently slide pizza onto preheated stone or baking sheet and bake 5-10 minutes, or until crust is blistered and potatoes are golden around the edges. Remove from oven with pizza peel, transfer to a cutting board and drizzle lightly with olive oil. Repeat pizza prep with remaining dough and ingredients. Slice and enjoy!

garlic-potato-pizza.title: Garlic Potato Pizza

garlicky-gochujang-spaghetti.description:
Quite pasta-bly the most famous noodle in the world, spaghetti is made a bit differently in the Italian region of Abruzzo, just east of Rome. Just like standard spaghetti, the Abruzzese version is long and thin, made with durum wheat semolina and water, but instead of having a rounded shape, this spaghetti is uniquely square and goes by the name spaghetti alla chitarra. Cooked to al dente, Trader Joe’s Spaghetti alla Chitarra’s shape and toothsome texture are well-suited to the buttery, spicy notes of the Gochujang Paste-infused sauce in this recipe.

Note: Before draining your cooked spaghetti, reserve a cup of the starchy pasta water to help emulsify the sauce. Add it little by little to the pan until your gochujang sauce becomes smooth, shiny, and thoroughly coats every noodle.
ingredients: 1 package (1 lb.) TJ’s Organic Spaghetti alla Chitarra Pasta, cooked according to package instructions
1 stick (or 8 tablespoons) TJ’s Salted Butter Quarters, divided
¼ cup TJ’s Organic Raw Apple Cider Vinegar or TJ's Rice Vinegar
¼ cup of your favorite TJ’s Honey

steps.text: To a large sauté pan, add 6 tablespoons butter over medium heat. Add garlic and sauté until aromatic, about 3 minutes. Add gochujang, vinegar, and honey to the pan. Cook 3-5 minutes until sauce thickens, stirring constantly to prevent the sauce from burning.

Add cooked spaghetti and remaining butter to pan and stir. Slowly add pasta water a few tablespoons at a time until the sauce becomes shiny and thoroughly coats each noodle. You may not need to add all the water.
Season with salt to taste, divide into bowls, and serve.

garlicky-gochujang-spaghetti.title: Garlicky Gochujang Spaghetti

garlicky-sweet-chili-green-beans.description:
This green bean side dish skips the stereotypically creamy casserole base, calling instead for charred Red Onion, fragrant Garlic, and tangy Sweet Chili Sauce to complement beautifully blisteredf Trader Joe's French Green Beans.

Pro-tip: Batch cook the beans in a blazing hot skillet to ensure they’re evenly blistered.
ingredients: 1 24-ounce bag of frozen TJ’s French Green Beans
1 medium-sized TJ’s Red Onion, cut into ¼-inch thick slices
1 ½ cups TJ’s Dry Roasted & Salted Almonds, chopped

steps.text: Heat a large non-stick skillet over high heat. While the pan is heating, set an empty sheet pan next to the stove.

Lightly spray the hot skillet with canola oil, then add a single layer of green beans (about half of the bag). Allow them to blister in the pan without disturbing them, for 2 to 3 minutes. Then shake the skillet to char on all sides. Transfer blistered beans to the sheet pan. Repeat with remaining green beans.

After the final batch of green beans has been transferred to the sheet pan, spray the empty skillet with more canola oil, then add the red onion slices, tossing them occasionally until they begin to char on the edges, 2-3 minutes.
Add all of the green beans back to the skillet with the onions, and add the chopped garlic, tossing to combine.
Season with salt, add the sweet chili sauce, then toss to coat.
Sprinkle in the chopped almonds, reserving a handful for garnish.
Place green beans on a platter and garnish with the remaining almonds to serve.

garlicky-sweet-chili-green-beans.title: Garlicky Sweet Chili Green Beans

ginger-honey-pickled-peaches.description: Preserve a bit of summer's bountiful produce with a sweet ginger kick.
ingredients: 1 cup TJ's Apple Juice or TJ's Country Peach Juice

steps.text: To peel the peaches, blanch in boiling water for about 2 minutes then immediately transfer with a slotted spoon to a bowl of ice water. Once peaches have cooled a minute or two, gently slide the skins off with your fingertips. Cut peaches in half, remove pits then cut into quarters.

To make the pickling brine, combine fruit juice, vinegar, honey, ginger and cinnamon in a medium sized nonreactive pot (any pot EXCEPT that made of aluminum, cast iron or copper). Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for 3-5 minutes.

To pickle the peaches, add peach segments and cook just until tender, about 3-5 minutes. 

Carefully remove peaches with a slotted spoon and transfer to a glass jar with a resealable lid. Let pickling mixture cool slightly and then pour over peaches. Seal with lid and store in the refrigerator. Ready to eat immediately, but will develop more flavor overnight. Each batch should keep for an additional week or two in the refrigerator. If any off flavors or smells develop, or if you notice fermentation, please discard.

Pairing & Serving Suggestions: Perfect served alongside roasted chicken or ham, warmed and spooned over vanilla ice cream, or even pureed and mixed into a cocktail (try it with sparkling grape juice, prosecco or bourbon)...

ginger-honey-pickled-peaches.title: Ginger Honey Pickled Peaches

gingerosa.description:
Our Triple Ginger Brew contains a substantial amount of fresh ginger, making it bold with a big bite. It really does offer that one-two-three ginger punch—perfect for ginger devotees and ideal as the base for mocktails and cocktails alike. Embellish this marvelous mocktail as you wish with an array of garnishes for a truly festive feel. 

Pro-tip: If you have an extra 30 minutes, sugar your cranberries! They make an especially impressive holiday garnish and require just the addition of sugar and water. Prepare the cranberries ahead of time and skewer them to serve.
ingredients: 1/2 bag TJ's Organic Whole Fresh Cranberries (seasonal), rinsed
3/4 cup TJ's Organic Sugar, divided (for optional step)
1 TJ's Navel Orange, sliced, for garnish

steps.text: Combine Ginger Brew and Orange Juice in a large pitcher with ice.

Optional Sugared Cranberries Garnish (about 30 minutes): Make a simple syrup by combining ½ cup sugar and ½ cup water in medium-size saucepan over medium-high heat. Stir to dissolve the sugar and bring to a boil. Remove from heat and let cool for 5 minutes. Add cranberries to simple syrup to thoroughly coat. Lay them on parchment paper or a cooling rack over a rimmed baking sheet to catch any drips. Let the cranberries dry for 5 minutes. They should feel sticky at the end of the waiting period. Add remaining sugar to a shallow bowl and add cranberries in batches, tossing them in the sugar until coated. Place them back on parchment paper or cooling rack for 10 more minutes before using.
To assemble the drinks: pour Ginger Brew and Orange Juice mixture into glasses with ice. Garnish with mint, orange slices, and skewered cranberries (or sugared cranberries) to serve.

gingerosa.title: Gingerosa

gluten-free-shrimp-scampi-tagliatelle.description: Made with a combination of corn and rice flours, Trader Joe’s Gluten Free Tagliatelle Pasta cooks up to an impressive al dente doneness, not dissimilar to traditional wheat noodles, and its ribbon-like construction makes it a superb vehicle for delivering and soaking up the garlicky and aromatic sauce in this shrimp scampi recipe. Top each bowl with toasted Nutritional Yeast for some added (and also gluten free) crunch!
ingredients: 1 package (8.8 ounces) TJ’s Gluten Free Tagliatelle Pasta, cooked according to package instructions, reserving one cup of pasta water
6 tablespoons of your favorite TJ’s Olive Oil, divided
1 pound TJ’s Wild Uncooked Argentinian Shrimp, thawed and patted dry
4 roughly chopped cloves of TJ’s Garlic
½ teaspoon TJ’s Red Pepper Flakes
½ cup of your favorite dry TJ’s White Wine
Juice from half of a TJ’s Lemon
¼ cup TJ’s Parsley, finely chopped

steps.text: Heat large sauté pan over medium heat. Add 2 tablespoons olive oil and once hot, add nutritional yeast. Cook for about 3 minutes until yeast is golden in color and begins to smell toasted. Remove from pan and wipe the pan clean.
Return pan to medium heat and add two tablespoons olive oil. Add thawed shrimp and cook 2 minutes per side. Remove from pan.

Add remaining 2 tablespoons olive oil. Add garlic and red pepper flakes and sauté for 2-3 minutes, until aromatic. Add white wine and cook until reduced by half, about 3 minutes. Add butter and whisk until sauce is emulsified.

Add shrimp and pasta to pan and toss to combine. Add ¼ cup of pasta water to pan and continue tossing sauce with pasta until sauce has thickened and becomes glossy, adding more pasta water incrementally, if necessary. Add lemon juice and season with sea salt to taste. Top with nutritional yeast and parsley to serve.

gluten-free-shrimp-scampi-tagliatelle.title: Gluten Free Shrimp Scampi Tagliatelle

gnocchi-ricotta-peas.description: Trader Joe’s Gnocchi are made with simple ingredients—a blend of potato and flour—and require little preparation to really shine. Here we’ve combined these delicate dumplings with creamy ricotta, fresh peas, zesty lemon juice, and a little crushed red pepper for a light, bright, and comforting bite.. Best yet, this dish comes together in under 20 minutes, making it a wonderful weeknight dinner option.
ingredients: Add 2 tablespoons TJ’s Sea Salt, plus more to taste
1 teaspoon TJ’s Organic Crushed Red Pepper
1 tablespoon zest and 1 tablespoon juice from a TJ’s Lemon

steps.text: Bring medium-sized pot of water to a boil and season the water with two tablespoons of sea salt.
Add the gnocchi and cook 1 minute, then add peas and cook for another 1-2 minutes. Strain gnocchi and peas and add them to a serving bowl.
Top gnocchi and peas with small dollops of ricotta, drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice, and sprinkle with crushed red pepper and lemon zest.
Season with a sprinkle of sea salt and garnish with basil leaves to serve.

gnocchi-ricotta-peas.title: Gnocchi with Ricotta & Peas

gnocchi-with-bacon-brussels-sprouts.description: Tender gnocchi, caramelized Brussels sprouts, and crispy Trader Joe's Uncured Dry Rubbed Sliced Bacon all enveloped in a cheesy sauce…what's not to love?
ingredients: 6 strips TJ's Uncured Dry Rubbed Sliced Bacon, diced
1 package TJ's Brussels Sprouts, cooked according to microwave instruction then quartered
1 package TJ's Gnocchi, cooked according to package instructions, reserving a 1/2 cup pasta water

steps.text: In a large frying pan over medium heat, add diced bacon, and cook until bacon begins to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add onion, garlic, and Brussels sprouts to pan, and sauté until onions are translucent, Brussels sprouts are caramelized, and bacon is golden brown.
Add cooked gnocchi to the pan and toss to combine.
Remove from heat while you prepare the sauce.
To a medium-sized pot on medium heat, melt butter, then add flour and whisk until combined.
Add the milk, salt, pepper, and mustard and stir until it thickens, about 3 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in cheese until melted.
Return the pan with gnocchi to a medium-low heat and add cheese sauce.
Add pasta water, one tablespoon at a time, until the sauce thins and coats the gnocchi. (You will likely not need all the pasta water.)

gnocchi-with-bacon-brussels-sprouts.title: Gnocchi with Bacon & Brussels Sprouts

goat-greatest-of-all-toast.description: These flavorful Trader Joe's Yellow Cling Peaches are grown in Valencia, Spain where they're nurtured in proximity to the warm Mediterranean Sea-then peeled, pitted, and preserved in white grape juice. Serve the beautiful, intact Halves with a dollop of cheese or cream in the center and a sprinkle of granola or coconut. Slice to add a pop of color & burst of juicy sweetness to your ice cream, yogurt, or fruit salad. Or try this sweet-savory breakfast or snack combo and layer them on toast atop a hearty schmear of Trader Joe's Goat's Milk Cheese Marinated with Herbs.
ingredients: 1 container TJ's Goat's Milk Cheese Marinated With Herbs, softened to room temperature
4 TJ's Cling Peach Halves, thinly sliced

steps.text: Toast multigrain bread to desired level of doneness.
Top each piece of toast with a goat cheese disk and spread to cover evenly.
Top with peach slices and basil.
Drizzle with oil & herbs from cheese container, if desired. Enjoy!

goat-greatest-of-all-toast.title: G.O.A.T. (Greatest Of All Toast)

gochu-dang-pot-roast.description:
The key to highlighting the savory flavor and fall-apart texture of Trader Joe's USDA Choice Premium Angus Beef Boneless Chuck Roast is slow roasting or braising, making it a must-have for cozy season grocery lists. Impressively sized and budget-friendly to boot, Chuck Roast is ideal for feeding large groups or meal-prepping for a busy week ahead.  

By employing a handful of Trader Joe’s products to help save time (hooray for Mirepoix and Organic Beef Broth!) and build big flavor (TJ’s Gochujang FTW!), this recipe is mostly hands off, requiring about 30 minutes of prep before popping the pot roast in the oven to cook low and slow.
ingredients: 1 TJ’s Premium Angus Beef Boneless Chuck Roast
1 bag TJ’s Dutch Yellow Baby Potatoes

steps.text: Preheat oven to 325°F. Pat chuck roast dry and salt generously on all sides.
In a 3-quart Dutch oven with a lid, heat oil over medium-high heat. When oil is hot, add roast and sear on every side, until a golden crust is achieved, 3-5 minutes per side, then remove from pot.

Lower heat to medium. Add mirepoix and sauté until softened and aromatic, about 5 minutes. Add gochujang and stir frequently, until mirepoix veggies are evenly coated and gochujang darkens in color, about 2 minutes. Add flour and stir again, until mirepoix veggies are evenly coated.
Add ¼ cup broth to deglaze the pot, using a wooden spoon to scrape up any darkened gochujang. Add remaining broth and bring to a simmer.
Add roast back to pot, cover with lid, and place in oven to cook for 2 hours. Remove from oven, add potatoes to pot, replace lid, and return to oven to cook for 1 hour, until roast is fork-tender.
Remove roast from oven and use two forks to shred the meat. Stir and salt to taste. To serve, plate meat and potatoes, and cover with thickened gravy from the pot. Gochu-dang, that’s good!

gochu-dang-pot-roast.title: Gochu-Dang, That’s Good Pot Roast!

gochujang-glazed-carrots.description: Trader Joe’s Gochujang is a Korean fermented red pepper paste that works just as well as a condiment as it does a soup base, a marinade, a dipping sauce, and so much more. It's simultaneously sweet, savory, and spicy—and it’s the base of this fiery-hued glaze that you’ll want to pour over all of your roasted vegetables from this day forward.
ingredients: 1 pound (half the bag) TJ’s Organic Carrots of Many Colors, peeled and quartered lengthwise
2 teaspoons TJ’s Organic Toasted Sesame Oil
¼ cup chopped TJ’s Green Onion

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
On a large, rimmed baking sheet, arrange quartered carrots in a single layer.
Combine the Gochujang, soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, canola oil, and sesame oil in a small bowl, and whisk to combine.
Pour glaze over the carrots, reserving a couple of tablespoons for serving. Using tongs, toss to coat carrots with.

Cover carrots with foil and bake on center rack of oven for 20 minutes, until carrots are tender and sauce is thinned out. Remove from oven and carefully remove foil. Return carrots to oven and bake an additional 25 minutes, tossing halfway through, until carrots are tender and caramelized at the edges. Remove from oven.
Transfer carrots to a serving dish, drizzle with reserved sauce and top with chopped green onions.

gochujang-glazed-carrots.title: Gochujang-Glazed Carrots

good-as-gold-mini-meatballs.description:
Trader Joe's Carolina Gold Barbeque Sauce is a rich, thick golden-hued, mustard-based sauce that reminds us of some of the best-grilled meats we've enjoyed in the Carolinas. It's sweet & smoky, with a hint of molasses and an ideal blend of spices.     

Use it as a glaze near the end of barbecuing, as a condiment for burgers and sandwiches, or as a dipping sauce for Trader Joe's Gluten Free Breaded Chicken Breast Nuggets, veggies, or fries.  You can even go non-traditional and use it as a simmer sauce for Trader Joe's Party Size Mini Meatballs. No matter how you use it, your result will be worth its weight in gold - Carolina Gold.
ingredients: 1 bag TJ's Party Size Mini Meatballs
1 bottle TJ's Carolina Gold Barbeque Sauce

steps.text: Place meatballs in a large microwave-safe container with lid. Microwave 4 minutes.
Meanwhile, in a small saucepan, heat barbeque sauce on low, stirring occasionally.
Remove bowl of meatballs from microwave. Add meatballs to saucepan and stir to coat with sauce. Continue to heat on low, about 3 minutes, until sauce is bubbly.
Transfer meatballs and sauce to a serving bowl. Garnish with chives and chili flakes to taste, and dig in!

good-as-gold-mini-meatballs.title: Good As Gold Mini Meatballs

grandmommys-gravy.description: This is an heirloom family gravy recipe that's been handed down for four generations. Made simpler with Trader Joe's Mirepoix (an essential soup- and sauce-starter comprised of conveniently chopped carrots, celery and onions), the base of this rich gravy calls for a roux (say "ROO"). It's a mixture of fat and flour used to thicken soups, stews, gravy and other velvety sauces. Proceed with caution: one taste and you'll be tempted to slurp this Southern classic right out of the gravy boat.
ingredients: 1 Turkey Neck, from TJ's Fresh Whole Turkey of your choice (if you choose to omit turkey neck, increase measurement of TJ's Turkey Stock to 3 Cups, and increase simmering time to thicken the gravy)
1 cup TJ's Chicken Broth or Vegetable Broth
2 tablespoons pan drippings from cooked turkey (optional)

steps.text: Place the turkey neck in a medium pot with 2 1/2 Cups of water. Cover and bring to a boil. Remove lid, reduce heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, until meat can be pulled from turkey neck with forks. Turn off heat, set shredded turkey meat and stock aside, and discard turkey neck.

While turkey neck stock simmers, heat olive oil in a large sauté pan over medium heat. Add Mirepoix to pan and sauté for 20 minutes or until browned, stirring occasionally. Turn off heat and set aside.

For the roux: In a wide sauce pan, melt the unsalted butter over medium heat. Add flour and whisk vigorously until flour is fully incorporated with butter, being careful not to burn the mixture. Roux will darken slightly to a light caramel color.

Measure 2 cups of the turkey neck stock from pot and slowly incorporate into the roux, whisking constantly. Repeat the process with 1 cup TJ's Chicken or Vegetable Broth, incorporate slowly and whisk constantly. Add sautéed Mirepoix, salt, pepper and pan drippings (if desired) to the gravy and stir until combined. Reduce heat to low and simmer until desired consistency is reached. Serve immediately*.
*If dinner is not quite ready, keep gravy covered on the stove over low heat, stirring occasionally. Just before serving, add stock to thin gravy to desired consistency.

grandmommys-gravy.title: Grandmommy's Gravy

gratest-fruit-caprese.description:
Nearly everyone who’s experienced it enjoys that moment when the Burrata ball is sliced open to reveal luscious cream loaded with shreds of fresh mozzarella. But not everyone knows that this coveted Burrata Filling is actually an Italian cheese on its own, known as Stracciatella. 

Trader Joe’s Stracciatella Burrata Filling is richly textured and mildly sweet, and brings cheesy, Italian flair to your summer entrées and side dishes. Drop dollops of Burrata Filling on your hot-from-the-oven pizza or plate of pasta primavera. It makes a great addition to a crisp green salad, and it truly shines as the base of a classic Caprese—or this whimsical version that swaps traditional tomatoes with grated frozen fruit.

Note: Keep fruit frozen while preparing the components of this dish.
ingredients: Your favorite TJ’s Extra Virgin Olive Oil
A few sprigs of TJ’s Fresh Basil
1 TJ’s Ciabatta Demi Baguette, sliced into rounds and toasted

steps.text: To a shallow serving platter or bowl, evenly distribute the Stracciatella. Using a fine grater, carefully grate frozen fruit over the Stracciatella until covered.
Drizzle with olive oil, sprinkle with salt, add a few drops of glaze, and garnish with basil sprigs.
Serve immediately with toasted ciabatta.

gratest-fruit-caprese.title: The Gratest Fruit Caprese

great-balls-of-fire.description:
These Garlic & Herb Pizza Dough-wrapped Homestyle Angus Beef Meatballs bring big flavor with a fiery kick, thanks to Trader Joe’s Italian Bomba Hot Pepper Sauce. They’re as fun to make as they are to eat, so consider corralling a few extra hands to help assemble! 

This recipe was a runner-up in the 2026 Store Recipe Contest and was created by the Crew at Store #217 in Rancho Cucamonga, CA!

Pro-tip: To cut down the prep time, let your block of cream cheese sit on the counter for about an hour prior to assembly.
ingredients: 2 packages TJ’s Garlic & Herb Pizza Dough, left on the counter for 30 minutes to come to room temperature
1 package TJ’s Homestyle Angus Beef Meatballs, cooked to your preferred package instructions, then cooled
1 jar TJ’s Italian Bomba Hot Pepper Sauce
1 log TJ’s Butter with Parmesan, Garlic & Herb, melted

steps.text: In a medium-sized bowl, combine the Bomba Sauce with the cream cheese, and stir until smooth.

Cut each pizza dough into eight equal pieces, so you have a total of 16 pieces. (You’ll need only 12 dough balls, so reserve the extra four pieces for another use—breadsticks, perhaps?) Gently flatten each piece of dough into a three-inch circle.
Spread a heaping tablespoon of the Bomba mixture onto each dough round.

Place one meatball on top of the mixture, in the center of the dough round. Pull the dough up and around the meatball, pinching the seams together to enclose the meatball, taking care not to wrap it too tightly.
Place as many dough balls in the air fryer that will fit without touching, seam side-down. Air fry at 375°F for 7-10 minutes, or until puffed and golden brown. Repeat with remaining dough balls.
Brush or drizzle with melted butter to serve.

great-balls-of-fire.title: Great Balls of Fire

greek-style-potato-salad.description: While it's sure to please your 4th of July party patrons served right out of said package, Trader Joe's Old Fashioned Potato Salad is also a marvelous, not-quite-blank canvas for all manner of mix-ins. This recipe cools things down by combining our trusty 'tater salad with diced red bell pepper, crunchy cucumbers, briny Kalamata olives, and Trader Joe's Organic Crumbled Feta Cheese. It's a Greek style side dish that positively sings alongside Trader Joe's Spatchcocked Lemon Rosemary Chicken.
ingredients: 1 container TJ's Old Fashioned Potato Salad
1 TJ’s Red Bell Pepper, cored, de-seeded and diced
1/2 jar TJ’s Kalamata Olives, drained and sliced in half

steps.text: Transfer potato salad to a large serving bowl. Gently fold in cucumbers, bell pepper, cheese, and olives. Garnish with parsley and serve.

greek-style-potato-salad.title: Greek Style Potato Salad

green-dragon-fish-tacos.description: On a heat scale of "Meh" to "Yowza!!" Trader Joe's Green Dragon Hot Sauce rates a solidly satisfying "Whoa!" (About a 7 on the more mundane 1-10 scale). Made with jalapeños, tomatillos, cilantro, garlic, and habanero pepper powder, with a dash of vinegar and a splash of lime juice, it's a creative condiment that's delicious on... just about everything. Seriously! Drizzle Green Dragon on eggs, salads, burgers, enchiladas, fried rice, fish tacos...
ingredients: 2-3 TJ's Organic Tomatoes on the Vine
TJ's Organic Shredded Green & Red Cabbage with Orange Carrots

steps.text: Preheat oven to 475°F. Arrange fish nuggets on a greased baking sheet. Bake on center rack of oven for 15-18 minutes until crisp. Remove from oven and let cool slightly.
While fish nuggets bake, slice tomatoes and set aside. Warm tortillas in a pan over medium heat or directly over the gas flame, using tongs to flip.
To assemble each taco, place two nuggets in a warm tortilla and top with tomatoes and cabbage. Drizzle with as much hot sauce as you like and enjoy!

green-dragon-fish-tacos.title: Green Dragon Fish Tacos

green-goddess-fried-goat-cheese-medallio.description: Trader Joe’s Chevre is fresh, soft, and unaged; its subtle, earthy undertones and ever-so-slight sweetness add interest to all sorts of common comestibles and simple dishes. Serve this Goat Cheese log with crackers and crudités, crumble it over pastas, pizzas, and omelets, or fry thick medallions coated in TJ's Green Goddess Spice Blend-seasoned breadcrumbs and serve atop a spinach salad.
ingredients: 1 TJ’s Chevre Goat's Milk Cheese, sliced into 6 medallions, then chilled until ready to use
½ cup TJ’s Japanese Style Panko Breadcrumbs
1 teaspoon TJ’s Green Goddess Spice Blend

steps.text: Line up a plate of chilled goat medallions next to the bowl of beaten egg. In a small bowl, thoroughly combine breadcrumbs and the Green Goddess seasoning with a fork. Place an empty plate next to breadcrumb bowl.
steps.title: Prepare your dredging station

steps.text: Dip 1 chilled goat cheese medallion in the egg, thoroughly and evenly coating it. Use a fork to lift it out of the egg and let the excess drip back into the bowl, then carefully add the medallion to the panko bowl. Use another fork to gently flip medallion until thoroughly and evenly coated, and carefully transfer to the empty plate. Repeat with remaining cheese medallions.

In a medium frying pan, add oil and heat over medium. When the oil is hot, add half of the medallions and fry until golden on one side, 2-3 minutes. Carefully flip and cook until the second side is golden. Transfer medallions to a paper towel-lined plate or cooling rack. Repeat with remaining medallions.
Serve over a salad, on a cheese board, in a sandwich, with a fried egg…

green-goddess-fried-goat-cheese-medallio.title: Green Goddess Fried Goat Cheese Medallions

green-goddess-grilled-corn.description: Nothing says summer like fresh corn grilled in its own husk. Baste it with Trader Joe's Green Goddess Salad Dressing and a smattering of chili flakes before you toss it on the grill, and you've got a fresh-tasting, unfussy side dish to pair with the rest of your summer fare.
ingredients: TJ's Sea Salt & Pepper, to taste

steps.text: Remove two or three outer layers of the husk from each ear of corn. A few layers should remain to protect the corn as it cooks. Gently peel back the remaining husks to expose the corn and remove as much of the silk as is possible. Place husks back over the ears and add to a large bowl or baking dish. Fill with water to cover corn and soak for 1 hour.
Gently peel back the husks once again to expose the corn. Baste generously with dressing, and top with chili flakes (if using), salt and pepper.

Fold the husks back into place and line up all the corn on a sturdy sheet of aluminum foil. Place the foil directly on the grill over medium heat. Grill 15 minutes, turning frequently. Remove foil from grill and cook another 5 minutes, allowing the husks to get nice and charred. Remove from grill and let cool for a few minutes before serving.

green-goddess-grilled-corn.title: Green Goddess Grilled Corn

green-goddess-pasta-salad.description: A consummate crowd-pleaser for al fresco appetites of all kinds, this pasta salad layers snappy haricots verts and blanched kale with crunchy slivered almonds for an array of teeth-tickling textures. The whole thing is tied together with Trader Joe's Green Goddess Salad Dressing, a salad sidekick that offers fragrant notes of basil & chives, savory garlic & green onion, bright lemon juice, and tangy apple cider vinegar, ensuring flavorful zing in every forkful of pasta and veggies.
ingredients: 1 package TJ's Organic Brown Rice & Quinoa Spaghetti
1 bag TJ's Organic Tuscan Kale, stems removed OR 1 bag TJ's Cruciferous Crunch
1 bottle TJ's Green Goddess Salad Dressing
TJ's Fresh Basil, rinsed and dried

steps.text: Cut corner off bag of haricots verts and microwave 2 minutes. Remove haricots verts from package and place on a clean dish towel to cool and dry. Transfer haricots verts to cutting board and slice in half crosswise; set aside.

Bring a large pot of generously salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook 7 minutes. Add kale and cook about 2 more minutes, until noodles are very al dente and kale is wilted. Drain and rinse thoroughly with cold water. Drain very well and transfer mixture to a large bowl. Add haricots verts, dressing, and almonds to bowl and toss to combine. Season to taste with sea salt and toss once more.
Serve immediately, or chill pasta salad for 1 hour. Tear up or slice fresh basil and garnish just before serving.

green-goddess-pasta-salad.title: Green Goddess Pasta Salad

green-goddess-veggie-bowl.description: Plates are great, but sometimes an entire meal in one bowl is even better—not to mention, it’s a handy vessel for eating on-the-go or on the couch. Fluffy, protein-packed Trader Joe’s Organic White Quinoa acts as the base of this bowl, and is crowned with Greek Chickpeas with Parsley & Cumin and roasted sweet potatoes, and finally gilded with tangy feta and a hearty drizzle of Green Goddess Dressing. Layer the ingredients accordingly so you can enjoy every component of this plant-based powerhouse in each bite.
ingredients: 2 cups TJ’s Organic White Quinoa, cooked according to the package instruction
1 can TJ’s Greek Chickpeas with Parsley & Cumin
½ cup TJ’s Green Goddess Dressing
½ cup TJ’s Raw Slivered Almonds

steps.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.

Drain the liquid in the can of chickpeas. Arrange chickpeas on one half of a baking sheet and diced sweet potato on the other. Drizzle sweet potato with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Bake for 30-40 minutes, until chickpeas become crispy in texture and sweet potato is fork tender.
To assemble, add quinoa to the bottom of the bowl and top with chickpeas, sweet potato, and spinach. Pour 2 tablespoons of dressing over each bowl. Sprinkle with feta and almonds to serve.

green-goddess-veggie-bowl.title: Green Goddess Veggie Bowl (The Hook)

green-juice-smoothie.description:
It's not always easy to get your greens. As vital as verdant veggies like kale & spinach are to a healthy diet, they are easily overlooked in your day-to-day eating. That's why we recommend Trader Joe's Organic Cold Pressed Green Juice Beverage—a delicious and refreshing blend of leafy greens, veggies, and zesty citrus fruit.    

As brilliantly green as it is brilliantly concocted, each serving (about eight fl. ounces) of this Green Juice Beverage contains the following: one cucumber, two stalks of celery, a quarter of a grapefruit, a quarter of a head of lettuce, one kale leaf, four spinach leaves, six sprigs of parsley, a teaspoon of mint tea, and a bit of lemon. In other words, there's close an entire garden's worth of veggies, cold pressed and ready to drink inside each bottle - and an organic garden, at thatip it plain, or use it to give your morning smoothies a boost of fresh, vegetal flavor.
ingredients: 8 fl. oz. TJ's Organic Cold Pressed Green Juice Beverage
1 heaping cup TJ's Frozen Pineapple Tidbits
4 tablespoons TJ's Oven Toasted Old Fashioned Organic Oats

steps.text: Add all ingredients to a blender. Cover and blend on high until thoroughly combined. Pour into a glass and enjoy!

green-juice-smoothie.title: Green Juice Smoothie

griddled-pepper-jelly--cream-cheese.description: A bit of heat, a bit of sweetness, a lot of cream cheese. This 'wich is especially excellent when cut into triangles and served as an appetizer.
ingredients: 1 jar TJ's Hot & Sweet Pepper Jelly
1 block of TJ's Cream Cheese, cut into 1/4"slices

steps.text: Heat skillet over medium heat. Divide butter and spread evenly on slices of bread. Place one slice butter-down on skillet. Immediately place slices of cream cheese onto bread, enough to cover (about five). Top cream cheese with pepper jelly. Place second slice of bread on top with butter facing up.
Let cook for 3-4 minutes, until bottom is golden brown. Flip the sandwich and let it cook for 3-4 more minutes, until bottom is golden brown and the cream cheese has softened.
Transfer sandwich to a cutting board and cut into triangles, or your preferred shape.
Cook remaining two sandwiches in the same manner. Serve immediately.

griddled-pepper-jelly--cream-cheese.title: Griddled Pepper Jelly & Cream Cheese

grilled-asparagus-salad.description: Trader Joe's Grilled Asparagus Spears lend smoky flavor to this salad without the need for firing up the grill.
ingredients: 1 package TJ's Grilled Asparagus Spears, thawed according to package directions and chopped into large pieces
1 bag TJ's Roasted Corn, microwaved according to package directions
2 TJ's Red Bell Peppers (or Enjoya Peppers), chopped
1/2 to 3/4 cup TJ's Organic Rosé Vinaigrette

steps.text: Combine vegetables in a large bowl. Drizzle with vinaigrette and gently toss to coat. Season to taste with salt.
Chill in refrigerator for 1 hour and serve.

grilled-asparagus-salad.title: Grilled Asparagus Salad

grilled-blue-cheese-apricots-spicy-pecan.description: This blues-y composition (made flowing with mozzarella) gets jazzy with inflections of bright dried apricots and spicy pecans. You'll be singing for more!
ingredients: I slice of your favorite TJ's Multigrain Bread
3 Tbsp TJ's Caved Aged Blue Cheese, crumbled
2 Tbsp TJ's Sweet and Spicy Pecans, chopped

steps.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Lightly toast bread (light setting on toaster) or about 1 to 2 minutes each side in the oven).
Mix blue cheese, apricots and pecans together. Set aside.

Place arugula on toast, top with mozzarella, and then with the blue mixture. Place in oven and toast until all cheese is melted, apricots are warm and pecans are slightly toasted; about 6 to 8 minutes. Adorn with extra apricots and/or pecans. Serve right away.

grilled-blue-cheese-apricots-spicy-pecan.title: Grilled Blue Cheese, Apricots & Spicy Pecans

grilled-camembert-apple-prosciutto.description: There is ham and cheese, and then there is grilled Camembert, Apple, & Prosciutto on Cinnamon Raisin Bread. Prepare to be delighted!

steps.text: Spray one side of each slice of bread with canola oil, and place the slices (sprayed-side down) on a clean working surface.

Cut the camembert into thin pieces and place (lightly spread) on each slice of bread. On one slice of bread, layer the apple, followed by the Prosciutto, atop the cheese. Carefully sandwich the two sides together.

Heat a large fry pan or griddle over medium heat until hot. Place the sandwich on the pan and reduce the heat to medium-low. After about a minute, cover the pan with a large lid, and let it cook for about 2-3 minutes more, until the bottom is golden brown. Flip the sandwich and let it cook for 3-4 more minutes (covering again after 1 minute to encourage the melt), until bottom is golden brown and the cheese is melting-to-oozing over the edges.
Transfer the sandwiches to a cutting board and cut in half. Serve immediately.

grilled-camembert-apple-prosciutto.title: Grilled Camembert, Apple & Prosciutto

grilled-caprese-on-cauliflower-crust.description: Carb conscious, cutting out gluten, covet the capabilities of cauliflower - we've sandwiched it all in this Grilled Caprese, along with layer upon layer of fresh tastes and textures. So good!

steps.text:
Cauliflower Crust: Preheat oven to 425º.

Pour cauliflower into a pyrex pie dish; microwave on high for 5 minutes; take out and stir-repeat 3 times (total time in microwave = 20 minutes). Spread the heated cauliflower over a large piece of parchment paper or clean dish towel and let cool completely. 

Add eggs, salt and pepper to a large mixing bowl and whip. Pour in cauliflower and cheese;.mix well. 

Line a quarter-sized sheet pan (about 9 1/2" x 13" x 1") with parchment paper and spread the cauliflower mixture evenly across the pan. Place in oven for 25 minutes. remove when the cauliflower is baked to a golden brown on top. Allow to cool completely in the pan.

Cut into sandwich slices. Use right away or refrigerate or freeze until ready to use. (Once refrigerated or frozen, place in a 350ºF oven for 6 to 10 minutes to bring to room temperature before serving or using in recipes.)

Grilled Caprese: Taking two slices of the prepared Cauliflower Crust, spray one side of each slice of crust with canola oil, and place the slices (sprayed-side down) on a clean working surface.

On each crust, layer on two slices of mozzarella. On one crust, atop the cheese, layer the tomato, and the basil. Carefully sandwich the crusts. 

Heat a large fry pan or griddle over medium heat until hot. Place the sandwich on the pan and reduce the heat to medium-low. After about a minute, cover the pan with a large lid, and let it cook for about 2-3 minutes more, until the bottom is golden brown. Flip the sandwich and let it cook for 3-4 more minutes (covering again after 1 minute to encourage the melt), until cheese is melting. 

Transfer the sandwiches to a cutting board and cut in half. Serve immediately.

grilled-caprese-on-cauliflower-crust.title: Grilled Caprese on Cauliflower Crust

grilled-fruit-skewers.description: Meat and veggies are solid skewer options, but have you experienced the surprising simplicity and downright deliciousness of grilled fruit skewers? The direct heat of the grill will caramelize the sugars in the fruit and enhance their natural sweetness, resulting in a light dessert that also happens to be visually stunning. A TJ’s Test Kitchen pro-tip: with their sturdy structure and intense fruit flavors, a combo of Trader Joe’s Pineapple, Watermelon, and Cantaloupe can take the heat (berries need not apply). And if you can take the heat, a sprinkle of TJ’s Chile Lime Seasoning Blend will really make these skewers sizzle.
ingredients: Your favorite TJ’s Oil, for grill grates
TJ’s Chile Lime Seasoning Blend, to taste

steps.text: Skewer 3-4 pieces of each fruit onto each skewer (depending on the length of your skewer), in whatever order you’d like, topping each skewer with a wedge of lime.

Carefully brush grill grates with oil. Grill skewers over medium heat, 2-4 minutes per side until grill marks appear. Remove from heat and squeezed grilled lime over the entire skewer. Lightly sprinkle with Chile Lime Seasoning Blend, to serve.

grilled-fruit-skewers.title: Grilled Fruit Skewers

grilled-kim-cheese.description: For a magnificently melty, gloriously golden grilled cheese sandwich, use Trader Joe’s Organic Mayonnaise. It has a higher smoke point than butter, making it less likely that your bread will burn, and you won’t have to wait for your butter to soften, giving you more time to enjoy this punchy, piquant, kimchi-packed grilled cheese. Yes, please!

steps.text: Spread an even layer of mayo on each slice of bread.

Heat a medium-sized, non-stick pan over medium heat. Add one slice of bread to the pan, mayo side-down, then top with Muenster cheese, chopped kimchi, and Provolone. Top with the remaining bread slice, mayo-side-up. Cook 4-5 minutes, until the bread is golden and the cheese begins to melt.
Carefully flip the sandwich, cover and cook another 4-5 minutes until the bread is golden and the cheese is fully melted. Serve immediately.

grilled-kim-cheese.title: Grilled Kim-Cheese

grilled-olive-zucchini-rice-salad.description: Grilling olives gives them savory oomph and a pleasant pop of texture, but it can be a time-consuming task to say the least. To bring them into weeknight recipe territory without the extra work, grab a jar of Trader Joe’s Grilled Pitted Green Olives. You’ll get the most out of each jar by using the oil the olives are bathed in to cook the zucchini and dress the salad, and you won’t spend the evening fishing wayward olives out of the base of your barbeque.
ingredients: ¼ cup sliced TJ’s Grilled Pitted Green Olives, plus 3 tablespoons of oil, divided
2 medium-sized TJ’s Zucchini, sliced into half-moons
1 cup TJ’s Organic Baby Spinach, roughly chopped
1 microwavable bag of TJ’s Rice Medley, cooked according to package instructions
Juice from half a TJ’s Lemon

steps.text: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil from olive jar to a medium-sized skillet, over medium heat. Add sliced zucchini and sauté until zucchini begin to brown, about 5-7 minutes.
To your serving bowl, add warmed rice, chopped spinach, cooked zucchini, and slices olives. Add remaining oil and lemon juice, then toss to combine.

grilled-olive-zucchini-rice-salad.title: Grilled Olive & Zucchini Rice Salad

grilled-paneer-skewers.description:
Trader Joe’s Paneer Indian Style Cheese is a firm and crumbly fresh cheese with a subtle tang.
