Its decidedly mild flavor makes it an excellent choice for curries and soups, as it allows the spices and aromatics to be the star of the show, while its ability to hold its shape comes in handy when frying, baking, or in this case, grilling. These skewers make a fun appetizer, or a satisfying main alongside a Half-Hearted BLT Salad or Quick Golden Butter Rice. 

Don’t forget the skewers! If using wooden skewers, soak them in water in advance to prevent them from burning.

Pro-tip: Tossing the Paneer in the seasoned yogurt helps prevent it from sticking on the grill. To imbue it with TJ’s Tikka Masala Curry Sauce flavor, marinate it overnight.
ingredients: 1/3 cup TJ’s Plain Greek Yogurt Made with Whole Milk
3 tablespoons TJ’s Tikka Masala Curry Sauce
1 package TJ’s Paneer Indian Style Cheese, cut into one-inch cubes
10-15 of your favorite TJ’s Cherry or Grape Tomatoes

steps.text: In a medium-sized bowl, combine the Greek Yogurt and curry sauce. Add cubed paneer to bowl and toss to coat. Cover and marinate overnight (or if you’re pressed for time, simply proceed to the next step).
Lightly coat tomatoes in oil.
To assemble the skewers, thread paneer and tomatoes onto a skewer, alternating between each as you go.

Heat grill or grill pan over medium-high heat, and oil, as needed. When hot, add skewers, and cook for 2-3 minutes per side. Take care not to flip too soon, otherwise they may stick. Season with salt to serve.

grilled-paneer-skewers.title: Grilled Paneer Skewers

grilled-peach-salad.description: Grill a few extra peaches when prepping this salad and serve them with Trader Joe's Vanilla Ice Cream for dessert!
ingredients: 3 large TJ's Peaches, firm with a little give
1 1/2 Tbsp TJ's Extra Virgin California Olive Oil
1 cup diced TJ's Sliced Roast Chicken Breast with Rib Meat
1/4 cup TJ's Sliced Honey Roasted Almonds
6 tablespoons TJ's Fat Free Balsamic Vinaigrette

steps.text: Cut the peaches in half and pit them. Cut the halves into wide wedges, and then toss the peaches with olive oil.

Place the peaches directly on the grill (or cast iron griddle on stovetop) and cook over a medium heat (on all sides) until grill marks form and peaches are tender but not falling apart; about five minutes. Remove peaches from heat and set aside.
In a large serving bowl, layer spinach, chicken, blueberries, goat cheese and almonds. Add peaches and drizzle with balsamic vinaigrette. Enjoy!

grilled-peach-salad.title: Grilled Peach Salad

grilled-pineapple-prosciutto-stuffed-por.description:
Marinade, dressing, glaze: Trader Joe’s Soyaki is a versatile superstar when it comes to grilling, and it imbues a ton of flavor to TJ’s Frenched, Bone-In, Center-Cut Pork Loin Chops from the inside out. 

In this recipe, what’s on the inside is what really matters since these Pork Chops are thoroughly stuffed with grilled (and Soyaki-dress) Pineapple and a TJ’s Prosciutto Wrapped Fresh Mozzarella Cheese stick, offering a double dose of pork and a sensational cheese pull when you cut into it. Yes, cheese!
ingredients: 2 TJ's Frenched, Bone-In, Center-Cut Pork Loin Chops
2 TJ's Prosciutto Wrapped Fresh Mozzarella Cheese sticks

steps.text: Place pork chops in a shallow dish. Pour ½ cup of Soyaki over the pork chops and turn them so they are evenly coated. Place in the refrigerator and allow to marinate for 4 hours to overnight, covered. Flip the pork chops halfway through the marinade time.
Heat grill to medium-high heat. Grill pineapple for 3-6 minutes per side, or until it is caramelized and slightly charred.
Remove the pineapple from the grill and chop into small pieces, then place in a bowl. Add 2 tablespoons of Soyaki and mix to combine. Set aside.

Remove the pork chops from the marinade and discard any leftover Soyaki. Place the pork chop flat on a cutting board. Using a sharp knife, cut horizontally into the side of the pork chop, making a deep incision but not cutting all the way through to create a pocket for filling.

Place 1 heaping tablespoon of the chopped pineapple into each pork chop. Tuck two halves of the prosciutto-wrapped mozzarella sticks into each pork chop pocket. Spoon in the remaining pineapple between the two chops to fill the pockets.
Grill the pork chops over the direct heat for approximately 5 minutes on each side. Move the chops to indirect heat, brushing each chop with about a tablespoon of Soyaki.
Cover the grill and continue to cook until the chops reach an internal temperature of 145°F. Rest the chops for 5 - 10 minutes before serving.

grilled-pineapple-prosciutto-stuffed-por.title: Grilled Pineapple & Prosciutto-Stuffed Pork Chops

grilled-sharp-cheddar-applewood-bacon-sh.description: Grindy! This delicious beast marries applewood smoked bacon, sautéed sprouts and flowing sharp Cheddar on a crispy multigrain crust.
ingredients: 1/2 cup TJ's Shaved Brussels Sprouts, lightly sautéed
2 slices TJ's Multigrain Sliced Bread or TJ's Sprouted Wheat Sourdough Bread
2 slices TJ's Uncured Applewood Smoked Bacon, cooked

steps.text: Spray one side of each slice of bread with canola oil, and place the slices (sprayed-side down) on a clean working surface.
Divide the cheese and pile evenly on each slice of bread. On each slice, place two strips of bacon. On one slice, add the sautéed sprouts. Carefully sandwich the two sides together.

Heat a large fry pan or griddle over medium heat until hot. Place the sandwich on the pan and reduce the heat to medium-low. After about a minute, cover the pan with a large lid, and let it cook for about 2-3 minutes more, until the bottom is golden brown. Flip the sandwich and let it cook for 3-4 more minutes (covering again after 1 minute to encourage the melt), until bottom is golden brown and the cheese is melting.
Transfer the sandwiches to a cutting board and cut in half. Serve immediately.

grilled-sharp-cheddar-applewood-bacon-sh.title: Grilled Sharp Cheddar, Applewood Bacon, & Shaved Sprouts

grilled-zucchini-with-salsa-macha.description:
Trader Joe’s Crunchy Sesame Sunflower Seeds Pepitas Salsa Macha is a versatile condiment that offers a sublimely crunchy texture, a toasty, nutty flavor, with little pops of heat, thanks to the addition of tiny Pequin chile peppers. A drizzle easily boosts tacos, roasted veggies, and pizza. Here, Salsa Macha not only dresses the grilled zucchini and feta cheese, the olive oil in the jar is brushed over the zucchini before grilling to help prevent sticking. 

Opt for TJ’s Authentic Greek Feta with an ultra-creamy texture that easily crumbles. It acts as a cooling complement to the bites of heat throughout…
ingredients: 3 TJ’s Zucchini, sliced into thin planks
TJ’s Crunchy Sesame Sunflower Seeds Pepitas Salsa Macha
1 block TJ’s Authentic Greek Feta In Brine, crumbled

steps.text: Heat grill or grill pan over medium-high heat.
Salt zucchini planks on both sides, then pat dry to remove excess moisture.
Brush salsa macha over both sides of the zucchini until evenly coated with oil.
Grill for about 5 minutes on each side, or until grill marks are achieved and the zucchini softens in texture.
Remove from heat and onto a serving platter. Crumble feta over the zucchini, then drizzle a few spoonfuls of the salsa macha. Finish with a squeeze of lemon to serve.

grilled-zucchini-with-salsa-macha.title: Grilled Zucchini with Salsa Macha

gyro-sliders.description: The mechanics of the Japanese gyroball pitch were specifically designed to reduce stress on the pitcher—much like this slider recipe was designed to reduce stress on the chef (that’s you!) by using TJ’s Fully Cooked Gyro Slices. Boost your strikeout percentage by giving the Gyro Slices a quick sear, and pile the sliders high with an arugula salad complemented by tangy tomatoes, TJ's Organic Tahini, and Crumbled Feta cheese.
ingredients: TJ’s Organic Sugar Plum Grape Tomatoes, sliced
8 TJ’s Sweet Pull Apart Aloha Rolls

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Place the rolls on a sheet pan in the hot oven for 4-6 minutes.
In a non-stick pan over medium heat, sear the gyro slices* on both sides until they are nicely caramelized (about 1 ½ minutes each side). While they are browning, make the salad.

To make the salad:
Mix the tahini with a tablespoon of water to thin slightly.  Toss the arugula, tomatoes, and feta gently in the sauce.
Remove the rolls from the oven. Split the buns in half, pressing down lightly.
On the bottom half of each roll, place a tablespoon of TJ’s Tzatziki. Top each with a slice of gyro (folding to fit the roll) and a small amount of salad. Skewer to secure.
Serve Immediately.

gyro-sliders.title: Gyro Sliders

half-hearted-blt-salad.description:
Trader Joe’s Romaine Hearts add a delightful, crunchy texture to mixed green salads. It’s the lettuce of choice for a Caesar, Niçoise, or Cobb salad—a triple threat, if we’ve ever seen one. Romaine leaves bring excellent crunch to a burger or sandwich, and are an excellent option for using as a wrap or lettuce cup.

And did you know that Romaine Hearts can even be grilled, like in this BLT-inspired salad? Fire up the grill (or grill pan)!
ingredients: 2 TJ’s Romaine Hearts, cut in half lengthwise
8 slices of TJ’s Uncured Apple Smoked Bacon, cooked according to package instructions, then roughly chopped
1 cup TJ’s Mini Heirloom Tomatoes, sliced in half
TJ’s Buttermilk Ranch Dressing, to serve

steps.text: Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat. Carefully brush grates or pan with olive oil. Sprinkle Ranch Seasoning over both sides of each slice of bread. Grilled until crisp and imprinted with grill marks, about 3-5, then flip and repeat. Remove from grill and chop or tear into squares. Set aside.
Place each Romaine half cut-side down on grill for 5-7 minutes, or imprinted with distinct grill marks. Remove from heat and place on serving platter
Assemble the salad: Lay romaine hearts cut-side-up on a platter. Top with chopped bacon, sliced tomatoes, and homemade croutons. Drizzle with Buttermilk Ranch Dressing to serve.

half-hearted-blt-salad.title: Half-Hearted BLT Salad

halloumi-watermelon-balsamic-bites.description: During Halloumi cheese production, the curds are heated to high temperatures, a process which gives it both its “squeaky” texture and ability to hold its shape when grilled. Pair it with a chilled glass of Rosé for the ultimate summertime snack.
ingredients: 1 package TJ’s Watermelon Spears or 1/4 of a TJ's Watermelon, cubed

steps.text: Cook cheese according to package instructions, remove from pan and cut each slice in half.
Slice the watermelon spears into thirds.
Assemble 6-8 wooden skewers as follows… Cheese, watermelon, fig, basil. Repeat.
Drizzle balsamic glaze over each stick and enjoy!

halloumi-watermelon-balsamic-bites.title: Halloumi & Watermelon Balsamic Bites

harissa-potato-salad.description:
Trader Joe's Traditional Tunisian Harissa is one of those special sauces that you will want to put on everything and anything, once you get a taste. It's prepared in small batches with fresh, red chiles that are grilled in a tumbler over an open flame, and blended with a traditional mix of herbs and spices. This deep red concoction is smooth and spreadable, with a little smoke flavor (from the grilling), and a healthy amount of heat. Yes, it is as flavorfully divine as it sounds.   

Create a traditional dish with this Tunisian Harissa atop TJ's Albacore Tuna in Olive Oil. For a flavorful dip with a kick, stir some Harissa into your favorite TJ's Hummus. Or, liven up classic potato salad with a spoonful (or two, or three) of this spicy stuff for an effortless summer side dish.
ingredients: 1 container TJ's Old Fashioned Potato Salad
1 tablespoon TJ's Traditional Tunisian Harissa (or more, if you're feeling brave!)
4 slices TJ's Uncured Apple Smoked Bacon, cooked and crumbled

steps.text: Combine potato salad and harissa in a medium serving bowl. Taste and add more harissa, if desired.
Gently fold in bacon crumbles.
Enjoy immediately, or refrigerate until ready to serve.

harissa-potato-salad.title: Harissa Potato Salad

harvest-pasta-sauce.description: This autumnal-inspired sauce calls on Trader Joe's Organic Canned Pumpkin for its velvety texture, vibrant orange hue, and slightly sweet, earthy flavor. It's the perfect accompaniment to al dente pasta or fluffy baked potatoes when the weather turns chilly.
ingredients: 2 cans TJ's Organic Diced No Salt Added Tomatoes
1 pound of your favorite TJ's Pasta, cooked

steps.text: Heat oil in a sauce pot over medium heat. Add onion, carrots and garlic, and saute 3-5 minutes, until onions are translucent.
Add tomatoes, pumpkin, water, herbs and salt to sauce pot. Stir to combine. Bring to a simmer and cook, covered, for 1 hour, stirring occasionally to ensure sauce doesn't stick to pot.

Turn off heat. Use an immersion blender or blend sauce mixture in batches until smooth. Stir in half & half and maple syrup, and season to taste. Serve over hot pasta and garnish with fresh herbs, if desired. Enjoy immediately.

harvest-pasta-sauce.title: Harvest Pasta Sauce

harvest-pilaf.description: The sweet-tart flavor and satisfying chew of Trader Joe’s Sweetened Dried Cranberries can enhance a range of sweet and savory dishes. Add these little ruby gems to baked goods, toss them in salads, or feature them in this festive, fall-inspired rice pilaf recipe. Dig in!
ingredients: 1 box TJ’s Rice Orzo Pilaf Mix
2 tablespoons of your favorite TJ’s Olive Oil
A few shakes of TJ’s 21 Seasoning Salute
1/3 cup chopped TJ’s Raw Pecans Halves

steps.text: In a medium saucepan with a lid, prepare the Rice Orzo Pilaf Mix according to the package instructions.

While the orzo is simmering, add olive oil to a large sauté pan over medium high heat. Add chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 2-3 minutes. Add sweet potato and cook until tender, about 10-15 minutes.
Add kale to sauté pan, and cook for 5 minutes, or until the kale is tender. Season with sea salt and 21 Seasoning salute.
Combine the cooked rice pilaf with the sweet potato mixture in a serving bowl. Add chopped pecans and dried cranberries. Toss to serve.

harvest-pilaf.title: Harvest Pilaf

hemp-seed-cookies.description: Reminiscent of Italian cookies coated in sesame seeds, these cookies pack a powerful protein punch, thanks to Trader Joe’s Organic Shelled Hemp Seeds. Toeing the line between sweet and savory, they are a marvelous accompaniment to a cup of tea or coffee.
ingredients: 4 cups TJ’s Unbleached Enriched All-Purpose Flour, plus more for shaping the cookies
2 sticks TJ’s Unsalted Butter, room temperature
2 teaspoons TJ’s Organic Pure Bourbon Vanilla Extract

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F. Prepare baking tray with parchment paper.
Add flour, baking powder, and salt in medium bowl, stir to combine, and set aside.

Using an electric mixer, cream the butter and sugar on medium speed, until light in color and fluffy, about 5 minutes. Scrape the bowl down once to ensure the ingredients are fully incorporated. Add one egg at a time and mix between each addition, then add the vanilla.
On low speed, add the dry ingredients, one spoonful at a time until completely incorporated. The batter should be stiff and slighty sticky.
Prepare your dipping station by pouring the milk and hemp seeds into two separate small, shallow bowls.

To shape the cookie, lightly dust the counter and your hands in flour. Divide the dough into four pieces and use your floured hands to roll each piece of dough back and forth on the counter until the dough forms a long rope, about 22 inches long and 1-inch wide. Use a knife to cut each cookie into 2-inch pieces.
Dip each piece of dough in milk, then roll in hemp seeds, covering all sides of the dough. Place on prepared baking tray.
Bake for 15 minutes on center rack of the oven. The tops of the cookies will be pale in color, but the bottoms will be golden brown.
Cool for 10 minutes before serving. Store cookies in an air-tight container.

hemp-seed-cookies.title: Hemp Seed Cookies

herby-compound-butter.description:
Trader Joe’s Unsalted Butter Quarters is a suberb choice for spreading over toast, adorning a bowl of mashed potatoes, and basting your holiday TJ's All-Natural Turkey. Butter yet, bolster a stick of Unsalted Butter with fresh herbs and seasoning to make an aromatic compound butter. Tuck a few slices under the skin of your bird before roasting, and use the rest to baste during cooking, infusing the classic aromas of Thanksgiving into every bite.

Pro-tip: Prepare the compound butter up to one week in advance. Once it's been prepped, stick it in the fridge to firm up, then it's ready whenever you need it!

steps.text:
To the bowl of a small food processor, add destemmed herbs and pulse for about 30 seconds until evenly chopped. Add butter and a few cranks of salt and pepper, then pulse again for another 30 seconds until completely combined.

Alternatively, use a knife to finely chop the destemmed herbs, then add them to a medium-sized bowl with the butter, salt and pepper. Use a spatula to fold the ingredients together until evenly combined.

Add butter to the center of a sheet of parchment paper, placing it in a mound. Lift the bottom half of the parchment paper up and over the butter so the mound is now at the bottom of the parchment. Begin at the bottom of the parchment where the butter is, and roll the parchment upward to form it into a log. Twist the ends to the butter is completely enclosed.
Refrigerate until firm.

herby-compound-butter.title: Herby Compound Butter

herby-salami-apple-sammies.description:
Trader Joe’s Organic French Baguettes have a crispy crust with a chewy, tender interior, and a slightly yeasty flavor—and they are superb for all your sandwich-making needs. Give the baguette a quick toast in the oven before layering in creamy cheese, savory salami, with sweet, crunchy apple slices, for an array of texture, temperature, and flavor in every bite.

While sandwiches are really celebrated as the ultimate lunch fare, we like this one for breakfast, too!
ingredients: 1 package Boursin® Garlic & Fine Herbs Gournay Cheese
1 package of your favorite TJ’s Salami

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350° F.
Place whole baguette on center rack of oven and toast for 10 minutes, until hot and crusty.
Cut baguette into four equal pieces, then partially slice each piece open—so the top and bottom are hinged together.
For each sandwich, spread cheese on the bottom half of the bread, add four slices of salami, and top with six slices of apple to serve.

herby-salami-apple-sammies.title: Herby Salami & Apple Sammies

here-we-come-a-wassailing.description: A sweetened blend of black currant, apple, and lemon juices, with cinnamon, clove, nutmeg, cardamom, ginger, and orange peel, Trader Joe's Winter Wassail is a fruit punch whose flavors and aromas evoke the holidays. You can serve it chilled, over ice with bourbon; or warmed, in a big mug, with a cinnamon stick garnish. It's also a merry mulling mixer with red wine, simmered on the stovetop and served steaming...
ingredients: 1 part TJ's Bourbon (we used TJ's Kentucky Bourbon)
Handful of TJ's Fresh Cranberries or Pomegranate Seeds, plus more for garnish

steps.text:
To Prepare the Ice Ring:

Line the bottom of a bundt pan with navel slices, cranberries and/or pomegranate seeds, and a few springs of rosemary. Fill pan halfway with water, then freeze until solid.

To Prepare the Punch:

Add bourbon and wassail to a large punch bowl. (Using the '1 part to 2 parts' ratio, muliply amounts based on your number of guests.) Stir briskly to combine.
Once the ice ring is frozen, remove bundt pan from freezer and let sit at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Run bottom and sides of pan under hot water until ice ring slides out. Flip ice ring over and gently place in punch bowl.
Serve punch with orange slices, fresh cranberries and/or pomegranate seeds, and rosemary for garnish.

here-we-come-a-wassailing.title: Here We Come A-Wassailing

heres-lookin-at-yuzu-kid.description: Step aside, blenders and shakers. A simple stirring of Sparkling Coconut Water with Yuzu and TJ’s White Rum of the Gods is all you need for a remarkably refreshing, unfussy nod to the classic daiquiri.
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz. TJ’s White Rum Of The Gods
4 oz. TJ’s Sparkling Coconut Water with Yuzu

steps.text: Fill a chilled glass with ice. Add rum and a squeeze of lime juice. Pour in the Sparkling Coconut Water with Yuzu and stir. Garnish with a lime slice.

heres-lookin-at-yuzu-kid.title: Here's Lookin' At Yuzu, Kid

homemade-buttermilk-ranch-dressing.description: Ranch dressing is mere minutes away with the help of Trader Joe’s Ranch Seasoning Blend. Creamy and cooling, this homemade dressing is superbly herbaceous, and comes together so quickly you’ll hardly have time to think of all the ways you can use it. We’re particularly fond of using it as a dip for chicken wings, and crudité, and French fries, and…

steps.text: Combine all ingredients in blender or with a whisk until well blended.

homemade-buttermilk-ranch-dressing.title: Homemade Buttermilk Ranch Dressing

homestyle-meatball-subs.description: Trader Joe’s Homestyle Angus Beef Meatballs are no ordinary meatballs! Their recipe starts with a base of tender, ground 100% Angus Beef, to which a bit of panko breadcrumbs is added to create an even more toothsome texture, along with onion and garlic purée, a blend of aromatic herbs like basil and oregano, as well as grated Parmesan and Romano cheeses for some extra umami before being shaped into their characteristic form. The result is a super flavorful and texturally satisfying Meatball that’s ready to be cooked in an array of recipes: served with spaghetti, smashed into sliders, dipped into your favorite TJ’s sauce, or bathed in marinara and sandwiched within a cheesy TJ’s Sandwich Roll.
ingredients: TJ’s Organic Extra Virgin Olive Oil Spray
1 package TJ’s Homestyle Angus Beef Meatballs
2 cups of your favorite TJ’s Marinara Sauce
3 TJ’s Sandwich Rolls, sliced lengthwise, leaving one edge intact

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F. Spray a sheet pan with olive oil, then arrange meatballs in a single layer. Bake for 15-20 minutes, until the internal temperature reaches 165°F when probed with a meat thermometer.

While the meatballs are in the oven, bring marinara sauce to a simmer in a wide sauté pan over medium-low heat. When meatballs are cooked through, add to sauté pan, and toss with sauce until thoroughly coated.
On a separate sheet pan, arrange rolls cut side up and place a slice of provolone in each roll. Bake for 5 minutes, until the bread is toasted, and the cheese has melted.
Fill each sandwich roll with 4 meatballs and a ladle of sauce to serve.

homestyle-meatball-subs.title: Homestyle Meatball Subs

honey-gochujang-corn-cookie-ice-cream-sa.description:
It’s no secret that our Crew is comprised of some of the most culinarily creative folks around, so for the second time, we challenged our stores across the country to a Recipe Contest, inviting them to create a delicious recipe using no more than five Trader Joe’s ingredients.

This winning recipe comes from Store #426—Houston (Alabama Theater), TX! Our judges were positively impressed by the creative use of Trader Joe's Gochujang in this dessert, as well as the inspired cookie construction, made possible by combining TJ’s Cornbread Mix with softened French Vanilla Ice Cream!
ingredients: 2 tablespoons TJ’s French Vanilla Ice Cream, plus plenty more for scooping
½ cup TJ’s Unsalted Butter, softened

steps.text: In a medium-sized bowl, whisk cornbread mix and flour together.
Melt 2 tablespoons of ice cream.
In a separate bowl, use a whisk to cream together honey, butter, and melted ice cream.

Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients, and use a spatula to mix until incorporated. Pro-tip: towards the end of mixing, when the dough begins sticking to mixing utensil, use clean, wet hands to finish combining.
Roll approximately 2 tablespoons of dough into balls. You should have 18 dough balls.
Roll each ball in about a teaspoon of gochujang, until the exterior of each dough ball is fully covered.
Space dough balls at least 2 inches apart on a baking sheet, then place baking sheet in the freezer for at least 15 minutes, until dough balls harden.
While dough balls are freezing, preheat oven to 350°F.
Transfer baking sheet from freezer to oven and bake for about 10 minutes, or until the edges of the cookies are just golden brown.
Remove cookies from oven and let cool completely, about 30 minutes.

Once cooled, flip cookies over. To assemble ice cream sandwiches, place a heaping scoop of ice cream atop one cookie, then press another cookie on top of the ice cream to complete the sandwich. Repeat.
Serve or freeze immediately. Enjoy!

honey-gochujang-corn-cookie-ice-cream-sa.title: Honey Gochujang Corn Cookie Ice Cream Sandwiches

honey-roasted-feta.description: A Feta of this quality deserves to be savored. Made for us by 4th generation Israeli cheesemakers, it's creamy yet crumbly, totally toothsome, and wonderfully briny. Here, we've given it the royal treatment by brushing it honey and baking it to slightly-browned, barely-bubbling perfection...
ingredients: 2 tablespoons TJ's California Extra-Virgin Olive Oil
TJ's Organic On The Vine Tomatoes, sliced (optional)

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees.
Line a small baking pan with foil.
Cut feta as you would cut a loaf of bread into four equal slices. Place slices facedown on foil-covered sheet pan. Cover with olive oil.
Bake for eight minutes, or until the cheese is soft to the touch (but not melted). Remove from oven.
Preheat the broiler.
Heat the honey in the microwave until it is fluid enough to spread with a pastry brush. Remove honey from microwave and spread generously over feta slices.
Place honey-covered feta in broiler for about two minutes. Keep a close eye on it and remove from broiler once the top of the cheese browns and begins to bubble.
Serve with flatbread, tomatoes, and thyme. Enjoy!

honey-roasted-feta.title: Honey Roasted Feta

hot-beef-cheddar-sandwich.description:
Some shaved steak you find on the market comes from the round, which tends to be a tougher cut of meat. Trader Joe’s Shaved Beef Steak, however, comes from the cap of the rib eye, so it’s especially tender and flavorful. And because our Shaved Steak is sliced so thin, it cooks up extra quickly, making it a weeknight dinner-winner. In the mood for stir fry? Shaved Steak is the perfect protein for that. How about fajitas? Yes, indeed. A quick soup? Definitely. This hot beef sandwich with a homemade Cheddar Gruyère Mélange Cheese sauce? Oh, goodness, yes!

Pro-Tip: The cheese sauce comes together quickly. To avoid scorching, prepare and measure your ingredients before you begin this step.
ingredients: 1 package TJ’s All Natural Shaved Beef Steak
½ teaspoon TJ’s Sea Salt, plus more for seasoning Shaved Beef
A few cranks of TJ’s Black Peppercorns
About 2 cups of grated TJ’s Cheddar Gruyère Mélange Cheese

steps.text: To a large skillet, add oil and place over medium high heat. Add shaved beef and cook for 5-7 minutes, until no longer red. Use tongs to help separate beef slices while cooking. Remove from heat.
steps.title: Prepare Shaved Beef Steak

steps.text:
To a medium-sized pot on medium heat, melt butter, then add flour and whisk until combined.

Add 1 cup of milk, salt, and mustard and stir until mixture thickens, about 2-4 minutes, until it coats the back of a spoon.

Remove from heat and stir in cheese, a handful at a time, until melted and smooth. Slowly add reserved ¼ cup of milk until a pourable consistency is achieved.
steps.title: Make Cheddar Gruyère Mélange Cheese Sauce

steps.text: Divide shaved beef among the bottom toasted buns, pour cheese sauce over each sandwich, and top with remaining buns to serve.
steps.title: Assemble Sandwiches

hot-beef-cheddar-sandwich.title: Hot Beef & Cheddar Sandwich

hot-honey-goat-cheese-pizza.description:
Trader Joe’s customers just love our cheese logs made from Goat Milk, and we offer a variety of flavors. We’re excited to introduce another flavor, and honey, it’s sure to be the hot new thing: Trader Joe’s Hot Honey Goat Milk Cheese! Goat Milk Cheese, Honey, red pepper flakes, and habanero pepper powder come together to create a combination that definitely hits that Hot-sweet spot—not too sweet, with a spiciness that builds, but plateaus before taking over.

Looking to spice up pizza night? Try baking our Hot Honey Goat Milk Cheese onto a TJ’s Plain Pizza Dough! Adorn with toasty walnuts, peppery arugula, and a heavy drizzle of TJ’s Spicy Honey Sauce to really gild the lily. 

Pro-tip: For ease of assembly, be sure to allow extra time for the pizza dough come to room temperature before rolling it out.
ingredients: 1 TJ’s Plain Pizza Dough, left to sit at room temperature for 20 minutes
TJ's Unbleached Enriched All-Purpose Flour, for dusting
1/2 - 3/4 log TJ’s Hot Honey Goat Milk Cheese
1/3 cup TJ’s California Walnut Halves & Pieces

steps.text: Preheat oven according to pizza dough package instructions.
Lightly dust your work surface with flour, then stretch by hand or roll the dough into a 10” diameter oblong or circle. Carefully transfer dough onto a baking sheet or pizza stone.
Crumble goat cheese over the dough, then top with walnuts.
Bake according to the pizza dough’s package instructions, until crust is golden, cheese is melted, and walnuts are toasted.
Remove pizza from oven. Top with arugula and drizzle with Spicy Honey Sauce before slicing.

hot-honey-goat-cheese-pizza.title: Hot Honey Goat Cheese Pizza

hot-hot-shrimp-tacos.description: Keep a bag of Trader Joe’s Gluten Free Breaded Shrimp on hand for whenever the craving for shrimp tacos strikes. They cook quickly, with a crisp and airy coating, making them a worthy contender to your weeknight dinner lineup. Plus, we’re serving these tacos with a creamy, sweet and spicy sauce that makes a stupendous spread on sandwiches, too.
ingredients: ¾ cup TJ’s Sweet Chili Sauce
1-2 tablespoon TJ’s Habanero Hot Sauce, depending on your preferred spice level
1 bag TJ’s Organic Shredded Green & Red Cabbage with Orange Carrots
¼ cup TJ’s Cilantro leaves, for garnish

steps.text:
Prepare the sauce:
In a small bowl, combine mayo, sweet chili sauce, and habanero hot sauce. Refrigerate while you prepare the tacos, to help meld the flavors.

Prepare the shrimp:
Cook the shrimp according to your preferred package instruction.

Prepare the slaw:
In a medium bowl, combine cabbage with ½ cup sauce.

Warm the tortillas:
In a large skillet, over medium heat, add four tortillas and warm 1-2 minutes per side. Repeat with remaining tortillas.

Taco Assembly:
To your warm tortilla, add slaw, four shrimp, drizzle with sauce, and garnish with lime juice and cilantro.

hot-hot-shrimp-tacos.title: Hot Hot Shrimp Tacos

hot-smoky-rigatoni-bake.description: Trader Joe's Rigatoni Pasta is the key to this smoky, cheesy casserole. Large enough to feed a crowd, this recipe can be made ahead for busy weeknights-once assembled, simply cover with foil and refrigerate or freeze, then pop it in the oven when you're ready to serve.
ingredients: 1 package (about 1 pound) TJ's Sweet OR Hot Italian Sausage, casing removed
2 teaspoons TJ's Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 cup TJ's Whole Milk Ricotta Cheese
2 cups TJ's Shredded Mozzarella Cheese, divided

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add rigatoni to pot and boil for 10 minutes, just until al dente. Drain and set aside.

While pasta is cooking, in a small bowl, combine ricotta and half of the grated parmesan. Stir and set aside. In a large sauce pan over medium heat, add olive oil and sausage. Brown sausage for 7-9 minutes until it reaches 145°F, breaking meat up with a spoon as it cooks. Add paprika and stir to combine. Reduce heat to low and add marinara. Heat until sauce is warmed through, stirring occasionally.

Return drained pasta to pot and add half of marinara mixture, stirring to combine. Gently fold in ricotta mixture. Transfer half of the pasta to a 9x13 pan. Sprinkle half of the Mozzarella over pasta. Top with remaining pasta and remaining sauce and spread in an even layer. Top pasta with remaining Mozzarella and Parmesan cheeses.

Place pan in middle rack of oven and bake until edges are bubbling and cheese is melted, about 35 minutes. Remove pan from oven and let cool for 10 minutes. Garnish with shredded basil, if desired, and serve.
*If cooking from frozen, leave foil on and bake for 1 hour, then remove foil and bake an additional 15 minutes.

hot-smoky-rigatoni-bake.title: Hot & Smoky Rigatoni Bake

hot-spicy-wings-with-chunky-blue-cheese.description: Serve these spicy wings with plenty of ice-cold Simpler Times Lager to tame the heat.
ingredients: 1 bag TJ’s Hot & Spicy Chicken Wings Sections
1 cup (about 12) TJ’s Organic Cut and Peeled Carrots
1/3 cup TJ’s Chunky Blue Cheese Dressing & Dip
A handful of TJ’s Parsley (optional garnish)

steps.text: Place wings in a circle (leave space in the center) on a microwave safe plate. Microwave uncovered on high: FROZEN wings 7 to 9 minutes – THAWED wings 4 to 5 minutes or until heated through. Plate will be hot, remove carefully.
While wings are heating, rinse celery stalks, trim both ends and cut into thirds.
Once wings have cooled for a minute, arrange them on a platter, over a bed of parsley. Serve with a bowl of blue cheese dressing, celery sticks and carrots.

hot-spicy-wings-with-chunky-blue-cheese.title: Hot & Spicy Wings with Chunky Blue Cheese

iced-chai-latte.description: Spiced Chai Latte Mix, a generous splash of Cold Brew, topped off with homemade vanilla chai whipped cream... Mmm... Does it get any better? Actually, yes! Plan ahead and make your own Cold Brew ice cubes.
ingredients: 2 teaspoons TJ's Spicy Chai Tea Latte Mix
1 teaspoon TJ's Organic Pure Bourbon Vanilla Extract

steps.text: To make whipped cream: In a large bowl, with a hand mixer or stand mixer combine: 1/2 cup heavy cream, 2 teaspoons Chai Mix and 1 teaspoon Bourbon Vanilla Extract. Whip until stiff peaks form, about 4 minutes. Set aside.

To make chai iced latte: In a medium-sized pitcher, whisk together 6 tablespoons chai mix and 1/2 cup hot water until mix completely dissolves. Add 1 cup cold brew to pitcher and stir until combined. Serve chilled or pour over ice (we recommend making your own cold brew ice cubes), then top with reserved whipped cream.

iced-chai-latte.title: Iced Chai Latte

inside-out-apple-cheddar-hand-pies.description:
Inspired by the regional food pairing of Cheddar cheese atop a slice of apple pie, these hand pies are filled with TJ’s New Zealand Sharp Cheddar Cheese and topped with Trader Joe’s Apple Pie Spread! Baking results in an ooey-gooey cheesy filling that pairs impressively well with the sweet apple-y glaze atop.

With help from TJ’s Organic Crescent Rolls, you’ll sidestep the time-consuming task of prepping the dough from scratch, so you can spend less time making them and more time enjoying them! They’re terrific for breakfast with a cup of coffee or served as an after-dinner treat—and we wouldn’t say no to one as an afternoon snack, either.
ingredients: ¼ block TJ’s New Zealand Sharp Cheddar Cheese (or your favorite TJ's Sharp Cheddar Cheese), sliced into thin planks
½ cup TJ’s Apple Pie Spread

steps.text: Preheat oven to 375°F, and line a baking sheet with parchment paper; set aside.
Remove crescent rolls from tube, unroll and divide dough into four rectangles, each rectangle consisting of two triangles.
Pinch seams together, then gently stretch the dough so it’s an even thickness.
Add 3-4 planks of cheese to the left side of the rectangle, lengthwise, leaving a half-inch border around the top left, and bottom edges.
Fold the right edge of the dough over to cover the cheese and align the edges to make a smaller rectangle.
Use the tines of a fork to seal the edges of pie. Repeat until you have four pies.
Arrange hand pies on prepared baking sheet and brush the tops with beaten egg
Bake for 12 minutes, or until golden.
Remove from oven. Let cool 3-5 minutes.
Carefully spoon 2 tablespoons of apple pie spread over the top of each pie. Sprinkle with crushed apple chips to serve.

inside-out-apple-cheddar-hand-pies.title: Inside-Out Apple & Cheddar Hand Pies

instantly-elevated-brownies.description:
When the craving for freshly baked brownies hits, reach for a box of Trader Joe’s Brownie Truffle Baking Mix and you’ll have enchantingly chocolatey brownies cooling on your windowsill within the hour. Yes! And if you’re looking to instantly elevate your next batch without much effort, a couple tablespoons of Trader Joe’s 100% Colombian Instant Coffee will intensify those rich, chocolatey notes.

Pro-tip: As an alternative to oil spray, use the empty butter wrapper to grease your baking pan.
ingredients: 1 stick TJ’s Salted Butter, melted (see pro-tip)
1 box TJ’s Brownie Truffle Baking Mix
2 tablespoons TJ’s 100% Colombian Instant Coffee granules

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease an 8x8-inch baking pan and spray with canola oil spray.
In a large bowl, add melted butter and eggs and whisk to combine. Add brownie mix and dried coffee granules and stir until no dry bits remain. Do not overmix.
Pour batter into prepared baking pan and bake on center rack of oven for 25-30 minutes. Allow brownies to cool in the pan for 30 minutes before serving.

instantly-elevated-brownies.title: Instantly Elevated Brownies

italian-style-turkey-meatloaf-sliders.description: This slider recipe takes TJ’s Italian Style Turkey Meatloaf off-speed from a model main dish to MVP status by “splitting” the loaf into slices and searing them to create a craveable crust. The meatloaf slices become the centerpiece for the slider, which is stacked with a dollop of bruschetta, melted mozzarella cheese, and fresh basil, with some extra heat thrown courtesy of Crispy Jalapeño Pieces.
ingredients: 1 pkg. TJ’s Italian Style Turkey Meatloaf
6 TJ’s Mozzarella Slices, cut into fourths
12 TJ’s Sweet Pull Apart Aloha Rolls
8 fresh TJ's Basil leaves, cut into chiffonade

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Cut the meatloaf crosswise into 6 x ½ inch slices—and again down the center to make 12 slices.

Heat an oven-proof non-stick pan over medium-high heat. When hot, spray with olive oil spray. Sear both sides of the meatloaf slices for about 2 minutes each side until nice and crispy. Leave in the pan.
Top each piece of meatloaf with a spoonful of the Bruschetta and two quarter-slices of mozzarella.
Place the rolls on a sheet pan in the hot oven for 4-6 minutes, until golden brown.
Place the mozzarella-topped meatloaf in the hot oven for 4 minutes.

Remove the rolls and the meatloaf. Split the buns in half, pressing down lightly. On the bottom half, place the cheesy meatloaf. Top with a tablespoon of Crispy Jalapeño Pieces, chiffonade of basil and the top bun. Skewer to secure.
Serve immediately.

italian-style-turkey-meatloaf-sliders.title: Italian-Style Turkey Meatloaf Sliders

jalapeno-corn-kickers.description: It's not always preferable to be corny & cheesy. Unless... you're our recipe for Jalapeño Corn Kickers! Consider this fabulous app for your next party. It features fresh TJ's Jalapeños stuffed with our Chunky Artichoke & Jalapeño Dip that is studded with TJ's Roasted Corn, and made extra rich & cheesy with Trader Joe's Shredded Mozzarella. This app is hot, and we mean that in all ways!
ingredients: 1 package TJ's Chunky Artichoke & Jalapeño Dip
1 cup TJ's Shredded Mozzarella Cheese, divided
2 teaspoons finely chopped TJ's Cilantro, plus more for garnish
1/4 cup TJ's Japanese Style Panko Breadcrumbs

steps.text: Preheat oven to 375°F.

Slice the jalapeños in half lengthwise. For a nicer presentation, slice each stem in half as well. Scrape out the seeds and membranes from each half. Place jalapeños on a baking sheet and set aside.  (Note: when working with jalapeños, wear disposable gloves to avoid eye irritation.)
In a medium bowl, combine artichoke dip, corn, 1/2 cup mozzarella, and 2 teaspoons cilantro. Stir until well incorporated.
In a small bowl, combine melted butter and panko breadcrumbs. Set aside.

With a small spoon, fill each jalapeño half with about 1 tablespoon of the cheese mixture. Smooth the mixture so that it fills the entire cavity evenly, reaching the top edge of the pepper, but not overflowing (if the peppers are filled too much, they can tip over while baking). Arrange filled peppers on the baking sheet, then top with reserved 1/2 cup of mozzarella, followed by a sprinkle of the panko mixture over each jalapeño.
Bake until cheese is browned and bubbling and the peppers have softened, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven and cool before serving. Garnish with extra cilantro.

jalapeno-corn-kickers.title: Jalapeño Corn Kickers

jalapeno-limeade-margarita.description:
Trader Joe’s Organic Jalapeño Limeade is a slightly sweet, slightly spicy sipper, bursting with tart lime and a kick of jalapeño that make it an ideal warm weather refresher. And it makes a simply stellar margarita mixer when combined with your favorite TJ’s Tequila.

Seeking a little more spice this summer? Add a Chile Lime Seasoning Blend rim to really turn up the heat!
ingredients: 2 tablespoons TJ’s Chile Lime Seasoning Blend
1 ½ ounce of your favorite TJ’s Tequila
¾ cup TJ’s Organic Jalapeño Limeade

steps.text: Rim the glass: Place the chile lime seasoning in a shallow dish. Rub 1 wedge of lime around the rim of the glass. Turn glass over and place directly in the seasoning; twist and turn it until the rim is sufficiently coated with seasoning (what “sufficiently” means is entirely up to you).
Fill glass with ice, add tequila and limeade, and stir to combine.
Serve with a wedge of lime and a garnish of jalapeño slices.

jalapeno-limeade-margarita.title: Jalapeño Limeade Margarita

jam-jar-cocktail.description:
When you get to the bottom of the Trader Joe’s Strawberry Preserves jar and there isn’t quite enough to spread on toast, use the rest (and the jar) to make a cocktail! Using the jar as your cocktail shaker, combine leftover preserves with vodka and whatever herbs and citrus you have on hand for a refreshing, sensationally simple cocktail.

Have a bit more jam leftover? Double the recipe for two drinks!
ingredients: An almost empty jar of TJ’s Strawberry Preserves (about two tablespoons)
1 ½ ounces of your favorite TJ’s Vodka
1 tablespoon of juice from a TJ’s Lemon (or whatever citrus you have on hand)
¼ cup of your favorite TJ’s Sparkling Water

steps.text: To the jam jar, add basil and muddle with a spoon.
Add vodka, lemon juice and ice. Close the jar with lid and shake.
Top with sparkling water to serve straight out of the jar. Alternatively, pour contents into a glass to serve.

jam-jar-cocktail.title: Jam-Jar Cocktail

jasons-cheesy-mashed-potatoes.description: It's one thing to heat up Trader Joe's Frozen Mashed Potatoes and serve them as-is, but it's another thing entirely to doctor them up with cheese, butter, & cream. This indulgent recipe from one of our Southern California Store Captains might just be the very definition of "leveling up."
ingredients: 2 bags Trader Joe's Frozen Mashed Potatoes
1 package TJ's Shredded Swiss Cheese & Gruyère Cheese Blend

steps.text: Empty both packages of potatoes into a large pot. Stirring frequently, warm over medium heat for about 5 minutes or until the potato medallions start to break apart. Add butter, cheese, and heavy cream and stir until evenly mixed. Continue to cook for about 15 minutes or until all cheese and butter have melted and mixture is warmed throughout.
Serve immediately and enjoy!
Recipe Credit: Captain Jason at store #171 in Pasadena, CA

jasons-cheesy-mashed-potatoes.title: Jason's Cheesy Mashed Potatoes

joe-joes-cupcakes.description: A cookie so nice, we named it twice! From the snap of the sweet chocolate cookie to the velvety creme within, Trader Joe’s Chocolate Vanilla Creme Joe-Joe's Sandwich Cookies are everything a sandwich cookie should be. Enjoy them the old-fashioned way alongside a cold glass of milk, or double down on the dessert factor by dunking in melted chocolate or crumbling to form the crust of an irresistible ice cream cake. Best yet, triple down with a trifecta of uses in this celebratory cupcake recipe in which Joe-Joe’s are crushed into the cupcake batter, sprinkled over the frosting, and whole Joe-Joe’s adorn the top of each cupcake as a generous garnish!
ingredients: 1 package (30 cookies) of TJ’s Chocolate Vanilla Creme Joe-Joe's Sandwich Cookies
2 cups TJ’s Buttermilk Pancake & Baking Mix
¾ cup TJ’s Organic Cane Sugar
5 teaspoons TJ’s Organic Pure Bourbon Vanilla Extract, divided
1 block (8 ounces) TJ’s Cream Cheese, at room temperature
½ stick TJ’s Unsalted Butter, softened at room temperature
2 ½ cups TJ’s Organic Powdered Sugar

steps.text:
Preheat the oven to 350°F. Line the wells of 2 cupcake pans with 18 paper liners, set aside.

Coarsely chop 8 Joe-Joe's, set aside.

Add pancake mix, cane sugar, milk, oil, eggs, and 1 tablespoon vanilla in a large bowl and whisk to combine, until the batter is smooth. 

Add chopped cookies to mix and gently fold in with a rubber spatula until evenly incorporated, being careful not to over mix.

Evenly divide the batter into lined cupcake pan, filling each cup about 2/3 full. Bake for 16-18 minutes, until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Remove from oven and allow cupcakes to cool completely (about 30 minutes – 1 hour.)
steps.title: Prepare Cupcakes

steps.text: Combine the cream cheese, softened butter, and 2 teaspoons vanilla in the bowl of an electric mixer. Beat on medium speed until smooth, 1-3 minutes, scraping down the sides of the bowl with a rubber spatula as needed. Add the powdered sugar in half-cup increments and blend until thoroughly combined and fluffy.
steps.title: Prepare Frosting

steps.text:
Remove filling from four Joe-Joe’s and finely crush the cookies. Set aside.

Frost the cooled cupcakes, then sprinkle with crushed cookies. Garnish each cupcake with an entire cookie. Enjoy!
steps.title: Assemble Cupcakes

joe-joes-cupcakes.title: Joe-Joe's Cupcakes

joes-bloody-mary.description: With tangy tomato purée, briny clam juice, and a savory spice blend, Trader Joe's Bloody Mary Mixer stands up to any homemade version. Simply add vodka, ice, and garnish with abandon to recreate this classic brunch beverage.
ingredients: 1 1/4 ounce TJ's Vodka Of The Gods
1 TJ's Celery Stalk, rinsed and trimmed
TJ's Colossal Olives Hand Stuffed With Garlic Cloves, plus one tablespoon brine from jar (optional)

steps.text: Spread a thin layer of chile lime seasoning on a shallow dish or clean cutting board. Rub a slice of lemon around the rim of a glass. Place rim of glass in seasoning and twist and turn to coat.

Fill the chile-rimmed glass with ice. Add bloody mary mixer, vodka, and olive brine, if using. Stir and add more mixer or vodka to taste. Garnish with a celery stalk, a few stuffed olives, and sliced lemon. Cheers!

joes-bloody-mary.title: Joe's Bloody Mary

joes-in-cider-sipper.description: This pleasantly pucker-y, curiously cool alternative to a margarita has all the charms of a drink crafted at an upscale cocktail bar—including the sweet & spicy garnished rim—without the hefty price tag.
ingredients: Generous pinch of TJ’s Cayenne Pepper
1/2 of a TJ’s Fresh Lemon (plus a lemon slice for garnish)
4 to 6 oz. TJ’s Organic Sparkling Lemon + Strawberry Apple Cider Vinegar Beverage

steps.text: Prep the sweet & spicy rim mix: Combine the sugar, salt and cayenne in a shallow bowl that's wide enough to fit your glass. (This makes more than what is necessary for 1 beverage—save the rest for future drinks!). Wet the rim of the glass and dip the edge in the sweet & spicy mix to coat.

Prep your cocktail: Place ice in a highball glass. Add the tequila, a generous squeeze of lemon juice, and pour in the Sparkling Strawberry + Lemon Apple Cider Vinegar juice. Garnish with a lemon slice and serve.

joes-in-cider-sipper.title: Joe's In-Cider Sipper

katsu-style-soyaki-tofu.description:
Filling and flavorful, with a magnetic, “one-more-bite” appeal courtesy of its panko-powered crunch, this vegan, katsu-inspired recipe takes Trader Joe’s Organic High Protein Super Firm Tofu to flavorsome new heights. Traditionally, katsu is served with a sticky-sweet tonkatsu sauce (Japanese-style barbecue sauce); this recipe leans on Trader Joe’s Soyaki as both a marinade and a dipping sauce for ease of prep.

If you aren’t in the mood for rice and shredded cabbage, this crunchy, umami-infused tofu can be paired with the sides of your choosing (Riced Cauliflower and Baby Bok Choy, perhaps?). What’s more, the hands-free hour recommended to marinate the tofu allows you to relax with your latest read, squeeze in a workout, or simply decompress from the day before it’s time to fire up the air fryer or oven.
ingredients: 1 package TJ’s High Protein Super Firm Organic Tofu, sliced into four cutlets
3/4 cup TJ’s Soyaki Sauce (plus more for serving)
1/2 bag TJ’s Japanese Style Panko Breadcrumbs
Cooked TJ’s Rice (Brown or White), to serve
Sautéed TJ’s Shredded Green Cabbage or Cut Napa Cabbage, to serve

steps.text:
Blot tofu cutlets with a paper towel to soak up excess moisture. Place in a shallow container and cover with ¾ cup Soyaki Sauce. Marinate for a minimum of 1 hour, and up to overnight, flipping tofu halfway through.

Remove tofu from sauce. Add flour and oat milk to sauce and whisk until smooth. Place tofu back into the mixture and flip to coat on all sides.

Pour the panko into a shallow dish. Place marinated tofu in the panko, turning and gently pressing the breadcrumbs on all sides until well coated.
steps.title: Prep The Tofu

steps.text:
Air Fryer Method: Heat an air fryer to 400°F. Place the tofu in the fryer basket and spray with avocado oil. Cook for 12 minutes, flipping the tofu over and spraying again halfway through cooking. Remove from fryer and serve.

Oven Method: Spray breaded tofu with avocado oil spray and bake on a sheet pan lined with parchment paper in an oven preheated to 425 degrees F for 12-15 minutes, flipping the tofu over half way through the cooking process. Remove from oven and serve.

Stovetop Method: Fill a sauté pan with enough canola oil to partially submerge (but not cover) the tofu cutlets, on medium-high heat. Shallow-fry the tofu for approximately 4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown. Drain the tofu on a cooling rack for a minute or two before serving.
steps.title: Cook the Tofu

steps.text: Divide cooked rice and cabbage among four plates. Carefully slice tofu cutlets with a serrated knife and fan slices over steamed rice and shredded cabbage. Top each plate with green onions and serve with a lemon wedge and a side of Soyaki Sauce for dipping.
steps.title: Serve!

katsu-style-soyaki-tofu.title: Katsu-style Soyaki Tofu

key-lime-pie-strawberry-whipped-cream.description: What could be better than a tangy Key Lime filling nestled in a classic graham cracker crust? How about a tangy Key Lime filling nestled in a classic graham cracker crust, topped with freshly whipped cream that just so happens to be infused with sweet-tart strawberry flavor?! This recipe calls on Trader Joe's Freeze Dried Strawberries to infuse the whipped cream with plenty of strawberry goodness, without altering its luxurious texture.
ingredients: 1 bottle (16 oz) TJ's Heavy Whipping Cream
1 TJ's Key Lime Pie, thawed according to package directions

steps.text: Add the strawberries to the bowl of a food processor. Pulse to the consistency of a fine powder, set aside.

Add whipping cream, powdered sugar, and strawberry powder to a medium bowl. Using a hand mixer or whisk, beat until peaks form. (Be careful not to overbeat—the cream will turn lumpy instead of fluffy!)

Spread, dollop, or swoosh whipped cream atop the Key Lime Pie to your heart's content. Serve immediately.

Whipped cream can be prepared a few hours ahead of time and refrigerated until needed. Cover and refrigerate leftovers and use within a day.

key-lime-pie-strawberry-whipped-cream.title: Key Lime Pie with Strawberry Whipped Cream

kick-smoreover-dip.description: We’re bringing a quintessential camping treat to the great indoors and dishing it out in dip form—no sticky hands here! We’re topping a magnificently melty chocolate base with vegan, gluten-free Trader Joe’s Marshmallows and baking them 'til they're golden and gooey. Serve it with an array of cookies for an immensely delicious dipping experience.
ingredients: 1/4 cup TJ's Organic Reduced Fat Coconut Milk
Your favorite TJ's cookies, for dipping

steps.text: Preheat oven to 425ºF.
In a 6"cast iron skillet, pour in the chocolate chips, followed by the coconut milk. Give the mixture a quick stir. Arrange the halved marshmallows in a single layer covering the chocolate mixture.
Place the skillet on center rack of the oven and bake for about 8-10 minutes. Keep an eye to make sure the marshmallows don't burn.
When the marshmallows are golden and toasted, remove the skillet from the oven. Let cool ever so slightly and serve with your desired dip accompaniments.

kick-smoreover-dip.title: Kick S'moreover Dip

kickin-corn-dip.description:
When we crafted this Kickin' Corn Dip recipe in our test kitchen, our tasters simply couldn't get enough of it. It takes three cheeses to create its creamy base: velvety cream cheese, spicy Pepper Jack, and our finely shredded Mexican Blend for superb meltability.

The chipotle peppers, adobo sauce and lime juice in Trader Joe's Cowboy Caviar Salsa cut through the all that creamy richness with irresistible heat and tangy flavor-this dip is not for the faint of heart, folks. Topped with our frozen Roasted Corn (and even more cheese for good measure), it's baked until bubbling, ready to be scooped up by your favorite (corn) tortilla chips, crudités, or Cornbread Crisps.
ingredients: 3/4 cup TJ's Organic Pepper Jack Cheese (shredded)
1 cup TJ's Fancy Shredded Mexican Blend Cheese, divided

steps.text: Preheat oven to 375°F. Grease a 2-quart baking dish with cooking spray, set aside.

Add cream cheese to a medium size, microwave safe bowl. Microwave on half power for 1 minute intervals, whipping with a fork in between, until warm and smooth. Add cowboy caviar, Organic Pepper Jack Cheese and 3/4 cup Mexican Blend Cheese and stir to combine. Scrape mixture into prepared baking dish and top with remaining cheese and roasted corn.
Place dish on center rack of oven and bake 30 minutes, until well browned and bubbling. Cool slightly before digging in with your edible scoop of choice (chips, crudités Cornbread Crisps...).

kickin-corn-dip.title: Kickin' Corn Dip

kicky-curry-dipping-sauce.description: What do you get when you combine vibrantly colored Yellow Curry Sauce with tangy Greek yogurt and Trader Joe's Spicy Honey Sauce? A versatile, vivaciously flavored dipping sauce with warm spices and creamy-cool mouthfeel that’s ideal alongside roasted Sweet Potato Fries, chicken skewers, grilled tofu…
ingredients: ½ cup TJ’s Yellow Curry Sauce
¼ cup TJ’s Spicy Honey Sauce

steps.text: In a small bowl, whisk all ingredients. Adjust to taste with more Spicy Honey Sauce as desired.
Serve the cool dip with hot sweet potato fries, chicken skewers, grilled tofu...
Store leftover dip covered in refrigerator for 2 days.

kicky-curry-dipping-sauce.title: Kicky Curry Dipping Sauce

kiss-my-cornbread-with-jalapenos-bacon.description: Folding Trader Joe's Hot & Sweet Jalapeños into our pleasantly sweet Cornbread Mix gives this recipe some heat, without any need for fire extinguishers. Including bacon makes it that much more delicious, because, well, bacon (we used our Uncured Applewood Smoked Bacon, but feel free to sub in your favorite TJ's bacon here). And while it's perhaps gilding the lily a bit, our Clarified Butter (Ghee) is the ideal partner to honey for added sweet & savory in every bite.
ingredients: 1/2 cup TJ's Hot & Sweet Jalapeños, diced
4 slices TJ's Apple Smoked Bacon, cooked and chopped

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease bottom and sides of an 8-inch square baking pan. In a small bowl, mix clarified butter and honey; set aside.
Beat eggs, oil, and milk in a large mixing bowl. Add cornbread mix and stir just until moistened-do not over mix. Fold in diced jalapeños and chopped bacon. Pour mix into prepared pan.
Bake on the center rack of oven 35-38 minutes or until golden brown and toothpick inserted into center comes out clean. Serve warm, with honey butter.

kiss-my-cornbread-with-jalapenos-bacon.title: Kiss My Cornbread with Jalapeños & Bacon

korean-hot-chicken-inspired-pizza.description: Inspired by the sticky-sweet and spicy sauce served over Korean fried chicken, Trader Joe’s Korean Style Yangnyeom Sauce offers a complex balance of sweet and heat as the base sauce of this pizza. Paired with jalapeño and habanero peppers in TJ’s Shredded Pepper Jack Cheese and a cayenne-based hot sauce on TJ’s Spicy Chicken Nuggets, this pizza will surely make your taste buds tingle and keep you coming back for another bite!
ingredients: 1 TJ’s Pizza Dough, left to sit at room temperature for 20 minutes
TJ's Unbleached Enriched All-Purpose Flour, for dusting
½ cup TJ’s Yangnyeom Sauce, plus more for drizzling
1 ½ cups TJ’s Shredded Pepper Jack Cheese
1/2 package TJ’s Spicy Chicken Nuggets, sliced into thirds
TJ’s Cilantro, leaved plucked from the stems, to garnish

steps.text: Preheat oven according to pizza dough packaging instructions.
Lightly dust your work surface with flour, then stretch by hand or roll the dough into a 12” diameter circle.
Use a spoon or spatula to evenly spread the yangnyeom sauce evenly over the dough, leaving the outer crust bare.
Top with cheese and spicy chicken nuggets, then bake according to the pizza dough’s recommended bake time.
Remove pizza from oven, then drizzle with more yangnyeom sauce and top with cilantro before slicing.

korean-hot-chicken-inspired-pizza.title: Korean Hot Chicken-Inspired Pizza

lasagna-carbonara.description: With all the rich, smoky flavors of spaghetti carbonara, and the gooey, cheesy goodness of home-baked lasagna, this recipe brings two giants of cozy, pasta-based comfort food together at last. Starting with the basic building blocks of a world-class lasagna (Ricotta, Shredded Mozzarella, and the phenomenally easy-to-use no-boil Trader Joe's Lasagna Noodles), we add Uncured Apple Smoked Bacon, peas, and plenty of garlic, carbonara-fying the dish into a marvelous pasta mash-up.
ingredients: 1 package Uncured Apple Smoked Bacon, cooked crispy, drained and chopped into small pieces
2 cups TJ's Shredded Mozzarella Cheese, divided
1/2 can TJ's Cannellini White Kidney Beans, rinsed, drained and pureed until smooth
1/2 tub (1 cup) TJ's Whole Milk Ricotta
4 medium cloves TJ's Premium Peeled Garlic, minced
1/4 teaspoon TJ's Red Chili Pepper Flakes, or more to taste
TJ's Sea Salt & Ground Black Pepper, to taste
1 cup TJ's Organic Frozen Peas, defrosted and drained
3/4 cup TJ's Organic Low Sodium Chicken Broth, divided
1 box TJ's No Boil Italian Lasagna Noodles

steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F and arrange a rack in the middle. Combine chopped bacon and 1 cup mozzarella cheese in a medium bowl, set aside.

In a large bowl, place the half can of pureed cannellini beans, 1 cup ricotta, 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese, 4 minced garlic cloves, 1/2 teaspoon basil and 1/4 teaspoon of chili flakes. Mix until combined, creating a cheese spread. Season with salt and pepper, to taste.
In a blender or food processor, combine 1 cup defrosted peas, 1/2 cup parmesan, and 1/2 cup broth. Blend until smooth. Season pea sauce with salt and pepper, to taste.

Spread 1/2 cup of pea sauce in an even layer over the bottom of an 8-by-8-inch baking dish. Place two sheets of lasagna over the top of the sauce in the middle of the dish. There will be room around the edges of the noodles. Add one third of the ricotta cheese spread over the noodles. Use the back of a spoon to spread the cheese to the edges of the noodles. Next, sprinkle one third of the bacon mixture on top. Add another layer of noodles and repeat process two more times. Cover the top layer of noodles with remaining pea sauce. Sprinkle 1 cup of mozzarella over the top. For extra moisture, add 1/4 cup broth around the edges of the noodle stack.

Coat 1 side of a large piece of aluminum foil with canola oil spray and cover the dish tightly with the foil, oil-side down. Bake until the sauce is starting to bubble around the edges, about 40 minutes. Remove the foil and continue baking until the top of the cheese begins to brown, about 20 minutes more. Remove the pan and let cool for at least 15 minutes before slicing.

lasagna-carbonara.title: Lasagna Carbonara

layered-salmon-quiche.description: This crustless quiche is an ideal addition to a spring brunch menu.
ingredients: 1 (6 oz) can TJ's Wild Alaskan Pink Salmon
2 Tablespoons TJ's Unbleached All Purpose Flour
3/4 cup shredded TJ's Baby Swiss Cheese, divided
1/2 cup TJ's Frozen Chopped Spinach, defrosted and water squeezed out

steps.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Grease a 9-inch broiler-safe pie dish with canola oil spray, set aside.
In a medium bowl, mix salmon, flour, 1/2 cup cheese and 5 grinds each of salt, pepper and everyday seasoning. Place salmon mixture in an even layer on the bottom of the prepared pie dish, set aside.
In a medium pan over medium heat, sauté shallots in butter until caramelized, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and allow to cool.
In a separate bowl, beat eggs, then stir in heavy cream, spinach and caramelized shallots. Pour egg mixture over the top of the salmon mixture in the pie dish.

Place dish on center rack of oven and bake 20 minutes. Remove dish from oven, add reserved 1/4 cup of cheese and broil until cheese begins to brown, about 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool for 5 minutes, slice, and enjoy.

layered-salmon-quiche.title: Layered Salmon Quiche

leek-bacon-egg-tottins.description: Tottins—think potato tots baked in a muffin tin—are fun breakfast fare that can be prepped in advance and eaten on-the-go. These tottins are filled with crunchy Trader Joe’s Turkey Bacon, caramelized leeks, and herby goat cheese. But you need not limit them to the AM of your day. They make a great lunch-box ready, protein-packed snack, too!
ingredients: TJ’s Avocado Spray, for greasing tin
36 (less than one bag) TJ’s Potato Tots
½ package TJ’s Trimmed Leeks, ends trimmed, quartered lengthwise & roughly chopped
½ log TJ’s Chevre Fine Herbs Goat Cheese

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F degrees. Spray cups of a cupcake tin with avocado oil. Fill each cup with three potato tots and set aside.

Add butter and leeks to a skillet over medium-high heat, and sauté 5 minutes until leeks are caramelized. Transfer sauteed leeks to a medium bowl. In the same pan, cook bacon according to package directions. Once crispy, remove to cool, blot dry, then chop into small pieces.

Add bacon pieces to bowl of leeks, then stir in eggs, salt, and pepper. Set aside. Add three to four small pieces of goat cheese on top of the potato tots in each cup. Then, evenly distribute the egg mixture among the cups.

Place pan in center rack of oven and bake 18-20 minutes until egg is cooked and tops have browned slightly. Allow to cool for a minute, then run a knife around the edge of each cup, and carefully remove tottins and place in a serving platter. Enjoy!

leek-bacon-egg-tottins.title: Leek & Bacon Egg Tottins

lemon-blueberry-waffle-ice-cream-sandwic.description: Trader Joe's Blueberry Waffles are made with blueberry flavored bits, plus natural blueberry flavoring, to deliver the utmost blueberry-on-blueberry experience. When toasted, they take on a wonderfully crisp exterior and chewy interior, much like waffles you'd make from scratch, at a fraction of the time. When slathered with tangy lemon curd and sandwiched around slabs of blueberry lemon curd ice cream, they make for a superlative summer dessert.
ingredients: 1 quart TJ's Super Premium French Vanilla Ice Cream, softened
1 cup TJ's Wild Boreal Blueberries, thawed and drained

steps.text:
Prepare ice cream: Using a stand mixer or hand mixer, combine ice cream (save container and lid), 1 jar lemon curd, and lemon juice. Gently fold in blueberries just until combined (don't overmix or you'll lose the tie-dye look!). Pour mixture back into ice cream container, cover and freeze until solid, 4 hours or overnight.

Line a baking sheet or serving plate with paper towels. Remove ice cream from freezer (it needs to be completely frozen).

Use scissors to cut a notch in the ice cream container and gently tear it away so you have a log of ice cream.

Using a sharp knife, slice the ice cream log into disks, placing them in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet.

Place baking sheet back in freezer while you prep the waffles.
Assemble sandwiches: Toast the waffles to your preferred level of doneness. Slather with lemon curd. Place an ice cream disk atop one waffle and close the sandwich with another. Enjoy immediately.

lemon-blueberry-waffle-ice-cream-sandwic.title: Lemon Blueberry Waffle Ice Cream Sandwich

lemon-chicken-orzo-soup.description: Think pasta salad is reserved for spring and summer? This recipe, and our recipe taste-testers, beg to differ. It's a bright soup with the power to beat the winter blahs, made substantial with Trader Joe's Mediterranean Pasta Salad. Tangy Lemon Pepper Grilled Chicken adds protein and zingy flavor, balanced by briny feta and olives in the pasta salad. A quick simmer in savory Organic Free Range Chicken Broth, and you'll have the sights and smells of the sunny Mediterranean filling your soup bowl...
ingredients: 2 cartons TJ's Organic Free Range Chicken Broth
2 tubs TJ's Mediterranean Style Orzo Pasta Salad
1 package TJ's Lemon Pepper Grilled Chicken, sliced into bite-sized pieces

steps.text: Add broth to a medium saucepan and heat over medium high. Bring to a boil, add the orzo salad and chicken, then lower heat and simmer 8 minutes.
Serve hot with a squeeze of lemon.

lemon-chicken-orzo-soup.title: Lemon Chicken Orzo Soup

lemon-garlic-cauliflower-rice.description: Whether you need a simple side dish or the base to a grain-free bowl, Trader Joe's Organic Riced Cauliflower is the veritable veggie for the job. Here, we’re amping it up with aromatic garlic, a squeeze of bright lemon juice, a sprinkle of herbaceous parsley, and a generous grating of Parmesan cheese. For a satiating weeknight meal, serve alongside grilled salmon or roast chicken.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon juice from a TJ’s Lemon
2 tablespoon TJ’s Fresh Parsley, finely chopped
TJ’s Organic Ground Black Pepper, to taste

steps.text: Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat then add riced cauliflower. Cook until heated through and water is absorbed, about 3-4 minutes.
Push cauliflower to one side of the pan, then add olive oil. Once hot, add garlic and sauté until softened and aromatic, about 2-3 minutes. Stir to combine sautéed garlic and cauliflower.
Remove from heat, add lemon juice, parsley, and grated cheese, then stir to combine. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

lemon-garlic-cauliflower-rice.title: Lemon Garlic Cauliflower Rice

lemon-mustard-vinaigrette.description: Don't stop at salad—mix this vinaigrette with lentils, roasted vegetables, steamed rice…
ingredients: 3 teaspoons TJ’s Dijon Mustard with White Wine
1/4 teaspoon TJ’s Sea Salt, or to taste
1/4 teaspoon TJ’s Ground Black Pepper, or to taste
1/2 cup of your favorite TJ’s Extra Virgin Olive Oil

steps.text: In a small bowl, whisk together shallot, lemon juice, vinegar, mustard, honey then season with salt and pepper. Slowly whisk in oil until emulsified. Taste and adjust seasoning as desired. Makes about 1 cup of vinaigrette.
Serving suggestions: mix with warmed lentils, wilted kale and tomatoes, drizzle over grilled asparagus, or dress a baby spinach salad (with pistachios, beets, goat cheese and red onion).

lemon-mustard-vinaigrette.title: Lemon-Mustard Vinaigrette

lemon-pesto-potato-salad.description:
In Italian, the word pesto can be translated as “to pound” or “to crush,” referring to the traditional method in which pesto sauce is made. With Trader Joe’s Lemon Pesto Sauce, the laborious process of crushing whole lemons with Grana Padano cheese, almonds, and a pinch of pepper has already been done for you. The result is a light and bright sauce, bursting with lemon flavor, that’s ready to use straight out of the jar. Toss it with your favorite pasta when you need dinner pronto, or swap your starch and combine it with potatoes for an easy-peasy potato salad. 

Pro-tip: Save your starch water! Potatoes release starch into the water they are boiled in. Before you drain the potatoes, reserve some of it to add to the pesto to emulsify the sauce and help coat the potatoes evenly.
ingredients: 1 package (1 pound) TJ’s Teeny Tiny Potatoes, sliced into 1-inch rounds
A few cranks of TJ’s Black Peppercorns
¼ cup finely chopped TJ’s Mint, to serve

steps.text: Add potatoes to a large pot and fill with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil.
When the water begins to boil, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer about 10 minutes, or until potatoes can be easily pierced with a fork.
Reserve 1/2 cup of starch water from the pot, before draining the potatoes. (You may not need all the water.)
In a large bowl, add Lemon Pesto Sauce. Slowly add 1/3 cup starch water and whisk until the sauce has thinned and has completely emulsified with the water. Add more water, if needed.
Add potatoes to the bowl and toss until completely coated in the sauce.
Season with salt and a few cranks of pepper.
Top with chopped mint to serve.

lemon-pesto-potato-salad.title: Lemon Pesto Potato Salad

lemon-ricotta-ravioli-salad.description: Cut to resemble the sunflowers, or girasoli, that blanket the Italian countryside each summer, Trader Joe's Ricotta & Lemon Zest Ravioli are a revelation in warm-weather cuisine. Made for us by a trusted Italian pasta partner, these tender, eggy, sunflower-shaped pasta pockets are stuffed with a bright & creamy filling of fresh ricotta cheese, real Sicilian lemon zest, salt, butter, & breadcrumbs. For a delicious dinner in a flash, simply throw together a crisp arugula salad, then top it with these quick-cooking Ravioli and a shower of salty, shaved Parmesan... Mangia bene!
ingredients: 1 package TJ's Ricotta & Lemon Zest Ravioli (limited)
TJ's Shaved Parmesan, Romano & Asiago Cheese
TJ's Dry Toasted Pine Nuts OR TJ's Roasted Not So Salty Cashew Pieces

steps.text: Bring 4 quarts of lightly salted water to a boil. Add ravioli, bring back to a gentle boil. Cook 3 minutes until al dente. Drain and set aside.

In a large bowl, toss arugula with a small amount of dressing to coat. Divide dressed arugula among shallow serving bowls. Top with ravioli, a generous shower of cheese, a sprinkle of pine nuts (optional), and a few grinds of lemon pepper. Serve immediately, with more dressing on the side.

lemon-ricotta-ravioli-salad.title: Lemon Ricotta Ravioli Salad

lemon-thyme-triple-berry-pie.description:
Trader Joe’s Pie Crusts are available in our freezer all year long, making every day a great day to bake a pie—like this berry pie with elevated additions of lemon and thyme! There are two Crusts in each box, so you can double down and make two pies, or double up and top your pie with a lattice, as we've done here. . If your lattice skills are lacking, worry not—our handy-how-to video will have you braiding and crimping with the best of them in no time! Read the recipe below, then follow along with our recipe video to learn how to lattice and crimp your Pie Crust! 

A Note On Timing: While you will need at least 5 hours to make this pie, most of it is inactive, requiring only 30 minutes of active preparation to make the filling and assemble. (The cook time includes two hours to thaw the crust and two hours to cool the finished pie.)
ingredients: 1 box TJ’s Frozen Pie Crusts,  thawed at room temperature for 2 hours
5 cups of your favorite TJ’s Berries, (we use a mix of fresh Blueberries, Raspberries, and Blackberries)
1/3 cup TJ’s All-Purpose Flour, plus more for dusting
A pinch of TJ’s Sea Salt
Zest from 1 TJ’s Lemon, plus 2 tablespoons juice
TJ’s Heavy Cream, for brushing on crust; and to whip up for topping (optional but encouraged!)
TJ’s Turbinado Raw Cane Sugar, for sprinkling

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
In a large bowl, combine berries, sugar, flour, butter, salt, lemon zest and juice, and thyme. Stir gently to combine, then set aside.
Gently unroll both pie crusts. Note: if the crusts have any cracks, pinch and smooth out the cracks with your hands or a rolling pin over the plastic liner. Then remove the plastic.
Carefully place one of the rounds into a 9-inch pie pan, gently smoothing it against the sides. Some of the dough will hang over the top. Chill while you prepare the lattice top.
Lightly flour your countertop or work surface. Place the second pie crust on floured surface, then remove the plastic liners. Lightly dust the top of the pie crust.
Cut the round into ¾-inch strips. You should have at least 12 strips.
Remove pie pan from refrigerator, then spoon the filling into the crust. Using your fingers or a pastry brush, brush the edges of the bottom crust with a bit of water.

Evenly space out half of the strips vertically over the filling, the longest strip should be placed at the center of the pie.

Fold every other strip back halfway.

Place one strip of dough perpendicular to the vertical strips, placing at the center of the pie.

Unfold the folded vertical strips over the horizontal strip so they lie flat again.

Fold the other vertical strips back halfway (the strips you didn’t fold back the first time), then place another strip perpendicular to the folded vertical strips. Then unfold the vertical strips so they lie flat again.

Repeat the process until the entire pie is covered.

Trim any strips that hang over the pie pan edge.
steps.title: Make the Lattice

steps.text: Fold the bottom crust overhang up and onto the rim of the pan. Use your left index finger and thumb to pinch together a small section of dough, closest to the filling, while your right index finger pushes the other side of the dough into itself, making a half triangle shape. Continue this process around the entirety of the pie.
steps.title: Crimp the Edge

steps.text: Lightly brush the top of the pie and crimped edge with cream, then sprinkle with turbinado sugar.

Place the pie on a foil-lined sheet pan, then bake at 400°F for 15 minutes. Lower the temperature to 375°F and bake 45-55 minutes, until the filling bubbles and the crust is golden. (If the crust browns too quickly, tent the top with a piece of foil.)

Note: As the moisture in the berry filling evaporates during baking, it may bubble up and through the lattice top. While a bubbling filling will help ensure a well-set filling when cooled, be sure to bake your pie on a foil-lined baking sheet to avoid a potential mess in the oven.
Let the pie cool for 2 hours, allowing the filling to set.
Serve with a dollop of whipped cream and enjoy!

lemon-thyme-triple-berry-pie.title: Lemon & Thyme Triple Berry Pie

linguine-limone-alfredo-with-shrimp.description: Inspired by a well-known & well-loved dish at an equally well-known & well-loved Italian restaurant here in L.A., Trader Joe's Limone Alfredo Sauce tastes like a bright, sunny spring afternoon... If said spring afternoon was, say, mixed with whole milk, whipping cream, butter & real Parmigiano Reggiano cheese, that is zesty, creamy Alfredo is perfect with long-cut pasta like Trader Joe's Linguine, and since it also brightens up seafood like you wouldn't believe, we suggest adding some garlic-sautéed shrimp to the pasta party...
ingredients: 1/2 bag TJ's Frozen Cooked Medium Shrimp

steps.text: In a large pot, bring water to a rolling boil; add salt if desired. Add noodles and stir gently to separate. Bring water back to a boil and cook 8 - 10 minutes or until desired doneness is reached.
Remove from heat and drain pasta well. Place pasta back in empty pot.
In a medium skillet, melt butter. Once melted, add shrimp and garlic; sauté for 2 - 3 minutes, just until shrimp are thoroughly heated.
Add sauce and shrimp to noodles and mix until thoroughly coated. Add parsley if desired and salt to taste.
Serve and enjoy!

linguine-limone-alfredo-with-shrimp.title: Linguine Limone Alfredo with Shrimp

loaded-breakfast-buns.description: Trader Joe’s Brioche Hot Dog Buns combine all the fluffiness and mild sweetness of brioche with all the form and function of a hot dog bun to help you take your hot dogs to the next level. But one need not limit their imagination to just hot dogs — these Buns also work wonders for fried fish, hot chicken, egg salad, and lobster rolls, and are remarkably well-suited to complementing your morning bacon and eggs!
ingredients: 4 slices TJ’s Organic American Singles Cheese
4 slices TJ’s Uncured Apple Smoked Bacon, cooked then chopped into bite-sized pieces
TJ’s Habanero Hot Sauce, to serve

steps.text: Place a medium-sized non-stick pan over medium heat, toast buns until golden, 2-3 minutes on each side, then remove from pan.
Lower heat to medium-low and add butter. Once melted, add eggs and cook to the doneness of your liking. Remove from heat, and season with salt and pepper.

To assemble your breakfast bun, open the bun and place two slices of cheese in the crevice, then a slice of bacon on each side of the bun. Add half of the scrambled eggs on top of the cheese, between the two slices of bacon. Repeat with second bun.
Drizzle with hot sauce to serve.

loaded-breakfast-buns.title: Loaded Breakfast Buns

loaded-potato-pancakes.description: While latkes are a Hanukkah tradition, they're not just for holidays. For a tasty brunch bite or a satisfying midday snack, try topping Trader Joe’s Potato Pancakes with Soy Chorizo, melted cheese, and sour cream. Serve as an appetizer or fill your plate for an entire meal!
ingredients: 1 package TJ’s Potato Pancakes, cooked according to preferred package heating instructions
4 TJ’s Pepper Jack Slices, torn into quarters
½ package TJ’s Soy Chorizo, cooked according to package instructions

steps.text: To the cooked potato pancakes, arrange two quarters of cheese on top and return them to cook for an additional minute, to help melt the cheese.
Evenly distribute the soy chorizo on top of each potato pancake, followed by a tablespoon of sour cream.
Garnish with cilantro leaves, to serve.

loaded-potato-pancakes.title: Loaded Potato Pancakes

loaded-totchos.description: Crisp and pleasantly salty with a warm, tender interior, Trader Joe's Trader Potato Tots hit the mark for appetizer awesomeness and superb late-night snacking. They're crafted with shredded Northwest potatoes that are pressed into bite-size nuggets and fried to achieve a gloriously golden, crunchy exterior. Use them as a base for cheesy Totchos with hot & sweet jalapeños, black beans, and your protein of choice-we opted for a batch of Jackfruit Carnitas for a marvelously meatless presentation.
ingredients: 1 block TJ's Jalapeño Jack Cheese, shredded and divided
1 can TJ's Organic Black Beans, drained
1/2 batch of Jackfruit Carnitas (or 2 cups of your favorite cooked protein)
TJ's Hot & Sweet Jalapeños, Sour Cream & Cilantro (for garnish)

steps.text: Spread tots on a large, rimmed baking pan and cook according to package directions. Remove pan from oven and set on heat-safe work surface.
