Using tongs or a spatula, pile half of the tots in the center of the pan. Sprinkle with half of the cheese, then pile remaining tots on top. Scatter black beans, jackfruit carnitas, remaining cheese and jalapeños atop the tots.
Return pan to oven and cook 5-10 minutes more to melt the cheese. Remove from oven and let cool slightly. Garnish with cilantro and sour cream, and enjoy!

loaded-totchos.title: Loaded Totchos

mac-chos.description:
By combining creamy, mild Monterey Jack cheese with savory, spicy jalapeño and habanero peppers, you get Trader Joe’s Shredded Pepper Jack Cheese Blend. And when you combine Shredded Pepper Jack Cheese, a handful of crushed tortilla chips, TJ’s Hot Pico de Gallo, and a box of TJ’s Diner Mac & Cheese, the result is a loaded mac and cheese punctuated by the flavors and crunch of nachos! Dig in! 

Pro-tip: You can cut the cook time down by following the microwave instruction on the package of Mac n’ Cheese instead of the oven instructions in step 1. For the cheesy, crunchy top, finish it in the oven by following step 2.
ingredients: 1 box TJ’s Joe's Diner Mac n' Cheese
½ cup TJ’s Pepper Jack Cheese Blend
¼ cup crushed TJ’s Tortilla Chips
1 short stalk TJ’s Green Onions, chopped

steps.text: Preheat oven to 375°F. Remove package from box and remove film from package. Place on a baking sheet and bake on the middle rack for 20 minutes.
Carefully remove from oven. Top with crushed tortilla chips and pepper jack cheese. Return to the oven for an additional 5-7 minutes, until the cheese melts and begins to brown.
Top with a couple spoonfuls of pico de gallo and a sprinkle of chopped green onion to serve.

mac-chos.title: Mac-chos

magnifislaw-burger-meal.description: Trader Joe's Magnifisauce is a truly special sauce whose flavors harken to an array of classic burger condiments, with the subtle tang of vinegar, and a spread of spices. In other words, it's made with slow-food ingredients, but a squeeze of the bottle gets you the best of the fast-food experience. Toss it with slaw, spread it on burgers or sandwiches, use as a dipping sauce...magnificent... Magnifisauce.
ingredients: 2 packages TJ's Organic Shredded Cabbage & Carrots
4 TJ's Burgers or Meatless Patties of your choice
1 bag TJ's Handsome Cut Fries OR TJ's Potato Tots
TJ's ripe avocado, jalapeño, or your favorite burger garnishes

steps.text: In a large bowl, toss cabbage and carrots with about a cup of Magnifisauce (adjust to taste) until well-combined. Set aside.
Bake fries according to package directions.
While fries bake, season burgers/patties with salt & pepper and cook to your liking, on a grill or grill pan, under the broiler, or in a skillet. Grill buns if desired.

Place burgers/patties on buns; top burgers with prepared Magnifi-Slaw. Serve with fries and a sidecar of Magnifisauce for dipping. Enjoy your Magnifi-Meal! (Feel free to make a milkshake for maximum fast-food style indulgence.)

magnifislaw-burger-meal.title: Magnifi-Slaw Burger Meal

manchego-fig-bites.description: Produced using the whole milk of the region's native Manchega sheep, Trader Joe's Manchego Añejo Cheese exemplifies the clean, buttery, slightly nutty flavor and delightfully crumbly texture of Manchego, then takes it to another level altogether by aging it for a full year. All that extra time lets the cheese develop rich, caramelized notes and a firm, but still gracefully elastic structure, making it a staunchly dependable appetizer companion for dried figs, prosciutto, and a crisp glass of Sauvignon Blanc.
ingredients: 1 wedge TJ's 12-Month Aged Manchego Añejo, cubed
6 slices TJ's Prosciutto, sliced in half lengthwise
TJ's Whole Grain Dijon Mustard and TJ's Honey, to serve (optional)

steps.text: Fold a slice of prosciutto back and forth on itself to create a ruffled look. Gently skewer the folded prosciutto with a toothpick, followed by a fig half and a cube of cheese. Repeat assembly process with remaining ingredients.
Serve alone or with TJ's Whole Grain Dijon Mustard and your favorite TJs Honey for dipping.

manchego-fig-bites.title: Manchego Fig Bites

mango-lime-sparkling-mock-a-ritas.description: Trader Joe’s Sparkling Lime Water is getting the spicy margarita treatment (sans tequila), infused with jalapeño, fresh lime, and adorned with a chile lime rim. Instead of diluting those flavors with ice, opt for a Trader Joe’s Mango Cream Bar to keep it cold (yes!) and further infuse it with sweet-tart, refreshing mango flavor as it melts (double yes!).
ingredients: 2-3 tablespoons TJ’s Chile Lime Seasoning Blend

steps.text: Place the chile lime seasoning in a shallow dish, slightly wider than the glasses. Rub a wedge of lime around the rim of each glass. Invert glasses and place in the seasoning, twisting and turning to coat the rim.
steps.title: Prepare the Chile Lime Rim

steps.text: Add a slice of jalapeño and a lime wedge to each glass. Using a spoon or a cocktail muddler, gently crush them to extract their flavors.
steps.title: Prepare the Drink

steps.text: Place a mango cream bar, stick side up, in each glass.
Divide the sparkling water between the two glasses to serve.

mango-lime-sparkling-mock-a-ritas.title: Mango Lime Sparkling Mock-A-Ritas

ingredients: 1/2 cup TJ's Limeade (or TJ's Organic Jalapeño Limeade, if you enjoy a kick!)
3/4 cup (4 shots) TJ's Reposado Distinqt Tequila (optional)
2 cups TJ's Organic Frozen Mango Chunks

steps.text: Begin by rimming the glasses: Add salt to a small plate, then squeeze the juice of 1 lime onto a separate plate. Dip the rim of the drinking glasses into the lime juice, then dip into the salt. Set aside.
In a blender, add the juice from 4 Limes with the Orange Juice, Mango Chunks, Limeade and the Agave Sweetener. Pulse several times until liquefied, then add the Ice and pulse again.
Pour into salt-rimmed glasses and garnish with lime slices. Fiesta time!

mango-limeadita.title: Mango Limeadita

mango-mango-frozen-cheesecake.description: This is basically the sunshine and pleasures of summer blended into a vibrant, irresistible cheesecake with Mango, Mango, coconut cashews, strawberries, honey...
ingredients: a few sprigs of TJ's Organic Mint, to garnish
a sprinkling of TJ's Organic Flake Coconut, to garnish

steps.text: Grind coconut cashews, soft and juicy mango, coconut oil, and salt in a blender or a food processor for about a minute, or until the mixture coarsely comes together. Flatten the mixture out on the bottom of an 8-inch non-stick spring form pan.

Chill crust in fridge while the filling is made. Blend mango, lemon juice and honey. Add mascarpone and mango Greek yogurt; blend until uniform color. Pour filling over chilled crust and freeze for at least two hours.
Remove from freezer ten minutes before serving. Top cheesecake with fresh mango and strawberries, garnish with coconut flakes and mint sprigs. Serve immediately.

mango-mango-frozen-cheesecake.title: Mango, Mango Frozen Cheesecake

mango-melba-shortcake.description: If Dame Nellie Melba had known about mangos, she would have asked Chef Escoffier to make the dessert with this luscious tropical fruit instead of peaches... well, at least we think so!
ingredients: 1 jar TJ's Organic Reduced Sugar Raspberry Preserves
1 bag TJ's Organic Frozen Mango Chunks, thawed
1 package TJ's Organic Biscuits, baked and cooled
TJ's Super Premium French Vanilla Ice Cream

steps.text: In a small sauce pan, over low heat, heat the jam until syrupy. Fold in mango chunks and remove from heat.
Split biscuits in half, spread whipped cream on the bottom half and fill with mango mixture.
Top with a scoop of ice cream.

mango-melba-shortcake.title: Mango Melba Shortcake

mangorita.description: Bursting with mango sweetness, balanced by citrus tartness, and kicked up with Chile Lime Seasoning, this drink invites you to refresh, revitalize, and really, really revel in Mangorita! moments.
ingredients: 2 TJ's Lime (1 for .5 oz juice, 1 for garnish & glass prep)
1 TJ's Mango, peeled, pitted & coarsely chopped

steps.text: Prepare the Glasses: Place the chile lime seasoning in a shallow dish or spread in a small pile (shape depends on glass) on a clean cutting board. Rub a slice of lime around the rim of each glass. Turn glasses over and place directly in the pile seasoning; twist and turn it so the rim gets coated with seasoning.
Blend the Mangorita: Place mango, 1 tablespoon lime juice, margarita mix, tequila and ice into a blender. Pulse several times until mixture is well blended and slushy.
Pour into chile-lime rimmed glasses, garnish (optional), sip back and revel.

mangorita.title: Mangorita!

maple-brown-butter-salmon.description: Trader Joe’s Salmon Fillets are hearty, delicious, and emphatically versatile. Salmon is a particularly protean source of protein, working wonders in everything from soups, to stir-fried, to quick and easy single sheet pan bakes. To make an especially delicious center-of-the-plate option for everyday dinners and special occasions alike, we suggest a drizzle of homemade brown butter right before serving.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons TJ’s Salmon Rub Seasoning Blend
2 tablespoons of your favorite TJ’s Maple Syrup

steps.text: Preheat oven to 325° F, and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Pat fillet dry then place skin-side down on prepared baking sheet. Sprinkle seasoning over the salmon, then brush with maple syrup to coat. Bake in oven for about 20 minutes, or until the internal temperature reads 145° with a thermometer.

While the salmon bakes, melt butter in a small saucepan over medium heat. With a silicone spatula, stir occasionally as the butter begins to bubble and brown. When the butter smells nutty and the milk solids become golden at the bottom of the pan, remove from heat, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove salmon from oven, and carefully transfer to serving platter. Drizzle with brown butter to serve.

maple-brown-butter-salmon.title: Maple & Brown Butter Salmon

maple-espresso-black-tea-latte.description: A perfect autumn morning calls for a perfect autumn drink, and for our money, nothing fits that bill quite like our new, delightfully unique Maple Espresso Black Tea. Made with a blend of select black & herbal tea leaves, natural maple flavor, and ground espresso beans, a steaming latte made with this Tea is just the thing to help turn a perfect autumn morning into a perfect autumn day.
ingredients: 2 TJ's Maple Espresso Black Tea Blend teabags
Your favorite milk or non-dairy beverage, warmed

steps.text: Brew 2 tea bags in 1/3 cup of hot water and steep for 8 minutes.
Remove tea bags and fill rest of the cup with warm milk or non-dairy beverage.
Sweeten if desired.

maple-espresso-black-tea-latte.title: Maple Espresso Black Tea Latte

maple-harissa-glazed-sweet-potatoes.description: We challenged Trader Joe's Crew Members across the country to a Recipe Contest, inviting them to create their own delicious dishes using no more than five TJ's ingredients. We were WOW-ed by the submissions! This recipe won 2nd Runner Up, and was created by Ry Keener from Store #134 in Federal Way, Washington.
ingredients: ½ cup TJ’s Sweet & Spicy Pecans

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 400°F.
Wash sweet potatoes. Do not peel; leave skins on.
Using a mandoline or sharp knife, thinly slice the potatoes and set aside.
Add oil, maple syrup, Harissa, and salt to a large bowl and mix until combined.
Add potatoes to the bowl and toss until evenly coated in the mixture.
In a 10-inch pan arrange potato slices upright and in a row. Repeat with the remaining empty space in the middle of the pan.
Peel and slice the garlic and nestle between potato slices, evenly distributed throughout.
Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes.
While baking, chop the pecans. At the 30-minute mark, remove foil and sprinkle pecans over potatoes.
Bake an additional 20 minutes, uncovered.
Serve warm and enjoy!

maple-harissa-glazed-sweet-potatoes.title: Maple & Harissa Glazed Sweet Potatoes

maple-marshmallow-popcorn-bars.description: Trader Joe’s Mini Maple Flavored Marshmallows melt easily with butter to create a gooey and oh-so-delicious binder for sweet snack bars. For the crucial crunchy component, add slightly crushed TJ’s Movie Theater Popcorn in lieu of the typical cereal to take these bars in a decidedly sweet and salty direction. Festively fall-y and filled with the sweet, caramelly scent of Maple, these bars are a marvelous treat in a lunchbox or on movie night.
ingredients: 1 (six ounce) bag TJ’s Mini Maple Flavored Marshmallows

steps.text: In a medium saucepan, add butter and melt over medium heat. Add Mini Maple Flavored Marshmallows and stir with a silicone spatula until completely melted with the butter, about 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, add popcorn and gently crush with your hands. Carefully pour melted marshmallow mixture over the popcorn. Stir with spatula until thoroughly combined.
Pour popcorn mixture into an 8x8 parchment lined baking dish. Cover with an additional piece of parchment and press to evenly distribute into the dish.
Let sit 15 minutes before slicing and serving.

maple-marshmallow-popcorn-bars.title: Maple Marshmallow Popcorn Bars

maple-rosemary-butternut-squash-walnuts.description: This easy, autumnal side dish appeals to sweet and savory squash lovers alike. Trader Joe’s Salted Butter accentuates the richness of maple syrup and the herbaceous notes of rosemary that pair harmoniously with roasted butternut squash.
ingredients: ½ cup TJ’s Raw California Walnut Baking Pieces

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
In a large bowl, combine cut squash, melted butter, maple syrup, chopped rosemary, and salt. Toss together to evenly distribute.
Pour contents of bowl onto a rimmed baking sheet in a single layer. Bake on center rack of oven for 20 minutes.
Remove from oven, flip the squash using a spatula and return to the oven for an additional 15 minutes until tender and beginning to brown.
Add walnut pieces, toss to combine, and serve.

maple-rosemary-butternut-squash-walnuts.title: Maple Rosemary Butternut Squash with Walnuts

maple-spiced-whipped-cream.description: How you dress your pie is almost as important as the pie itself. This whipped cream recipe is tasty with Trader Joe's Pumpkin Pie, of course, but would also be incredible atop a slice of Trader Joe's Pancake Bread or Trader Joe's Vegan Banana Bread. (And if you really want to spice things up, add a pinch of cayenne to offset the sweet, velvety cream-you'll be glad you did!)
ingredients: 5-6 teaspoons your favorite TJ's Maple Syrup

steps.text: Pour whipping cream into a large bowl. Using a hand mixer or whisk, whip until soft peaks form. Fold in syrup and cinnamon. Serve with pumpkin pie, scones, coffee, muffins, ice cream...

maple-spiced-whipped-cream.title: Maple Spiced Whipped Cream

marinated-manchego.description:
Produced exclusively in Spain’s La Mancha region, Manchego is a sheep’s milk cheese that’s been produced for hundreds of years, and it’s still crafted exclusively from the whole milk of the region’s Manchega sheep. Trader Joe's Manchego is aged for six months and offers aromas of flowers, nuts, and lavender. Try it shaved over a salad, as part of a charcuterie board, or really break the mold and marinate it in olive oil and an array of aromatics. 

Pro-tip: The Manchego will become more flavorful the longer it marinates. Prepare it the day before you plan to serve it for a maximum flavor, make-ahead appetizer.
ingredients: 1/2 cup of your favorite TJ's Extra Virgin Olive Oil
Rind from 1/2 TJ's Orange, peeled and sliced into thin strips
A few small sprigs TJ's Rosemary
1 block TJ's Manchego Cheese, cut into bite-sized cubes

steps.text: In a small saucepan, heat olive oil over medium-low heat. Add smashed garlic cloves, orange peel strips, rosemary sprigs, and peppercorns, and cook until garlic just begins to become golden, about 5-7 minutes. Remove from heat and let cool for 10 minutes.

Add Manchego cubes to a container with a fitted lid. Carefully pour aromatic olive oil and the aromatic add-ins over the Manchego. Seal the container and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Remove cheese from refrigerator 20 minutes prior to serving.

marinated-manchego.title: Marinated Manchego

marshmallow-blondies.description: Shaped like a brownie and with the same craveably chewy texture, the Blondies prepared with a box of Trader Joe's Blondie Bar Mix also possess the brown sugary goodness of your favorite chocolate chip cookie. Irresistible on their own, they're an excellent stand-in for graham crackers in this chocolatey, gooey, bakery-style take on s'mores, just in time for summer.
ingredients: 1 box TJ's Blondie Bar Baking Mix
2-1.75 oz bars Trader Joe's Milk Chocolate, roughly chopped

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease an 8X8-inch baking pan with canola oil spray, set aside. Using a pair of clean kitchen scissors, cut marshmallows into quarters, set aside.

In a large mixing bowl, slowly whisk melted butter into egg. Gently fold in blondie bar mix just until combined, followed by marshmallows and chocolate. Spread blondie mixture evenly into greased pan.

Place pan on center rack of oven and bake until blondies are deep golden brown, about 30-33 minutes. (Marshmallows will puff up-don't fret! They'll sink back down as they cool.) Remove pan from oven and let cool completely on a wire rack prior to slicing and serving.

marshmallow-blondies.title: Marshmallow Blondies

marvelous-mustard-gravy.description: Turkey isn’t the only main dish that deserves the gravy treatment. But what kind of gravy goes great with ham, pork, or chicken? We think it’s this gravy, which gains it’s pleasantly grainy texture and tart, lightly spicy edge from Trader Joe’s Whole Grain Dijon Mustard. Indeed, it is especially complementary with thick slices of sweet-savory roast ham—either on the plate, or on a leftovers sandwich. Come to think of it, it’d also be excellent on roasted pork loin, Brussels sprouts, roast chicken...
ingredients: 2 TJ’s Shallots, peeled and finely diced
2 TJ’s Garlic cloves, peeled and finely minced
1/2 cup Villa Borghetti Pinot Grigio (or other dry white wine)
1/4 cup TJ’s Whole Grain Dijon Mustard
TJ’s Sea Salt & Freshly Ground Black Pepper, to taste

steps.text: In a 1-quart sauce pan, over medium heat, melt butter until foaming. Add the shallot and garlic and sauté until golden brown.
Deglaze the pan with the white wine, scraping any caramelized bits loose from the bottom. Stir in mustard and gravy and bring to a simmer.

Stir in heavy cream. Season to taste with freshly ground black pepper and a little salt, if needed. Ladle hot gravy over mashed potatoes, roast turkey, stuffing, pork loin, chicken thighs, roasted vegetables, etc…garnish with fresh chives and enjoy!

marvelous-mustard-gravy.title: Marvelous Mustard Gravy

mashed-sweet-potatoes-brown-butter.description:
Within each bag of Trader Joe’s Mashed Sweet Potatoes is just one simple ingredient: sweet potatoes that have been peeled, cooked, and mashed, then frozen into portioned pucks. That’s it—nothing else added, all the prep work done, ready to use whenever you need them. Their sweet, earthy flavor shines in this simple, yet impressive holiday side that gets its incredible depth and alluring aroma from brown butter, made with Trader Joe’s Unsalted Butter Quarters.

Pro-tip: Double the brown butter recipe and spread it on toast, spoon it over oatmeal, or toss it with a bowl of popcorn!
ingredients: ½ stick TJ’s Unsalted Butter Quarters, chopped into cubes
1 package TJ’s Mashed Sweet Potatoes, prepared according to package instructions
½ cup Sweet and Spicy Pecans, chopped

steps.text: In a small saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. With a silicone spatula, stir occasionally, as the butter begins to bubble and brown. When the butter smells nutty and the milk solids become golden at the bottom of the pan, remove from heat, about 5-7 minutes.

To your serving bowl, add cooked mashed sweet potatoes. Spoon brown butter plus the toasty bits at the bottom of the pan atop the sweet potatoes. Top with chopped pecans, and a sprinkle of salt and pepper to serve.

mashed-sweet-potatoes-brown-butter.title: Mashed Sweet Potatoes with Brown Butter

matcha-matcha-cupcakes.description: Each box of Trader Joe’s Matcha Green Tea contains seven individual packets of vibrant emerald-green tea powder that comes from tea leaves that are grown and ground for us in Japan. Brewed, it has a rich taste that presents a delicate hint of sweetness. Mix one packet with eight ounces of hot water for a steaming cup of Matcha tea. Or use six of them whip up a batch of these virescent cupcakes, complete with Matcha-tinted buttercream frosting. Mmm, mmm, Matcha!
ingredients: 2 cups TJ’s Buttermilk Pancake & Baking Mix
¾ cup TJ’s Organic Cane Sugar
1 cup TJ’s Whole Milk, plus 2 teaspoons for the frosting
1 tablespoon TJ's Organic Pure Bourbon Vanilla Extract
6 TJ’s Single Serve Matcha Green Tea Packets, divided

steps.text:
Preheat the oven to 350°F. Line the wells of 2 cupcake pans with 18 paper liners, set aside. 

Add pancake mix, cane sugar, 1 cup milk, oil, eggs, and vanilla in a large bowl and whisk to combine, until the batter is smooth. Add contents of 4 matcha packets to bowl and whisk until thoroughly incorporated.  

Evenly divide the batter into lined cupcake pan, filling each cup about 2/3 full. Bake for 16-18 minutes, until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Remove from oven and allow cupcakes to cool completely (about 30 minutes – 1 hour.)
steps.title: Prepare the Cupcakes

steps.text: While cupcakes are baking, in the bowl of an electric mixer with paddle attachment (or in a bowl with a hand mixer), beat softened butter on medium speed until smooth. Reduce speed to medium low and add powdered sugar to bowl in 1/2 cup increments, mixing thoroughly between additions. Scrape bowl with a spatula. Add 2 teaspoons milk and 1 1/2 matcha packets to bowl and beat on medium-low speed to combine.
steps.title: Prepare the Frosting

steps.text: Using a spatula or a piping bag, frost cooled cupcakes. Then using a sieve or fine-mesh strainer, lightly sprinkle remaining ½ packet of matcha powder over the frosted cupcakes.
steps.title: Frost Cupcakes

matcha-matcha-cupcakes.title: Matcha Matcha Cupcakes

mediterranean-lamb-cheesesteak.description: Inspired by the components of a traditional cheesesteak, this Mediterranean version is decidedly elevated, swapping thin beef in favor of Trader Joe’s Shaved Lamb Shoulder. It has an ideal fat-to-lean ratio, a light, mild flavor, and marvelous melt-in-your-mouth texture. Instead of provolone or cheese sauce, TJ’s Crumbled Feta and Tzatziki take its place and are complemented by chopped cucumbers and tomatoes, all stuffed into a TJ’s Sandwich Roll.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon TJ’s Extra Virgin Olive Oil
½ TJ’s Yellow Onion, thinly sliced
¼ cup chopped TJ’s Fresh Parsley

steps.text: In a large sauté pan, heat oil over medium-high heat. Add oil; when it’s hot, add sliced onion. Cook until softened, stirring occasionally, about 5-7 minutes.
Add slices of shaved lamb to the pan. Cook until it no longer pink and is evenly browned throughout. Season with salt and pepper. Add chopped parsley to pan.
Slice each sandwich roll through the slip-top, without cutting all the way through the roll. Gently pry each roll open to make it easier to fill.
Add a spoonful of Tzatziki to each roll, then top with onion and lamb. Top with another spoonful of tzatziki, cucumber, tomatoes, and feta. Serve with a lemon wedge.

mediterranean-lamb-cheesesteak.title: Mediterranean Lamb Cheesesteak

mediterranean-mezze-dip.description: Trader Joe’s Organic Hummus is as classic as they come: thick and creamy, with tangy, nutty notes and just the right amount of savory seasonings, including garlic, cumin, lemon juice, and sea salt. It makes a stellar standalone spread for sandwiches, and a spectacular base for this impressive, mezze-inspired dip.
ingredients: 1/2 cup of your favorite mini TJ’s Tomatoes, sliced into rounds
A drizzle of your favorite TJ’s Extra Virgin Olive Oil
A few cranks of TJ’s Black Peppercorns
TJ’s Pita Chips and TJ’s Pita Bread, for dipping

steps.text: Spread hummus over a serving platter or plate.
In a separate bowl, stir together yogurt and harissa until combined. Spread mixture on top of hummus.
Evenly distribute sliced cucumbers, tomatoes, and olives over the yogurt layer.
Sprinkle with crumbled Feta cheese and chopped parsley.
Drizzle with olive oil and finish with a few cranks of black pepper.
Serve with pita chips and flatbread.

mediterranean-mezze-dip.title: Mediterranean Mezze Dip

mezcal-limeade.description: The ideal warm-weather cocktail contains a simple list of ingredients and is quick to assemble—shakers need not apply. Case in point: this lounge chair-ready recipe for Mezcal Limeade. Trader Joe’s Espada Pequeña Mezcal brings some smokey notes, TJ’s Chile Lime Seasoning Blend adds a touch heat, and TJ’s Limeade makes it pleasantly sweet. Did we mention you can easily double this recipe? ¡Salud!
ingredients: 1 tablespoon TJ’s Chile Lime Seasoning Blend
1 ½ ounce TJ’s Espada Pequeña Mezcal

steps.text: Prepare the Glass: Place the chile lime seasoning in a shallow dish. Rub a slice of lime around the rim of each glass. Turn glasses over and place directly in the pile seasoning; twist and turn it so the rim gets coated with seasoning.
Fill glass with ice, add mezcal and limeade, and stir to combine.
Serve with a wedge of lime.

mezcal-limeade.title: Mezcal Limeade

mezza-luna-lasagna.description: Half-moon shaped slices of butternut squash lend this lasagna a decidedly fall feeling.
ingredients: 1 large TJ's Butternut Squash (seasonally available), peeled, sliced lengthwise and cleaned of seeds and string
2 cups TJ's Chopped Frozen Spinach, defrosted and squeezed of some water
12 sheets TJ's No Boil Lasagna Noodles
1/2 cup TJ's Grated Parmigiano Reggiano Cheese

steps.text: Preheat oven to 375°F. Slice squash halves into 1/2"half-moon-shaped pieces. Spray a large baking sheet with a light dusting of oil and sprinkle with a little sea salt and pepper. Place the slices on the sheet in a single layer. Lightly spray the tops and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Bake until the slices are tender, about 35 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool; lower oven temperature to 350°F.
Empty Alfredo sauce into a sauce pan; warm over very low heat, just enough to liquefy, and remove from heat. Place ricotta, spinach, nutmeg and a pinch of salt into a bowl and combine. Set aside.

Assemble lasagna: Coat the bottom of a 9"x 13"baking dish with a light layer of Alfredo sauce. Place four sheets of noodles side by side and top them with more Alfredo sauce. Next, add squash in a single layer. Top squash with more Alfredo sauce and another layer of noodles. Top noodles with all of the ricotta-spinach mixture and smooth out. Top with another layer of noodles, then Alfredo sauce and the last of the squash. Pour over the remainder of Alfredo sauce and top with Mozzarella & Parmesan cheeses.
Cover lasagna with foil and bake for 40 minutes. Remove foil and bake another 5-10 minutes or until cheese is golden and bubbly. Remove from oven and rest 15 minutes before slicing.

mezza-luna-lasagna.title: Mezza Luna Lasagna

michelada.description: The greatest thing about a Michelada? It's a bracing, refreshing beverage on a sizzling summer day. The second greatest thing? The recipe can be molded to fit your mood (less tomato juice, more hot sauce, extra lime juice)...whatever your preference, make sure you have enough supplies on hand for seconds.
ingredients: 1 ice-cold can TJ's Simpler Times Lager (or your favorite lager)

steps.text: Pour a tablespoon of chili lime seasoning into a shallow rimmed plate. Slice a lime in half and rub it around the edge of a pint glass. Dip the edge of the glass in chili lime seasoning to coat.
Fill the glass 2/3 full with ice. Add bloody mary mixer and a little hot sauce to taste—it's spicy, so start small!
Squeeze the juice of 1 lime into glass. Top up with beer, garnish with a fresh lime slice and enjoy.

michelada.title: Michelada

millers-irish-soda-bread.description: This staple St. Patrick's Day recipe comes to us from a Crew Member's home kitchen and begins with a bag of Trader Joe's Organic Unbleached All-Purpose Flour. It pairs best with a swipe of good quality butter and a piping hot mug of TJ's Original Irish Breakfast Black Tea.
ingredients: 3 cups TJ's Organic Unbleached All-Purpose Flour, sifted
2 tablespoons TJ's Unsalted Butter, softened, plus more for serving

steps.text: Preheat oven to 375°F (350°F if using a glass pan). Grease an 8-inch square baking pan, set aside.

Mix (by hand) all dry ingredients together in one bowl, egg and milk in another bowl. Mix wet and dry together, then add butter. Pour into prepared baking pan and sprinkle a bit of sugar on top of dough.
Bake on center rack of oven for 45-60 minutes. Let cool... if you can. Enjoy!

millers-irish-soda-bread.title: Miller's Irish Soda Bread

mini-caprese.description: This salad-on-a-stick makes an awesome afternoon snack or party platter addition.
ingredients: 1 package TJ's Mini Pearl Grape Tomatoes
1 package TJ's Organic Basil, cut into strips
1/4 teaspoon TJ's Sea Salt, or to taste
1/4 teaspoon TJ's ground Black Pepper, or to taste

steps.text: Rinse Tomatoes and Basil.
Layer Tomato, Basil and Mozzarella on a toothpick.
Season with Salt & Pepper.
Serve with Balsamic Vinaigrette for dipping.

mini-caprese.title: Mini Caprese

mini-chicken-wonton-stir-fry.description: Our Chicken Cilantro Mini Wontons are delicious enough on their own as an appetizer or snack, but when placed as the centerpiece of a sweet and spicy stir fry, they truly shine—especially when they’re allowed to brown on the bottom prior to steaming. Combine that with the crunchy, satisfying texture of our Organic Broccoli Slaw and Baby Bok Choy, and you’ve got an easy, satisfying entrée that’ll keep your guests coming back for seconds.
ingredients: 1 bag TJ’s Chicken Cilantro Mini Wontons
1 bag TJ’s Baby Bok Choy, chopped into quarters
1/4 cup TJ’s General Tsao Stir Fry Sauce

steps.text: Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in skillet. Once warm, add frozen wontons to skillet, allow to cook for 5 minutes or until golden brown. Add 2 tablespoons water, cover, and steam for 2 minutes, then remove from skillet.
Add 1 tablespoon olive oil back to skillet. Add chopped bok choy and allow to cook until just brown. Add in broccoli slaw, a cup or so at a time, until just tender. Add wontons back to skillet.
Add ¼ cup General Tsao sauce to skillet, stir-fry to combine, then serve over rice.

mini-chicken-wonton-stir-fry.title: Mini Chicken Wonton Stir Fry

mini-sweet-potato-biscuits.description: These sweet potato-infused biscuits will be the talk of your Thanksgiving table.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 450°F. Mix honey and butter together and set aside. Place sweet potatoes in a large bowl and mix with nutmeg, brown sugar, cinnamon, and vanilla; taste and adjust seasoning. Add the bacon and baking mix and blend well. Add butter and milk to the mixture, stirring until soft dough forms. If dough is too sticky add more baking mix a little at a time until dough is soft, but no longer sticky.

Flour a work surface and place the dough onto the surface. Dust the top of the dough and your hands with flour, and press the dough into a 3/4-inch-thick rectangle. Sprinkle a small amount of additional flour on the top of the dough. Fold the dough over onto itself as if folding a napkin (also called a tri-fold). If necessary use a metal spatula to lift the dough off the counter and dust under it with flour, turn the dough 1/2 turn, dust the top with flour and roll the dough into a 3/4-inch-thick rectangle and repeat the tri-fold. Repeat this procedure one more time (three times in all). After the third turn and tri-fold, dust under and on top of the dough, if needed, and roll the dough into a 1/2-inch-thick rectangle.

Dip a 1.5 inch round cookie cutter in flour and cut out the biscuits; dip the cutter in flour between each biscuit. Press straight down to cut and lift straight up to remove; transfer the biscuits to a baking sheet; place biscuits about 1/2 inch apart.

Gently gather the scraps of dough left after cutting, pat and roll out once more; cut as many biscuits from the remaining dough as possible, then hand shape any remaining dough. Bake on center rack of oven for 10-12 minutes or until golden brown. Let stand 3 minutes. Serve warm with honey butter.
Biscuits are bite-sized, 1 serving is 3 biscuits. Makes 3 to 4 dozen.

mini-sweet-potato-biscuits.title: Mini Sweet Potato Biscuits

minted-peas--goat-cheese.description: This bright, fresh side dish is a perfect partner to our Spatchcocked Lemon Rosemary Chicken.
ingredients: 2 teaspoons your favorite TJ's Extra Virgin Olive Oil
Dash TJ's Sea Salt, to taste

steps.text: Microwave peas according to package directions. Add peas to a colander and rinse under cold water for 1-2 minutes to stop cooking. Shake colander to remove excess water, and pour peas into a medium-sized bowl. Add olive oil, lemon juice and mint, and gently stir to combine. Add sea salt to taste.
To serve, spoon peas into a bowl or plate, and top with goat cheese crumbles.

minted-peas--goat-cheese.title: Minted Peas & Goat Cheese

miso-congee.description:
Trader Joe’s White Miso Paste is made of fermented rice and soybeans, and like many fantastic, fermented foods, it has a complex flavor—a mix of savory, salty, and umami. Our White Miso Paste is made with a shorter-than-standard fermentation period to yield a delicate umami flavor, making this a very versatile Miso. It plays dual roles in this cozy, highly customizable congee dish—flavoring the rice porridge base and adding oomph to the roasted squash topping.

Customize Your Congee: Walk the aisles of your neighborhood Trader Joe’s and you will find an array of crunchy, spicy, herby, and umami-packed products that make superb congee toppings and will enhance your congee-eating experience. Choose what you like, skip what you don't! If you need some suggestions, we recommend a sprinkle of Roasted & Salted Pumpkin Seeds, a generous drizzle of Crunchy Sesame Sunflower Pepita Salsa Macha, a touch of fresh Green Onions, and a handful of Fried Shallots, to name a few. But as we said, you do you!
ingredients: 1 carton (4 cups) TJ's Organic Low-Sodium Chicken Broth
3 cups TJ's Peeled & Cut Butternut Squash
1 tablespoons TJ's Organic Toasted Sesame Oil
1/3 cup of your favorite TJ's Honey
4 tablespoons plus 1/4 cup TJ's White Miso Paste, divided
Garnishes of choice (e.g. Roasted & Salted Pumpkin Seeds, Crunchy Sesame Sunflower Pepita Salsa Macha, sliced Green Onions, Fried Shallots…)

steps.text:
In a large saucepan, heat canola oil over over medium heat. Add ginger and garlic, and sauté until aromatic, about 2 minutes. Add chicken stock and water; bring to a boil. 

Add rice, and once bubbling, reduce heat to a gentle simmer. Cook, stirring occassionally, until the rice breaks down into a porridge-like consistency, about 30-40 minutes.
steps.title: Make the Congee

steps.text:
While the congee simmers, prepare the squash. Preheat oven to 400°F. In a large bowl, combine diced squash, sesame oil, honey, and 4 tablespoons white miso paste. Toss to completely coat the squash. 

Place in baking dish, and roast in oven, tossing occassionally, until squash is soft and caramelized, about 20 minutes. Set aside until ready to serve congee.
steps.title: Roast the Honey-Miso Squash

steps.text: Fill a medium-sized saucepan 3/4 full with water and bring to a boil over medium heat. Once boiling, gently lower eggs into water, and cook for 7 minutes. Transfer to an ice bath until ready to serve with congee. When ready to serve, de-shell the eggs and slice each in half.
steps.title: Don't Forget the Jammy Eggs

steps.text: Stir in 1/4 cup miso paste into the congee, then remove from heat. Divide hot congee among bowls. Add squash and a sliced jammy egg. Customize your bowl with whichever toppings you like!
steps.title: Finish & Customize Your Congee

miso-congee.title: Miso Congee with Honey-Miso Squash

mojoe-toast.description: A simple, TJ's version of the popular avocado toast sensation in restaurants and cafés everywhere. We've added the kick of Sardines in Harissa for extra protein boost and flavor.
ingredients: 2 small (1 oz) slices TJ's Multigrain Bread, toasted

steps.text: Mash 1/4 of an avocado with a fork on one slice of toasted bread.
Lay half (2oz) of the tin of sardines over the avocado, then drizzle a bit of the extra oil on top.
Garnish with microgreens, cilantro or arugula if desired.
Repeat on other slice of toast.
Enjoy!

mojoe-toast.title: MoJoe Toast

morning-muffin-in-a-mug.description: Swap your morning bowl of oatmeal for a morning muffin in a mug using Trader Joe’s Gluten Free Organic Rolled Oats with Ancient Grains & Seeds. By using a microwave, this filling muffin cooks up in minutes for a speedy, satisfying start to your day. Note: the muffin will rise as it cooks, so be sure to use a 16 oz. (or larger) mug.
ingredients: ½ cup TJ’s Gluten Free Organic Rolled Oats with Ancient Grains & Seeds

steps.text: Mix all ingredients in a coffee mug. Stir well until thoroughly combined.
In a microwave oven, heat on high for 4 minutes*, or until mixture is no longer wet on the surface. The muffin will expand as it cooks and may partially rise out of the mug.

Carefully remove the mug from the microwave, as it will be very hot, and let cool for about 5 minutes. Top with some fresh berries (optional), drizzle with more honey if desired, and serve.

*Microwave heat times may vary depending on oven wattage.

morning-muffin-in-a-mug.title: Morning Muffin In a Mug

mozzarella-roasted-corn-egg-bake.description: This savory egg dish works equally well with fruit for breakfast or lightly dressed greens for lunch.
ingredients: 4 cups shredded TJ's Zucchini (4-5 medium zucchinis)
1 medium TJ's Yellow Onion, sliced thinly
1/4 cup TJ's Balsamic Vinegar of Modena
2 cups frozen TJ's Roasted Corn, defrosted
2 Tablespoons chopped TJ's Cilantro, plus more for garnish

steps.text: To extract the moisture from the zucchini, spread the zucchini out on a tray and sprinkle with 1 teaspoon salt. Set aside.

While the zucchini sits, prepare the balsamic caramelized onions: In a medium skillet over medium heat, melt 1 tablespoon of butter. Add onion slices and stir to coat with butter. Sprinkle the onions with reserved 1/2 teaspoon salt. Stir until onions cook down and begin to turn golden, about 5 minutes. Add 2 teaspoons sugar and continue to stir until onions darken to a medium golden color and turn translucent, about 5 more minutes. Add 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar, scrape up the bits from the bottom of the pan and turn heat to low. Heat, stirring occasionally, until most of the liquid absorbs, about 5-7 more minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.

Preheat oven to 375°F. In small batches, place the zucchini shreds in a clean cloth and squeeze the water out. Repeat as needed. In a large skillet over medium heat, melt reserved 2 tablespoons of butter. Add zucchini shreds and cook until slightly golden. Add corn and stir until heated through. Transfer zucchini and corn to a large bowl and let cool completely (if the mixture is too hot for these next steps, the ingredients clump together and will result in uneven cooking!).

Add caramelized onions, mozzarella, 2 tablespoons cilantro and 6 eggs to zucchini. Gently stir until uniform. Transfer mixture to a greased 9.5 inch glass pie dish. Cover loosely with greased foil, grease side down. Place on center rack of oven and bake 25-30 minutes, until there is no liquid when a knife is inserted into the center of the egg bake. Remove foil and broil until the cheese on top is brown and bubbly, about 3-5 minutes. Remove from oven and cool. Garnish with cilantro just before serving.
Serve warm with fruit for breakfast, or with a side salad for lunch or dinner.

mozzarella-roasted-corn-egg-bake.title: Mozzarella & Roasted Corn Egg Bake

mushroom-miso-soup.description: If you’ve gone overboard with cheesy casseroles or creamy pastas in search of cold weather comfort food, let this reset recipe guide you back to balanced shores. Sautéed onion, crimini mushrooms, and tender bok choy are bathed in Trader Joe’s Miso Broth, which boasts a triple-flavor-threat of miso, mushroom and ginger, and adds incredible depth and lip-smacking savory-ness to anything in its presence. The addition of Organic Sprouted Tofu in the last few minutes of cooking makes this soup ideal for a light lunch on its own (although you could always serve it in smaller portions as a first course!).
ingredients: 1 package TJ's Baby Bok Choy, rinsed and trimmed
1 package (16 oz.) TJ's Organic Extra Firm Sprouted Tofu, cut into bite-size pieces
TJ's Sesame Oil & Soy Sauce, for garnish

steps.text: Heat a large pot over medium heat, add 2 tablespoons olive oil. When oil is hot, add onion and a pinch of salt. Sauté onions for 3 minutes. Add mushrooms and stir. Saute 10-15 minutes, until mushrooms are browned and most of the water from the mushrooms has evaporated.

Add broth to pot and bring to a boil. Add bok choy and reduce heat to a simmer. Cook for 5 minutes. Add tofu and cook another 2-3 minutes, just until heated through. Remove from heat and season to taste with salt. Ladle soup into large bowls, garnish with a splash of sesame oil and soy sauce, and enjoy!

mushroom-miso-soup.title: Mushroom Miso Soup

not-cio-e-pepe-pasta.description:
Delightfully delicate and mild-flavored, Trader Joe’s Organic Silken Tofu is oh-so soft and can act as everything from a cream or egg substitute, to a hearty inclusion in spicy soups, or even a creamy dessert component. Or, in conjunction with TJ’s Nutritional Yeast and TJ’s White Miso Paste, it makes a solid swap for a silky cheese sauce in this dairy-free take on the cheese and pepper pasta sauce, cacio e pepe.   

Pro-tip: Toast your TJ’s Black Peppercorns! To really add a peppery oomph to this dish, remove a teaspoon of peppercorns from the jar and toast them in a hot pan until they become fragrant. After they’ve cooled, grind them into the dish as instructed below.
ingredients: 1 block TJ’s Organic Silken Tofu, drained
1/3 cup TJ’s Nutritional Yeast, plus more for sprinkling
¼ cup juice from fresh TJ’s Lemons
A few heavy cranks of TJ’s Black Peppercorns, plus more for serving

steps.text: Fill a large pot with water and bring to a boil over high heat. Cook to al dente, according to the package instructions. Reserve 1 cup pasta water before draining.
While the pasta cooks, in a blender, combine tofu, nutritional yeast, miso paste, and lemon juice. Blend on medium until thoroughly combined.

Add ground pepper to a large sauté pan and heat over medium. Add tofu mixture and stir to combine. Immediately add the cooked pasta and toss to coat. Add pasta water a quarter of a cup at a time until the sauce clings to the pasta and becomes glossy.
Serve with a sprinkle of nutritional yeast and a crank of black pepper.

not-cio-e-pepe-pasta.title: Not-cio e Pepe Pasta

nutty-monkey-banana-bites.description: What's better than a frosty handful of Trader Joe's Gone Bananas? How about Gone Bananas dipped in creamy, salted peanut butter and topped with flaked coconut?

steps.text: Remove Gone Bananas from package and arrange on a serving platter.
Use a spoon to dollop peanut butter on each piece.
Sprinkle a pinch of coconut on the peanut butter.
Enjoy promptly!

nutty-monkey-banana-bites.title: Nutty Monkey Banana Bites

oat-beverage-matcha-latte.description: A creamy, non-dairy matcha latte is easy to enjoy anytime and won't cost you more than 5 minutes of your time - enter Trader Joe's Matcha Green Tea Single-Serve Packets and Trader Joe's Non-Dairy Oat Beverage.  Just a few steps below yields a rich, smooth, slightly earthy & sweet cup. Enjoy hot or cold!
ingredients: 1 package TJ's Matcha Green Tea Single-Serve Packages

steps.text: Empty matcha powder package in hot water and whisk until dissolved.
Add oat beverage and whisk until combined. Serve and enjoy immediately.

oat-beverage-matcha-latte.title: Oat Beverage Matcha Latte

olive-bar-dip.description: Bring Trader Joe’s Jumbo Pitted Kalamata Olives and Spanish Manzanilla Olives with Pimentos to the party with this sharable, baked dip. Taste the flavors of an entire olive bar in every satisfyingly savory bite.
ingredients: Pinch TJ’s Organic Crushed Red Pepper
1 cup TJ’s Jumbo Pitted Greek Kalamata Olives, drained and halved lengthwise
1 cup Spanish Manzanilla with Pimento Paste, drained and halved crosswise
½  cup TJ’s Crumbled Feta Cheese
1 TJ’s Organic French Baguette, sliced and toasted for dipping

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.

Drain oil from marinated artichokes into a saucepan, and set artichoke hearts aside. Add peeled garlic cloves and crushed red pepper to saucepan. Cook over low heat for 10 minutes. Strain garlic from the oil, placing into a medium sized bowl and reserve oil for drizzling.
Quarter the artichokes and place in bowl with garlic. Add chopped olives, capers, and parsley to the bowl and gently stir to combine.

Spread marinara in the bottom of a 10-inch oven-safe skillet or baking dish. Spread olive mixture on top and sprinkle with feta cheese. Bake on center rack of oven for 10 to 15 minutes, until heated through.
Remove skillet from oven and top with lemon zest. Drizzle with a bit of reserved garlic oil and let sit 5 minutes before digging in with toasted baguette slices.

olive-bar-dip.title: Olive Bar Dip

olive-herb-cream-cheese-dip.description: Made with organic, pasteurized milk and cream, Trader Joe’s Organic Plain Cream Cheese Spread is soft, spreadable, and highly versatile, with a remarkable range of uses, from the extravagant to the everyday. Spread it on your morning bagel, use it in cheesecake recipes, or make this sensationally simple, savory dip that’s equally excellent for snacking on the couch as it is served as an appetizer at shindigs and soirées.
ingredients: 1 container TJ’s Organic Plain Cream Cheese Spread
½ cup TJ’s Olive and Herbs Mixed Nuts, finely chopped
TJ’s Celery, chopped into 3-inch pieces for dipping
TJ’s Fig & Olive Crisps, for dipping

steps.text: In a medium-sized bowl, combine organic cream cheese and chopped nuts mix. Use a flexible spatula to thoroughly mix. Serve in a smaller bowl with celery and Fig & Olive Crisps for dipping.

olive-herb-cream-cheese-dip.title: Olive & Herb Cream Cheese Dip

olive-oil-cake.description: Slice into the dark golden crust of this olive oil cake and you'll reveal a tender, sunshine-yellow inner crumb, made impossibly moist thanks to the addition of Trader Joe's Organic Spanish Extra Virgin Olive Oil. Enjoy it with a generous swoosh of vanilla buttercream frosting, or go the simple route and serve slices with freshly whipped cream and a handful of fresh berries.
ingredients: 1 stick (1/2 cup) TJ's Unsalted Butter, softened

steps.text:
Preheat oven to 375°F. Line a 9-inch cake pan with a circle of parchment paper and grease with canola oil spray, set aside.

In a medium bowl, sift together flour, sugar, salt, baking powder, and baking soda. Set aside.

In the bowl of a stand mixer or in a large bowl with a hand mixer, beat eggs at medium speed. Continue mixing while slowly adding olive oil for 2-3 minutes, until mixture thickens. Add milk, clementine juice, and 1 tablespoon clementine zest and mix just until combined.

Add dry ingredients to egg mixture and beat on low speed just until combined (batter will be thin). Pour batter into greased pan.

Bake on center rack of oven for 45-50 minutes, rotating halfway through, until cake is a dark golden brown and a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Let cake cool 2 hours before removing from pan and frosting.

In the bowl of a stand mixer or in a large bowl with a hand mixer, add butter, powdered sugar, vanilla paste, milk, and salt.

Beat on low speed until powdered sugar is incorporated, then increase speed to medium for 2 minutes. Add more milk if necessary, to reach a spreadable consistency.

Unmold cake and remove parchment from bottom. Place cake on a serving platter or cake stand. Frost cake, garnish with remaining zest, and serve. Cake can be covered and stored on the counter for up to three days (if it lasts that long!)

olive-oil-cake.title: Olive Oil Cake

olive-oil-citrus-upside-down-cake.description:
Pick up a bottle of Trader Joe’s Organic Spanish Extra Virgin Olive Oil, and you’ll be on your way to imbuing all kinds of dishes with its fruity, verdant flavor—from dressings and marinades, to dipping your favorite crustybread, and of course, cake! The addition of Olive Oil in this cake batter delivers a moist, tender crumb, while its tasting notes pair exceptionally well with the citrus in and on top of the cake. 

How to assemble that beautiful citrus topping with ease, you ask? Check out the recipe video! Then head to the produce section of your neighborhood Trader Joe’s and pick up a handful of Navel Oranges or a variety in-season citrus. Let’s bake! 

Pro-tip: To ensure a foolproof flip, employ both parchment paper (line the pan with a long strip so it extends an inch beyond the top of the pan, plus a round that covers the bottom) and a couple tablespoons of Butter to grease your cake pan.
ingredients: ¼ cup TJ’s Salted Butter, plus 2 tablespoons for greasing the pan
7 TJ’s Oranges (Navel, Cara Cara, Blood Oranges, or a mix)
¾ cup TJ’s Organic Brown Sugar
1 cup TJ’s Organic Spanish Extra Virgin Olive Oil
¾ cup TJ’s European Style Organic Plain Whole Milk Yogurt
1 ½ cups TJ’s Organic Cane Sugar
2 teaspoons TJ’s Organic Pure Bourbon Vanilla Extract

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Grease cake pan with 2 tablespoons butter, then line with a long strip and round of parchment paper.
Zest and juice one orange for the cake batter. Set aside.

Cut the ends off each remaining orange, then place orange on the flat end while you carefully remove the peel and pith with a knife.

Slice peeled oranges into thin slices and remove any seeds. Blot with towel or paper towel to remove excess juice.
steps.title: Prepare the Oranges

steps.text:
In a small saucepan over medium heat, melt remaining butter with brown sugar. Stir with a spatula to help dissolve the sugar. Once it comes to a boil, immediately pour into cake pan. Allow to cool for a few minutes.

Arrange orange slices over caramel, overlapping slightly, so there aren’t any gaps.
steps.title: Prepare the Caramel

steps.text:
In a large bowl, whisk eggs and olive oil until combined, then whisk in yogurt, sugar, vanilla, and reserved orange zest and juice.

In a medium-sized bowl, whisk flour, salt, and baking powder to combine.

Gently whisk flour mixture into olive oil mixture.
steps.title: Make the Cake Batter

steps.text: Pour batter over orange slices. Bake for 60-70 minutes, until the cake is golden in color and a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Remove from oven and let rest 5 minutes.

Place a large plate over the top of the cake pan. Holding both pan and plate, carefully flip. Tap the bottom of the cake pan with a spoon to help loosen the cake from the pan. Carefully remove cake pan.

Note: If any orange slices stick to the pan, don’t worry! Usa a spatula to carefully remove slices from the pan and place atop the cake.

olive-oil-citrus-upside-down-cake.title: Olive Oil & Citrus Upside-Down Cake

steps.text: Slice bagel in half and toast.
Spread a tablespoon of cream cheese on each side, then layer half the remaining ingredients on each side making two sandwiches.
Serve immediately, and make sure to follow up with a mint (you’ll need it).

ooey-gooey-mac-and-cheese.description: Trader Joe’s Ooey Gooey Cheese Blend is thoughtfully comprised of nutty Gruyere, mild yellow Cheddar, sharp white Cheddar, and buttery Havarti. This creamy, dreamy combo is the Ooiest and Gooiest we could find, based on our research, making it an ideal choice for a grilled cheese sandwich, French onion soup, and of course, this cozy, comforting mac and cheese.
ingredients: 1 bag TJ’s Ooey Gooey Cheese Blend
12 ounces TJ's Organic Cavatappi Pasta, cooked for two minutes less than package instructions, reserve 1 cup pasta water, then drain

steps.text: In a large pot or Dutch oven, melt butter over medium heat. Add flour and whisk vigorously until it thickens and becomes golden in color, about 3-5 minutes.
Add milk, a half cup at a time, whisking after each addition until fully incorporated. Once all the milk has been added, bring to a simmer, whisking occasionally until thickened, about five minutes.

Lower heat and add cheese, whisking until a smooth sauce forms. Add cooked pasta and stir with a wooden spoon until evenly coated. Add pasta water, a splash at a time until sauce is glossy and ooey gooey. Season with salt and a dash of your favorite TJ’s hot sauce to serve.

ooey-gooey-mac-and-cheese.title: Ooey Gooey Mac & Cheese

orange-banana-sorbet.description:
There is no value quite like the Trader Joe's Banana. It's a value so exciting that sometimes, you might find yourself buying more bananas than you could possibly eat before they begin to brown...but when it's too hot to bake banana bread, what do you do?

You're in luck-super-ripe bananas are exactly what this easy, three-ingredient recipe requires. Since it doesn't call for any added sugars or sweeteners, the bananas have a big job to do... ripe (and therefore naturally sweeter) bananas are key.
ingredients: 2 teaspoon TJ's Organic Pure Bourbon Vanilla Flavor (for best results, do not substitute vanilla extract)

steps.text: Slice three bananas and arrange on a sheet pan lined with parchment paper. Freeze 8 hours.
Pour two cups of orange juice into ice cube trays, freeze 8 hours or until solid.

In a food processor, pulse half the frozen orange juice cubes and half the frozen banana slices, until the mixture appears almost crumbly. Add the remaining frozen orange juice cubes, frozen banana slices, and vanilla. Continue to pulse until the mixture reaches a creamy consistency, stopping to scrape down the sides of the bowl as needed (this will take several minutes).
For a soft serve-like texture, remove from food processor and serve immediately. For a harder, ice cream-like texture, freeze overnight.

orange-banana-sorbet.title: Orange & Banana Sorbet

orange-chicken-pizza.description:
TJ’s Mandarin Orange Chicken on a pizza? Of course! And using Trader Joe’s Pizza Crust from our bakery section as the base means you’ll be ready to pizza party within 30 minutes!

This recipe was a runner-up in the 2026 Store Recipe Contest and was created by the Crew at Store #20 in La Jolla, CA! Way to go!
ingredients: 1 bag TJ’s Pizza Seasoned Toscano Cheese

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F. Let sauce packets thaw on counter. Place chicken on a baking sheet and bake for 15 minutes. Remove from oven then carefully dice into small, bite-sized pieces.
To assemble the pizzas, drizzle one sauce packet over each crust, then top with diced chicken. Sprinkle with cheese.
Bake both pizzas for about 5 minutes, or until the cheese has melted and the crust has browned.
Top with green onions and a hefty drizzle of Crunchy Chili Onion to serve.

orange-chicken-pizza.title: Orange Chicken Pizza

organic-coconut-raspberry-chia-pudding.description:
Whether you’re looking to prep a nutrient-dense breakfast, snack, or after-dinner treat, chia seed pudding fits the bill! When exposed to liquid, chia seeds absorb it rapidly, developing a pleasantly thick, pudding-esque texture. And by combining TJ’s Organic Chia Seeds with Trader Joe’s Organic Non-Dairy Unsweetened Coconut Beverage, the result is a delightful, dairy-free treat that requires only five minutes of hands-on prep!

Pro-tip: Any berry will work in this recipe. Try swapping in your favorite TJ's berries, or combining them, to add variety to your meal-prep routine.
ingredients: 1 cup TJ’s Organic Non-Dairy Unsweetened Coconut Beverage
¼ cup TJ’s Organic Chia Seeds
2-4 tablespoons TJ’s Organic Blue Agave Syrup

steps.text: In a small bowl, add coconut beverage, chia seeds, and agave. Stir to combine.
In the serving bowl, jar, or cup of your choice, add raspberries and macerate then with the back of a wooden spoon.

Top raspberries with chia pudding and refrigerate for 1 hour. Remove from the refrigerator and stir the chia pudding to break up any clumps (this will help ensure a smooth consistency.) Return to the refrigerator and chill for two more hours or overnight prior to serving.

organic-coconut-raspberry-chia-pudding.title: Organic Coconut Raspberry Chia Pudding

overnight-yoats.description:
The thorough straining of the liquid whey during production is what gives Trader Joe’s Plain Greek Nonfat Yogurt a concentrated, powerful flavor and dense, velvety texture. Its delightfully creamy, thick consistency makes it ideal for dips, sauces, marinades, smoothies, and beyond. And because it comes in a hefty 32-ounce tub, there’s enough for meal prep for the week! Add it to overnight oats for ultra-creamy texture, plus a protein boost.

Pro-tip: Multiply this recipe to make as many portions as you need for the week.
ingredients: ¼ cup TJ’s Greek Nonfat Plain Yogurt
½ cup of your favorite TJ’s dairy or non-dairy beverage

steps.text: In a resealable container or jar, combine all ingredients and stir until combined. Cover and refrigerate 6 hours or overnight.
In the morning, add toppings, if desired, and serve cold.

Fresh Banana + TJ’s Creamy Salted Peanut Butter

Your favorite TJ's Berries + TJ's Multifloral & Clover Honey

Walnuts + TJ's Organic Vermont Maple Syrup

TJ’s Organic Guava Fruit Spread + TJ’s Organic Unsweetened Flake Coconut + Fresh Mango
steps.title: Toppings Inspiration

overnight-yoats.title: Overnight Y'oats

palak-paneer-pasties.description: This take on the pasty (PASS-tee)-a hand-held, sturdy pastry crust wrapped around a hearty filling-eschews the traditional beef, onion & potato, in favor of a vegetarian Palak Paneer.
ingredients: 1 package TJ's Pie Crusts, thawed according to package directions
2 trays TJ's Palak Paneer, microwaved according to package directions

steps.text: Preheat oven to 375°F. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper; set aside.

Working in two batches, unroll softened dough and smooth together any cracks with your hands. Remove top layer of plastic film and cut dough into quarters. Place a piece of dough on lined baking sheet and top with 1/4 cup palak paneer. Starting at one corner and working around the edge of the dough, gently pull dough up toward center, pinching and folding edges to create a dumpling. Repeat with remaining dough and filling (you'll end up with 8 pasties).

In a small bowl, thoroughly whisk the egg. Using a pastry brush, evenly brush the tops of the pasties with whisked egg. Place baking sheet on center rack of oven and bake for 30 minutes, until crust is golden. Allow to cool 5 minutes. Enjoy on the go, or at the table with mixed greens and Cumin-y Riced Cauliflower on the side.

Wrap leftover pasties in cling wrap and toss in the freezer. To reheat, remove cling wrap and place pasty on a microwave safe dish. Heat at 50% power for 1 minute, then at full power for 1 minute. Allow to cool slightly before serving.
steps.title: Freezing/Reheating Instructions:

palak-paneer-pasties.title: Palak Paneer Pasties

paloma-picante.description: Lazy, late summer afternoons call for relaxing with a refreshing drink in hand, and it’s hard to come by a drink more refreshing than a paloma. Made with Trader Joe’s Tequila Blanco (a 100% blue agave tequila from a family-owned distillery in Jalisco, Mexico), our paloma recipe gets a peppery kick courtesy of Trader Joe's Spicy Honey Sauce and a rim of tangy Chile Lime Seasoning. (Pro-tip: add the honey to the grapefruit juice and shake well before adding ice to ensure the honey fully dissolves.)
ingredients: ¾ to 1 cup TJ’s Ruby Red Grapefruit Juice
4 tablespoons freshly squeezed juice from TJ’s Fresh Limes (reserve 2 wedges for garnish)

steps.text: Pour a small amount of Chile Lime Seasoning onto a shallow plate. Rub a lime wedge around the top of each serving glass and dip rim into Chili Lime Seasoning to coat. Set aside.
In the jar of a cocktail shaker, add the grapefruit juice, lime juice, and Spicy Honey Sauce. Shake well to dissolve honey. Taste and adjust heat level with more honey if desired.
Add tequila and some ice cubes to cocktail shaker and shake to mix.
Fill prepared glasses with crushed ice. Strain the cold cocktail into glasses and garnish each with a lime wedge. Cheers!

paloma-picante.title: Paloma Picanté

panettone-egg-nog-bread-pudding.description: Could you even imagine the holidays at Trader Joe's without pyramids of Panettone in our stores? We certainly can't. This light, moist, & elegantly sweet fruitcake-in-a-big-red-box has been calling Trader Joe's its home for the holidays for 20 years and counting. Here, we've combined it with our Egg Nog—another holiday classic—for a two-ingredient bread pudding base to beat the band...
ingredients: TJ's Unsalted Butter, for greasing pan
TJ's Organic Powdered Cane Sugar, for dusting

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease an 9 x 13 baking pan, casserole dish, or shallow Dutch oven with butter; set aside.
Remove panettone from packaging and chop into approx. 1-inch cubes.
Place cut panettone in a large bowl and pour egg nog over the bread. Toss together until egg nog is mostly absorbed.
Pour mixture into the greased pan and bake for about 40 minutes, or until liquid thickens and center is set.

Remove from oven and let cool slightly. Serve warm and enjoy!

Recipe Credit: Our excellent Crew Member Mandi at store #136 in Vancouver, WA!

panettone-egg-nog-bread-pudding.title: Panettone & Egg Nog Bread Pudding

pantry-pasta.description: Think you don't have enough ingredients on-hand for a delicious, make-it-in-minutes meal? Think again. If you've got pasta, a can of fish, garlic, olive oil, & some spices, then you’ve got pantry pasta! This variation calls for Trader Joe’s Pappardelle Pasta & TJ’s Solid White Albacore Tuna in Olive Oil, but virtually any version of each ingredient will do. Use this recipe as a guide to help you improvise with whatever ingredients you have on hand!
ingredients: 1 package (or 8 ounces) TJ’s Pappardelle Pasta, cooked according to package directions then drained
3 tablespoons of your favorite TJ’s Olive Oil
1 can TJ’s Solid White Albacore Tuna in Olive Oil
½ cup TJ’s Grated Parmesan Cheese

steps.text: Heat olive oil in large sauté pan over medium heat. Add garlic, tuna, and red pepper flakes and sauté for a few minutes, until garlic is aromatic, and fish is heated through.
Add cooked pasta, chopped dill, and lemon juice, then toss to combine. Remove from heat.
Season pasta with salt then transfer to serving bowls. Garnish with lemon zest and grated cheese to serve.

pantry-pasta.title: Pantry Pasta

parmesan-tapenade-arancini.description:
These Arancini are impressively easy to assemble, thanks to the clever use of Trader Joe's Frozen Brown Rice and TJ’s Parmesan Tapenade (plus an egg) to make the flavorful filling. Consider this air-fried appetizer for your next game night, cocktail party, or whenever you’re in need of a fun, midday snack!   

This recipe was a runner-up in the 2026 Store Recipe Contest and was created by the Crew at Store #132 in Kirkland, WA!
ingredients: 1 bag TJ’s Frozen Brown Rice, cooked according to your preferred package instructions
½ cup TJ’s Japanese Style Panko Breadcrumbs
TJ’s Caro Sugo Italian Tomato Basil Sauce, warmed

steps.text: In a medium-sized bowl, combine rice, Parmesan Tapenade, and egg, and mix to combine.
Form mixture into seven rice balls. Use gloves or wet hands to prevent sticking.
Add panko to a small bowl. Add rice balls one at a time and gently press with panko to coat.
Air fry at 400°F for six minutes, or until golden.
Serve with Caro Sugo and enjoy!

parmesan-tapenade-arancini.title: Parmesan Tapenade Arancini

pb-jar-overnight-oats.description: When there isn’t quite enough Trader Joe’s Organic Creamy Salted Valencia Peanut Butter left to spread on a sandwich, use the rest (and the jar) to make overnight oats! Peanut butter adds savory oomph to the oats and the jar makes a superb serving vessel for on-the-go breakfasting!
ingredients: ½ cup of your favorite dairy or non-dairy TJ’s milk
An almost empty jar of TJ’s Organic Creamy Salted Valencia Peanut Butter
½ cup TJ’s Gluten Free Rolled Oats
¼ cup of your favorite TJ’s berry

steps.text: Add milk to your almost empty jar of peanut butter and shake to loosen the peanut butter.
Add remaining ingredients to jar, seal with lid, and shake to combine.
Refrigerate overnight before serving.

pb-jar-overnight-oats.title: PB-Jar Overnight Oats

pbj-protein-bowl.description: Trader Joe's Peanut Butter with Honey is made with just three ingredients—dry roasted peanuts, honey, and salt. Sea salt amplifies the floral sweetness of the honey, and further highlights the round, roasted flavor of the peanuts. And when experienced with strawberries and your favorite TJ's protein powder, you can get your PB&J fix and protein for breakfast, too!
ingredients: 2 scoops TJ's Organic Hemp Vanilla Protein Powder
1/2 cup TJ's Organic Unsweetened Vanilla Almond Beverage
2 tablespoons TJ's Peanut Butter with Honey, plus more for drizzling
Handful TJ's Peanut Butter Protein Granola
Handful TJ's Fresh Strawberries, hulled & thinly sliced, for garnish (optional)

steps.text: Add frozen strawberries, protein powder, banana, almond beverage, and peanut butter to a blender pitcher. Blend until smooth, adding more almond beverage if needed (mixture should be thick). Scrape mixture into bowls. Top with granola and sliced strawberries, and drizzle with peanut butter. Grab a spoon and dig in.

pbj-protein-bowl.title: PB&J Protein Bowl

pbj-semifreddo.description: Semifreddo (Italian for “half frozen”) is a light, refreshing Italian dessert with a texture that lies somewhere between ice cream and mousse. Our recipe takes a delicious detour from the traditional egg yolk base of the classic—making it a semi-semifreddo, if you will—calling on mascarpone, heavy whipping cream, and smooth peanut butter to create its craveably creamy texture. (With a classic PB&J on our minds, we’ve included Freeze Dried Strawberries and strawberry preserves to add a nostalgic angle to this timely twist on tradition.) Its luscious, velvety mouthfeel and sweetly cooling, make-ahead construction make it an excellent dessert option for warm-weather entertaining. Watch the video to see how it's made.
ingredients: 1 tsp. TJ’s Canola Oil or Sunflower Oil, to grease pan
½ cup TJ’s Organic Cane Sugar, divided
1 tablespoon TJ’s Organic Pure Bourbon Vanilla Extract
1 cup TJ’s Creamy Salted Peanut Butter
¼  cup TJ’s Cage-Free 100% Liquid Egg Whites
¾ cup TJ’s Heavy Whipping Cream
½  cup chopped TJ’s Honey Roasted Peanuts, divided
¾ cup small dice TJ’s Fresh Strawberries

steps.text: Lightly oil a 8 ½ x 4-inch loaf pan. Line with parchment paper, creasing the edges so it sits securely in the pan, and leaving plenty of overhang to cover the top of semifreddo when freezing.
In a large bowl, beat the mascarpone and ¼ cup sugar with a rubber spatula until smooth. Stir in vanilla. Transfer half of the mixture to a separate bowl.
In bowl #1, stir the peanut butter into the mascarpone (the mixture will become quite thick). Thin the mixture with 1-2 tablespoons warm water, stirring vigorously until smooth and creamy. Set aside.
In bowl #2, stir the strawberry preserves into the mascarpone until smooth.

In a stand mixer fitted with the whisk attachment, whip the egg whites with a pinch of salt to form soft peaks. On high speed, slowly “rain” in the remaining ¼ cup sugar until stiff peaks are achieved and you have a glossy meringue (this will take approximately 5 minutes). Divide the meringue between the mascarpone mixtures, and fold in just until no streaks remain.
Add the cream to the stand mixer bowl (no need to wash). Whip to soft peaks.
Divide the whipped cream between the mascarpone mixtures, folding in gently but thoroughly to ensure an even mixture with no visible streaks.
Reserve a few freeze dried strawberry slices for garnish, then crush the remaining strawberries in the bag.
Fold the crushed dried strawberries and fresh strawberries into the strawberry semifreddo mixture.
Fold ¼ cup chopped peanuts into the peanut semifreddo mixture.

Spoon the strawberry mix into the lined loaf pan. Smooth the surface with a knife or back of a spoon. Gently spoon the peanut mixture atop the strawberry layer, smoothing the top. Tap the loaf pan firmly on the counter to remove any air bubbles. Fold the parchment paper over the semifreddo and freeze at least 6 hours to overnight.
To serve, gently unmold the semifreddo onto a serving platter and remove the parchment paper. Garnish with remaining chopped peanuts and dried strawberry slices.
Run the blade of a sharp knife under hot water and slice semifreddo into 6 or 8 thick slices, wiping knife with a towel after each slice. Serve immediately.

pbj-semifreddo.title: PB&J Semifreddo

peach-slab-pie.description:
The dough for our classic Trader Joe's Frozen Pie Crusts is crafted from scratch, with pure butter you can taste. Each one bakes into a wonderfully golden crust that's flaky on the fork and sturdy enough to carry a hearty amount of filling. Plus, these Crusts are extra easy to work with, so you can skip all that pastry chef perspiration! Simply remove one from the box (there are two), let it thaw, unroll it into a pie plate, fill, then bake.   

This functionally flattened pie recipe (featuring the aforementioned flaky Crusts) is perfect for picnics and parties. Feel free to substitute your favorite fruit for the peaches-just be sure to taste and adjust the sugar accordingly prior to baking.
ingredients: 1/2 cup TJ's Brown Sugar, plus more for sprinkling
You will also need an 11x15-inch rimmed baking sheet

steps.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Position one rack on bottom rung of oven and one in the center. Place a large cookie sheet on bottom rack of oven.

Unroll two circles of dough onto parchment-lined cutting board, with edges overlapping. Using a flour-dusted rolling pin, roll together cracks in the dough. Fold edges inward to create a rectangle, slightly larger than the baking sheet. Transfer dough to baking sheet, fitting edges up and over the sides of the pan. Refrigerate for 10 minutes.
Remove baking sheet from refrigerator and prick holes in dough with a knife. Place sheet on center rack of oven and bake for 15 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside. Reduce heat to 375°F.
Repeat the rolling process with remaining dough to create the top layer of pie. Refrigerate for 10 minutes.

Add thawed peaches, brown sugar, lemon juice, cinnamon and ginger to a large bowl and gently fold together with a spatula. Pour peach mixture into a strainer to drain excess liquid. Pour strained peaches evenly into par-baked crust, and cover with remaining dough.

Use a fork to crimp the edges of dough together around the edges of the baking sheet. Poke scattered holes in the dough to vent while baking (alternatively, use a knife to cut desired shapes out of dough).

In a small bowl, whisk the egg. Brush top crust with egg wash and sprinkle with brown sugar. Place pie in center rack of oven and bake for 70 minutes, rotating pan halfway through. Remove pie from oven when crust is golden and filling is bubbly. Let cool one hour prior to serving.

peach-slab-pie.title: Peach Slab Pie

peachy-granola-crisp.description: California tree-fruit growers regularly supply Trader Joe’s with some of the best stone fruits we’ve ever tasted—like big, beautiful, flavorful Yellow Peaches. They’re shipped to our stores very cold, so they stay as fresh as possible. The fruit will feel firm to the touch, but don’t make the mistake of thinking it isn’t ripe. It’s ripe. Just leave your Peaches out at room temperature for 24-36 hours to let them soften and allow their bright, peachy aroma to shine through. It’s worth the wait. So go ahead… eat a peach. Use them for pies, smoothies, salads, or this impressively simple granola crisp!
ingredients: ¼ -½ cup TJ’s Organic Sugar, depending on the sweetness of the peaches
2 cups TJ’s Just the Clusters Vanilla Almond Granola, lightly crushed
4 tablespoons TJ’s Salted Butter Quarters, melted

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350° F.
In a large bowl, combine peaches with sugar and toss until completely coated.
Pour into an 8x8 baking dish or evenly distribute between individual ramekins.
In the large empty bowl, combine crushed granola with butter, and mix with a spatula until crumbly yet cohesive.
Top peaches with granola mixture and bake for 45 minutes, or until crisp topping becomes golden, and the peach syrup gently bubbles.
Let cool slightly before serving with whipped cream, Greek yogurt, or ice cream.

peachy-granola-crisp.title: Peachy Granola Crisp

peachypeach-bellini.description: Coming to Trader Joe's from a family-owned German winery, this bubbly beverage is just peachy, and if you add some peach purée, it's just Peachy-Peach lower alcohol content (8% ABV) begs for a brunchy application, but lest you get the wrong impression, it also sparkles with apps or dessert... Pretty much anytime is fine for this sweet, celebratory wine.
ingredients: 1 cup TJ's Frozen Freestone Peach Slices

steps.text: In a blender, blend peaches slightly to make a chunky purée.
Spoon about a tablespoon of puree into the bottom of a champagne flute. Poor Bellini over purée.
Top with mint leaves and enjoy!

peachypeach-bellini.title: Peachy-Peach Bellini

peanut-butter-banana-blondie-bars.description:
This recipe transforms classic Blondie Bars from bake sale stalwarts into fancy dessert superstars. Hidden beneath a luscious dark chocolate and peanut butter cup topping, you’ll find a creamy peanut butter & sliced banana-laced filling, buttressed by a delightfully chewy, chocolate chip-studded bar base made from Trader Joe’s Blondie Bar Mix.

Enjoy them alongside an ice-cold glass of milk for a true after-dinner treat, or serve them as an alternative to cake at your next big celebration (even if that celebration is just a day ending in “y”). One way or another, you’re sure to experience dessert rapture in every Blondie Bar bite.
ingredients: TJ’s Coconut Oil Spray, to grease pan
1 box TJ’s Blondie Bar Baking Mix
½ cup TJ’s Old Fashioned Blister Peanuts, chopped
1 stick plus 2 tablespoons softened TJ’s Unsalted Butter, divided
1 cup TJ’s Creamy Salted Peanut Butter
1 teaspoon TJ’s Organic Pure Bourbon Vanilla Extract
1/3 cup plus 4 ounces TJ’s Heavy Cream, divided
2-3 large or 4-5 small TJ’s Bananas, sliced
1 cup chopped TJ’s Organic 73% Dark Chocolate Bar (about 2.5 Bars) OR your favorite TJ’s Dark Chocolate)
15 TJ’s Milk Chocolate Peanut Butter Cups, unwrapped and frozen

steps.text:
Prep the Blondie Bar base:
Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease a quarter-sheet pan with coconut oil spray and line with parchment paper. 

In the bowl of an electric mixer, whisk egg and melted salted butter until smooth and creamy. Add Blondie Bar Baking Mix and chopped peanuts and stir to combine. Spread mixture evenly onto the parchment lined pan.

Bake on center rack of oven 12-15 minutes. Remove and cool completely.

Prep the peanut butter & banana filling:
In the bowl of an electric mixer, add 1 stick softened, unsalted butter, peanut butter, vanilla, and salt. Beat on high speed, scraping down the sides of the bowl, until smooth and combined.

Add powdered sugar and heavy cream. Beat on low to combine, then increase to high speed for 5 minutes, scraping the bowl down now and then, until very light and fluffy.

Spread half of the filling on the cooled blondie base. Top with a layer of sliced bananas. Blot bananas with a paper towel to dry. Smooth remaining filling evenly over bananas. Refrigerate until firm (about 1 hour).

Prep the dark chocolate topping:
Place a small pot with one inch of water over low heat. Place the chocolate, butter, and cream in a heatproof bowl that fits over the small pot. Slowly melt the mixture, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat and allow to cool 5 minutes. (Pro tip: If the melted chocolate separates, add a splash of cream and stir to combine.) While chocolate cools, chop frozen peanut butter cups into small pieces, or pulse in a food processor.

Smooth melted chocolate evenly over the peanut butter filling and sprinkle with chopped peanut butter cups. Refrigerate 5 minutes, then score just through the chocolate easy slicing. Refrigerate 1 hour or until ready to serve.

Slice into 24 squares, garnish with freshly sliced bananas, and serve.

peanut-butter-banana-blondie-bars.title: Peanut Butter & Banana Blondie Bars

peanut-butter-brownies.description: Do you like warm, chocolaty brownies? What about gooey, melted peanut butter cups? If that's a 'yes' to both, then this one's for you! (And if that's a 'no' to either, then frankly we're confused, but we digress...) Enjoy this classic, easy-bake recipe from the Trader Joe's vault, starring two of our most enduring dessert darlings: Trader Joe's Truffle Brownie Mix and Trader Joe's Dark Chocolate Peanut Butter Cups.
ingredients: 1 container TJ's Peanut Butter Cups, unwrapped

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Prepare brownies according to package instructions.

Remove brownies from oven and press half of the the peanut butter cups, bottoms down, into the warm brownies making rows that cover the top of the brownies entirely. Place brownies back into the oven for one to two minutes, or until the peanut butter cups soften. Use a spatula or knife to spread softened peanut butter cups into a gooey frosting over the brownies.
Optional: chop the rest of the peanut butter cups in half, then press them into the already-melted "frosting" or use as garnish.
Allow to cool (if you can). Enjoy!

peanut-butter-brownies.title: Peanut Butter Cup Brownies

peanut-butter-cup-cinnamallow-treats.description: Take your marshmallow treats to the next level with Crunchy Cinnamon Squares Cereal and Dark Chocolate Peanut Butter Cups.
ingredients: 6 cups TJ's Crunchy Cinnamon Squares Cereal
20 TJ's Dark Chocolate Peanut Butter Cups, cut into halves

steps.text: Coat a 13x9 pan with canola oil spray and set aside. Remove cereal bag from outer box. With cereal still in the bag, use your hands to crush cereal into smaller pieces; measure out 6 cups and set aside.

In a large pan, melt butter over medium heat. Add marshmallows and stir until melted. Turn off heat and add crushed cereal and 2/3 of the peanut butter cups to pan. Stir quickly to incorporate into marshmallow mixture.

Press the cereal mixture into greased pan with the back of a spoon. Top with remaining peanut butter cups. Using a piece of waxed paper, gently press peanut butter cups into treats. Let cool, then cut into squares and enjoy!

peanut-butter-cup-cinnamallow-treats.title: Peanut Butter Cup Cinnamallow Treats

peanut-butter-jelly-cinnamon-rolls.description: PB&J doesn't just have to be relegated to the realm of sandwiches. Its satisfying mix of savory and sweet lends itself well to all kinds of delights, like this easy-to-make, even-easier-to-enjoy cinnamon roll treat, using Trader Joe's Organic Jumbo Cinnamon Rolls with Vanilla Icing.
