The addition of bright, fruity Organic Reduced Sugar Strawberry Preserves and salty, flavorful Creamy Salted Peanut Butter puts a sensational spin on an old favorite. Enjoy as a dessert, or as a particularly opulent brunch option.
ingredients: 1 package TJ's Organic Jumbo Cinnamon Rolls with Vanilla Icing
5 tablespoons TJ's Organic Reduced Sugar Strawberry Preserves
5 tablespoons TJ's Creamy Salted Peanut Butter

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F. Remove cinnamon rolls from package and transfer to a large cutting board or workspace, reserve icing.
Gently separate and unravel cinnamon rolls until you have long strips of dough.
Using a spoon, spread or drip a tablespoon of peanut butter over the length of each strip of dough.
To each strip of dough, add a tablespoon of evenly distributed, small mounds of jelly over the peanut butter layer.
Gently roll the dough strips back into their cinnamon roll shape and place on a parchment-lined baking sheet, about 2 inches apart.
Bake on center rack of oven for 18-20 minutes until golden brown. Remove from oven and let cool slightly. Drizzle rolls with reserved icing and enjoy.

peanut-butter-jelly-cinnamon-rolls.title: Peanut Butter & Jelly Cinnamon Rolls

peanutty-satay-sauce.description: Peanut butter serves as the base of this versatile sauce. Use it to marinate chicken or shrimp, dress your salads, or as a dip for veggies or grilled meat. You can adjust the consistency by adding more or less water. Top with crushed Trader Joe’s 50% Less Salt Roasted & Salted Peanuts for an extra burst of nuttiness and a delightful crunch.
ingredients: ½ cup TJ’s Creamy Salted Peanut Butter
¼ cup TJ’s 50% Less Salt Roasted & Salted Peanuts, crushed

steps.text: Using a whisk or a spoon, mix all ingredients (except for water, salt, and peanuts) together in a medium-sized bowl.
Slowly add water and stir until desired consistency is achieved. You may not need to use all of the water.
Taste and season with sea salt, if necessary.
Top with crushed peanuts to serve.

peanutty-satay-sauce.title: Peanutty Satay Sauce

peppermint-smores-cake.description: S'mores aren't just a summertime treat. When combined with peppermint & chocolate-a classic holiday flavor combo-they're a wintertime treat, too! What are you waiting for? Deck the halls & preheat the oven, because this moist-cake-meets-chewy-melted-marshmallow dessert is about make your holiday season even brighter...
ingredients: 1 cup TJ's Cinnamon Graham Crackers, crumbled
2 sticks (1 cup) TJ's Unsalted Butter, melted and divided
1 package TJ's Chocolate Peppermint Loaf & Baking Mix (seasonal)

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line a 9x11-inch baking pan with parchment paper, set aside.
In a medium mixing bowl, combine graham cracker crumbs, sugar, and one stick (1/2 cup) of melted butter. Mix until combined. Press mixture into an even layer on the bottom of the greased pan.

In a medium bowl mix egg, water, and the rest of the melted butter to combine. Add baking mix and stir, just until batter comes together. Pour batter in the pan on top of the crust and spread into an even layer, completely covering the crust.
Bake on the middle rack of the over for about 40 - 45 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the middle comes out clean.

Remove cake from oven, leaving oven on. Arrange marshmallows in a single layer on top of the cake, completely covering its surface. Place back in oven for about 5 minutes, or until marshmallows begin to brown on top. (For an extra-crisp top layer, toast the marshmallows with a kitchen torch after the cake comes out of the oven.)
Let cool completely. Remove from pan and enjoy!

peppermint-smores-cake.title: Peppermint S'mores Cake

pepperoni-slab-pizza.description: This rectangular Pizza Crust is studded with golden bubbles and offers a pleasantly yeast-y chew. Keep some simple toppings on hand (cheese, sauce, et. al.) and everyday can be Pizza Day!
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups TJ's Organic Shredded Mozzarella Cheese
A few dashes TJ's Organic Oregano (optional)

steps.text: Preheat to 425°F. Lightly brush top and bottom of crust with oil. Spread sauce evenly over crust to within half an inch of the edges. Top with cheese, pepperoni, and oregano. Place on a pizza pan, baking sheet, or for a crisper crust directly on oven rack, and bake 5 to 8 minutes. Cook until cheese is melted and crust is golden brown and crisp on edges.

pepperoni-slab-pizza.title: Pepperoni Slab Pizza

peri-peri-potato-salad.description:
A little spicy, a little sour, even a little sweet, Trader Joe’s Peri-Peri Sauce contributes a whole new point of view to prototypical potato salad. Its smooth, creamy consistency and welcoming heat meld masterfully into the dressing base; combined with tender Dutch Yellow Potatoes, sliced celery, and brightly colored bell peppers, the finished dish is topped with a handful of chips for an unexpected dose of craveable crunch.

This potato salad is best served at room temperature within two hours of cooking. Store leftovers in the refrigerator and enjoy within two days.
ingredients: ¼ cup TJ’s Organic Plain Yogurt
1 bag (1.5 lbs.) TJ’s Dutch Yellow Baby Potatoes
4 stalks TJ’s Celery, thinly sliced (about 1 cup total), leaves reserved
1 TJ’s Yellow or Red Bell Pepper, diced
TJ’s Vegetable Root Chips or TJ's Ode to the Classic Potato Chip, for garnish

steps.text: In a large bowl, mix the mayonnaise, yogurt, smoked paprika, seal salt, and Peri-Peri Sauce—start with 1 tablespoon of the sauce and increase amount to your preferred level of heat. Fold in the parsley and green onion. Set aside.

Place potatoes in a pot of cold water and bring to a boil. Turn the heat down to a very low simmer (to avoid bursting the potatoes) and cook until a knife inserted slides easily through the potato, about 10-15 minutes. Pro tip: Cook time will vary depending on the size of your potatoes. When you insert a knife into a potato and lift it out of the water, it should slide easily from the knife. If it holds to the knife, the potato is not yet cooked. Remove potatoes from boiling water with a slotted spoon and transfer to a clean kitchen towel until cool enough to handle.
While the potatoes are cooking, prepare an ice bath. Place celery leaves into a fine mesh sieve and dip in the ice bath to crisp, then drain and transfer to a clean kitchen towel to dry.

Place the sliced celery into a sieve and dip into the boiling potato water for 30 seconds to set the color. Dip celery into the ice bath to cool, then drain and transfer to a clean kitchen towel to dry.
When the potatoes are cool enough to handle, gently peel them and cut into large dice.
Fold potatoes into the dressing until coated. Add the diced bell pepper and blanched sliced celery. Taste and adjust with more salt and Peri-Peri Sauce if desired.
Garnish potato salad with celery leaves and a handful of chips and serve.

peri-peri-potato-salad.title: Peri-Peri Potato Salad

pesto-portabella-burger.description: The kale in Trader Joe's Vegan Kale, Cashew & Basil Pesto gives it some serious depth, while the basil infuses it with freshness, and the cashew butter lends it enough creaminess to leave you saying, "Parmesan? Who needs Parmesan?!" Aside from the obvious pasta pairings, it makes a splash as a spread on burgers and sandwiches, too.
ingredients: 2 packages TJ's Portabella Mushrooms, wiped with a damp cloth, stems removed
2 TJ's Roasted Red Bell Peppers, thinly sliced
4 of your favorite TJ's Artisan Rolls, baked according to package directions
TJ's Vegan Kale, Cashew & Basil Pesto

steps.text: Preheat grill to medium-high. Brush mushrooms with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Grill mushrooms, gill side-down for 5 minutes; flip mushrooms and grill another 3-5 minutes until tender. Remove from heat and place provolone on top to melt.

Slice rolls in half lengthwise. Generously slather bottom half of a roll with pesto. Top with mushroom, bell pepper, spring mix, and top half of roll. Repeat with remaining ingredients and enjoy immediately.

pesto-portabella-burger.title: Pesto Portabella Burger

pineapple-parfait.description: We’re taking the parfait on a tropical holiday! Alternating layers of lusciously creamy Trader Joe’s Premium French Vanilla Ice Cream and pineapple chunks swimming in tart Trader Joe’s Cold Pressed Pineapple Juice are topped with toasted coconut and crunchy macadamia nuts—a combo that may cause you to exclaim “Parfait, hooray!” Serve with a spoon and a straw to scoop and sip every last drop.
ingredients: 2 tablespoon TJ’s Organic Unsweetened Flake Coconut
¼-1/2 cup TJ’s Cold Pressed Pineapple Juice
3 scoops TJ’s Premium French Vanilla Ice Cream
TJ’s Whipped Cream Can, to top
2 tablespoon TJ’s Dry Roasted & Salted Macadamias, coarsely chopped

steps.text: In a small frying pan over medium-high heat, add coconut and toast until golden and fragrant, about 3-4 minutes.

To assemble: In a tall, wide-mouth glass, add a splash of pineapple juice, a few chunks of pineapple, and top with a scoop of ice cream. Repeat ice cream and pineapple layers until you reach the top of the glass. Add a swirl of whipped cream and sprinkle with toasted coconut and chopped macadamia nuts to serve.

pineapple-parfait.title: Pineapple Parfait

pineapple-quinoa.description: Cooking Trader Joe's Organic Quinoa in pineapple juice makes for a sweet-savory side that pairs effortlessly with grilled fish or smoked chicken.
ingredients: 16 oz. TJ's Pineapple Juice (refrigerated) or 2 cans TJ's 100% Pineapple Juice (shelf-stable)
1/4 teaspoon TJ's Crushed Red Chile Pepper

steps.text: Prepare quinoa according to package instructions replacing water with pineapple juice.
Coat skillet with grapeseed oil. Add frozen pineapple and pepper. Sauté until the pineapple and pepper soften. Add green onion, salt and red chile pepper. Sauté for an additional two minutes.
Combine pineapple mixture with quinoa and serve.

pineapple-quinoa.title: Pineapple Quinoa

pizza-bagels.description: Step up your afternoon snack game with this classic pizza bagel recipe.
ingredients: 3 TJ's Bagels cut in half (for a total of 6)
4 pieces TJ's Fully Cooked Uncured Apple Smoked Bacon, chopped

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place all bagel halves on a baking sheet. Spread pizza sauce on each, about 2 heaping tablespoons or more to your liking. Sprinkle shredded mozzarella liberally on each, covering the entire bagel. Chop 4 pieces of fully cooked bacon and put on 3 bagels. Place 3 pieces of pepperoni on top of the remaining 3 bagels. Place in oven for 12 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbling. We recommend dipping in your favorite Ranch or Blue Cheese Dip. Have fun with the toppings… add more or less to your liking!

pizza-bagels.title: Pizza Bagels

polenta-veggie-stacks.description:
With just a few shakes, Trader Joe’s Mushroom & Company Multipurpose Umami Seasoning Blend seasons every component of this simple sheet pan recipe, adding depth and a pleasant savory flavor to the entire dish. While you can serve each ingredient next to each other, try stacking this side dish instead! TJ’s Organic Polenta makes a sturdy base for piling on all the veggies and TJ’s Silver Goat Cheese rounds. 

Almost as compelling as this recipe’s cozy deliciousness? Its sheet pan prep won’t leave you with a sink full of dishes. Hooray!
ingredients: 1/2 TJ’s Organic Polenta, sliced into ½-inch rounds
TJ’s Silver Goat Cheese Log, sliced into 4 ½-inch rounds
1 cup TJ’s Organic Mixed Medley Cherry Tomatoes, sliced in half
TJ’s Mushroom & Company Multipurpose Umami Seasoning Blend

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.

To a 9x13 sheet pan, lightly drizzle with olive oil. Arrange polenta, goat cheese, tomatoes, kale, and mushrooms each in their own row in a single layer. Drizzle with more olive oil then season with a few sprinkles of the umami seasoning.
Roast for 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Arrange each stack: polenta on the bottom, stacked with goat cheese, followed by tomatoes, kale, and topped with a mushroom cap to serve.

polenta-veggie-stacks.title: Polenta & Veggie Stacks

pop-goes-the-elote.description: Trader Joe’s Everything But the Elote Seasoning Blend includes hints of nearly everything that comes along with elote (chile pepper, Parmesan, chipotle powder, dried cilantro, sea salt, etc.), except, of course, the elote itself. But in this recipe, the corn comes back, only this time, it’s off the cob... Pop Goes the Elote!
ingredients: 3 tablespoon TJ's Everything but the Elote Seasoning Blend

steps.text: In a 3-quart pan, pour in oil to cover the bottom.  Add 2-3 kernels of corn to pan, cover and heat. When these kernels pop, add the remaining popping corn, then cover and shake pan over medium heat until popping stops.
Remove from heat. Pour melted butter and sprinkle seasoning over popcorn. Mix until thoroughly covered.
Let popcorn cool slightly and enjoy!

pop-goes-the-elote.title: Pop Goes the Elote

poppin-pumpkin-seeds.description: This recipe combines favored fall flavors into one irresistibly pumpkin-y snack.
ingredients: 1/2 tsp TJ's Sea Salt, more to taste
2 Tbsp TJ's Clarified Butter or TJ's 100% Canola Oil
2 cups TJ's Raw Shelled Pumpkin Seeds
1 1/2 Tbsp fresh TJ's Rosemary Leaves, roughly chopped

steps.text: Mix salt, paprika, cinnamon, cumin and cayenne together in a small bowl. Set aside.

Warm butter (or oil) and sugar together in a large skillet over medium heat; add pumpkin seeds and spice mixture to pan and stir until sugar is melted and the seeds are fragrant, 5 to 6 minutes (add a lid when seeds start to pop).
Remove from heat, add fresh rosemary and sprinkle on additional salt (if desired) and toss. Immediately spread seeds out on a parchment-lined baking sheet and cool completely before serving.

poppin-pumpkin-seeds.title: Poppin’ Pumpkin Seeds

pork-belly-tacos.description:
For tacos with slow-cooked flavor in 20 minutes, we turn to Trader Joe’s Fully Cooked Pork Belly to sidestep the normally slow pork belly prep. Simply season with cumin, crisp in a pan, and shred for an immensely satisfying and speedy taco filling, complemented by a bright and zesty slaw, dressed with Pineapple Salsa.

Use the pan you crisp the Pork Belly in to warm your tortillas for fewer dishes and to soak up some of the flavor from the pork belly.
ingredients: 1 package TJ’s Fully Cooked Pork Belly, sliced lengthwise
½ package TJ’s Shredded Green Cabbage
¼ cup TJ’s Cilantro bunch, leaves removed from stems
TJ’s Avocado slices or Avocado’s Number Guacamole, for serving

steps.text: Sprinkle cumin on both sides of the sliced pork belly.
Over medium heat, on a grill pan or medium-sized frying pan, add oil and slices of pork belly, and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, until crisp. Remove from pan and shred with a fork.
Make the slaw: add cabbage, pineapple salsa, cilantro leaves, and lime juice to a medium-sized bowl. Toss to combine.
Heat the tortillas: On a grill pan or medium-sized frying pan, heat to medium high and add your tortillas. Heat for one to two minutes per side.
Assemble the taco: Fill your warmed tortilla with shredded pork belly, add slaw, and top with two avocado slices or dollop of guacamole.

pork-belly-tacos.title: Pork Belly Tacos

potato-pancakes-asparagus-poached-eggs.description: Trader Joe's Potato Pancakes are might tasty when served with the traditional sour cream & apple sauce. Or even with ketchup, à la hash browns. Or smothered in cheese & chives. Or—as we found out here—served on a bed of lemony-garlic sautéed asparagus, beneath a perfectly poached egg.Consider yourself an egg-poaching novice? Follow the step-by-step video instructions below, and you'll find yourself coached to a perfect poach in no time!

steps.text:
Fill a large pot with 3-4 inches of water and bring to a rolling boil. Lower heat to simmer and add 1 tablespoon apple cider vinegar.

Crack 1 egg into a strainer to separate the yolk from the white (reserve egg whites for an omelet!) and gently pour the yolk into a small bowl. Stir the simmering water with a spoon to create a vortex in the pot. Carefully slide the egg into center of vortex and cook for 3 minutes. Use a slotted spoon to remove the cooked egg and set on a clean plate. Repeat poaching process with remaining eggs.

While water boils, heat oil in a large sauté pan on medium heat. Add garlic, lemon juice, and asparagus to pan. Use tongs to sauté until asparagus is cooked through, about 3 - 5 minutes. Remove pan from heat and set aside. 

Prepare latkes according to package instructions, set aside.
Separate the asparagus onto 4 plates. Top each plate of asparagus with a potato pancake, then top each potato pancake with a poached egg. Add salt and pepper to taste.  Enjoy!

potato-pancakes-asparagus-poached-eggs.title: Potato Pancakes with Asparagus & Poached Eggs

potato-tot-poutine-onion-gravy.description: The super scrumptious caramelized onion gravy in this recipe gets its umami edge from TJ's Mushroom & Co. Umami Seasoning. A ladle-full will surely elevate a slice of turkey, but what you really need to try is some atop Trader Joe’s Potato Tots with melted mozzarella. This inspired take on a comfort-food classic is so good, it just might replace mashed potatoes at your main holiday meal!
ingredients: 1 medium TJ’s Yellow Onion, peeled and thinly sliced
1 ½ tablespoons TJ’s Mushroom & Co. Multipurpose Umami Seasoning
1 package (8 oz) TJ’s All Natural Fresh Mozzarella Log, cut into large dice
2 tablespoons sliced TJ’s Green onions, for garnish

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F. Line a sheet pan with tin foil.
In a 1 quart sauce pan, over medium heat, melt the butter until foaming. Add the sliced onions and cook slowly over medium heat, stirring frequently, until the onions are a deep golden brown.
Add the Turkey Flavored Gravy and the umami seasoning and stir to combine. Bring to a simmer. Turn the heat off while you prepare the poutine base.
Spread the Tots on the lined sheet pan and place in the oven. Cook for 25 minutes until very crisp, turning at the halfway mark.
Place half of the tots in an oven-proof dish and scatter with half of the mozzarella. Repeat with remaining tots and remaining mozzarella.
Bake in the oven for 5-10 minutes, or until the cheese just begins to melt. While the cheese melts, turn the heat back on under the gravy and cook, stirring until hot.
Remove tots from the oven and ladle the gravy on top. Garnish with green onions and serve immediately.

potato-tot-poutine-onion-gravy.title: Potato Tot Poutine with Caramelized Onion Gravy

potsticker-soups-on.description: Gyoza are super when steamed, and fantastic when fried up in a skillet (and dipped in TJ's Gyoza Dipping Sauce, of course)… but do you want know another way to enjoy these delicious dumplings? Soup! Simmer some sautéed veggies in broth with soy sauce and sesame oil, toss in your favorite Trader Joe's Gyoza Potstickers (we've got Chicken, Pork, Shrimp, and Vegetable to choose from), and Potsticker Soup's On!
ingredients: 1 package TJ's Gyoza Potstickers (Pork, Chicken, Shrimp or Vegetable)
2 packages TJ's Low Sodium Chicken Broth
1 tablespoon TJ's Reduced Sodium Soy Sauce
1 tablespoon TJ's Organic Toasted Sesame Oil
Handful of chopped TJ's Fresh Cilantro, for garnish
TJ’s Crunchy Chili Onion, or your favorite TJ’s Hot Sauce (for garnish)

steps.text: Coat the bottom of a large frying pan with oil (about 2-3 tablespoons) and lightly fry potstickers over medium-high heat until nicely browned on both sides, about 7-10 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.

In a large soup pot over medium heat, heat two tablespoons olive oil. Add mirepoix and sauté until onions appear translucent. Add broth and bring to a slow simmer. When the soup gets some energy, toss in the spinach and stir in soy sauce and sesame oil.

When the soup is officially simmering, add the potstickers. Ladle soup into bowls and garnish with cilantro and a heaping spoonful of chili onion crunch or hot sauce. (Make sure you have extra spoons on hand... never underestimate the charisma of Trader Joe's Potsticker Soup's On!)

potsticker-soups-on.title: Potsticker Soup's On!

preposterously-peanut-butter-cup-cookies.description:
Trader Joe's Creamy Salted Peanut Butter is simple, and simply scrumptious. There are just two ingredients inside every jar: peanuts from the southeastern United States, and salt. That is all.     

However, with just a few more ingredients (and this handy recipe), you can take peanut butter from simply scrumptious to downright drool-worthy. Here, we've turned the classic peanut butter cookie on its head by enveloping the dough around our customers' favorite Trader Joe's Dark Chocolate Peanut Butter Cups before baking. The result is an ooey-gooey, sweet-salty cookie treat that's not to be missed. Be sure to have an ice-cold glass of milk or your favorite non-dairy beverage handy when these come out of the oven!
ingredients: 2 cups (1 jar) TJ's Creamy Salted Peanut Butter, stirred
2 cup TJ's Organic Cane Sugar, plus more for rolling cookies
2 teaspoons TJ's Organic Pure Bourbon Vanilla Extract
16 TJ's Dark Chocolate Peanut Butter Cups, wrappers removed

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line two baking sheets with parchment paper, set aside. Pour a bit of sugar on a shallow plate for rolling cookies, set aside.

In a large bowl, mix peanut butter, sugar, eggs, baking soda, and vanilla until combined. Take a large scoop of cookie dough, place peanut butter cup in the center and pat dough closed around the cup to form a dough ball. Roll dough ball in sugar and place on prepared baking sheet. Repeat with remaining ingredients until you have 8 dough balls per baking sheet.

Bake sheets, one at a time, on center rack of oven for about 13 minutes, until golden brown. Remove from oven and let cool on baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring cookies to cooling racks. Cookies are best enjoyed warm!

preposterously-peanut-butter-cup-cookies.title: Preposterously Peanut Butter Cup Cookies

pressure-cooker-corned-beef-cabbage.description:
Pickling spices of mustard, coriander, bay leaf, red chili pepper, and dill seed create the signature flavor profile of Trader Joe's Uncured Corned Beef Brisket: savory and fragrant, balanced by tangy vinegar powder and sweet brown sugar. We've opted for a high quality, tender brisket cut with no nitrates or nitrites, which creates an impossibly juicy, incredibly flavorful finished dish.  

Traditionally, corned beef is cooked low and slow-but if you don't have three or four hours to stand stove-side, opt instead for pressure cooker preparation. Complete with complex beer braised flavor, and fork-tender carrots, potatoes, and cabbage, the end result is corned beef and all the fixings, ready for a St. Patrick's Day potluck in a fraction of the time.
ingredients: 1 TJ's Jumbo Yellow Onion, trimmed and cut into large chunks
1 bag (1.5 pounds) TJ's Organic Mini Potato Medley OR Red Potatoes
1 bag TJ's Organic Cut & Peeled Carrots
1 head TJ's Green Cabbage, trimmed and cut into wedges
TJ's Whole Grain Mustard Dijon, for serving

steps.text: Place onion chunks in pressure cooker. Remove brisket from package and cut into three large pieces. Arrange brisket atop onions, fat-side down. Pour beer and enough water to cover the brisket.

Seal pressure cooker lid and cook on high pressure for 20 minutes per pound (that's 70 minutes for a 3.5-pound brisket; add or subtract cook time as necessary based on the weight of your brisket). Let pressure release naturally for 20 minutes, then manually release remaining pressure. Carefully transfer brisket pieces to a cutting board and cover with foil.

Strain cooking liquid, reserving 1.5 cups liquid to cook vegetables; discard solids. Add potatoes, carrots and cabbage wedges to pressure cooker and cover with reserved liquid. Seal lid and cook on high pressure for 3 minutes. Quick release pressure. Use tongs to transfer vegetables to a large serving platter; reserve cooking liquid for serving.
Gently slice corned beef against the grain and arrange next to vegetables on serving platter. Spoon cooking liquid atop corned beef. Serve with whole grain mustard on the side.

pressure-cooker-corned-beef-cabbage.title: Pressure Cooker Corned Beef & Cabbage

prosciutto-melon-bites.description:
Trader Joe's Sliced Prosciutto is crafted for us by a well-known, award-winning Italian salumeri here in the U.S. They begin with full hams that are cured in the traditional Italian style, then allowed to age slowly for 10-12 months.    

As the hams age, their flavor intensifies and their character builds, resulting in richly-flavored Prosciutto that's outstanding on Panini with arugula & Asiago, and super on a pizza-try it with pesto or a cream-based sauce and inch-long cuts of asparagus. We especially enjoy it with fresh melon in this no-cook, summery appetizer recipe that pairs wonderfully with a crisp, fruity rosé or dry cider.
ingredients: 1/2 TJ's Tuscan Melon (or small TJ's Cantaloupe), cubed
1 package TJ's Sliced Prosciutto, gently sliced in half lengthwise

steps.text: Lay a piece of prosciutto on a clean, dry work surface. Set a melon cube at one end, and wrap prosciutto around melon.
Top with a fresh basil leaf or two, and push a toothpick through the center to secure.
Enjoy!

prosciutto-melon-bites.title: Prosciutto Melon Bites

pulled-port-sandwiches.description:
When it comes to vegan or vegetarian grilling, Trader Joe’s Portabella Mushrooms are unbeatable. Hearty and nutritious, Portabellas make an ideal meat substitute: they take on marinades and sauces spectacularly well, they’re the perfect shape and size for a plant-powered burger patty, and they even tend to take on a meat-like texture after a few minutes on the barbecue. And on top of all that, they’re super easy to work with: just a quick wipe with a wet paper towel, a slice or two here and there, and you’re ready to get cooking. 

Our Portabella Mushrooms can be cut into quarters for veggie kebabs, stuffed with TJ’s Chevre for incredible appetizers, or sliced super thin and mixed with your favorite TJ’s BBQ sauce for a tasty, meat-free take on a pulled pork sandwich.
ingredients: 2 TJ’s Portabella Mushrooms (12659), cleaned and thinly sliced
½ cup of your favorite TJ’s Barbecue Sauce
½ bag TJ’s Organic Coleslaw Kit, tossed with the included salad dressing

steps.text: Heat a large sauté pan over high heat. Add a tablespoon of oil. Once hot, add sliced mushrooms and cook until they expel liquid then begin to brown, about 5 minutes. Season with salt.
Add remaining oil and sliced onion. Cook for 3-5 minutes, until onions become soft.
Reduce heat to medium and add barbecue sauce, stirring to combine. Sauté until sauce thickens slightly, 3-5 minutes.
Add half of the pulled mushroom to the bottom half of each bun. Top with dressed coleslaw to serve.

pulled-port-sandwiches.title: Pulled Port Sandwiches

pumpkin-bars.description:
One of our favorite things about Trader Joe’s Pumpkin Bread and Muffin Mix is the way the subtle flavor of the pumpkin is perfectly complemented by the zesty additions of spices like cinnamon and nutmeg. Second to that fantastic flavor is its ease of use: Follow the package instructions and you’ll get a loaf of moist and fluffy, lightly spiced pumpkin bread, or a dozen standard-sized muffins, every time.

But if you’re seeking something even more dessert-y, say, for an after-dinner treat or booster club bake sale, you can follow the recipe below for a pumpkin bar of sorts that’s decidedly more “brownie” in texture than “bread.” The sweet, sour cream topping is by no means required, but will make these bars all the more delicious.
ingredients: 1 stick TJ’s Unsalted Butter, melted and cooled (plus additional butter to grease the pan)
1 box TJ’s Pumpkin Bread & Muffin Mix
¾ cup TJ’s Organic Cane Sugar
½ teaspoon TJ’s Pure Bourbon Vanilla Extract

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease an 8-inch square baking pan with some unsalted butter.

In a medium bowl, whisk eggs. Slowly add remaining butter, whisking to incorporate. Add pumpkin bread mix, sugar and water to bowl. Fold together with a spatula just until combined. Transfer batter to prepared baking pan, smoothing into an even layer (batter will be sticky).

Bake on center rack of oven for 35 minutes, until top is a dark golden brown and a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Remove from oven and let cool completely on cooling rack before slicing.
In a small bowl, whisk sour cream and vanilla. Add powdered sugar and continue whisking until combined. Cover and refrigerate.
To serve, slice into squares and top with a dollop of sour cream topping. Sprinkle with pumpkin pie spice, if desired, and serve.

pumpkin-bars.title: Pumpkin Bars

pumpkin-choc-oat-chip-muffins-with-pumpk.description: What impressed us most about Trader Joe's Gluten Free Pumpkin Bread & Muffin Baking Mix was that if we hadn't known it was gluten free, we wouldn't have known it was gluten free-it's that good! And no, that's not a typo in the recipe title-these chocolate-chunk studded muffins are gilded with Pumpkin butter-infused butter.
ingredients: TJ's Canola Spray (to grease muffin tin)
1 box TJ's Gluten Free Pumpkin Bread & Muffin Mix (seasonal)
1 cup TJ's Gluten Free Rolled Oats
2 sticks TJ's Unsalted Butter, softened to room temperature

steps.text:
Preheat oven to 400°F. Grease muffin pan with canola spray and set aside.

In a large bowl, whisk together muffin mix, water, oil and eggs. Add applesauce, oats and chocolate chunks and stir gently; do not overmix.

Spoon batter into muffin tins about 2/3 full. Bake for 26-30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Cool for 20 minutes.

While muffins are cooling, mix softened butter and pumpkin butter in a small bowl until well blended.

Break open muffins and serve with a healthy dollop of Pumpkin Butter Butter. Muffins will keep in an airtight container for three days.

pumpkin-choc-oat-chip-muffins-with-pumpk.title: Pumpkin Choc-Oat Chip Muffins with Pumpkin Butter-Butter

pumpkin-pie.description: Take this handy recipe (straight from our TJ's Pie Pumpkin label), throw in some dough rolling, light stirring and a can-do attitude, and you'll have a pie worthy of your Thanksgiving spread.
ingredients: 1 TJ's Frozen Pie Crust, thawed according to package directions
1/2 cup to 1 cup whipping cream (use more for a larger Pie Pumpkin)
1/2 cup to 1 cup TJ's Organic Brown Sugar (use more for a larger Pie Pumpkin)
1 teaspoon TJ's Organic Pure Bourbon Vanilla Extract

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F. Wash and dry pumpkin, slice in half and remove stem. Use a spoon to scrape out string and seeds and discard (or toast seeds for a snack). Place pumpkin halves cut-side down on a foil-lined baking sheet. Bake 1 1/2 hours, until tender. Remove sheet from oven and remove foil; set aside to cool.
Gently unroll thawed crust into a 9"pie pan. Fold crust edge so it doesn't hang over the edge of the pan, and use a fork to crimp edge, if desired. Set aside.

Scoop pumpkin flesh into a large mixing bowl and mash with a fork until smooth. Add butter, cream, sugar, vanilla, pumpkin pie spice, and salt and mix until combined. Taste and adjust seasonings and sugar if needed. Fold in eggs. Pour filling into crust.
Place pie on center rack of oven and bake 1 hour. Cool 1 hour before slicing. Serve with whipped cream, if desired.

pumpkin-pie.title: Pumpkin Pie

pumpkin-snack-cake.description: Trader Joe's Gluten Free Pumpkin Bread & Muffin Baking Mix is easy to make, and even easier to eat. When we tasted it, what impressed us most about this Mix was that if we hadn't known it was gluten free, we wouldn't have known it was gluten free. This recipe for a substantial, super-moist snack cake eschews the egg, oil and water called for on the box in favor of a can of Trader Joe's Organic Pumpkin, along with some flaked coconut and chia seeds for delightfully toothsome texture.
ingredients: 1 box TJ's Gluten Free Pumpkin Bread & Muffin Baking Mix
1/2 cup TJ's Organic Unsweetened Flake Coconut

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease an 8x8-inch baking pan with coconut oil spray. Set aside.
In a large bowl, combine dry baking mix with coconut and chia seeds. Fold in canned pumpkin (batter will be thick).
Spread batter into greased pan and smooth top. Bake on center rack of oven for about 55 minutes, or until dark golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool 10 minutes. Gently remove cake from pan and let cool completely on a baking rack before slicing and serving.

pumpkin-snack-cake.title: Pumpkin Snack Cake

pumpkin-spice-yogurt-dip.description: What's that? A fall-inspired dessert dip? Sign us up. Yes, dip doesn't just have to be an appetizer. Or maybe it's an appetizer dessert? No matter when you serve this sweet, creamy dip, Trader Joe's Pumpkin Pie Spice adds seasonal flair you'll want to dip into again, and again, and again.
ingredients: 1 cup TJ's Whole Milk Vanilla Bean Greek Yogurt
1 tablespoon of your favorite TJ's Honey
1/4 teaspoon TJ's Pumpkin Pie Spice (seasonal), plus more for sprinkling
Your favorite TJ's Apple varietal, sliced

steps.text: Combine yogurt, honey, and pumpkin pie spice in a small bowl and stir until blended. Top with a extra sprinkle of pumkin pie spice. Serve with sliced apples for dipping.

pumpkin-spice-yogurt-dip.title: Pumpkin Spice Yogurt Dip

quesabirria-tacos.description:
Trader Joe’s Beef Birria is tender, slow-cooked beef in a flavorful broth made with crushed tomatoes, dried chiles, and aromatic spices and often served as a simple stew. If you want to evoke the taco truck vibe at home—and we’re thinking you do—you can make your own Birria tacos. But if your mantra is “everything is better with cheese,” then make Quesabirria tacos!

We dip corn tortillas in the savory broth and fry them in a hot pan, top them with Birria and shredded mozzarella cheese, then sprinkle chopped onions and cilantro and fold into a taco. We suggest frying each side until the tortillas are crispy and the cheese is gloriously gooey and begins to brown at the edges. But don’t stop there—that lusciously spiced broth serves as a delectable dip for your tacos, too. Believe us, you’ll want to spoon, dip, and sip every last drop.
ingredients: 1 package TJ’s Beef Birria, prepared according to package instructions

steps.text: Heat grill pan, plancha, or large frying pan over medium heat and add oil.
Dip one side of the tortilla in the prepared Birria broth then lay the tortilla, broth side down, on the plancha.
Add cheese to half of the tortilla and the heated shredded birria to the other. Top both sides with chopped cilantro and onion.
Using tongs, fold the tortilla, gently pressing it together. Cook for 2-3 minutes until crisp, then flip and continue cooking for another 2-3 minutes, until both sides are crispy.
Remove from plancha and top taco with more chopped onion and cilantro.
Repeat with remaining tortillas, and serve.

quesabirria-tacos.title: Quesabirria Tacos

quick-chicken-tortilla-soup.description: With its simple, wholesome ingredients and medium-spicy flavor profile, Trader Joe’s Salsa Autentica is a natural addition to any meat or plant-based tacos, and an excellent sidekick for chip dipping—but did you know it makes a super soup starter, too? Use it in this recipe that relies on a few pantry favorites to get dinner on the table in under 15 minutes.
ingredients: 1 carton TJ's Organic Free Range Chicken Broth
1 can TJ's Whole Kernel Corn, drained
1 can TJ's Organic Black Beans, drained
1 can TJ's Premium Chunk White Chicken, drained
TJ's Avocado, , Cilantro, and Lime for garnish

steps.text: Add broth, salsa, corn, beans, and chicken to a large pot and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes.
To serve, ladle soup into bowls. Garnish with tortilla chips, sliced avocado, cilantro, and a squeeze of lime.

quick-chicken-tortilla-soup.title: Quick Chicken Tortilla Soup

quick-colcannon.description: Add this traditional Irish recipe to your St. Patrick's Day buffet.
ingredients: 6 slices TJ's Uncured Apple Smoked Bacon

steps.text: In a large frying pan on medium heat, cook 6 slices of bacon. Set cooked bacon aside on a paper towel-lined plate.

Discard all but 1 tablespoon of oil from the pan. Add bag of frozen mashed potato medallions and 1/3 cup of water. Cook over moderate heat, stirring frequently. After about 5 minutes, once potatoes begin to soften, add 1/2 bag cruciferous crunch and 2 additional tablespoons of water. Stir then cover to trap steam. Cook for another 2-3 minutes or so, stirring every so often, until greens soften a bit.
Chop cooled bacon into small pieces then add to pan of potatoes. Serve right away with a pat of butter on top.

quick-colcannon.title: Quick Colcannon

quick-couscous-chickpea-salad.description:
Trader Joe’s Organic Couscous cooks up impressively quickly on the stovetop or in the microwave, making it an outstanding building block for potlucks, picnics, and weeknight meals alike. Boost a bowl of this marvelously mild and delicately textured Couscous with a can of TJ's Greek Chickpeas with Parsley & Cumin to simultaneously add protein and dress the salad with the included seasoned oil.

Bonus: this salad can be prepared ahead of time and served warm or cold!
ingredients: ½ teaspoon TJ’s Sea Salt, plus more to taste
1 can TJ’s Greek Chickpeas with Parsley & Cumin
½ cup TJ’s Kalamata Olives, sliced
1 cup TJ’s Mini Pearl Grape Tomatoes, sliced
¼ cup chopped TJ’s Fresh Parsley

steps.text: Prepare the couscous according to your preferred package instruction, in the microwave or on the stovetop, with butter and ½ teaspoon salt.

After the couscous has been fluffed with a fork, add to a large bowl. Add the can of chickpeas, (including the seasoned oil), olives, tomatoes, and cucumbers. Toss to combine. Season with salt and pepper, add a squeeze of lemon, and top with parsley to serve.

quick-couscous-chickpea-salad.title: Quick Couscous & Chickpea Salad

quick-golden-butter-rice.description: Trader Joe’s Organic Basmati Rice is luxuriously long-grained, alluringly aromatic (its name comes from the Hindi word for “fragrant,” in fact), and incredibly handy. Each box comes with three frozen pouches that can be microwaved within minutes (or a little longer on the stovetop, if you’d prefer), ideal for work lunches or quick, weeknight dinners. It’s superb served simply, or, if you have a few extra minutes, it makes a splendid side amped up with turmeric-tinged butter, sweet golden raisins, and crunchy cashews. Mmmm!
ingredients: 1 bag TJ’s Organic Basmati Rice, prepared according to package microwave instructions
¼ cup chopped TJ’s Yellow Onion
¼ cup chopped TJ’s Roasted & Unsalted Whole Cashews, roughly chopped

steps.text: On medium heat, melt butter in a medium-sized sauté pan. Add onion and sauté until it softens, about 3 minutes. Add turmeric to the pan and bloom in the butter, 2 minutes.

Add cashews and raisins and toss to combine. Then add prepared rice and stir to evenly coat in the turmeric butter. Add chicken broth concentrate and stir to combine, then remove from heat. Top with cilantro leaves to serve.

quick-golden-butter-rice.title: Quick Golden Butter Rice

quick-pickled-red-onions.description: Thanks to the addition of “the mother,” that cloudy layer seen at the bottom of the bottle, Trader Joe’s Apple Cider Vinegar contains a multitude of enzymes and gut-friendly bacteria, making it a fermented goldmine that you can use in an array of applications. Use it to make snazzy salad dressings, enhance soups and sauces, and even tame the bite and color of red onions into a pleasantly tangy and versatile condiment with a lovely pink hue. These pickled red onions pair spectacularly well with tacos, eggs, burgers, grain bowls, and beyond!
ingredients: 3/4 cup TJ’s Organic Raw Apple Cider Vinegar

steps.text: Combine vinegar, water, sugar, salt, and whole peppercorns in a small saucepan and bring to a boil. Remove from heat.
Add onions to a sealable, heat-safe glass or ceramic jar with lid. Carefully pour the warm brine over the onions.
They are ready to use when the onions become bright pink in color, about 20 minutes. After that, cover and keep refrigerated.

quick-pickled-red-onions.title: Quick-Pickled Red Onions

raspberry-dark-chocolate-banana-bread.description: This recipe takes our classic Trader Joe's Banana Bread Mix over the top, with the addition of rich dark chocolate and sweet-tart raspberries for a more dessert-like loaf.
ingredients: TJ’s Canola Oil Spray or Coconut Oil Spray, to grease pan
2 tablespoons TJ’s All-Purpose Flour, plus more for dusting pan
1 cup TJ’s Fresh or Frozen Raspberries, plus a few more for garnish
1/2 cup TJ’s 72% Cacao Dark Chocolate Chips

steps.text: Spray 8” x 4” loaf pan with pan spray and then lightly dust with flour. Shake out excess.
Preheat oven to 350°F.
Slice one banana in half lengthwise—each half should be ¼“ thick for garnishing the banana bread. Set aside the slices. Mash the remaining banana, which should be approximately ½ cup.
Combine the mashed banana, eggs, oil, and water in a bowl. Add the banana bread mix. Stir just until combined (be careful to not overwork the batter).
In a separate bowl, toss the raspberries and chocolate chips with flour to coat. Gently fold the mixture into the banana bread batter.
Pour batter into prepared pan and smooth the top. Arrange the reserved slices of fresh banana and a few raspberries on top.
Bake on center rack of oven for 70-75 minutes, or until loaf is golden brown and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Let loaf cool before slicing and serving.

raspberry-dark-chocolate-banana-bread.title: Raspberry & Dark Chocolate Banana Bread

ratatouille-pasta.description: Based on a traditional Bulgarian recipe (and made in Bulgaria to boot), our Eggplant Garlic Spread is stellar on sandwiches, toast, crackers, and crostini, to be sure. But it also makes for a mighty flavorful addition to a traditional ratatouille—particularly when said ratatouille is paired with penne pasta…
ingredients: 1 small TJ’s Yellow Onion, thinly sliced
2 cups TJ’s Zucchini, chopped into thin half moons
1 can TJ’s Organic Diced & Fire Roasted Tomatoes
1 teaspoon TJ’s Organic Crushed Red Pepper Flakes
¾ bag TJ’s Penne Rigate, prepared according to the package instructions and reserve 1 cup pasta water
⅓ cup chopped TJ’s Fresh Basil
TJ’s Grated Parmesan Cheese, for sprinkling

steps.text: In a large sauté pan over medium-high heat, add olive oil. When the oil is hot, add the onions and zucchini, and cook for about 10 minutes, or when the zucchini begins to soften and brown.
Add the tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the Eggplant Garlic Spread, red pepper flakes, and dried oregano. Using a spatula, scrape the bottom of the pan and incorporate with the sauce.
Lower the heat to medium low and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add cooked pasta and ¼ cup of the remaining pasta water to the simmering sauce. Add more pasta water if the sauce is too thick.
Remove from heat, season with salt to taste, and top with fresh basil and grated Parmesan. Enjoy!

ratatouille-pasta.title: Ratatouille Pasta

raw-cranberry-relish.description: This recipe skips the stove in favor of the food processor to deliver a refreshing relish that's made with raw Trader Joe's Cranberries and just-sweet-enough chunks of fresh apple. With a bite of crystallized ginger and tangy orange juice in the mix, it's a welcome counterpart to rich proteins, and adds oustanding oomph to any Thanksgiving spread.
ingredients: 1 bag TJ's Cranberries, rinsed and drained
1 medium-sized TJ's Honeycrisp Apple, peeled and cut into large chunks
A sprig of TJ's Thyme, destemmed
Zest and 1/4 cup juice from 1 TJ's Orange

steps.text: Add cranberries, apple chunks, thyme, nutmeg, salt, and orange zest to bowl of a food processor. Pulse 15 times to create a chunky relish. Add orange juice and pulse a couple more times to combine.
Transfer mixture to a bowl and fold in ginger, walnuts, and honey. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour and up to 1 day before serving.

raw-cranberry-relish.title: Raw Cranberry Relish

red-curry-chicken-drumsticks.description: Trader Joe’s All Natural Chicken Drumsticks cook up moist and tender whether they’re slathered in barbecue sauce and grilled, battered and fried, or marinated in TJ’s Thai Style Red Curry Sauce and roasted in the oven.
ingredients: 1 jar TJ’s Thai Style Red Curry Sauce
1 1/2 pounds TJ's All Natural Chicken Drumsticks
1 cup TJ's Honey Sesame Cashews, chopped
A handful of chopped TJ’s Green Onions, to garnish

steps.text: Combine curry sauce and drumsticks in a large bowl or sealable bag and marinate covered in the refrigerator for 30 minutes. About 10 minutes before you’re ready to cook, remove drumsticks from the refrigerator and preheat oven to 375°F.
Remove drumsticks from bowl and place onto a baking sheet or roasting pan, lightly greased with canola oil spray.
Place sheet on the center rack of the oven and bake for about 20 minutes, when the sauce begins to thicken.

Remove the baking sheet from the oven and sprinkle drumsticks with cashew pieces. Return sheet to oven and bake for another 5 minutes, or until the cashew pieces begin to brown and chicken reaches internal temperature of 165°F. Remove drumsticks from oven and let cool slightly before serving with a sprinkle of chopped green onions and cilantro.

red-curry-chicken-drumsticks.title: Red Curry Chicken Drumsticks

refreshing-raspberry-lemonade.description: Vibrantly colored and pleasantly tart, Trader Joe’s Organic Lemonade is cleverly complemented by sweet raspberries and herbal basil in this easy-to-assemble summer sipper. It’s delightful on its own and makes a fantastic base for batch cocktails — just add your favorite spirit.
ingredients: 10 TJ’s Basil Leaves, plus more for garnish
2 TJ’s Lemons, sliced into rounds for garnish

steps.text: In a large pitcher, muddle a handful of frozen raspberries with 10 basil leaves to release their flavors.
Add lemonade and the remaining frozen raspberries to the pitcher. Stir to combine.
Pour into glasses and garnish with a lemon slice and basil leaf to serve.

refreshing-raspberry-lemonade.title: Refreshing Raspberry Lemonade

ricotta-pesto-tear-share.description:
Looking for a showstopping appetizer for your next dinner or cocktail party? We’ve added pesto and ricotta cheese between two Trader Joe’s All Butter Puff Pastry Sheets for an impressive tear and share treat that’s as delicious to eat as it is delightful to look at.

Pro-tip: Chilled puff pastry is easier to work with than room temperature puff pastry. While you’re working with one sheet, keep the other in the refrigerator until ready to use.
ingredients: TJ’s Unbleached Enriched All-Purpose Flour, for dusting
1 box TJ’s All Butter Puff Pastry Sheets, thawed according to package instruction
½ cup TJ’s Part Skim Ricotta
¼ cup TJ’s Vegan Kale, Cashew, & Basil Pesto
A handful of TJ’s Grape Tomatoes, thinly sliced

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400° F. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper and set aside.
Lightly dust your work surface with flour and unroll one thawed sheet of puff pastry.
Using a rolling pin, roll the sheet out until it is the diameter of a dinner plate.
Place dinner plate on top of puff pastry sheet (with the bottom of the plate facing up) and cut around the plate with a knife. Remove the plate and excess dough.
Place puff pastry circle on lined baking sheet and refrigerate while you repeat these steps with the second sheet of puff pastry.

To assemble:
Remove baking sheet from refrigerator and use a spoon or spatula to spread ricotta over the chilled puff pastry circle, leaving a quarter-inch border along the outside edge. Top with pesto, leaving the same quarter-inch border.
Place second circle of pastry over the first and seal the edges together with your fingertips.
Place a glass upside down in the center of the circle. Using a knife, make four cuts from the edge of the glass to the outside of the ring, in the directions of north, south, east, and west.
Repeat step by cutting in the center of each quarter.
Repeat once more by cutting in between each eighth. You should now have 16 segments of dough. Remove the glass.

For tear and share twists: Select alternating twists (or you can twist them all) and one at a time, gently lift the pastry segment off the baking sheet and twist the dough two times. Be sure not to twist too tightly or the pastry will not cook through.
Apply egg wash to the top of the dough by using a pastry brush or a paper towel. Then decoratively adorn with slices of tomato.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, until golden brown. Let cool 10 minutes before serving.

ricotta-pesto-tear-share.title: Ricotta & Pesto Tear & Share

ridge-crispy-smoreover-bars.description: Ridiculous with Ridge Cut Potato Chips, Marshmallows, Butter and a rainbow of Bite-Sized Candy Coated Milk Chocolate Candies, these bars pack craveable sweet-and-salty cunch. Scrumptiously irresistible!
ingredients: 1 bag TJ's Ridge Cut Potato Chips with Sea Salt, crushed
1 bag TJ's Bite-Sized Candy Coated Milk Chocolate Candies or TJ's Candy Coated Milk Chocolate Dipped Peanuts

steps.text: Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium-high heat. Stir in marshmallows and melt completely.
In a large mixing bowl, pour the crushed chips, followed by the melted marshmallow and mix together thoroughly (take care to use utensils while mixing - the melted marshmallows are HOT!).
Fold in the chocolate candies, and then press the mixture into a 9"x 13"baking pan (you can use 9"x 9"if you like your bars super dense).
Let cool (place in freezer for 5 minutes to expedite); cut and serve.

ridge-crispy-smoreover-bars.title: Ridge Crispy S'moreover Bars

risotto-stuffed-delicata-squash.description:
Trader Joe’s Delicata Squash is a culinary treasure! It’s classified as a winter squash because when raw, its outer skin is hard like a butternut—but botanically, it’s more closely related to summer squashes like zucchini. When cooked, the striped skin softens and becomes edible (read: no peeling necessary!).

Sliced into rings or rippled half-moons and roasted, Delicata Squash is a festive side dish for an autumnally-inspired meal. Or for a meatless main dish, roasted Squash halves are comestible containers for a variety of fillings. How about Delicata Squash stuffed with TJ’s Mushroom Risotto? Yes, please!
ingredients: 1-2 TJ’s Delicata Squash (depending on size), sliced in half lengthwise, seeds removed
2 tablespoons of your favorite TJ’s Olive Oil
3 cups TJ’s Organic Tuscan Kale, destemmed
1/3 cup TJ’s Unsalted Dry Toasted Pecan Pieces
1/2 cup grated TJ’s Black Pepper Toscano Cheese, divided

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Drizzle olive oil over each delicata half. Season with salt. Roast skin side up for 20-25 minutes, or until you can easily pierce the squash with a fork.

While the squash roasts, prepare the filling: Add 1/2 cup of water, risotto, and kale to a large sauté pan over medium heat. Cover, stirring occasionally, and cook for about 7 minutes, until the risotto is heated through, and the kale has softened. Remove from heat. Add pecans, cranberries and ¼ cup grated cheese, and stir to combine.

Remove squash from oven. Carefully flip the squash and divide the filling among the squash halves. Top with remaining 1/4 cup of grated cheese, then return to the oven and roast for an additional 10 minutes.
Drizzle with glaze to serve.

risotto-stuffed-delicata-squash.title: Risotto-Stuffed Delicata Squash

roasted-brussels-sprouts.description:
The Christmas Trees of Thanksgiving, Trader Joe's Brussels Sprouts Stalks herald the start of the season. You can decorate them and showcase them as a point of commune and celebration. But, unlike the iconic evergreens, these enchanting offerings of Brassica buds spiraled around a sturdy stem can be eaten, too. The sprouts can be removed and then broiled, steamed or sautéed separately. Or, give your turkey a run for its centerpiece money and roast the whole stalk in the oven, complete with a sweet maple & olive oil glaze.     

Only available for a short growing period, Brussels Sprouts Stalks are limited in quantity, so make it a ritual to select your fresh, seasonal stalks soon!
ingredients: 3/4 cup of your favorite TJ's Maple Syrup
1/4 cup of your favorite TJ’s Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4 teaspoon TJ's Ground Black Pepper, or to taste
1/4 teaspoon TJ's Sea Salt, or to taste
TJ's Dried Cranberries or TJ's Fresh Pomegranate Seeds, for garnish

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F. Trim the stalk down to the fullest, best looking part. Trim sprouts off one side to make a flat bottom. Trim any "tough"leaves from the sprouts. Rinse stalk and trimmed sprouts well in fresh water. Wrap damp stalk in cling wrap and heat in the microwave for 4-5 minutes. Place the trimmed loose sprouts in a bowl, cover with cling wrap and microwave for 3 minutes

Whisk maple syrup and olive oil together. Place stalk flat side down along with any loose sprouts on a roasting pan and pour the maple syrup mixture over. Use a pastry brush to mop the maple syrup onto all sides of the sprouts and stalk. Season, to taste, with salt and pepper.
Place pan in oven and roast for 45 minutes, or until sprouts on stalk are fork-tender and caramelized to a golden color.
To serve: Place stalk on a holiday platter, pour any syrup from roasting pan over and garnish with something bright and tart such as dried cranberries or fresh pomegranate seeds.

roasted-brussels-sprouts.title: Roasted Brussels Sprouts

roasted-carrots-of-many-colors.description: Trader Joe's Organic Carrots of Many Colors taste like carrots-no surprise there-but their color really pops on a plate. Slice these vibrant taproots into spears, present them on a tray, and serve them with your favorite dip. Or toss them with olive oil, thyme, and salt & pepper, and roast them for about 20 minutes. The earthy, sweet flavor of these roasted carrots is equally at home alongside an Easter ham or Thanksgiving turkey dinner.
ingredients: 1 package (2 pounds) TJ's Organic Carrots Of Many Colors, rinsed and dried
1 tablespoon TJ's Organic Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tablespoon TJ's Organic Apple Cider Vinegar OR Balsamic Vinegar

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper, set aside.

Peel carrots and trim ends, discard ends and peels. Slice carrots in half crosswise, then slice in half lengthwise. Add carrots to a large bowl and drizzle with olive oil, vinegar, and salt, and toss to coat. Spread carrots evenly on prepared baking sheet and tuck a few sprigs of fresh thyme in between the carrots.

Place baking sheet on center rack of oven and roast 15-20 minutes, until carrots are fork tender. Turn oven to broil (high) and broil carrots 2-3 minutes (watch carefully to avoid burning). Remove sheet from oven and let cool 5 minutes before serving.

roasted-carrots-of-many-colors.title: Roasted Carrots Of Many Colors

roasted-lemon-garlic-artichokes.description: Add instant sophistication to any soiree with a few of these roasted artichokes.
ingredients: 1 package TJ's Globe Artichokes (4 count - Seasonal)
1 package TJ's Premium Peeled Garlic Cloves
2 tablespoons of your favorite TJ’s Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4 teaspoon TJ's Sea Salt, or to taste
1/4 teaspoon TJ's Ground Black Pepper, or to taste
TJ's Aioli Garlic Mustard Sauce, for dipping

steps.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Trim half an inch off the top of each artichoke, and cut in half lengthwise, being mindful of the spines. Using a sharp pairing knife, cut out the non-edible purple leaves and the hairy fibers in the center, forming a pocket.

Working in batches, place artichokes, leaf-side down, in a shallow bowl and squeeze half a lemon over the outside and inside of each artichoke, then place one or two garlic cloves in the center pocket. Drizzle the inside of each with half a tablespoon of olive oil and sprinkle liberally with salt and pepper. Tightly wrap each artichoke half in large, individual foil pieces.

Arrange foil-wrapped artichokes in a large baking dish. Bake for 45 minutes until tender. Once cool enough to handle, being mindful of the steam, remove artichokes from foil. Serve immediately with smoked aioli for dipping.

roasted-lemon-garlic-artichokes.title: Roasted Lemon-Garlic Artichokes

roasted-pork-tenderloin-potatoes-honey-u.description:
The secret to attaining the ultra-savory flavor and inviting aroma of this dish is Trader Joe’s Mushroom & Company Multipurpose Umami Seasoning Blend. Used thrice in this recipe, it seasons TJ’s Pork Tenderloin and Dutch Yellow Baby Potatoes, and is responsible for the Umami notes in the finishing butter. 

Pro-tip: Don’t skip the spud prep! Slicing the potatoes lengthwise ensures they finish cooking at the same time as the tenderloin.
ingredients: TJ’s Mushroom & Company Multipurpose Umami Seasoning Blend
1 bag TJ’s Dutch Yellow Baby Potatoes, sliced in half, lengthwise
½ stick TJ’s Unsalted Butter, softened
1 tablespoon of your favorite TJ’s Honey

steps.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.

Evenly coat pork with about 1 tablespoon of umami seasoning. Add 1 tablespoon oil to cast iron pan over medium-high heat. Once oil is hot, add seasoned pork loin. Use tongs to turn the pork loin until seared on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.

In a medium-sized bowl, add sliced potatoes, 2 tablespoons oil, and 2 teaspoons umami seasoning. Toss to evenly coat. Carefully add potatoes to the cast iron pan around the pork loin. Place pan in oven and cook for about 25 minutes, or until the pork loin reaches an internal temperature between 145°F-160°F and the potatoes are fork tender
While the pork and potatoes are roasting, prepare the honey umami butter by combining softened butter, honey, and 1 tablespoon umami seasoning in a medium-sized bowl with a spatula.
Carefully remove cast iron pan from oven. Spoon butter over the cooked pork loin and potatoes to serve.

roasted-pork-tenderloin-potatoes-honey-u.title: Roasted Pork Tenderloin & Potatoes with Honey Umami Butter

roasted-shishito-pepper-sauce.description: Drizzle this kicky sauce over fish tacos or spread it on a BLT for an unexpected pop of flavor.
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon TJ’s Sea Salt, or to taste
1/4 teaspoon TJ’s Ground Black Pepper, or to taste

steps.text: Pour 1 tablespoon olive oil in a heavy skillet over medium-high heat. Add the peppers and sauté about 3-5 minutes, turning occasionally until they blister on all sides. Remove peppers from heat and slice off the stems and discard. Combine shishito peppers, 2 tablespoons olive oil, 2 tablespoons lime juice, 2 tablespoons greek yogurt, 2 garlic cloves and salt and pepper in a blender. Pulse until desired consistency. Taste and adjust seasoning as desired. Makes about 1/2 cup of sauce.
Serving ideas: Dress a Southwestern salad (butter lettuce, corn, beans, tomatoes, red onion and tortilla chips), drizzle over shrimp tacos, or spread on a BLT sandwich

roasted-shishito-pepper-sauce.title: Roasted Shishito Pepper Sauce

roasted-squash-salad.description: Any of our Trader Joe's Extra Virgin Olive Oils function beautifully for your general cooking needs, but we also like them drizzled over simple salads like this one-where the oil's verdant notes an really "sing" alongside ingredients like peppery arugula, tangy goat cheese, & warm, sweet squash...
ingredients: TJ's Pumpkin Pie Pumpkin (seasonal) or your favorite TJ's squash
1 whole TJ's Chevre Goat Cheese Log (5 oz.)
1/3 cup TJ's Raw Pumpkin Seeds, dry toasted
2 tablespoons of your favorite TJ's Extra Virgin Olive Oil
TJ's Canola Oil Spray (to grease sheet pan)

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a sheet pan with parchment paper and spray lightly with canola oil spray.
Using a sharp knife, remove top of pumpkin and cut pumpkin in half lengthwise. Then use a sharp spoon or ice cream scoop to scrape out all of the seeds and strings.
Brush the pumpkin flesh with melted butter and cover in brown sugar.
Place pumpkin flesh-side down on the lined baking pan and pierce a few times with a fork.
Bake for 30-35 minutes or until a fork easily pierces the skin. Remove from oven and let cool slightly.
Using your ice cream scoop or spoon, scoop pumpkin flesh from the skin and place it into a bowl. Lightly mash.
Place arugula in a medium bowl and place cooked pumpkin on top. Add cheese (hand-tear the log into smaller pieces as desired, add pumpkin seeds, and drizzle with olive oil. Enjoy immediately.

roasted-squash-salad.title: Roasted Squash Salad

roasted-strawberry-spinach-salad.description: Roasting Trader Joe's Strawberries turns them into a delightfully sticky-sweet foil to earthy, TJ's Organic Baby Spinach and our rich Chevre with Honey.
ingredients: 1 pound TJ's Strawberries, cleaned, dried and hulled
1 tablespoon of your favorite TJ's Extra Virgin Olive Oil
6 oz TJ’s Organic Baby Spinach (1 package)
1/3 cup TJ's Chevre Log with Honey, crumbled

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Slice strawberries in half lengthwise. Toss with olive oil and place on a foil lined baking sheet.  Cook for 15 minutes.
Toss cookied berries with balsamic glaze and then set aside to cool.
Once the strawberries have cooled, combine with spinach and cheese. Toss and serve.

roasted-strawberry-spinach-salad.title: Roasted Strawberry & Spinach Salad

roasted-veggie-bowl.description: By combining the bright, zesty tomato and pepper flavors of a traditional chunky salsa with the texture and nuttiness of finely chopped pepitas, Trader Joe's Pepita Salsa has created a savory synthesis of seed and spice. Each bite carries the delicate sweet heat of puréed bell pepper and chipotle spices, making this one seriously satisfying salsa for scooping with tortilla chips or drizzling atop a hearty roasted veggie bowl.
ingredients: 1 package TJ's Frozen Brown Rice, microwaved according to package directions
2 cups of your favorite roasted vegetables, cold or warm (we used Brussels Sprouts & Delicata Squash, feel free to sub in whatever you have on hand)

steps.text: Divide rice among two serving bowls. Top each bowl with roasted veggies, a handful of kale and half an avocado. Drizzle with salsa and enjoy.

roasted-veggie-bowl.title: Roasted Veggie Bowl

rosemary-almond-olive-oil-sundae.description: Grown on the Mediterranean coast of Spain, Trader Joe’s Roasted & Salted Rosemary Marcona Almonds are a true treat. You can add them to cheeseboards, serve them in salads, and snack on them right out of the bag, and we’d be remiss not to mention that they make a surprisingly superb ice cream topping, served with a drizzle of olive oil in place of a typical chocolate or caramel sauce.
ingredients: 3 scoops TJ’s Super Premium French Vanilla Ice Cream
3 tablespoons TJ’s Roasted & Salted Rosemary Marcona Almonds, chopped
A small sprig of TJ’s Fresh Rosemary, chopped
3 tablespoons of your favorite TJ’s Extra Virgin Olive Oil

steps.text: Add ice cream to a small serving bowl. Top with chopped almonds and few rosemary leaves. Drizzle with olive to serve.

rosemary-almond-olive-oil-sundae.title: Rosemary, Almond, & Olive Oil Sundae

rumble-cakes.description: Let this recipe answer the clamoring call when a decadent dessert is what you desire.
ingredients: 1 stick TJ's Unsalted Butter, softened to room temperature
1/4 cup TJ's Walnut Halves and Pieces
1 package TJ's Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough, softened to room temperature

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350°F. In a large bowl, whisk butter and eggs. Add brownie mix and stir gently, just until combined. Fold in cherries and walnuts; set aside.

Grease an 8-inch square baking pan with canola oil spray. Place softened cookie dough chunks haphazardly around the bottom of the pan (there may be a few pieces of cookie dough leftover; do with them what you must). Pour the brownie mix evenly over the cookie dough and smooth out the top with a spatula.

Place pan on center rack of oven and bake 30-35 minutes, until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Remove pan from oven and let brownies cool slightly prior to slicing and serving. Enjoy as-is, or alongside a scoop of TJ's French Vanilla Ice Cream.

rumble-cakes.title: Rumble Cakes

salad-stuffed-sweet-potatoes.description: This recipe takes Trader Joe's Sweet Potatoes from sweetheart side dish to center of the plate stardom.
ingredients: 1 Tbsp TJ's 100% Greek Kalamata Olive Oil
1/2 cup TJ's Roasted and Salted Pecans, chopped

steps.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Wash potatoes and pat dry. Rub olive oil over the skins then place potatoes directly on center rack of oven.
Bake potatoes for 45 minutes or until a fork easily pierces the skin. Remove from oven and slice down the center, halfway through, making sure not cut all the way through to the bottom.
In a medium bowl, combine arugula, sliced beets, blue cheese and salted pecans. Toss the salad gently with tongs, then divide evenly among sweet potatoes. Garnish with balsamic glaze. Enjoy!

salad-stuffed-sweet-potatoes.title: Salad Stuffed Sweet Potatoes

salad-topped-murasaki-sweet-potatoes.description: Trader Joe’s Murasaki Sweet Potatoes are dark purple on the outside, and cream colored on the inside. Eye-catching! When you cut them open, your expectations simply don’t match up with what you’re seeing. They look like a russet, so they should taste like a russet, right? Nope. They’re fluffy & sweet, through and through, with just a hint of chestnut flavor. Roast & serve with butter for a simple, savory side dish, or top the roasted potatoes with TJ's Legume & Spinach Salad for a hearty, meatless meal with minimal prep.
ingredients: 4 TJ's Murasaki Sweet Potatoes (double quantity if potatoes are on the smaller side)

steps.text: Bake The Potatoes: Preheat oven to 425ºF. Pierce potatoes with a fork and arrange evenly on a baking sheet. Bake on center rack of oven for about 45 minutes, until potatoes yield to gentle pressure and flesh pierces easily with a fork. Remove from oven and set aside.

Plate & Serve: Combine salad with desired amount of dressing in a large bowl, set aside. When potatoes are cool enough to handle, slice in half lengthwise and arrange face-up on a serving platter. Arrange dressed salad evenly atop the potatoes, followed by a healthy handful of crumbled goat cheese, if desired. Dig in!

salad-topped-murasaki-sweet-potatoes.title: Salad-Topped Murasaki Sweet Potatoes

salted-caramel-speculoos-milkshake.description: If you look up "gilding the lily" in the dictionary, you'll find a photo of this droolworthy milkshake.
ingredients: 4 scoops TJ's Cookie Butter Ice Cream or TJ's French Vanilla Ice Cream
1 Tbsp TJ's Fleur de Sel Caramel Sauce

steps.text: In a blender, pulse together ice cream, caramel sauce, cookies, milk and ice until smooth.
Pour into a glass and top with whipped cream, Speculoos cookie crumbles and more caramel sauce.

salted-caramel-speculoos-milkshake.title: Salted Caramel Speculoos Milkshake

salted-maple-walnut-pie.description:
Akin to a Southern pecan pie, this dessert gives bicoastal vibes, thanks to Trader Joe’s Organic Vermont Maple Syrup and TJ’s California Walnut Halves & Pieces. The Maple and nutty notes in the filling are enhanced with salt for a decidedly balanced bite, and we even recommend a generous sprinkle as a final garnish atop every slice. 

A Note On Timing: While you’ll need about eight hours to make this pie, most of that time is inactive—the cook time includes 1 1/2 hours to thaw the crust and 4 1/2 hours hours to cool the finished pie.

Pro-tip: Don't skip the refrigerator chill after your pie cools. This step ensures your pie doesn't ooze when sliced (though, it will still be delicious.)
ingredients: 1 TJ’s Pie Crust, thawed according to package instructions
3 cups uncooked TJ’s Rice (or pie weights)
2 cups TJ’s California Walnut Halves & Pieces, roughly chopped
1 ½ cups TJ’s Heavy Cream, plus more for brushing over the crust
1 ½ cups TJ’s Organic Vermont Maple Syrup
½ teaspoon TJ’s Sea Salt, plus a few cranks to serve

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F. Roll thawed pie crust into a pie pan, poke the bottom of the crust a few times with fork tines, crimp the edges, if you’d like (check out the technique in this video!), then add a sheet of foil or parchment to the center of the pie and fill with uncooked rice (or pie weights, if you have them.) Bake for 20 minutes. Remove from oven and carefully remove the rice and foil/parchment, then return to the oven for an additional 5 minutes, until the crust just begins to become golden in color.
steps.title: Blind Bake the Crust

steps.text: Place walnuts on a baking sheet and toast in oven for 7-10 minutes, until golden in color and fragrant. Remove from oven and let cool.
steps.title: Prepare the Filling

steps.text: In a medium-sized saucepan, combine heavy cream and flour over medium-low heat, and whisk to combine. Add maple syrup and butter, and cook for 7-10 minutes, whisking constantly, until mixture has thickened. Remove from heat. Add salt, then stir in walnuts.
Place prepared pie crust on a baking sheet, then carefully pour in filling. Gently brush heavy cream over the edges of the pie dough. Bake for 35-45 minutes, until filling bubbles.
steps.title: Bake

steps.text: Remove from oven and let cool for at least 30 minutes. Refrigerate until completely chilled, four hours to overnight, before slicing. Serve with a sprinkle of salt.
steps.title: Cool

salted-maple-walnut-pie.title: Salted Maple Walnut Pie

salted-pots-de-creme.description:
A pot de crème, translated from French, means “pot of cream.” In our “pots,” we’re serving up a decadent, dark chocolate custard that is gently baked to yield an ultra-smooth and lusciously creamy texture. And to top it off (literally), each pot gets a generous sprinkle of Trader Joe’s Portuguese Flor de Sal—the key ingredient that adds depth and balance to every bite.

For your next dinner party, serve each guest their own pot de crème—and leave the ceramic Portuguese Flor de Sal crock on the table so they can sprinkle these delicate flakes over every bite!
ingredients: 1 ½ cup TJ’s Organic Heavy Cream
1 bar TJ’s Organic Dark Chocolate Bar 73%
4 egg yolks from TJ’s Eggs, egg whites reserved for another use
TJ’s Portuguese Flor de Sal, for sprinkling

steps.text: Preheat oven to 325°F.
In a small saucepan over medium-low heat, heat heavy cream and milk until steaming, but not yet boiling, then remove from stove.
Break up chocolate into small pieces and add to the pot, stirring with a whisk, until completely melted.
In a medium-sized bowl, whisk egg yolks and sugar.

Slowly add a small amount of the warm chocolate mixture to the egg yolks, whisking to help incorporate. Note: if you add too much chocolate mixture too quickly, the eggs can curdle. Continue to slowly add and whisk the chocolate into the yolks until completely incorporated.
Pour mixture into oven-safe ramekins and place ramekins in a baking dish with sides at least as tall as the ramekins
Pour enough boiling water in the baking dish so the water reaches halfway up the ramekins—taking extra care to ensure the water does not get in any of the ramekins.
Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove from oven and carefully transfer ramekins from the baking dish and into the refrigerator to chill for 2 hours.
To serve, sprinkle with flor de sal.

salted-pots-de-creme.title: Salted Dark Chocolate Pots de Crême

salty-maple-cold-foam.description:
A jar of Trader Joe’s Organic Maple Butter contains a single ingredient: organic maple syrup, that’s been whipped into a thick, spreadable, and delicious butter-like consistency. It’s fantastic on French toast, marvelous mixed into yogurt, enchanting as an accompaniment to a cheese board, and wonderful whipped into a coffeeshop-like cold foam to top a cup of coffee. 

To really fall-ify your morning brew, try adding this cold foam atop an iced coffee using TJ’s Pumpkin Spice Flavored Cold Brew Coffee Concentrate or a mug of TJ’s Autumn Maple Coffee. Mmmmmaple!

steps.text: In a measuring cup or tall glass, add heavy cream, whole milk, and maple butter. Stir to slacken the maple butter.

Use a milk frother or whisk to aerate the mixture until it has thickened and becomes foamy, about 1 minute. Alternatively, add mixture to a jar with a lid and shake until the same results are achieved, about 3 minutes.
Top with one or two cranks of sea salt.

Place a spoon, curved side up, over your cup of coffee, resting the tip of the spoon on the inner wall of the mug or glass just above the coffee. Pour the foam over the back of spoon to help create a thick, even layer of foam.

salty-maple-cold-foam.title: Salty Maple Cold Foam

sams-sweet-potato-soup.description: This rustic soup is comprised of a simple stack of TJ’s pantry and produce basics, and bolstered by a box of Trader Joe’s Pearled Couscous—tiny, delicate orbs with a pasta-like chew. This soup screams, or rather gently whispers, cozy with every spoonful. What’s the secret to Crew Member Sam’s Sweet Potato Soup success, you ask? It’s a couple teaspoons of TJ's Taco Seasoning Mix sprinkled in with the broth to add a little extra oomph!
ingredients: 2 medium-sized Sweet Potatoes, peeled and cubed
6 cups TJ's Low Sodium Vegetable Broth

steps.text: In a large pot, heat oil over medium heat. Add onion and sweet potato and sauté 5 minutes. Add couscous and sauté 5 minutes to toast.

Add vegetable broth and taco seasoning. Reduce heat and simmer until sweet potatoes are fork-tender, 25-30 minutes. Add kale and simmer 5 minutes more until wilted. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Ladle soup into large bowls and serve with crusty bread for dipping.

sams-sweet-potato-soup.title: Sam’s Sweet Potato Soup

sausage-kale-stuffing.description: Subtly sweet and not too hot, Trader Joe's Sweet Italian Pork Sausage is pre-seasoned and ready to star in everything from sausage & peppers to meat sauce. Add to it this stuffing recipe for your Turkey Day Feast, and be prepared for coworkers to ask, "What's that delicious smell?" when you reheat leftovers for lunch.
ingredients: 1 lb. TJ's Sweet Italian Pork Sausage or Hot Italian Pork Sausage, casing removed
1 package TJ's Organic Cooked & Peeled Chestnuts, halved
TJ's Shaved Parmesan, Romano & Asiago Cheese
TJ's Cranberry Sauce & Turkey Gravy, for serving (optional)

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease a 13x9-inch casserole dish with canola oil spray and set aside.

In a large saucepan, mix butter, water and seasoning pouch from stuffing mix and bring to a low boil for 3-5 minutes. Remove from heat and gently fold in croutons until thoroughly moistened. Transfer to a large bowl, cover and let sit 10 minutes.

While stuffing sits, heat a large sauté pan or skillet over medium. Add sausage to pan and sauté, stirring occasionally, until cooked through, about 8 minutes. Add kale to pan and sauté a few minutes more to wilt. Remove from heat and stir in chestnuts.
Gently fold sausage mixture into stuffing until evenly distributed. Transfer to casserole dish in an even layer. Top with a generous handful of cheese.

Place dish on center rack of oven and bake until center is heated through and top is golden brown, 30-45 minutes. Remove stuffing from oven and let cool slightly. Serve with gravy and cranberry sauce on the side.

sausage-kale-stuffing.title: Sausage & Kale Stuffing

sausage-veggies.description: Veggies seem to be at their most craveable when roasted. Paired with Spicy Italian Chicken Sausage and Rice Medley, they make for a filling, fantastically prepped meal you can enjoy all week long.
ingredients: 2 TJ's Russet Potatoes, rinsed and dried
1 TJ's Yellow Onion, rinsed and dried
3 TJ's Whole Organic Carrots, rinsed and dried
1 bag TJ’s Tricolor Peppers, rinsed and dried
1 bag TJ’s Organic Broccoli Florets, rinsed and dried
1 package TJ’s Spicy Italian Chicken Sausages (or your favorite TJ's fully cooked chicken sausage)
3 tablespoons TJ’s Extra Virgin Olive Oil, divided

steps.text: You will need 5 microwave-safe food storage containers for daily meal prep.
Adjust oven racks to upper and lower level of oven. Preheat oven to 400°F and line two large baking sheets with parchment paper; set aside.

Cube potatoes, onion and carrots. In a large bowl, gently toss cubed veggies with 1 tablespoon olive oil, 1 teaspoon seasoning and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Spread veggie mixture evenly on baking sheet. Bake on upper rack of oven for 10 minutes.

While potatoes, onion and carrots are baking, roughly chop peppers and broccoli. Slice sausages. In a large bowl, gently toss peppers, broccoli and sausages with 2 tablespoons olive oil, 1 teaspoon seasoning and 1/2 teaspoon salt. Spread mixture evenly on second baking sheet and set aside.

After 10 minutes, move the baking sheet with veggie mixture to the bottom rack of oven. Place the sheet with the sausage mixture on the upper rack of oven. Bake 20-25 minutes, until veggies are fork-tender. Remove both sheets from oven and set aside to cool.

Assemble meals: Microwave rice according to package directions. Combine the veggie and sausage mixtures in a large bowl, tossing gently to combine. Lay out five food storage containers. Divide rice evenly among containers. Divide veggie sausage mixture evenly among containers. Cover and refrigerate until ready to eat.
Remove lid from container and place in microwave. Heat in one minute increments, stirring occasionally, until heated through. Enjoy!
steps.title: To reheat:

sausage-veggies.title: Sausage & Veggies

scallop-ceviche.description: Trader Joe’s Patagonian Scallops are prized for their sweet flavor, tender texture, and bite-sized stature. Owing to their small proportions, these frozen Scallops easily thaw inside the refrigerator or in the bag submerged in cold water, after which they’re ready for all manner of recipes. Seared in a pan, cooked into chowder, served over pasta, or as the star of this ceviche, these Scallops sure are versatile!
ingredients: 1 package TJ’s Patagonian Scallops, thawed according to package instructions
½ small TJ’s Red Onion, finely chopped
½ TJ’s Red Bell Pepper, diced
½ cup TJ’s Fresh Mango, diced
1 TJ’s Jalapeño, diced (remove seeds if you prefer less spice)
1 cup freshly squeezed juice from TJ’s Limes
¼ cup roughly chopped TJ’s Fresh Cilantro
TJ’s Organic Yellow Corn Tortilla Chips Rounds, for serving

steps.text: Combine thawed scallops, onion, bell pepper, mango,  jalapeño, and lime juice in a large bowl, and toss to combine. Cover and chill for 30-45 minutes, or until scallops turn opaque.
Add cilantro, season with salt to taste, and serve with tortilla chips.

scallop-ceviche.title: Scallop Ceviche

sea-salted-saddle-crisp-salsa-snackers.description: Trader Joe's Sea Salted Saddle Potato Crisps are made from a combination of dried potatoes, corn meal, and rice flour and formed into perfectly "saddle-shaped" Crisps, hence the name we've chosen for these choice chips. They're cooked in sunflower oil to peak addictive crispiness, then Sea Salted juuust right for solo snacking (but in our humble opinion, a scoop of pico de gallo and a sprinkle of cheese never hurt anyone).
ingredients: TJ's Sea Salted Saddle Potato Crisps
TJ's Pico de Gallo Salsa (Mild or Hot, your choice!)
TJ's Fancy Shredded Mexican Cheese Blend

steps.text: Top a saddle crisp with a scoop of pico de gallo and sprinkle with cheese. Top with cilantro and enjoy immediately.

sea-salted-saddle-crisp-salsa-snackers.title: Sea Salted Saddle Crisp Salsa Snackers

seared-salmon-pickled-cucumbers.description:
