This seared salmon gets its savory, complex flavor from a 30-minute rest in an Organic Coconut Aminos Seasoning Sauce-infused marinade—which also serves as the base of a lemony, glossy finishing sauce for serving the fish. While the salmon marinates, you can whip up a batch of quick-pickled cucumbers, enjoy an evening walk, or kick back and relax until it’s time to fire up the burner.

Pro-tip: the finishing sauce comes together very quickly—be sure to have the finishing sauce ingredients measured and ready to go before you cook the salmon.
ingredients: 4 tablespoons your favorite TJ’s Extra Virgin Olive Oil
Zest and 1 tablespoon juice of a TJ’s Lemon, divided
1/3 cup TJ’s Organic Coconut Aminos Seasoning Sauce
2 cloves TJ’s Garlic, peeled and finely minced
¼ cup plus 1 tablespoon chopped TJs Fresh Dill, divided (reserve a few fronds for garnish)
1 package (1¼ or 1½ pounds) TJ’s Boneless Skinless Fresh Atlantic Salmon Fillet, cut into 4 portions
¾ package TJ’s Organic Persian Cucumbers
¼ cup TJ’s Organic Apple Cider Vinegar
¼ of a TJ’s Red Onion, very thinly sliced
4 tablespoons TJ’s Unsalted Butter, cut into small cubes
TJ’s Frozen Brown or Jasmine Rice, cooked according to package directions

steps.text:
Prep the marinade:
In a shallow dish or resealable bag, combine the olive oil, lemon zest, black pepper, coconut aminos, garlic, and ¼ cup chopped dill. Add salmon, turning the pieces over a few times to coat. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes (or up to overnight), turning the pieces halfway through, if possible.

Prep the quick-pickled cucumbers:
Using a vegetable peeler, strip long ribbons lengthwise from the cucumber, stopping when you reach the seedy core (you can snack on the core or reserve for another use). Cover and refrigerate cucumber ribbons until ready to use.

In a medium bowl, whisk the apple cider vinegar, sugar and salt. Toss the red onions in the vinegar mixture and let sit 5 minutes, or refrigerate until ready to use (up to 24 hours).

Just prior to cooking the salmon, toss the cucumber ribbons with the pickled onion mixture and stir in the remaining chopped dill.

Cook the salmon:
Heat a large, non-stick pan or oiled grill pan over medium high heat. Gently place the salmon pieces in the hot pan (reserve marinade). Reduce heat to medium, cover the pan, and cook the salmon approximately 4 minutes on each side, or until the internal temperature reaches 135°F.  Transfer salmon to a plate.

Finish the sauce:
Add marinade to the hot pan and bring to a vigorous boil over high heat for 1 full minute. Turn off the heat, add lemon juice, and swirl in the butter to create a glossy sauce. (If the sauce becomes too thick, add a tablespoon of hot water, a little at a time, while whisking.)

To serve:
Plate salmon with a side of steamed rice. Drizzle sauce over salmon and garnish with dill fronds. Use tongs to lift the pickled cucumber mixture out of the vinegar and drain the liquid, then swirl into a “nest” and plate alongside the salmon. Dig in!

seared-salmon-pickled-cucumbers.title: Seared Salmon & Quick-Pickled Cucumbers

sesame-quinoa-salad.description:
Some like it hot, but we like this grain salad at room temperature. It’s a great side dish to serve when you don’t want to spend all day in the kitchen or while you’re outside tending to the grill. Add a bag of Trader Joe’s Sugar Snap Peas for a pop of color and snappy crunch. Plus, they can even be steamed in its microwavable package for one less dish to wash—talk about convenient! In addition to dressing this salad, try marinating your protein in Trader Joe’s Organic Toasted Sesame Dressing before it goes on the grill for plenty of umami goodness throughout your entire meal!

Tip: Cool the cooked quinoa and thaw the pineapple ahead of time so you can assemble right before you’re ready to serve.
ingredients: 1 cup TJ's Organic Tricolor Quinoa, cooked according to package instruction and cooled to room temperature
1 bag TJ’s Sugar Snap Peas, steamed according to microwave package instructions
1/3 cup TJ’s Organic Toasted Sesame Dressing
¾ cup TJ’s Unsalted Dry Toasted Sliced Almonds

steps.text: When the quinoa has cooled to room temperature, add to large serving bowl.
To the quinoa, add steamed snap peas, pineapple, and carrots.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Top with green onions and sliced almonds.

sesame-quinoa-salad.title: Sesame Quinoa Salad

shaved-squash-salad.description:
Sharpen your knife or break out your mandoline for this simple, shaved salad. Use Trader Joe’s Zucchini Squash or Trader Joe’s Yellow Squash—or a combination of both!—for flavor and aesthetic variety.The combination of thin slices and salting the Squash to extract excess water results in a delicately soft texture that easily soaks up the bright, lemony vinaigrette and allows salty TJ’s Crumbled Feta, crunchy TJ’s Raw Pignolas, and herbal TJ’s Fresh Mint to shine. 

Pro-tip: To really bring out the nuttiness of the pine nuts, toast them in a 325°F oven for 10 minutes, or over low heat in a pan until golden.
ingredients: 4 TJ’s Zucchini Squash and or TJ’s Yellow Squash, thinly sliced with a knife or mandoline
½ cup of your favorite TJ’s Extra Virgin Olive Oil
3 tablespoons – ¼ cup juice from a TJ’s Lemon
A squeeze of your favorite TJ’s Honey
A couple cranks TJ’s Black Peppercorns
¼ cup TJ’s Raw Pignolas (Pine Nuts), toasted
A couple sprigs TJ’s Fresh Mint, stems removed

steps.text: To extract water from the squash, generously salt, then let sit for 10 minutes. Pat or squeeze dry.
While the squash sits, make the dressing by combining olive oil, lemon juice, honey, and salt and pepper to taste. Whisk to combine.
Gently toss squash in dressing, then top with feta, pine nuts, and mint. Serve immediately.

shaved-squash-salad.title: Shaved Squash Salad

shawarma-chicken-rice-soup.description: The aromatic marinade enveloping Trader Joe's Shawarma Chicken Thighs pulls double duty as a tenderizer and flavor booster in this well-spiced (but not spicy) take on classic chicken & rice soup. Built on a base of Trader Joe's Mirepoix, a convenient, chopped & ready-to-cook blend of carrots, celery & onion, this is a soup that tastes even better after a day in the fridge, where the spices can further intensify. Serve it alongside a crisp green salad and warm pita for a comforting winter meal.
ingredients: 2 packages TJ's Organic Free Range Chicken Broth, plus 2 cups water

steps.text: Using a sharp knife, chop chicken into bite-size pieces. Transfer chicken to a paper towel-lined plate to blot some of the excess oil, set aside.

Heat a large pot over medium heat, add 2 tablespoons olive oil. When oil is hot, add mirepoix and a pinch of salt. Sauté until onions are translucent, 3-5 minutes. Add chicken, chicken broth, and water to pot and stir. Partially cover and simmer for about 30 minutes, until chicken is cooked through.

Add rice, cumin, and 1 teaspoon salt to pot and stir. Cover and cook for 15-20 minutes more. Uncover, remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes. Skim excess oil and stir in lemon juice. Season soup to taste with salt. Ladle soup into large bowls and enjoy!

shawarma-chicken-rice-soup.title: Shawarma Chicken & Rice Soup

sheet-pan-ranch-crusted-chicken.description:
Have you ever seen the chicken dance? No, not that Chicken Dance! We’re talking what happens when Trader Joe’s All Natural Chicken Drumsticks are made the center of your sheet-pan-meal attention. (If you’ve never seen this, watch the video.) Maybe they’re shaking a leg because they’re about to be tastily seasoned with Trader Joe’s Ranch Seasoning Blend, dipped in egg, and dredged in our Organic Bread Crumbs. Or maybe they’re dancing so as not to be upstaged by the chorus of colorful Carrots that surround them. Either way, we know this kitchen-warming recipe will have you moving a leg or two... from the sheet pan to your mouth!

Note: If you’re feeding more people, you can add more Drumsticks to your sheet pan. Just be sure to increase the amount of crusting mixture, and plan accordingly for a longer cook time.
ingredients: 13" x 18" sheet pan, lined with aluminum foil
1 package TJ’s All Natural Chicken Drumsticks (6 drumsticks)
½ bag of TJ’s Carrots of Many Colors (about 6 carrots)
½ bag of TJ’s Brussels Sprouts

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F, and line a 13” x 18” sheet pan with aluminum foil. Remove the 6 drumsticks from the package and thoroughly pat dry with paper towels. Set aside while you prepare your crusting mixture.

To prepare the crusting mixture: get three wide and shallow bowls. In one, add approximately 3 tablespoons of ranch seasoning. In another, crack an egg and scramble it. In the third bowl, add about a half cup of breadcrumbs.

To coat: Roll each drumstick in the ranch seasoning until thoroughly covered. Next, dip in the egg completely. Allow excess egg to drip off before finally rolling each drumstick in breadcrumbs. Make sure each piece of chicken is completely covered.
Drizzle some oil (about a tablespoon) in the middle of your sheet pan and spread it around. Then arrange the crusted chicken on the oiled pan.

From the bag of carrots, select two of each color (orange, yellow, white, and purple). Peel the carrots, trim the ends, and cut into thick coins. (Try to keep the coins around the same size so they roast evenly.) Artfully place the carrots around the chicken.

Take about half your bag of Brussels sprouts, rinse them, halve them, and place in the remaining spaces on your sheet pan. Then slice the top off the head of garlic and place in the very center of the sheet pan, scattering the loose pieces of garlic around for added flavor.
Finally, lightly drizzle oil over everything (including the chicken). Add salt & pepper (to taste) to the vegetables, along with some shakes of ranch seasoning, if desired.

Bake your sheet pan in a conventional oven at 400°F for 25 minutes. To evenly brown your chicken, carefully remove the pan from the oven and turn each drumstick over using tongs. Return the sheet pan to the oven for an additional 25 minutes. Chicken is done when internal temperature reaches 175°-180° on your meat thermometer. (While it may be safe to eat at 165°F, this dark meat will be more tender and juicy when cooked a little bit longer.)
To serve, pile the veggies on a plate, and top with one or two drumsticks. Finish with a drizzle of ranch dressing, and some chopped fresh herbs.

sheet-pan-ranch-crusted-chicken.title: Sheet Pan Ranch Crusted Chicken & Colorful Carrots

shrimp-bruschetta.description: Enjoy this spicy shrimp as an appetizer or serve alongside fresh salad greens for a light lunch.
ingredients: 1 bag TJ's Jumbo Cooked Shrimp (Peeled, Tail Off, Whole)
3 cups quartered TJ's Mini Heirloom Tomatoes
3 Tablespoons TJ's Jalapeño Pepper Hot Sauce

steps.text: Remove shrimp from bag and place in a colander. Run shrimp under cold water for 5 to 7 minutes to defrost, set aside to drain.
Cut baguette into 3-inch pieces lengthwise (about 6 pieces), slice each piece into halves crosswise.

Grease skillet on stove and bring to medium heat. Spread 1 teaspoon of mayonnaise on each slice of baguette and toast face-down in skillet until golden brown (about 2 minutes each). (Alternatively, place baguettes, cut side up, on a baking sheet and broil until browned and crispy (about 3-5 minutes).)
In a medium sized bowl, mix together defrosted shrimp, tomatoes, parsley, and chili pepper sauce.
To assemble, spoon 1/4 cup of shrimp mixture over each slice of toasted bread. Enjoy immediately.

shrimp-bruschetta.title: Shrimp Bruschetta

shrimp-burger-salad.description: Trader Joe's Shrimp Seafood Burgers are made of 70% farm-raised, Pacific White Shrimp and 23% wild-caught Pollock, held together with rice flour and sunflower oil. They are seasoned with garlic powder, dried basil, salt, and black pepper, which makes for juicy and delicious Seafood Burgers-whether you grill, bake, or pan fry them. In this recipe we've ditched the bun and used these Burgers to make a quick and refreshing salad, perfect for a protein packed lunch.
ingredients: 2 - 4 tablespoons TJs Carrot Ginger Miso Salad Dressing

steps.text: Preheat a skillet to medium heat and add a little oil. Cook burgers for 4 to 5 minutes per side, until the shrimp turn opaque and reach an internal temperature of 145°F. Let cool slightly and set aside.
Divide spring mix among plates. Top each salad with a burger, sliced radish, and a drizzle of dressing. Enjoy immediately.

shrimp-burger-salad.title: Shrimp Burger Salad

shrimp-scampizza.description:
Each package of Trader Joe’s Shrimp Scampi contains shelled, deveined, tail-off shrimp in a rich, flavorful, and enchantingly aromatic sauce made with plenty of garlic, butter, white wine, lemon juice, and a bit of grated Romano cheese for extra umami oomph. It cooks up quickly and easily on the stovetop or in the oven, after which it can be served on pasta, rice, crusty bread, or… pizza, using the butter sauce in place of traditional marinara, yes!

Pro-tip: Add the cooked shrimp immediately after the pizza is removed from the oven to avoid overcooked shrimp.
ingredients: 1 TJ’s Pizza Dough, left to sit at room temperature for 20 minutes
TJ's Unbleached Enriched All-Purpose Flour, for dusting
1 ½ cups shredded TJ’s Fontina Cheese
1 package TJ’s Shrimp Scampi, prepared according to package instructions
A drizzle of your favorite TJ's Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 TJ’s Lemon, one half zested, the other half quartered and thinly sliced

steps.text: Preheat oven according to pizza dough packaging instructions.
Lightly dust your work surface with flour, then stretch by hand or roll the dough into a 12” diameter circle.
Using a pastry brush, coat the entire top of the dough with the warm shrimp scampi butter. Alternatively, use a spoon to drizzle the butter over the top of the entire dough.
Top with cheese, then bake according to the pizza dough package directions.
While the pizza is baking, add arugula to a medium-sized bowl and toss with olive oil and lemon zest.
When the crust is golden and the cheese has melted, remove pizza from the oven. Immediately top melted cheese with cooked shrimp. Finish with arugula and lemon slices before slicing.

shrimp-scampizza.title: Shrimp Scampizza

sicilian-tom-collins.description:
You know what they say—when life gives you gorgeous, sun-kissed, Sicilian-grown lemons, make Organic 100% Sicilian Lemon Juice! Cultivated on the island of Sicily since the 10th century (it isn’t called the “Lemon Riviera” for nothing), Sicilian lemons are known for their aromatic, slightly oily peels and bright, sour-yet-slightly-less-acidic flavor—and Trader Joe’s Organic 100% Sicilian Lemon Juice, captures the essence of an Italian lemon grove in a bottle. Use it in any recipe that calls for lemon juice—like lemon bars, chicken piccata, salad dressings, and this cocktail! 

Pro-Tip: This recipe makes enough rosemary simple syrup for eight cocktails, and it can be stored in the refrigerator for up to one month. Prep the rosemary simple syrup in advance, and you can go from thirsty to “Cheers!” in mere minutes.
ingredients: ½ cup TJ’s Organic Cane Sugar
2 ounces of your favorite TJ’s Gin
1 ounce TJ’s Organic 100% Sicilian Lemon Juice
A splash of TJ’s Italian Sparkling Mineral Water

steps.text: Combine water, sugar, and 1 rosemary sprig in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally until the sugar dissolves. When the mixture reaches a boil, remove from heat, and allow to cool, about 30-40 minutes. It will become syrupy as it sits. Once cooled, discard rosemary sprig.
steps.title: Make the Rosemary Simple Syrup

steps.text: In a cocktail shaker, or jar with a lid, add ice, gin, lemon juice, and one ounce of prepared rosemary simple syrup. Shake to combine. Strain into a tall glass with ice and add a splash of sparkling water. Garnish with a sprig of rosemary to serve.
steps.title: Prepare your Cocktail

sicilian-tom-collins.title: Sicilian Tom Collins

slow-cooker-chicken-chile-verde.description: Who wouldn't want to come home to a nice, warm meal? This Salsa Verde-style salute to the slow cooker yields you just that! Simply toss two jars of Trader Joe's Salsa Verde, two pounds of Trader Joe's Chicken Thighs, twelve cloves of minced garlic, half a teaspoon of ground cumin, and a large diced onion into your cooker, and you've got yourself an easy-peasy, hands-off, mess-free meal in just a few hours.
ingredients: 12 cloves TJ's Premium Peeled Garlic, minced
2 TJ's Jalapeños, deseeded and diced (use gloves!)
TJ's Organic Jasmine Rice, heated according to package directions
TJ's Organic Black Beans, heated according to package directions
TJ's Fresh Lime wedges and chopped Fresh Cilantro, for garnish

steps.text: Add onion, garlic, jalapeño, chicken thighs, salsa verde and cumin to slow cooker and stir to combine.
Cook on LOW for 6-8 hours or HIGH for 2-4 hours, until chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165 degrees.
Shred chicken with a fork and serve with rice and beans.
Garnish with lime wedges and chopped cilantro.

slow-cooker-chicken-chile-verde.title: Slow Cooker Chicken Chile Verde

smashed-potatoes.description: Enjoy these restaurant-style potatoes alongside a grilled steak or roasted chicken thighs.
ingredients: 1 (1lb) bag TJ’s Dutch Yellow Baby Potatoes
4 Tablespoons TJ’s Extra Virgin Olive Oil

steps.text: Preheat oven to 425 degrees.
Bring a medium pot of salted water to a boil. Add potatoes and boil until fork tender, about 10 minutes. Drain potatoes.

Place potatoes onto a cutting board then gently smash (we used the base of a heavy glass Pyrex measuring cup) until each potato reaches about half its thickness, being careful to keep the potato intact.

Drizzle about 2 tablespoons of olive oil onto a baking tray, then gently transfer each smashed potato onto the baking tray with a spatula. Generously brush the remaining olive oil atop the potatoes then sprinkle with salt and pepper. Place tray of potatoes in the heated oven and bake for 15 minutes. Flip the potatoes, season salt and pepper and bake an additional 10 more minutes the tops are until golden brown and crispy. Serve immediately.

smashed-potatoes.title: Smashed Potatoes

smoked-paprika-potatoes.description:
Trader Joe's Smoked Paprika begins with Spanish-grown sweet red peppers that are slowly roasted over hard wood planks to imbue this spice with its characteristic smokiness. The peppers are ground into a fine, super flavorful, brick red powder, and then packed into tins with a combination shaker/teaspoon lid, so you can use as much or as little as you like.

Use it anywhere you need a boost of smoky-sweet flavor: roast chicken thighs, corn on the cob, French fries, roasted potatoes…
ingredients: 8 medium sized TJ's Gold Potatoes, peeled and cut into one inch cubes
2 tablespoons of your favorite TJ's Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1-2 teaspoons TJ's 100% Spanish Organic Extra Virgin Garlic Flavored Olive Oil
1 tablespoon TJ's Smoked Paprika, plus an additional sprinkle to serve

steps.text: Place cut potatoes into a pot. Add enough water to cover the potatoes. Bring water to a boil. Cook potatoes until they start to become tender, about 10-15 minutes. Drain and place in large mixing bowl. Add chives, olive oil, garlic oil, salt and paprika. Gently toss, and give it a final sprinkle to serve.

smoked-paprika-potatoes.title: Smoked Paprika Potatoes

smoked-salmon-cream-cheese-bagels.description: There's a reason certain food pairings become classic in the breakfast canon—they're just that good. Recreate this morning masterpiece by coupling your favorite TJ's bagel and cream cheese combo with Trader Joe's Wild Sockeye Smoked Salmon. Then load it with toppings like thinly sliced red onion and cucumbers, briny capers, a sprig of dill, and a squeeze of lemon for the bagel shop experience at home without the bagel shop price tag. Good morning, indeed!
ingredients: 4 of your favorite TJ's Bagels, sliced in half
1 package TJ's Wild Sockeye Smoked Salmon
1/4 TJ's Red Onion, very thinly sliced
A few sprigs TJ's Fresh Dill, for garnish

steps.text: Toast bagels per your preference. Slather each half with cream cheese.
Top with bagel with salmon, red onion, cucumbers. capers, dill, and a squeeze of lemon to serve.

smoked-salmon-cream-cheese-bagels.title: Smoked Salmon & Cream Cheese Bagels

smoked-salmon-whipped-cream-cheese.description: Trader Joe’s Whipped Cream Cheese strikes an artful balance of superbly creamy and delightfully fluffy. It’s the ultimate option for spreading on bagels and toast with ease, and its texture makes it particularly well-suited to an array of mix-ins. We’re thinking all the classic bagel toppings folded into one super, smoked salmon spread! Or go beyond the bagel and into appetizer territory, when served with TJ’s Norwegian Sourdough Rye Chips.
ingredients: 2 ounces of your favorite TJ’s Smoked Salmon, chopped into bite-sized pieces
1 tablespoon juice from a TJ’s Lemon
A few cranks TJ’s Black Peppercorns

steps.text: In a medium-sized bowl, gently combine all ingredients using a rubber spatula.

smoked-salmon-whipped-cream-cheese.title: Smoked Salmon Whipped Cream Cheese

smokey-chimichurri-sauce.description: Drizzle this smoky, herbaceous sauce on steaks, salads, scrambled eggs, grain bowls, grilled fish…
ingredients: 5 grinds TJ's South African Smoke Seasoning (Seasonal)
3 TJ's Premium and Peeled Garlic Cloves

steps.text: Combine 1 tablespoon vinegar, 5 grinds South African seasoning, 1 teaspoon oregano, 3 garlic cloves and 2 tablespoons of EVOO in a blender or food processor. Pulse until garlic minces to desired consistency. Add cilantro and parsley and pulse a few more times until desired consistency. Pour mixture into a small bowl and stir in reserved 3 tablespoons of EVOO. Taste and adjust seasoning as desired. Makes about 1/2 cup of sauce.
Serving ideas: drizzled over a steak, gorgonzola and arugula salad, spoon over grilled salmon or bruschetta.

smokey-chimichurri-sauce.title: Smokey Chimichurri Sauce

smoky-sriracha-baked-beans.description: Take baked beans from "ho-hum" to "whoa!" with Trader Joe's Sriracha Sauce.
ingredients: 1/2 package TJ's Uncured Apple Smoked Bacon (or your favorite TJ's Bacon), chopped (optional)
1/2 cup TJ's Organic Sriracha & Roasted Garlic BBQ Sauce
Freshly chopped Cilantro, Chives or Parsley, for garnish (optional)

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F. Heat a large skillet over medium flame, add bacon and brown 5-7 minutes. Remove bacon and set on a paper towel lined plate to drain. Pour off bacon fat from pan; add onion to pan and sauté until translucent, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.

Pour beans into a 9x13 baking dish. Add bacon, onion, and bbq sauce and stir to combine. Place dish on center rack of oven and bake for 45-50 minutes, or until beans are bubbly, caramelized around the edges and slightly browned on top. Remove dish from oven and let cool 5 minutes. Garnish with cilantro, chives or parsley and enjoy!

smoky-sriracha-baked-beans.title: Smoky Sriracha Baked Beans

smothered-biscuits-gravy.description:
If you have breakfast on the brain, reach for a package of Trader Joe’s Ground Country Style Ground Pork Sausage. It’s mildly seasoned, sensationally savory, and coarsely ground for a satisfying bite, making it a must-have when whipping up a batch of biscuits & gravy. 

Pro-tip: To sidestep the time-consuming task of making biscuits from scratch, grab a can of TJ’s Organic Biscuits and you’ll be on your way to enjoying Smothered Biscuits with Country Style Gravy in about 30 minutes.
ingredients: 1 package TJ’s Ground Country Style Pork Sausage
TJ’s Sea Salt & TJ’s Black Pepper, to taste

steps.text: Prepare the biscuits according to package instructions. While they’re baking, prepare the gravy: heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the ground pork and brown, breaking it up into pieces with a wooden spoon as it cooks, about 8-10 minutes. When the pork has reached 145°F and is no longer pink, reduce heat to medium.

Sprinkle half of the flour over pork and stir to combine. Add remaining flour and stir once more to incorporate. Add one cup of milk to the pan and stir. Continue to add milk one cup at a time as gravy thickens. Cook for another 5-8 minutes to further thicken the gravy. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Garnish with fresh parsley.
Serve each biscuit with a generous spoonful of gravy on top.

smothered-biscuits-gravy.title: Smothered Biscuits with Country Style Gravy

soffritto-beans.description:
Much like a traditional mirepoix, a soffritto is a blend of aromatics that are indispensable in a cook's kitchen. We found that every Italian cook seems to have their own iteration, reflecting their chosen flavor favorites. Our Trader Joe's Italian Style Soffritto Seasoning Blend includes crispy onions, sun-dried tomatoes, sea salt, garlic, red peppers, parsley, rosemary, and sage.    

You can really add it to anything - it's delicious with roasted meats and veggies, with olive oil as a dipping sauce, added to burgers or meatloaf, in tomato sauce, stirred into hummus or other dips, blended into salad dressings... you get the idea. Its appearance in this recipe adds a burst of Italian home cooking flavor to a humble blend of great northern beans and crushed tomatoes, complete with a broiled cheese crust.
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons your favorite TJ's Olive Oil
1 1/2 tablespoons TJ's Italian Style Soffritto Seasoning Blend
2 cans TJ's Organic Great Northern Beans, drained
Juice of 1 wedge of TJ's Lemon
1 bag TJs Organic French Rolls, heated or toasted to your preference

steps.text: In a large skillet over medium heat, add oil and soffritto seasoning. Saute until fragrant, then add kale and diced tomatoes. Saute 5 minutes, until bubbling and kale is wilted.
Add beans cook another 5-10 minutes, until sauce thickens and beans are heated through. Remove from heat and stir in a squeeze of lemon wedge.
Transfer beans to an 8-inch square broiler-safe pan and top with shredded cheese. Broil on high for 2-4 minutes until cheese is golden and bubbly. Remove from heat and let cool slightly.
Ladle beans into bowls and serve with warm French rolls for dipping.

soffritto-beans.title: Soffritto Beans

southwestern-chopped-salad.description: Trader Joe's Southwestern Chopped Salad goes from fan-favorite side dish to marvelous main dish in a snap, thanks to the addition of hearty Organic Black Beans and fresh TJ's Teeny Tiny Avocados.
ingredients: 1 bag TJ's Southwestern Chopped Salad Kit
1 can TJ's Organic Black Beans, drained & rinsed

steps.text: Prep The Salad: Layer 1/2 cup black beans on the bottom of a large mason jar. Add a pinch of salt and drizzle with half of the dressing packet. Top with half of the salad and half of the cheese packet. Close the jar. Pack half of the crispy tortillas & pepitas in a separate container. Repeat salad assembly in another jar with remaining ingredients. Refrigerate jars until ready to serve.
Serve: When the lunch bell rings, gently shake the jar to distribute dressing. Pour salad into a bowl, garnish with crispy tortillas & pepitas and 1 freshly sliced avocado, and dig in!

southwestern-chopped-salad.title: Southwestern Chopped Salad

soy-chorizo-frittata.description: For a make-ahead brunch dish that can feed a crowd, you oughta make a frittata.
ingredients: 1 cup TJ's Shaved Cheese Blend, divided
6 TJ's Super Sweet Baby Bell Peppers, cored and sliced into rings
1/2 link TJ's Soy Chorizo, casing removed and crumbled
1/2 cup sliced TJ's Mini Pearl Grape Tomatoes (garnish)

steps.text: Preheat oven to 375°F. In a large bowl, whisk together 12 eggs, 1/3 cup half & half and about 5 dashes of 21 seasoning salute. Whisk until eggs are nice and fluffy. Stir in 3/4 cup of shredded cheese then set aside.

Heat a deep, 10-inch ovenproof skillet (a well-seasoned cast iron skillet works best), over medium heat. Spray with canola oil, then sauté bell peppers and onions until they just begin to soften, about 2 minutes. Add baby spinach and sprinkle with a few dashes of 21 seasoning salute. Keep stirring until spinach begins to wilt, another 2 minutes. Add crumbled soy chorizo and stir another minute until well incorporated. Remove about 1/3 of the ingredients from the skillet and set aside on a plate (for garnishing the top of the frittata).

Make sure all the ingredients are in an even layer on the bottom of the skillet, then pour the egg mixture over the top. Cook the frittata over medium heat, without stirring, until about 1 inch from the edge has begun to set, about 4-5 minutes. Sprinkle the sautéed ingredients that had been set aside over the top of the frittata and turn off heat.

Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake for about 16-18 minutes. Do not overcook. The consistency should be more like a custard than a sponge, so keep a close eye on it toward the end. The center might still look a little jiggly even when it is ready-so to check doneness-cut a small slit in the center of the frittata. If you see runny eggs in the cut, bake for another few minutes; if the eggs are set, it's done!

For a crispy top, heat broiler then sprinkle reserved 1/4 cup of cheese over the top of the frittata then broil until cheese is browned and bubbling, about 1 minute. To serve, run a rubber spatula around edge of frittata and transfer to a plate. Cut into wedges, garnish with tomatoes and cilantro and enjoy!

soy-chorizo-frittata.title: Soy Chorizo Frittata

soy-eggs.description:
Some would consider ‘pasture-raised’ to be the gold standard for chicken eggs. And it’s no wonder when you look at the color of the yolks of Trader Joe’s Pasture Raised Large Brown Eggs, especially when these eggs are boiled to a perfectly jammy consistency.

Steeping the cooked eggs in a soy sauce mixture not only imbues the exterior of the eggs with a lovely color, it adds a ton of umami flavor, too. Serve these eggs for breakfast or a snack with a drizzle of TJ's Sriracha Sauce and a sprinkle of TJ's Nori Komi Furikake Japanese Multi-Purpose Seasoning!
ingredients: ¾ cups TJ’s Low Sodium Soy Sauce
6 TJ’s Pasture Raised Large Brown Eggs
TJ's Nori Komi Furikake Japanese Multi-Purpose Seasoning

steps.text: Combine soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and ¼ cup water in a medium bowl and stir until the sugar dissolves.
Fill a saucepan with water and bring to a boil over high heat. Carefully add eggs to saucepan, lower heat to maintain a gentle simmer, and cook eggs for 7 minutes.
While the eggs are simmering, prepare an ice bath: fill a bowl with a cup of ice and cold water. After 7 minutes, remove eggs from saucepan and into the ice bath for a few minutes.
After the eggs have cooled, peel them, then add the eggs to the soy sauce mixture, ensuring that they are fully submerged. Cover and refrigerate for 1-2 hours.
Remove eggs from the marinade and slice each one in half. Serve with a drizzle of sriracha and a sprinkle of furikake.

soy-eggs.title: Soy Eggs

soyaki-chicken.description: Pick up a package of Trader Joe’s Organic Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs and you’re on your way to myriad meals. Cutlets, stir-frys, soups, braises, hearty salads, the list goes on and on. If you have a package of Chicken Thighs and need an idea for dinner, this recipe leans on TJ’s staples Soyaki and frozen Organic Jasmine Rice to create a savory, flavorful dish in about 45 minutes (and nearly half of that time is hands-off!). It’s not only ideal for dinner tonight—the leftovers make superb lunches, too.
ingredients: 1 package TJ’s Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, chopped into cubes
½ cup TJ’s Roasted & Unsalted Whole Cashews
2 bags TJ’s Organic Jasmine Rice, prepared according to package microwave instructions

steps.text: Combine Soyaki and Hoisin in a large bowl. Add chicken. Cover and marinate in refrigerator for 20 minutes.

In a large frying pan, heat oil over medium-high heat. When oil is hot, add chicken, and cook for 8 minutes. Add cashews to pan and continue to cook another couple of minutes, until the cashews become toasted and the internal temperature of the chicken reaches 165°F when probed with a thermometer.
Serve over rice and garnish with green onions.

soyaki-chicken.title: Soyaki Chicken

spaghetti-squash-with-meatball-marinara.description: We've passed on pasta in favor of spaghetti squash in this comforting twist on a classic Italian favorite.
ingredients: TJ's Grated Parmesan Cheese, to taste
TJ's Sea Salt & Ground Black Pepper, to taste

steps.text: Cook the squash: Use a sharp knife to cut squash in half lengthwise. Use a large table spoon to scrape out the seeds and string. Season with salt and pepper, place cut side up in a microwave safe dish and add about an inch of water to the bottom of the dish. Cover dish with cling wrap and microwave on high for 10-14 minutes. Allow to cool enough to handle before unwrapping. Use a table fork to scrape squash from top to bottom to separate flesh into strands of "spaghetti."

Prepare Meatball Marinara: Place meatballs in large skillet and cook according to package stove top directions. Once warmed through, add marinara sauce and cooked squash. Toss to cover and heat through; add Parmesan, salt and pepper, to taste. Serve right away.

spaghetti-squash-with-meatball-marinara.title: Spaghetti Squash with Meatball Marinara

sparkling-peach-smash.description: Lazy summer afternoons need a no-effort cocktail to match—look no further than this recipe for a peachy-keen, porch-worthy sipper.
ingredients: A squeeze of a TJ’s Fresh Lemon (plus a lemon slice for garnish)
1/4 to 1/2 teaspoon TJ's Organic Blue Agave syrup (optional)
4 oz. TJ’s Sparkling Black Tea & Peach Juice Beverage

steps.text: Fill a chilled glass with ice. Add the Kentucky Bourbon, a squeeze of lemon juice, and the agave. Stir. Pour in the Sparkling Black Tea and Peach Juice Beverage. Garnish with a lemon slice.

sparkling-peach-smash.title: Sparkling Peach Smash

sparkling-sweet-tea-bourbon-cocktail.description: Perfectly peachy, ultra-fizzy, and subtly sweet, Trader Joe's Sparkling Black Tea with Peach Juice Beverage sips like a sparkling summer afternoon. Even on the dreariest of days, it'll add spring to your step and leave you feeling peachy-keen. Follow this not-too-sweet tea & bourbon cocktail recipe and enjoy a warm-weather refresher with minimal fuss.
ingredients: 2 ounces TJ's Kentucky Bourbon Straight Whiskey
1 squeeze TJ's Multi-Floral and Clover Honey
1 can TJ's Sparkling Black Tea with Peach Juice Beverage

steps.text: Add honey and bourbon to a small glass. Stir vigorously until combined.
Fill a tall glass with crushed ice. Add bourbon mixture and top up with Sparkling Black Tea with Peach Juice Beverage.
Squeeze a lemon slice into the glass, stir gently and sip, sip, hooray!

sparkling-sweet-tea-bourbon-cocktail.title: Sparkling Sweet Tea & Bourbon Cocktail

spiced-chai-apple-crisp.description: With its fragrantly spiced, nose-tingling, ginger-forward profile, Trader Joe’s Spiced Chai Black Tea Concentrate lends fall-forward flavors anywhere you use it—in a creamy Spiced Chai Latte, stirred into your morning oatmeal, or baked into a cozy apple crisp.
ingredients: 12-13 small TJ's Honeycrisp or Granny Smith Apples, peeled, corred, & sliced approx. 1/4-inch thick (about 12 cups)
1 1/2 cups TJ's Organic Brown Sugar, divided
1 1/2 cups TJ's Gluten Free All Purpose Flour, divided
1/4 teaspoon plus a pinch TJ's Sea Salt
1/4 cup plus 2 tablespoons TJ's Spiced Chai Black Tea Concentrate
1 teaspoon TJ's Organic Pure Bourbon Vanilla Extract
1 1/2 cups TJ's Gluten Free Rolled Oats
1/2 cup TJ's Organic Virgin Coconut Oil (room temperature)
Whipped Cream and TJ's Caramel Sauce, for serving (optional, but encouraged!)

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.

Prep the Spiced Chai Apple filling: Combine apples, cranberries, 3/4 cup brown sugar, 1/2 cup flour, and 1/4 teaspoon sea salt in a large bowl. Add Spiced Chai Black Tea Concentrate and vanilla and stir, set aside.

Prep the Crisp topping: Combine oats, remaining flour, pumpkin pie spice, pepper, remaining salt, and remaining brown sugar in a bowl. Mix in coconut oil and work with your fingers to a crumbly consistency.

Assemble & Bake: Mound the apple mixture in a two-quart baking dish. Top with the Crisp Topping in an even layer. Place on a baking sheet and bake in the oven for 1 ½ hour or until a skewer can be easily inserted and the juices are bubbling and thick.

Remove from the oven, let sit for 10 minutes and serve with whipped coconut cream and a drizzle of caramel sauce.

 

Recipe Variations:

  • Use dried cherries in place of cranberries
  • Reduce oats by 1/4 cup and add 1/4 cup chopped walnuts or pecans
  • Make it vegan: use vegan whipped cream and omit caramel sauce

spiced-chai-apple-crisp.title: Spiced Chai Apple Crisp

spiced-chai-pancakes.description:
Trader Joe's Spiced Chai Black Tea Concentrate is brewed with filtered water and steeped in small batches to fully develop its characteristic flavors-namely, allspice, black pepper, cardamom, clove, cinnamon, and ginger. This robust rundown of redolent spices is combined with sugar to create the ideal base for a perfectly perfumed, satisfyingly sweet, and altogether tasty Spiced Chai latte.     

In addition to sweet liquid refreshment, this Spiced Tea Concentrate is an excellent stand-in for water when whipping up a batch of buttermilk pancakes on a lazy Sunday morning. It turns out you really can sip your Chai and eat it, too...
ingredients: 1 cup TJ's Spiced Chai Black Tea Concentrate (do not dilute!)
1 3/4 cup TJ's Buttermilk Pancake & All-Purpose Baking Mix

steps.text: In a medium bowl, whisk egg and spiced chai concentrate until combined. Whisk in pancake mix until smooth. Let batter stand 5 minutes.

Preheat a skillet over medium. Working in batches, use a quarter-cup measuring cup to drop batter into skillet. Cook for 1-2 minutes, flipping pancakes when edges are no longer glossy and bubbles form in the center. Cook another minute or so and transfer pancakes to a serving platter. Serve pancakes with toasted pecan pieces and plenty of syrup for drizzling.

spiced-chai-pancakes.title: Spiced Chai Pancakes

spicy-antipasti-skewers.description: For a fun and customizable take on antipasto—the Italian appetizer before a meal—we’re swapping out the traditional platter in favor of individual skewers. And thanks to the piquant peppers in Trader Joe’s Garlic & Jalapeño Stuffed Olives and Organic Pepper Jack Cheese they pack a pleasant punch of heat. You can preassemble the skewers before a party or let your guests assemble their own for an appealing appetizer activity.
ingredients: 1 jar TJ’s Garlic & Jalapeño Stuffed Olives, drained
1 block TJ’s Organic Pepper Jack, cut into cubes
1 package TJ’s Uncured Salame di Parma Mild Salami, folded into quarters
1 Demi Ciabatta Baguette, toasted and cubed
1 container Chimichurri Sauce, for dipping or drizzling
Wooden or metal skewers for assembly

steps.text: To Assemble: In whatever order you’d like, skewer each ingredient onto the stick and repeat so there are at least two of each ingredient.
To Serve: Drizzle assembled skewers with Chimichurri or pour into a bowl for dipping.

spicy-antipasti-skewers.title: Spicy Antipasti Skewers

spicy-calabrian-chili-pepper-pasta.description: Trader Joe's Italian Bomba Hot Pepper Sauce is made with fermented Calabrian chili peppers and builds heat, bite by bite, until you reach a crescendo of spice so invigorating that it paradoxically keeps you coming back for more. Drizzle it on pizza, grilled chicken, veggies, or scrambled eggs in lieu of hot sauce. Or sauté it with a few tablespoons of TJ’s Tomato Paste to create a vibrantly flavored sauce for coating pasta.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons of your favorite TJ's Extra Virgin Olive Oil
Zest and juice from 1 TJ’s Lemon, divided
1-2 tablespoons TJ's Italian Bomba Hot Pepper Sauce
TJ’s Shaved Parmesan Romano & Asiago Cheeses, to serve

steps.text: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add rigatoni and cook to al dente, about 10 minutes. Before draining, reserve ½ cup of the pasta water.

While your pasta is cooking, heat a large, high-sided skillet over medium heat. Add oil, and once the oil is hot, add garlic, lemon zest, tomato paste, and Bomba and sauté until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Carefully add cooked pasta to the skillet. Stir in reserved pasta water a tablespoon at a time until the sauce emulsifies, becomes glossy, and the pasta is thoroughly coated.
Remove from heat, stir in lemon juice, and season to taste with salt. After each portion is plated, top generously with shaved cheese and basil leaves to serve.

spicy-calabrian-chili-pepper-pasta.title: Spicy Calabrian Chili Pepper Pasta

ingredients: 1 bag TJ’s Gluten Free Breaded Chicken Breast Nuggets
1 box TJ’s Gluten Free Toaster Waffles

steps.text: Preheat oven to 425° F. Spread frozen nuggets in a single layer on a baking sheet. Place on center rack of oven and begin baking for 10 minutes.

Meanwhile, for extra color, heat and crunch, trim the top off of 2 jalapenos. Using a sharp paring knife, core the inside of the pepper to remove seeds. Dispose the seeds. Slice the peppers in half lengthwise then slice into long thin strips. Slice across the strips for a small dice. Set aside.
Remove nugget tray from oven, flip nuggets and return to oven to cook an additional 10 minutes or to an internal temperature of 175°F to 180°F.
In a small saucepan, add entire bottle of chili sauce. Heat on low, stirring occasionally about 2-3 minutes or until warmed. Remove pan from heat and set aside.
While the chicken nuggets are finishing up cooking, place waffles directly onto the oven rack and heat for 2-3 minutes or until hot, crispy and golden brown.

Remove chicken and waffles from oven and let stand 1 minute. Slice the waffles into quarters, and begin assembling. Place one nugget on top of one waffle wedge, then spoon warmed chili sauce over the top of the chicken. Sprinkle with diced jalapeno then top with another waffle wedge. Secure with toothpicks if desired. Place finished sandwich bites onto a platter and serve!

spicy-chicken-waffle-bites.title: Spicy Chicken & Waffle Bites

spicy-honey-butter.description: Whip Salted Butter with Trader Joe's Spicy Honey Sauce for a dreamy, hot & sweet spread that’s ready to slather on cornbread or chicken & waffles, or stir into your oatmeal to really kickstart your morning. Leftover honey butter (if you have any leftover, that is) can be stored in the refrigerator for up to one month.
ingredients: 2 sticks TJ’s Salted Butter, softened to room temperature
¼ cup TJ’s Spicy Honey Sauce

steps.text: In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment (or using a hand mixer), whip the butter with the Spicy Honey Sauce until light and fluffy.
Slather to your heart’s content.

spicy-honey-butter.title: Spicy Honey Butter

spicy-sausage-and-kale-soup.description:
Don't let the challenging-to-pronounce name intimidate you. Trader Joe's Mirepoix (pronounced meer-pwah) is a ready-to-use blend of carrots, onions and celery, named for the French aristocrat who employed the chef who likely institutionalized the use of this combination for cooking.     

What makes this particular product unique is that these three commonplace ingredients have been washed, peeled, and most importantly, chopped for you, so you can get right to the cooking. Use it as a base for sauces, casseroles, roasting meats, or in this recipe for comforting, Spicy Sausage and Kale Soup with Organic Quinoa.
ingredients: 1 package TJ's Spicy Italian Chicken Sausage (or any spicy TJ's Chicken Sausage)
3 tablespoons TJ's Extra Virgin Olive Oil, divided
1 teaspoon TJ's Spice of the World, Garlic Powder
1/2 teaspoon TJ's Spices of the World, Oregano
2 containers TJ's Organic Low Sodium Chicken Broth
1 cup TJ's Organic Red Quinoa, rinsed and drained
1 bag TJ's Organic Tuscan Kale, stems removed
TJ's Grated Parmesan Cheese or Fresh Lemon, sliced, for garnish

steps.text: Slice sausage links into half-inch thick coins, then slice coins in half. Heat a skillet over medium heat and add 1 tablespoon olive oil. When oil is hot, add sausage to pan and cook undisturbed for 5 minutes. Flip sausage pieces and continue to cook until browned, 3-5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.

Heat a large pot over medium heat, add remaining olive oil. When oil is hot, add mirepoix, garlic powder, oregano, salt and pepper. Sauté until onions are translucent and spices are fragrant, 3-5 minutes.

Add broth, water, and quinoa, and bring to a boil for 5 minutes. Add kale, cover pot and simmer for 10-15 minutes, until kale is tender and quinoa is cooked. Add sausage and cook another few minutes until warmed through.
Ladle soup into large bowls and garnish with grated parmesan or a squeeze of lemon. Serve with crusty bread for dipping and dig in!

spicy-sausage-and-kale-soup.title: Spicy Sausage and Kale Soup

spicy-shrimp-slaw.description: No grill? No problem. Toss some shrimp in Trader Joe's Organic Sriracha & Roasted Garlic BBQ Sauce and blast them under the broiler. They cook in mere minutes, with complex flavors of hickory smoke, sweet molasses, and fiery peppers that provide a counterpoint to cool, crispy slaw and sweet, charred mango chunks. The spicy, creamy dressing that accompanies said slaw is a snap to pull together, using the same lip-smacking sauce, TJ's Greek Yogurt and some apple cider vinegar.
ingredients: 1 cup plus 1/4 cup TJ's Organic Sriracha & Roasted Garlic BBQ Sauce
1/4 cup TJ's Plain Whole Milk Greek Yogurt
2 tablespoons TJ's Organic Apple Cider Vinegar
1 bag TJ's Organic Shredded Green & Red Cabbage with Orange Carrots
1 bag TJ's Uncooked Wild Argentinian Red Shrimp, thawed
TJ's Pepitas or Sunflower Seeds, for garnish

steps.text: In a medium sized bowl, whisk 1/4 cup BBQ sauce with Greek yogurt and vinegar. Add cabbage mixture and cilantro and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate.
Turn broiler to high. In a medium bowl, toss thawed shrimp with 1 tablespoon oil and remaining BBQ sauce, set aside.

In a medium bowl, toss thawed mango with 1 tablespoon oil. Spread evenly on one side of a large rimmed baking sheet and broil 5-6 minutes. Remove from oven and turn mango pieces over. Arrange shrimp on other side of baking sheet. Broil 2 minutes. Turn shrimp over and broil another 1-2 minutes until opaque and cooked through (they should be springy to the touch). Remove from oven.
Divide slaw among serving bowls. Top with a handful of pepitas or sunflower seeds. Top slaw with broiled shrimp and mango and enjoy immediately.

spicy-shrimp-slaw.title: Spicy Shrimp Slaw

spiked-spiced-cider.description: We've been selling orchards full of Trader Joe's Spiced Cider for more than 20 years, and we eagerly await its return, year after year. This fall-favorite is made exclusively for us with the juice of bursting-with-flavor apples, and brewed with spices like cinnamon, allspice and cloves. Just when you think the flavor has fully revealed itself, you discover a subtle hint of citrus at the finish that really pleases the palate, making it an ideal addition to a cozy, fall-inspired cocktail recipe with a robust bourbon whiskey.
ingredients: 1.5 ounces (1 shot) of your favorite TJ's Bourbon Whiskey
1 TJ's Organic Cinnamon Stick, for garnish (optional)

steps.text: Warm cider in a small sauce pan over medium heat, just until simmering (or, heat cider in a microwave-safe mug). Stir in bourbon and remove from heat.

Pour warm spiked cider in a mug or other heatproof glass. As it cools slightly, slice a mandarin in half crosswise. Squeeze the juice of a mandarin half into spiked cider. Slice the other mandarin half. Garnish with mandarin slices and a cinnamon stick. Bottoms up!

spiked-spiced-cider.title: Spiked Spiced Cider

spiked-strawberry-lemonade.description: For a cooling, sweet-tart sipper with plenty of kick, look no further than this Spiked Strawberry Lemonade, bolstered by Trader Joe’s Kentucky Bourbon Straight Whiskey.
ingredients: 1 1/2 oz. TJ's Kentucky Bourbon Straight Whiskey

steps.text: Muddle 2-3 mint leaves and a strawberry in the bottom of an old fashioned glass. Fill glass with ice. Add bourbon, 3 ounces strawberry lemonade and a squeeze of a lemon wedge and stir. Taste and add more lemonade if desired. Garnish with a strawberry and a fresh lemon wedge and serve.

spiked-strawberry-lemonade.title: Spiked Strawberry Lemonade

spiked-watermelon-sparkler.description:
Nothing calls upon a summer's day quite like a ripe, juicy watermelon, and Trader Joe's Sparkling Watermelon Juice is like a summer's day in a can!   

Made with fresh, not-from-concentrate watermelon juice, plenty of bubbles, and zero grams of added sugar, Trader Joe's Sparkling Watermelon Juice is the sweet and sparkling beverage of your warm-weather dreams. Enjoy it chilled, straight from the can, or add it to a cocktail, garnished with fresh watermelon and a sprig of mint. The sun is shining, and the sky is the limit!
ingredients: 1/2 cup (6-8 cubes) TJ's Watermelon, plus a few more cubes for garnish
4 ounces of your favorite TJ's Vodka

steps.text: Muddle watermelon and a few mint leaves in a 2-cup measuring glass.
Divide mixture among 2 old fashioned glasses and fill the glasses with ice.
Divide vodka among glasses, top up with sparkling watermelon juice, and stir just until combined.
Garnish with a watermelon cube, more fresh mint, and a squeeze of lime. Cheers!

spiked-watermelon-sparkler.title: Spiked Watermelon Sparkler

spinach-artichoke-gratin.description:
Gratins are indulgent, comforting dishes that often require laborious whisking (and time) to make the creamy sauce component of the dish. This gratin skips that time and effort in favor of flavorful and oh-so cheesy Trader Joe's Creamy Spinach & Artichoke Dip as the base. Sliced sweet potatoes offer a complementary sweetness to the dish, as well as an eye-appealing vibrant orange hue. 

Pro-tip: Adding milk to the heated Dip helps slacken the texture. The sauce will thicken again as the gratin bakes.
ingredients: 2 packages TJ's Frozen Spinach & Artichoke Dip, microwaved according to directions
2-3 medium-sized TJ's Sweet Potatoes, peeled and sliced into thin rounds
1 cup TJ's Quattro Formaggio Shredded Cheese Blend

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
In a medium-sized bowl, combine heated Spinach & Artichoke Dips and milk. Mix thoroughly.

Grease a medium-sized baking dish (9x9in or 10x7.5in) with canola oil spray, then add half of the spinach mixture to the baking dish. Arrange the sweet potato rounds upright on their thin sides in the baking dish. Top with remaining Spinach & Artichoke Dip.
Cover the baking dish with foil and bake on center rack of oven for 30-40 minutes.
Remove foil and sprinkle the cheese on top.
Return to oven and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, until golden and bubbling.
Remove from oven and let cool 10 minutes before serving.

spinach-artichoke-gratin.title: Spinach & Artichoke Gratin

spring-lentil-salad.description: Enjoy this hearty salad alongside toasted bread topped with a swipe of soft goat cheese.
ingredients: 3 teaspoons TJ’s Dijon Mustard with White Wine
1/4 teaspoon TJ’s Sea Salt, or to taste
1/4 teaspoon TJ’s Ground Black Pepper, or to taste
1/2 cup your favorite TJ’s Extra Virgin Olive Oil

steps.text: Make The Vinaigrette: In a small bowl, whisk together shallot, lemon juice, vinegar, mustard, honey then season with salt and pepper. Slowly whisk in oil until emulsified. Taste and adjust seasoning as desired. Makes about 1 cup of vinaigrette. Set aside.

Make The Salad: In a medium pan on medium heat, add 1 tablespoon of olive oil. Add chopped kale and sauté until wilted, about 3 minutes.

Add bag of cooked lentils and stir until heated through, about 3 more minutes.

Remove from heat and place into a large bowl.

Add quartered tomatoes then gently fold in 1/4 cup of vinaigrette. Taste and add more vinaigrette if needed.

This dish is best served warm, but it can also be prepared a day in advance and served cold.

spring-lentil-salad.title: Spring Lentil Salad

springy-goat-cheese-board.description: Trader Joe’s Chevre Fine Herbs Goat Cheese has a uniquely herbaceous, tangy taste that separates it from just a traditional log of goat cheese. This lovely Chevre is fresh, soft, and unaged, and rolled in blend of parsley, basil, dill, tarragon, and chives, making it the perfect foil for snappy green veggies on a spring cheese board. Grab a glass of Sauvignon Blanc and toast to the start of the season!
ingredients: 1 package TJ's Chevre Fine Herbs Goat Cheese

Your favorite raw green vegetables & fruit (we used green bell pepper, snap peas, Persian cucumbers, baby broccoli, green grapes) and/or your favorite cooked green vegetables (blanched asparagus, sautéed shishito peppers)
TJ's Dry Roasted & Salted Pistachio Nutmeats

steps.text: Remove goat cheese from package and place on the corner of a large cheese board (let soften at room temperature while you wash & prep your veggies).
Rinse and pat dry vegetables and fruit. Slice Persian Cucumbers into coins. Starting at the stem end of the bell pepper, slice into rings and remove core.
Artfully arrange prepped fruit and vegetables on the cheese board. Fill in the gaps between them with handfuls of pistachio nutmeats and olives.
Serve and enjoy!

springy-goat-cheese-board.title: Spring-y Goat Cheese Board

squash-tacos.description: Really good refried beans often require hours of cooking. But with Trader Joe’s Traditional Style Fat Free Refried Beans, you can enjoy the same great flavor by simply opening a can! Pair them with roasted squash and your favorite TJ’s tortillas for a minimal effort, maximum flavor (and meatless!) taco night.
ingredients: 1 package TJ’s Cut Butternut Squash or 1 ¼ pounds of your favorite TJ’s squash, peeled and cubed
1 tablespoon of your favorite TJ’s olive oil
10-12 of your favorite small TJ’s tortillas, warmed
1 bag TJ’s Organic Shredded Green and Red Cabbage with Orange Carrots
1 can TJ’s Traditional Style Fat Free Refried Beans, warmed according to package instructions
2 TJ’s Limes, sliced into wedges for serving

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400ºF. Place squash in a large bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and taco seasoning and toss to coat.
Spread seasoned squash on a large baking sheet and roast for 20-25 min until fork-tender, tossing squash halfway through cooking.
To assemble tacos: spread warmed refried beans on tortillas and layer with squash, cabbage, and salsa. Garnish with cilantro and limes wedges. Serve immediately.

squash-tacos.title: Squash Tacos

sriracha-bbq-chicken-skewers.description:
The formula for Trader Joe's Organic Sriracha & Roasted Garlic BBQ Sauce is simple: sriracha + BBQ Sauce... but, the genius is in the details. We combine spicy Sriracha (our very recipe of chili peppers, garlic, sugar, and vinegar), and combine it with what some might call "Memphis-style" BBQ Sauce-referring to its tomato-base, thick texture, reddish-brown color, and the taste of sweet molasses.   

This marvelous marriage tastes of Sriracha and... BBQ Sauce. It's garlicky, sweet, and spicy-all at once. Try it in this simple recipe for grilled chicken skewers, or use it to enhance burgers, kabobs, beef or pork ribs, veggies, grilled seafood...
ingredients: 1 package TJ's Boneless Chicken Breasts, cut into 2" cubes
1/2 cup TJ's Organic Sriracha & Roasted Garlic BBQ Sauce
2 tablespoons chopped TJ's Fresh Cilantro (optional garnish)
You will also need Bamboo Skewers, soaked in water for at least 20 minutes

steps.text: Heat grill to medium-high. Thread 4 or 5 chicken pieces onto each skewer.

Grill chicken until it begins to brown, flipping often, about 5-7 minutes. During the final stages of cooking, continually baste chicken with Sriracha BBQ sauce, about 3-5 minutes. Remove from grill when internal temperature of chicken reaches 165°F. Garnish with cilantro and serve.

sriracha-bbq-chicken-skewers.title: Sriracha BBQ Chicken Skewers

sriracha-bbq-meatballs.description: Make these meatballs a mainstay of your appetizer game.
ingredients: 1 bag TJ's Frozen Meatballs (we used the Turkey variety)
1 bottle TJ's Organic Sriracha and Roasted Garlic BBQ Sauce

steps.text: Empty meatball in a large microwave safe bowl. Cover with a lid or plate. Microwave for 4 minutes.
Meanwhile, in a medium saucepan, begin heating entire jar of Sriracha BBQ sauce on low, stirring occasionally.

Remove bowl of meatballs from microwave. Bowl will be hot, handle carefully. Add meatballs to saucepan and stir, coating meatballs on all sides with sauce. Continue to heat on low, about 3 minutes until bubbly.
Empty meatballs and sauce into a serving bowl. Garnish with chives and serve with toothpicks.

sriracha-bbq-meatballs.title: Sriracha BBQ Meatballs

sriracha-furikake-tofu-fries.description: If you've been to a poké bar, you're likely familiar with Furikake—it's a multi-purpose Japanese seasoning that's a fan favorite on the fast-fish scene. But Furikake isn't just for fish, folks—sprinkle it on scrambled eggs, roasted veggies, tofu, French fries—or even tofu fries!
ingredients: 2 packages TJ's Sriracha Flavored Baked Tofu
2 large TJ's Eggs, egg whites separated

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a sheet pan with parchment paper and spray lightly with canola oil spray.
Cut tofu into thin, "fry-sized" strips.
Place egg whites in a small bowl.
In a medium bowl, combine breadcrumbs, Parmesan, and furikake and toss together.

One by one, dredge tofu strips in egg whites, making sure every side is covered. Briefly hold each strip over bowl and allow excess to drip off. Roll egg white-covered strip in the breadcrumb/furikake mix until all sides are thoroughly covered. Place on greased baking sheet. Repeat until all tofu strips are properly coated and placed on baking sheet, a few inches apart.
Once all tofu strips are placed on sheet, lightly spray them with canola oil spray.
Place sheet in center rack of oven and bake for about 25 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove from oven, let cool, enjoy!

sriracha-furikake-tofu-fries.title: Sriracha Furikake Tofu Fries

sticky-monkey-buns.description: Ooey, gooey, fruity! Easy to make and a delight to enjoy for a special brunch spread or holiday gathering.
ingredients: 1 roll TJ's refrigerated Buttermilk Biscuits, separated & sliced into quarters
1 jar TJ's Fleur de Sel Caramel Sauce
2 ripe TJ's Bananas, sliced into medallions
1/3 cup TJ's Unsalted Dry Roasted Pecan Pieces

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F. Spray a standard muffin pan with coconut oil spray, set aside.
In a medium bowl, whisk together sugar, brown sugar and cinnamon. Toss biscuit pieces in sugar mixture until well coated; set aside.

Add 1 tablespoon caramel sauce to 10 of the greased muffin pan cups. On top of the caramel, layer the following ingredients in order: 4 banana slices, 1 teaspoon of pecans, and one small handful of jumbo raisins. Gently press three of the coated biscuit pieces over each cup (you will have a couple extra pieces - be creative).

Place pan in center rack of oven and bake approximately 15 minutes or until dough turns golden brown and an inserted toothpick comes out clean. Remove pan from oven and allow to cool for 1 minute. Flip the entire muffin pan over a clean cutting board to release sticky buns from the cups. Serve warm.

sticky-monkey-buns.title: Sticky Monkey Buns

strawberry-dome-cake.description: With red & blue berries topping an impressive mound of vanilla ice cream, buttressed by a foundation of vanilla cake, this recipe answers that all-important question: "What should we serve our Independence Day guests for dessert?"
ingredients: 1 half gallon TJ's French Vanilla Ice Cream, softened
1 TJ's Chantilly Cream Vanilla Bean Mini Sheet Cake (or 18 ounces of YOUR favorite TJ's Bakery cake)

steps.text: Lay a large sheet of plastic wrap inside a 2-quart stainless steel bowl, with the plastic edges overhanging, set aside.

Rinse strawberries and cut off the tops and tips. Slice each strawberry into 3-4 thin circles. Arrange strawberry slices in a single layer on the inside of the bowl, starting in the center and working out to the edges. Scoop softened ice cream over the top of the strawberries and smooth out until the surface is flat.

In a separate bowl, crumble the cake with your fingers. Spread the cake crumbles in a thick layer atop the ice cream and gently press down to secure. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and place in freezer for about 5 hours or until firm.

To serve, soak the bottom of the bowl in a separate bowl of warm water for a few seconds to help dislodge the cake. Remove the plastic wrap from the top of the bowl, place a serving plate over the cake and flip. Remove bowl and plastic wrap. Garnish cake with whipped cream, fresh blueberries and mint leaves. Serve immediately.

strawberry-dome-cake.title: Strawberry Dome Cake

strawberry-matcha-tiramisu.description: We challenged Trader Joe's Crew Members across the country to a Recipe Contest, inviting them to create their own delicious dishes using no more than five TJ's ingredients. We were WOW-ed by the submissions! This recipe won 1st Runner Up, and was created by Makenzie Mendelson from Store #656 in Newport News, Virginia.
ingredients: ½ cup and 3 tablespoons TJ’s Organic Cane Sugar, divided
1 package TJ’s Chocolate Chip Pain Au Lait
3 single-serve packets TJ’s Matcha Green Tea

steps.text: Blitz the entire bag of strawberries in a blender until powdery.
In a large bowl, add whipping cream and powdered strawberries and whip using a whisk or mixer until soft peaks form.
Once peaks have formed, add mascarpone and 1/2 cup sugar and mix until just combined. Set whipped cream mixture aside.
Mix 2 packets of matcha with 3 tablespoons of sugar and one cup of water. Mix until dissolved. A frother or a blender may help dissolve clumps.
Pour matcha mixture into a wide, shallow bowl and set aside.
Cut each Pain Au Lait lengthwise in half.
One by one, dip eight of the halves into the matcha mixture and arrange into a single layer in 8 x 8” baking pan. Some pieces may need to be cut to fit the pan.
Gently spread half the strawberry whipped cream mixture over the Pain Au Lait in an even layer.
One by one, dip remaining halves of Pain Au Lait into the matcha mixture and arrange to form a second Pain Au Lait layer.
Top with remaining strawberry whipped cream mixture, spreading evenly.
Carefully sift the third pack of matcha evenly over the top of the tiramisu.
Chill for at least 4 hours or overnight before serving. Enjoy!

strawberry-matcha-tiramisu.title: Strawberry Matcha Tiramisu

strawberry-mule.description: This recipe is especially excellent when spring strawberries are in full swing.
ingredients: 2 TJ's Fresh Strawberries, roughly chopped, plus 2 whole strawberries for garnish
4 ounces of your favorite TJ's Tequila

steps.text: Add chopped strawberries to a large measuring glass. Muddle or mash into a pulp with the back of a spoon. (For a spicy kick, muddle fresh cilantro and two slices of jalapeño with the strawberries.)
Add ginger beer, tequila and lime juice and stir to combine.
Fill two copper mugs with ice. Divide tequila mixture among mugs and top up with sparkling water. Garnish each mug with a fresh strawberry and serve.

strawberry-mule.title: Strawberry Mule

strawberry-sparkler.description: With its crisp bubbles, juicy strawberry notes and the clean kick of Texas Vodka, this sparkly-sweet cocktail recipe has mass appeal and major flavor. It's perfect for lounging by the pool, picnicking in the park, relaxing in the great outdoors...
ingredients: 4 oz. TJ’s Sparkling Strawberry Juice Beverage

steps.text: Place ice in a highball glass. Pour in the vodka and the juice of half a lemon (approximately 2 teaspoons). Add the Sparkling Strawberry Juice and stir. Garnish with a strawberry and serve.

strawberry-sparkler.title: Strawberry Sparkler

strawberry-speculoos-rolls.description:
These decadent Strawberry Speculoos Rolls employ time-saving TJ’s Organic Jumbo Cinnamon Rolls as the base and offer a double dose of Cookie Butter—filled with Trader Joe’s Speculoos Cookie Butter and adorned with crushed up TJ’s Speculoos Cookies. Yum! 

This recipe was the grand prize winner of the 2026 Store Recipe Contest and was created by the Crew at Store #701 in Chicago (South Loop)! KUDOS! 

Pro-tip: To streamline assembly and maintain structural integrity, be sure to prep & measure all of your ingredients prior to removing cinnamon roll dough from the refrigerator.
ingredients: 1 tube TJ's Organic Jumbo Cinnamon Rolls
1/2 bag TJ's Freeze Dried Strawberries, crushed and divided
1/2 cup TJ's Speculoos Cookie Butter Spread, melted

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line a 18x9 inch baking sheet with foil or parchment and set aside.

Unroll the cinnamon roll dough to form 1 cohesive slab of dough. Sprinkle ¼ cup freeze-dried strawberries over the dough. Drizzle evenly with cookie butter, then let sit for 5 minutes to allow the cookie butter to solidify a little (this will make rolling easier.) Roll back into a log, then roll in in crushed speculoos cookies so they adhere to the exterior of the roll.
Slice log into 5 rolls and place on greased cookie sheet. Bake for 15-18 minutes. Let cool for 10 minutes.

While the cinnamon rolls cool, prepare the frosting by squeezing the frosting packet from the cinnamon rolls tube in a medium-sized bowl. Add mascarpone and 2 tablespoons of freeze-dried strawberries and mix to combine. Liberally spread over the tops of the cooled cinnamon rolls.
Garnish with crushed speculoos cookies and freeze-dried strawberries to serve.

strawberry-speculoos-rolls.title: Strawberry Speculoos Rolls

strawberry-string-cheese-snack-rolls.description: It’s no secret that kids love Trader Joe’s String Cheese. It may surprise you that adults are as smitten with this stringable snack as their progeny. This mild, mozzarella-style cheese is portable and pulls apart with such ease. In addition to its notable String-ability is its impressive meltability, as evidenced by these sweet and cheesy snack rolls. They are easy to prepare, quick to cook, and downright delightful to snack on for both kids and kids at heart.
ingredients: ¼ cup TJ’s Fresh Strawberry Preserves

steps.text: Melt butter in a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.

Spread 2 tablespoons of strawberry preserves over one side of one tortilla. Place 1 string cheese stick in the center of the tortilla and fold each side of the tortilla over to encase the cheese. Repeat assembly for second roll.

Add rolls to the pan, seam side down, and cook for 2-3 minutes, until the tortillas become golden, and the cheese begins to soften. Flip and continue to cook until each tortilla is toasted and the cheese is melted.

strawberry-string-cheese-snack-rolls.title: Strawberry & String Cheese Snack Rolls

strawberry-watermelon-cereal-treats.description: Trader Joe’s Strawberry & Watermelon Marshmallows are everything a summer sweet-treat should be: fruity, fluffy, and fun to eat. They’re equally awesome snacked on straight out of the bag as they are melted down to make a fruity-flavored cereal bar. For a double dose of superb strawberry flavor, combine them with TJ’s Strawberry Yogurt O’s.
ingredients: 1 (eight ounce) bag TJ’s Strawberry & Watermelon Marshmallows

steps.text: Line a 9x9 baking dish with parchment paper; set aside.

In a large pot, add butter and melt over medium heat. Add Strawberry & Watermelon Marshmallows and stir with a silicone spatula until completely melted with the butter, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Add cereal to the pot, one cup at a time, stirring with spatula until thoroughly combined.
Pour mixture into the parchment-lined baking dish. Cover with an additional piece of parchment and press to evenly distribute into the dish.
Let sit 15 minutes before slicing and serving.

strawberry-watermelon-cereal-treats.title: Strawberry Watermelon Cereal Treats

stuffed-avocado.description: As if avocados could get any better.
ingredients: 1 can TJ's Yellowfin Tuna in Olive Oil, drained
1 Tbsp diced TJ's Red Bell Pepper
1/4 teaspoon TJ's Sea Salt, or to taste
1/4 teaspoon TJ's Ground Black Pepper, or to taste
1 TJ's Avocado, sliced in half and pit removed

steps.text: In a medium bowl, combine tuna, mayo, onion, celery, bell pepper, parsley, salt and pepper. For a creamier texture, scrape a spoonful of avocado from each side and add to the bowl. Mash the tuna salad with a fork until well incorporated. Spoon the tuna salad back into each avocado half. Serve and enjoy!

stuffed-avocado.title: Stuffed Avocado

stuffing-muffins.description:
These portable parcels of stuffing goodness are a warm and inviting antidote to chilly fall days. The recipe starts with Trader Joe’s Cornbread Stuffing Mix, liberally seasoned with chicken broth, garlic & onion powders, and fragrant spices. Once prepared, TJ's Dried Cranberries are folded in for a touch of seasonally-inspired sweetness.

The real secet to these mighty muffins, though, is TJ's Turkey Meatballs. Like finding the secret decoder ring inside the cereal box, simply slice into a Stuffing Muffin to reveal the reward baked within: a moist, savory Meatball. It’s a delightful surprise, made even tastier with a dip in our ready-to-heat-&-eat TJ's Turkey Gravy.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F. Mix 4 tablespoons butter, water and seasoning pouch from stuffing mix in a large saucepan and bring to a low boil for 3-5 minutes. Remove from heat and gently fold in croutons until thoroughly moistened. Cover and let sit for 10 minutes. Remove lid from stuffing and gently stir in cranberries.
While stuffing sits, place turkey meatballs in a microwave-safe dish. Cover and microwave 2-3 minutes. Remove from microwave, slice in half and set aside.

Grease a 12-cup muffin pan with remaining tablespoon of butter. Fill each muffin cup about 1/3 full with stuffing. Add a turkey meatball half (flat side down) to each cup and cover with stuffing until you have a small mound that sits slightly above the rim of the cup. Repeat with remaining stuffing and turkey meatball halves. Place pan on center rack of oven and bake 40-45 minutes. Remove pan from oven and let sit 10 minutes.
While muffins cool, heat gravy according to package directions. Gently remove muffins from pan with a fork or butter knife. Serve with gravy for dipping.

stuffing-muffins.title: Stuffing Muffins

sufganiyot-jelly-donuts.description:
These Sufganiyot, or fried donuts, make a fun, customizable, downright delicious baking project that can be made from flour to finish in under three hours (and that includes two hours of hands-off proofing time!)

The dough is lightly sweetened with Trader Joe's Organic Powdered Cane Sugar and the finished donuts are served with a snow-like sprinkle to complement an array of fillings, from classic Strawberry Preserves or Raspberry Preserves to TJ's Lemon Curd, or Cocoa Almond Spread. Choose your favorite or fry them all—your donuts, your choice!  

Pro-tip: Use an instant-read thermometer to check the oil temperature between batches. When dough is added, it can quickly lower the temperature. Make sure the oil returns to 325°F before adding more dough to ensure evenly cooked donuts.
ingredients: 1/4 cup TJ's Organic Powdered Cane Sugar, plus more for dusting
1/2 tablespoon SAF Active Dry Perfect Rise Yeast
1 3/4 cup TJ's Unbleached Enriched All-Purpose Flour, plus more for dusting
1/2 teaspoon TJ's Organic Pure Bourbon Vanilla Extract
3/4 cup of your favorite filling! Try TJ's Strawberry or Raspberry Preserves, TJ's Cocoa Almond Spread, or TJ's Lemon Curd
Special tool: Piping bag or squeeze bottle

steps.text: Combine warmed milk with powdered sugar and yeast. Stir, then allow to sit for 5 minutes until foaming. In a separate bowl, whisk the flour and salt together. Set aside.

When the yeast mixture is foaming, whisk in the egg, vanilla and melted butter. Stir in the flour mixture until fully incorporated and no lumps remain. The dough will be quite sticky. Cover the bowl, and let sit at room temperature for 1 1⁄2 to 2 hours, or until doubled in size.
Prepare 2 baking sheets. Dust one sheet with flour and place a cooling rack or paper towels on the other.

Dust a clean work surface with flour. Scrape the dough onto the floured surface. Sprinkle a light dusting of flour over the top and on your hands. Pat the dough into a 10x12-inch rectangle, approximately ¼-inch thick. Use a knife to cut the dough into 12, 2-inch squares. Transfer to the floured baking sheet.

Pour oil into a heavy pot and heat to 325°F.  Fry 3 donuts at a time (to avoid overcrowding the pot and lowering the oil temperature), flipping them after about 1 ½ minutes, or when the bottom side becomes golden brown. Flip and cook the other side for about 1 ½ minutes, maintaining the oil temperature between 325°F and 350°F. Remove donuts with a slotted spoon and place on prepared cooling rack, or paper towel-lined baking sheet. Repeat with remaining donuts.

When the donuts are cool enough to handle, insert a narrow paring knife or chopstick in the side. Wiggle back and forth to create a small pocket inside. Fill a piping bag or squeeze bottle with your filling(s) of choice. Squeeze about 1 tablespoon of filling into each donut. Dust with powdered sugar and serve immediately.

If you don't have a piping bag or squeeze bottle, you can make your own piping bag for filling these donuts by using a disposable zipper bag and following these steps:

Use scissors to make a small cut to one of the bottom corners of the bag. 

Open the bag and add your filling.

Squeeze the air out of the bag and seal, then carefully squeeze the filling towards the open corner of the bag. 

You are now ready to pipe!
steps.title: Extra Credit: How To Make A Piping Bag

sufganiyot-jelly-donuts.title: Sufganiyot (Jelly Donuts)

sugar-pumpkin-pie-nuts.description: Pile these candied nuts on a bowl of yogurt, ice cream, pancakes stuffed french toast…
ingredients: 1 lb assorted TJ's Nuts (TJ's Raw Cashew Pieces, TJ's Raw Pecan Pieces, TJ's Walnut Halves & Pieces)

steps.text: Place assorted nuts into a large bowl, set aside.

In a medium pot, combine the milk, sugar, salt and pumpkin pie spice and place over medium heat. Stir constantly for about 5 minutes until the sugar dissolves. Allow the mixture to come to a boil until it reaches at least 235°F but no more than 245°F.

Tip: If you do not have a candy thermometer, a great way to determine if you've reached this temperature range is to drop a spoonful of hot syrup into a bowl of very cold water. In the water, use your fingers to gather the cooled syrup into a ball. If it has reached soft-ball stage, the syrup easily forms a ball while in the cold water, but flattens once removed from the water-now you know!

Remove pot from heat, add vanilla extract, stir and pour over the bowl of mixed nuts. Using a wooden or silicone spatula, coat the nuts and lay on a flat surface covered with parchment or wax paper to cool. Once cooled, break apart and enjoy! Use as a topping on a salad, add to a fruit and cheese plate or simply eat by the handful.

sugar-pumpkin-pie-nuts.title: Sugar Pumpkin Pie Nuts

sushi-bake.description:
Originally invented as a cost-effective alternative to crab, Surimi has since taken on a culinary identity all its own, and is especially adored in dishes where its firmer texture and milder flavor make it preferable to crab, for some palates (and all wallets). Trader Joe’s Surimi Imitation Crabmeat is lightly sweet, a little briny, and delightfully flaky—and ready to be used in all sorts of seafood-y recipes, right out of the package. 

For sushi night without breaking the bank, or even leaving your home, this Sushi Bake is giving Spicy California Roll, and we’re here for it. 

Pro-tip: Cut cream cheese into small cubes and leave on a plate on your counter to help bring it to room temperature in about 30 minutes.
ingredients: 2 bags frozen Organic Jasmine Rice, prepared according to package heating instructions
TJ’s Nori Komi Furikake Japanese Multi-Purpose Seasoning
1/3 block TJ’s Cream Cheese, room temperature
¼ cup TJ’s Dynamite Sauce, plus more for drizzling
2 teaspoons TJ’s Reduced Sodium Soy Sauce
3 TJ’s Green Onions, finely chopped, divided
2-3 packages TJ’s Roasted Seaweed with Sea Salt, for serving
2 TJ’s Persian Cucumbers, sliced into matchsticks

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F. Spray a 2-quart or 11-by-7-inch baking pan with avocado oil spray.
In a small bowl, combine vinegar, sugar, and salt, and stir until dissolved. Add warm rice to a large bowl, then fold in vinegar mixture.
Spread seasoned rice into bottom of prepared baking dish, packing it down firmly. Top evenly with a generous sprinkle of furikake.

In a medium bowl, add Surimi and shred using two forks. Then add cream cheese, Dynamite Sauce, soy sauce, and two thirds of the green onions and mix with a spatula to combine. Evenly spread surimi mixture over the furikake layer, gently packing it down.

Bake for 20-25 minutes, until rice begins to brown at edges and the surimi mixture is heated through. Let cool for 5-10 minutes. Drizzle with more Dynamite Sauce, a sprinkle of furikake, and the remaining green onions.
To serve, scoop spoonfuls of the sushi bake atop sheets of roasted seaweed and serve with avocado and cucumbers.

sushi-bake.title: Sushi Bake

sweet--smoky-slaw.description: Made with Spanish-grown sweet red peppers that are slowly roasted over hard wood planks, Trader Joe's Smoked Paprika packs a powerfully smoky punch. It's the key to the sweet-smoky flavor of this slaw recipe that makes for an excellent warm-weather side dish or meatless main.
ingredients: 1 bag TJ's Broccoli & Kale Slaw Complete Salad Kit
1 can TJ's Organic Great Northern Beans, drained and rinsed

steps.text: In a serving bowl, toss the slaw with included dressing and toppings, set aside.

Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add paprika and stir until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add beans and a pinch of salt and stir to coat. Heat 3-5 minutes or until heated through. Remove from heat and let cool slightly.
Add warm beans to salad and gently toss to incorporate. Enjoy immediately.

sweet--smoky-slaw.title: Sweet & Smoky Slaw

sweet-and-spicy-chicken-skewers.description: Trader Joe's Spicy Peanut Vinaigrette isn't just for salads—it's also an instant marinade for chicken skewers and other grilled fare.
ingredients: 1 package TJ's Boneless Chicken Breasts, cut into 2" cubes
1 bottle of TJ's Spicy Peanut Vinaigrette
1 package TJ's Sliced Fresh Pineapple, cut into chunks
2 TJ's Green Bell Peppers, cut into 1.5" pieces
2 or 3 TJ's Oranges cut into approximately 6 slices (keep peel on)
2 TJ's Red Onions, sliced into large chunks

steps.text: Preheat grill to 375°F. Put cut chicken pieces in a bowl and the cut veggies and fruit into another bowl. Fill each bowl with half the bottle of spicy peanut vinaigrette. Let marinate for at least 20 minutes, though preferably overnight. Soak 10-12 wooden skewers in water while ingredients are marinating.

When ready, assemble ingredients on skewer in the following order: green pepper, onion chunk, pineapple slice, chicken piece, orange slice (skew through the skin), pineapple slice, chicken piece. Repeat until skewer is filled (not too tightly).

To keep the skewers from sticking, spray the top of the grill with canola oil. Grill for 12-15 minutes (turning skewer at 6 min). Chicken is done once it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F.   

Recipe Credit: Trader Joe's Stick It! 2013 HiiP Recipe Contest Featuring Food On A Stick 1st Place Winner - Shari Walsh
