sweet-and-spicy-chicken-skewers.title: Sweet and Spicy Chicken Skewers

sweet-apple-cheddar-breakfast-casserole.description: For a substantial breakfast that’s enough grub for a big group (or leftovers all week), we turn to a breakfast casserole filled with Trader Joe’s Sweet Apple Chicken Sausage to satisfy both the sweet and savory cravings at the table. They’re hearty and offer a subtle sweetness that pairs harmoniously with cheddar cheese. And if you need to satiate a sweet, savory, and spicy appetite, serve with a pour of your favorite hot sauce. This casserole can be made in advance and reheated when ready to serve.
ingredients: 3 TJ’s Sweet Apple Chicken Sausage, sliced
1 TJ’s Ciabatta Demi Baguette, cut into bite-sized pieces (or 5 cups)
1 cup TJ’s Baby Broccoli, chopped, bottoms of stems discarded

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a two-quart baking dish with oil spray.
In a medium-sized frying pan, over medium heat, add sliced chicken sausage and brown, about 5 minutes.
In small bowl, whisk eggs and milk together. Season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
In a large bowl, add bread cubes, sliced sausage, chopped broccoli, and shredded cheese. Pour egg mixture over the contents. With a spatula, mix until everything is evenly coated in the egg mixture.
Transfer to your baking dish and bake in oven for 30 minutes, or until top is golden brown and a knife inserted in the center comes out clean.
Let cool for 5 minutes before serving.

sweet-apple-cheddar-breakfast-casserole.title: Sweet Apple Sausage & Cheddar Breakfast Casserole

sweet-balls-of-fire.description: Goodness, gracious—you'll be so glad you made these meatballs.
ingredients: 1/2 cup TJ's Organic Reduced Sugar Raspberry (or Strawberry) Preserves

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Prepare sauce: In a sauce pan over medium heat, add raspberry preserves and sweet chili sauce. Heat until sauce begins to bubble, about 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove from heat.

Place meatballs in a 9x9 baking dish and cover with warm sauce mixture. Place dish in oven and heat for 40 minutes, or until meatballs are heated to 165°F and sauce is hot. Alternatively, use a slow cooker to heat meatballs and sauce, about 5-6 hours on low, or 2-4 hours on high until heated through.

sweet-balls-of-fire.title: Sweet Balls of Fire

sweet-gold-grilled-chicken-thighs.description: Trader Joe’s All Natural Bone-In Skin-On Chicken Thighs are darn-near-perfect for grilling. Thigh meat is always incredibly flavorful, and that robust flavor is even more pronounced when the skin and bones are left intact. And even more pronounced if you slather them in TJ's Carolina Gold Barbeque Sauce! Watch our how-to video or read the instructions that follow and you’ll be adding “grill master” to your resumé in no time.
ingredients: 1 package TJ’s All Natural Bone-In Skin-On Chicken Thighs
TJ’s Sea Salt & Ground Black Pepper, to taste
2 tablespoons TJ’s Olive Oil, plus more for greasing the grill
1/2 cup TJ’s Carolina Gold Barbeque Sauce (or your favorite TJ’s BBQ Sauce), divided, plus more for serving

steps.text: Season the chicken thighs with salt and pepper all over. Let sit for 30 minutes.
Preheat a medium hot grill. Using tongs, wipe the surface of the grill with a lightly oiled towel.
Drizzle the chicken thighs with olive oil. Brush with 1/4 cup of BBQ sauce (discard any remaining sauce).
Place chicken skin-side down on a clean grill. Let sit for 4 minutes. Turn ¼ and let sit another 4 minutes. If the chicken starts to char or burn, move to cooler spot on the grill.
Turn the chicken thighs over and let cook for 4 minutes, brush with more BBQ sauce, then make a quarter turn, baste more, and let cook 2 minutes.

Using a small knife or tip of an instant read thermometer, poke the chicken by the bones to make sure that the juices are clear. If not, baste with more sauce and continue to cook on the grill. Cook chicken to an interior temperature of 165°F.
Remove from the grill and let sit 5 minutes. Serve with additional BBQ Sauce on the side.

sweet-gold-grilled-chicken-thighs.title: Sweet Gold Grilled Chicken Thighs

sweet-kale-slaw-turkey-burger.description: Trader Joe's Turkey Burgers are made using fresh, white & dark turkey meat, a combination that ensures juicy, flavorful burgers. You can cook them on the stovetop or grill-from frozen, even!-in just a few minutes. Paired with crunchy kale slaw and ridge cut potato chips, dinner doesn't get much easier than this-and you don't have to sacrifice quality or taste for the sake of convenience and value.
ingredients: 1 package TJ's Broccoli Kale Slaw Complete Salad Kit
TJ's Gourmet White Hamburger Buns or TJ's Gluten Free Hamburger Buns

steps.text: Add oil to a grill pan or skillet and turn heat to medium-high. Cook turkey burgers according to package directions; remove from heat.
In a medium bowl, toss salad with included toppings and dressing. To assemble, place turkey burger on bottom half of bun. Top with slaw and top half of bun, and serve with potato chips.

sweet-kale-slaw-turkey-burger.title: Sweet Kale Slaw Turkey Burger

sweet-smoky-seared-tilapia.description: Trader Joe's Sweet & Smoky Peach Salsa takes seared tilapia to new heights.
ingredients: 2 TJ's Tilapia Filets, defrosted according to package directions
1 bag TJ's Frozen Organic Jasmine Rice
TJ's Smoked Paprika, Sea Salt & Pepper

steps.text: Microwave rice according to package directions. Pat tilapia filets dry with paper towels and generously season both sides with paprika, sea salt & pepper.
In a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat, melt ghee. Add tilapia to skillet and cook 2-3 minutes per side, until fish is opaque and flakes easily with a fork. Remove from heat.
To assemble: Divide rice among two plates and top each with a tilapia filet. Drizzle filets with desired amount of salsa, and garnish with lemon slices and cilantro. Enjoy immediately.

sweet-smoky-seared-tilapia.title: Sweet & Smoky Seared Tilapia

sweet-spicy-peach-ricotta-toast.description: There’s ricotta toast, and then there’s ricotta toast with Trader Joe's Spicy Honey Sauce, fresh peaches, and fragrant thyme. It looks fancy, but can be prepared in a flash, making it a must-have recipe for those hot summer mornings when turning on the stove is just not an option. And when stone fruit season ends, you can keep the sweet & spicy breakfast vibes going by subbing in sliced strawberries or ripe pears.
ingredients: 6 sprigs TJ’s Fresh Thyme, stems removed
7 tablespoons TJ’s Spicy Honey Sauce, divided, plus more for drizzling
Squeeze of a TJ’s Fresh Lemon wedge
1 tub TJ’s Whole Milk Ricotta Cheese
8 slices your favorite hearty TJ’s Multigrain Bread

steps.text: Toss peaches with fresh thyme leaves, 3 tablespoons spicy honey sauce and a squeeze of lemon. Set aside.
In a small bowl, mix ricotta with remaining 4 tablespoons spicy honey sauce.
Toast the bread. Top generously with the honey ricotta and macerated peaches.
Drizzle with spicy honey sauce and enjoy right away.

sweet-spicy-peach-ricotta-toast.title: Sweet & Spicy Peach Ricotta Toast

sweet-spicy-pecan-crusted-salmon.description: This fish dish gets its zing from a tangy honey mustard spread and our very own Sweet & Spicy Pecans.
ingredients: 1/2 cup (1 stick) TJ's Unsalted Butter, melted
3 Tablespoons TJ's Aioli Garlic Mustard Sauce
2 Tablespoons coarsely chopped fresh TJ's Rosemary
1/4 cup TJ's Japanese Style Panko Breadcrumbs
1/4 cup finely chopped TJ's Sweet and Spicy Pecans
4 teaspoons chopped TJ's Parsley, plus more for garnish
TJ's Fresh Salmon Boneless Skinless Fillets (2 large fillets)

steps.text: Preheat oven to 425 degrees F.
In a small bowl, stir together melted butter, mustard, and honey.
Cut potatoes into eighths and coat with ½ cup of the honey mustard mixture, set the rest of the mixture aside. Sprinkle rosemary over potatoes.
Grease a baking sheet with canola oil spray then spread coated potatoes in an even layer, leaving room to add the salmon filets later. Begin baking potatoes for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, in another small bowl, mix together panko crumbs, pecans, and parsley, then set aside.
Place salmon filets skin-side down on a plate. Season with salt and pepper then brush generously with reserved honey mustard mixture. Sprinkle the tops of the fillets with the panko crumb mixture.

After 20 minutes, remove tray of potatoes from oven then add salmon filets, skin side down on the tray next to the potatoes. Bake salmon and potatoes for an additional 10 to 15 minutes, or until salmon flakes easily with a fork. Serve with a wedge of lemon and garnish with extra parsley.

sweet-spicy-pecan-crusted-salmon.title: Sweet & Spicy Pecan-Crusted Salmon

sweet-spicy-pimento-grilled-cheese.description: Our rich, peppery Pimento Cheese Dip and Hot & Sweet Jalapeños co-star in this fun and fiery (and super easy-to-make) grilled cheese, which can easily be adjusted to your preferred level of heat by simply adding more or fewer jalapeño slices. Here’s a hot tip: make sure to keep your burner on low during the cooking process to ensure an even browning and magnificently melty interior without scorching your bread.
ingredients: ¼ cup TJ’s Pimento Cheese Spread
TJ’s Hot & Sweet Jalapeños, to taste

steps.text: Allow butter to soften.

Spread pimento cheese over one side of two slices sourdough bread. Top one slice with 3-4 slices of jalapeño, or more to taste. Sandwich bread slices together, with cheese and jalapeños in the middle.
Melt one tablespoon of butter in a skillet on low heat.
Spread remaining ½ tablespoon of softened butter over outside surface of sandwich.
Cook the sandwich in skillet for 4-5 minutes per side, until bread is well browned and cheese is melty inside. Remove from skillet, slice in half, and serve.

sweet-spicy-pimento-grilled-cheese.title: Sweet & Spicy Pimento Grilled Cheese

sweet-spicy-whipped-brie.description:
The idea of any double cream cheese is that it contains at least 60% butterfat, guaranteeing a rich and creamy result in every bite… and we’re doubling down on the declaration that double cream cheeses are doubly delicious. Dubious? Doubtful? Don’t be. Instead, head to the cheese case at your neighborhood Trader Joe’s, pick up a wedge of Trader Joe’s Double Cream Brie, and taste for yourself. If you care to take it up a notch, break out your stand mixer for this elevated app—brie-lieve us, it’s worth the additional prep!

Pro-tip: After you slice the rind off the Brie wedge, allow the cheese to warm to room temperature for about 20 minutes. This will result in an extra-creamy texture.
ingredients: A few cranks of TJ’s Black Peppercorns
TJ’s Organic French Baguette,  your favorite TJ’s Crackers, or slices of your favorite TJ’s Apple, to serve

steps.text: Remove Brie from the refrigerator, and slice off the rind (it will be easier to do while the wedge is cold.) Discard the rind and chop Brie into cubes. Let come to room temperature for about 20 minutes.

After the cheese has warmed, add to the bowl of a stand mixer. Using the paddle attachment, whip on medium-high for 3-5 minutes, intermittently scraping the bowl with a spatula while the mixer is off, until no lumps remain.
Transfer to a serving bowl of plate and drizzle with honey and a few cranks of pepper. Serve with baguette slices, your favorite crackers, and apple slices.

sweet-spicy-whipped-brie.title: Sweet & Spicy Whipped Brie

sweet-tangy-apricot-glaze.description:
Trader Joe’s Organic Apricot Preserves couple the uniquely sweet and delicately tart flavor of its star stone fruit with a silky-smooth texture that’s ideal for spreading over toast, muffins, or freshly made pancakes. These qualities shine splendidly in a savory context, too.

It’s a spectacular base for a sweet and tangy glaze that can be poured over a variety of dishes—pan-fried pork chops, fried chicken thighs, blanched green beans, or roasted brussels sprouts. We’re particularly fond of coating our fully cooked Chicken Meatballs with this glaze and serving it over steamed rice, topped with chopped green onion, for a quick and flavorful lunch or dinner option.
ingredients: ½ cup TJ’s Organic Apricot Preserves
1 tablespoon TJ’s Aioli Garlic Mustard Sauce
½ teaspoon TJ’s Organic Crushed Red Pepper

steps.text: To a small saucepan over medium heat, add all ingredients and whisk to combine.
When it begins to bubble, whisk continuously for 1 minute, until it thickens, then remove from heat.

sweet-tangy-apricot-glaze.title: Sweet & Tangy Apricot Glaze

taco-monkey-bread.description:
Interested in tackling a fun food project that’ll feed a crowd? We’re using Trader Joe’s Organic Biscuits as a stupendous and easy-to-use base for a savory, taco-inspired monkey bread that’s as fun to assemble as it is to eat! We’re loading a Bundt pan (or two loaf pans, if you prefer) with biscuit dough balls filled with spicy ground beef and cheese and serving it with all the go-to taco fixings! Not only does a Bundt pan yield a showstopping shape for serving, but the center is ideal for a bowl of sour cream or your favorite TJ’s salsa or guacamole! Watch the video to see how it’s made.

Note: this recipe makes twice the amount of filling needed for one Bundt-size monkey bread. That means you could double the rest of the recipe to make two monkey breads or use the extra filling for a shepherd’s pie, sloppy joe sandwiches, stuffed peppers, or as a taco-inspired topping for homemade pizza!
ingredients: 2 tablespoons of your favorite TJ’s Olive Oil
1 pound TJ’s All Natural Lean Ground Beef
½-1 package TJ’s Taco Seasoning Mix
2 cups TJ’s Organic Crushed Fire Roasted Tomatoes
1 cup TJ’s Fancy Shredded Mexican Style Cheese Blend, plus more for garnish
1 cup TJ’s Salted Butter, melted and cooled
Your favorite TJ’s Salsa, for dipping
Your favorite TJ’s Guacamole, for dipping,
TJ’s Iceberg Lettuce, shredded, to serve

steps.text: In a large sauté pan over medium-high heat, add the oil and sauté the chopped onion until translucent. Add the ground beef and cook, breaking up with a spatula, until cooked through, about 10 minutes. Stir in the taco seasoning mix, ½ packet for mildly spicy, or a whole packet for hot and spicy! Add the canned tomatoes and bring to a simmer. Cook for 10 minutes until thickened, then cool completely.
Preheat the oven to 350° F.

Remove the biscuits from the cans and cut each in half widthwise. Flatten each with the palm of your hand or by using a rolling pin. Fill each flattened biscuit half with one tablespoon of taco meat and a tablespoon of shredded cheese. Fold the biscuit dough up and over the filling, pinching edges together, then gently roll into a ball using the palm of your hand.

Dip each dough ball in the melted butter then place them in the Bundt pan—don't worry if there are gaps, they will fill as the biscuit dough rises and bakes. Pour the remaining butter evenly over the top.
Bake in the oven for 20-30 minutes, until golden in color and well risen.
Let cool slightly then gently flip to remove from tin.

taco-monkey-bread.title: Taco Monkey Bread

tahini-caramel-brownies.description: Trader Joe's Brownie Truffle Baking Mix continues to be a customer favorite, and it's easy to see why: Loaded with rich, chocolatey goodness, it goes from box to brownie pan in mere minutes, and comes out moist and fudgy in the middle with delightfully chewy edges. PSA: These brownies are excellent served warm-and even more excellent when accompanied by a scoop of TJ's French Vanilla Ice Cream.
ingredients: TJ's Canola Oil or Coconut Oil Spray, to grease pan
1 box TJ's Brownie Truffle Baking Mix
1 stick (4 oz) TJ's Salted Butter, melted
1/4 cup TJ's Fleur de Sel Caramel Sauce, warmed in the microwave

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease an 8-inch square baking pan with canola oil spray; set aside.

In a large bowl, whisk eggs. Add brownie mix and melted butter, stir to combine (do not overmix). Pour batter into prepared pan, spreading evenly to pan edges with a spatula. Drizzle warmed caramel and tahini atop batter. Gently drag a sharp knife along the surface of the batter to swirl the tahini and caramel.
Place pan on center rack of oven and bake 25-30 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool 45 minutes before slicing.

tahini-caramel-brownies.title: Tahini Caramel Brownies

tahini-salad-dressing.description:
Food may not be the first thing that comes to mind when you hear the phrase "dress for success," but it should be. After all, a well-seasoned salad dressing can make or break a meal, especially if salad is the focal point. Too heavy and the flavors of the other components are lost; too light and there's nothing to really hold it together.    

Trader Joe's Organic Tahini provides the perfect balance in this recipe, and allows it to transcend seasons-drizzle it atop roasted broccoli salad in the winter, or on grilled chicken & spinach salad during the warm summer months. And while this recipe may have "salad dressing" in the name, don't let that stop you from transcending salad and dressing chicken kebabs, grilled shrimp, cubed tofu, or roasted veggies for dinner success.
ingredients: 1/4 cup water; 2 teaspoons TJ's Minced Garlic
1/8 teaspoon TJ's Sea Salt, or to taste

steps.text: Add all ingredients to a small bowl and whisk vigorously until well incorporated.
Taste and adjust seasoning as necessary.
Drizzle with abandon and enjoy!

tahini-salad-dressing.title: Tahini Salad Dressing

tangy-grilled-chicken-tenders.description: Trader Joe's Strained Thick & Creamy Plain Greek Yogurt plays dual roles in this recipe, as both the base of the tangy marinade and creamy dip! The natural acids in the Yogurt and Thick & Creamy texture help tenderize TJ's All Natural Chicken Tenders to help ensure moist meat, every time you fire up the grill (or grill pan).
ingredients: 1 cup TJ's Strained Thick & Creamy Plain Greek Yogurt
1 teaspoon TJ's Cuban Style Citrusy Garlic Seasoning Blend
2 tablespoons juice from a TJ's Lemon
1 1/2-2 pounds TJ's All Natural Chicken Breast Tenders
Your favorite TJ's Oil or Oil Spray, for greasing the grill grates
A few sprigs TJ's Cilantro, chopped, for garnish
1 TJ's Persian Cucumber, sliced into thin coins

steps.text: Add yogurt, seasonings, and lemon juice to a medium bowl and stir to combine.

For the dipping sauce, remove 1/4 cup of mixture and place into a small container fitted with a lid and refrigerate. Add chicken tenders to the medium bowl with the remaining marinade, then stir to coat evenly. Cover bowl and refrigerate for one hour.

Oil the grate of a grill or grill pan and preheat to medium-high. Shake excess marinade from chicken, skewer chicken (if desired), then grill 6-8 minutes per side, until juices run clear and internal temperature reaches 165°F. Remove from heat.
Remove reserved dipping sauce from refrigerator and add chopped cilantro and cucumber slices to serve.

tangy-grilled-chicken-tenders.title: Tangy Grilled Chicken Tenders

taquito-lada-casserole.description: This enchilada hack calls for taquitos in place of a hand-rolled filling—perfect for busy weeknight dinner prep.
ingredients: 2 cups TJ's Shredded Mexican Cheese Blend, divided
3 TJ's Green Onions, white and green parts, sliced
1/2 can TJ's Fire Roasted Diced Green Chiles

steps.text: Preheat oven to 425°F. Arrange taquitos in a single layer in a 7-inch by 10-inch baking dish and cover evenly with enchilada sauce. Top with 1 1/2 cups cheese, followed by olives and chiles.

Bake casserole on center rack of oven for 20 to 25 minutes, or until internal temperature reaches 165°F. Remove pan from oven and garnish with remaining cheese and green onions. Allow to cool slightly before serving.

taquito-lada-casserole.title: Taquito-lada Casserole

teatime-madeleines.description: For a strikingly stunning yet simple DIY-cookie decoration, dress up Trader Joe’s Madeleine Cookies with a pop of color from crushed Trader Joe’s Freeze Dried Strawberries and chopped pistachios. Adorn your teatime spread with these delicate and fanciful cookies for some added flair. A fun task for decorators of all ages, simply sprinkle the strawberries and pistachios over the homemade glaze while still wet—they will adhere to the cookies as the glaze dries.
ingredients: ¼ cup TJ’s Organic Powdered Sugar
¼ cup TJ’s Freeze Dried Strawberries, crushed
¼ cup TJ’s Dry Roasted & Salted Pistachio Nutmeats finely chopped

steps.text:
To make the glaze:
In a small bowl, combine powdered sugar and milk, and whisk until fully incorporated and thick in consistency. Work quickly, as the glaze will firm up as it sits.

On a diagonal, dip the top third of the madeleine cookie into the glaze. Place on a wire rack. Sprinkle crushed strawberries and chopped pistachios over the glaze. Let sit for 10 minutes to allow the glaze to set.

teatime-madeleines.title: Teatime Madeleines

teeny-tiny-potatoes-with-sweet-roasted-g.description: Keep this easy potato side dish recipe in your back pocket to serve alongside grilled steaks, roast chicken, pork chops...
ingredients: 2 cloves TJ's Peeled Garlic (or more, if you like)
4 tbsp TJ's Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1/4 teaspoon TJ's Sea Salt, or to taste
1/4 teaspoon TJ's Ground Black Pepper, or to taste

steps.text: Preheat oven to 325°.
Wrap garlic in a piece of foil with 1 tbsp of olive oil and roast in the oven until soft; about 30 minutes.
At the same time, place potatoes on a baking sheet and into the oven - bake until tender, about 30 minutes.
Remove garlic from oven, mash and mix with remainder of olive oil; place in a mixing dish and set aside.
Remove potatoes from oven and add to bowl and gently toss with mashed garlic mixture.
Toss salt and pepper over potatoes to taste. Serve immediately. Enjoy!

teeny-tiny-potatoes-with-sweet-roasted-g.title: Teeny Tiny Potatoes with Sweet Roasted Garlic

tempeh-cauliflower-stir-fry.description: Trader Joe’s Reduced Sodium Soy Sauce is aromatic, rich with umami, and slightly less salty than a full-sodium soy sauce. It’s made using the traditional Honjozo method, which uses a six month to two-year natural brewing and fermentation process—this means our Reduced Sodium Soy Sauce tastes authentic and is ideal for all your soy sauce needs. We’re pretty sure you won’t even notice the missing sodium! Use it as both the marinade and finishing sauce for this Organic 3 Grain Tempeh and cauliflower stir fry.
ingredients: 1 package TJ’s Organic 3 Grain Tempeh, cut crosswise into 16 equal pieces
4 tablespoons TJ’s Reduced Sodium Soy Sauce, plus more for drizzling
1 bag TJ’s Riced Cauliflower Stir Fry

steps.text: To a medium-sized bowl, add cut tempeh and four tablespoons soy sauce. Toss to combine and let sit for five minutes.
Heat a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat and add two tablespoons oil. Add marinated tempeh and fry until golden, about 3-5 minutes on each side. Remove from pan and transfer to a plate.
Add remaining oil to pan and cook cauliflower stir fry until warmed through, about 7 minutes.
Divide stir fry among bowls and top with tempeh. Serve with extra soy sauce for drizzling.

tempeh-cauliflower-stir-fry.title: Tempeh & Cauliflower Stir Fry

teriyaki-bbq-tofu-with-soycutash-greens.description: Inspired by a similar dish at very popular LA restaurant, we decided to recreate using our own TJ's products! It's simple, nutritious, satisfying, and much, much lighter on your wallet.
ingredients: 1 package Trader Joe's Organic Baked Teriyaki Tofu
1 cup TJs Organic Brown Sugar BBQ Sauce & Marinade, plus more to finish, if desired
2 tablespoons water, or more if needed
2 bags TJ's Organic Power to the Greens

steps.text: Remove tofu from package and pat dry with paper towels; place in a shallow dish and cover with barbecue sauce. Set aside for 30 minutes.
Place soycutash in a microwave safe dish, add water and cover with damp paper towels; heat on high for 2 minutes or until heated through. Set aside.
Heat grill to high, add tofu and sear on both sides; lower heat and continue to cook until warmed through; about 5 minutes.

Heat olive oil in a large skillet; add greens and sauté until wilted, about 3 to 5 minutes; season with salt and pepper. Remove from heat and divide between 2 plates. Divide soycutash and layer atop greens. Slice tofu lengthwise, arrange atop soycutash and drizzle with warmed barbecue sauce, if desired.

teriyaki-bbq-tofu-with-soycutash-greens.title: Teriyaki BBQ Tofu with Soycutash Greens

teriyaki-chicken-fried-rice-stuffed-pine.description:
"I'm stuffed!" It's the universal exclamation of fullness, content, and satisfaction after a great meal-it's also how you'll feel after enjoying this Trader Joe's Crew Member-created recipe for Teriyaki Chicken Fried Rice Stuffed Pineapple. Starchy brown rice and pineapple pieces are stir-fried with our ever-popular Soyaki Sauce to create a tantalizingly tangy base for savory Trader Joe's BBQ Chicken Teriyaki.     

By serving the finished dish in its very own hollowed out pineapple half, you'll ensure nothing goes to waste. And by skipping the takeout in favor of a trip to your neighborhood Trader Joe's, your wallet will remain stuffed, too!
ingredients: 2 bags TJ's Frozen Jasmine Rice, heated
1 bag TJ's Frozen BBQ Chicken Teriyaki

steps.text: Slice whole pineapple lengthwise into 2 halves.

With a sharp knife, carefully score the insides of both halves like a checker board. With a large spoon, scoop out the inside which will produce bite-sized pineapple pieces. Set pineapple pieces along with their juice aside in a separate bowl.

Add 2 tablespoons of coconut oil to a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Add the chicken and cook for 5 minutes until heated through. Add cooked rice, soyaki and reserved pineapple pieces and juices to the pan and continue to stir to heat through until the rice becomes a little sticky, about 2 minutes. Add sauce packets that come with the BBQ Chicken Teriyaki. Continue to sauté until heated through.
Add fried rice to the pineapple halves and serve.
Recipe Credit: Trader Joe's 2015 Crew Member Strut Your Stuffed Recipe Contest Winner - Michael Ryan - Cerritos, CA (Store #104)

teriyaki-chicken-fried-rice-stuffed-pine.title: Teriyaki Chicken Fried Rice Stuffed Pineapple

thanksgiving-leftovers-sandwich.description: The Thanksgiving Day meal usually gets all the glory, but we think that leftovers are the real superstars. Let this recipe inspire you to sandwich together all the odds and ends that are left in your fridge after the big meal. And we strongly encourage you to top your creation with a big handful of Trader Joe’s Thanksgiving Stuffing Seasoned Kettle Chips for a burst of savory, herbaceous notes, and outstanding crunch.
ingredients: ½ tablespoon TJ’s Unsalted Butter Quarters
2 thick slices leftover Thanksgiving turkey (or TJ’s Grilled Chicken Strips)
A big handful of TJ’s Thanksgiving Stuffing Seasoned Kettle Chips, gently crushed

steps.text: Place a medium nonstick pan over medium heat and add butter. When melted, lay the hot dog bun flat, cut-side down and griddle for 1-2 minutes, until golden.

Place bun on serving plate, cut side up. Spread a generous amount of cream cheese to one side and an equal amount of cranberry sauce to the other. Add the turkey or chicken to the middle, sprinkle with thyme leaves, and top with crushed chips to serve.

thanksgiving-leftovers-sandwich.title: Thanksgiving Leftovers Sandwich

the-baby-wedge.description: Trader Joe’s Ice Cube Baby Iceberg Lettuce is grown using a unique seed variety bred to produce purposely petite Iceberg Lettuce heads. While they are sizably smaller, they possess the same firm crunchiness and mild (although slightly sweeter) flavor as your standard head of Iceberg. Are you thinking cute, Baby wedge salads? So are we, and Trader Joe’s has everything you need to create this miniature-sized classic.
ingredients: 1 TJ’s Ice Cube Baby Iceberg Lettuce head, cut into quarters
½ cup TJ’s Chunky Blue Cheese Dressing & Dip
8 strips your favorite TJ’s Bacon, cooked then chopped
1/3 cup TJ’s Teeny Tiny Tomatoes, sliced in half
¼ cup finely diced TJ’s Red Onion
½ cup TJ’s Crumbled Blue Cheese

steps.text: Place toppings in bowls for an easy DIY wedge bar. Or to serve assembled, dress each wedge with dressing, then add toppings equally among the four wedges.

the-baby-wedge.title: The Baby Wedge

the-breakfast-bowl.description: Plates are great, but sometimes an entire meal in one bowl is even better—not to mention, it’s a handy vessel for eating on-the go or on the couch. The base of this breakfast bowl is none other than Trader Joe’s Hash Brown Patties, their crispiness ready to catch sautéed Organic Shredded Kale, a rich, runny egg yolk, and subtly spicy Chili Onion Crunch.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons of your favorite TJ’s Olive Oil
TJ’s Chili Onion Crunch, for drizzling

steps.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Place hash brown patties on a baking sheet. Bake for 25 minutes, until crisp, flipping once halfway through.
Heat olive oil in a sauté pan on medium heat. Add kale and cook for 5-7 minutes, until the kale brightens in color and softens in texture. Season with salt and pepper.

On medium-low heat, add half a tablespoon of butter to a frying pan. When melted and starting to bubble, crack one egg into the pan and cook as desired. Add another half tablespoon of butter and repeat with each egg.
To assemble, add two hash browns to the bottom of the bowl, add the kale, sliced avocado, and top with the prepared egg. Drizzle with chili onion crisp.

the-breakfast-bowl.title: The Breakfast Bowl (The Approach)

the-italian-deli-meat-sandwich.description:
How best to describe Trader Joe’s Parmesan Tapenade? On a purely technical level, it’s made from thick shreds of umami-rich Parmesan cheese, which have been combined with a medley of diced garlic, jalapeños, and Manzanilla olives, then seasoned with herbs like cilantro, oregano, and thyme, and marinated in a blend of olive oil, sunflower oil, and red wine vinegar.

On a practical level, it’s a catch-all condiment, dip, and spread that adds briny, spicy, savory zing to all sorts of dishes, from pastas, salads, and steaks to artichokes, endives, toast, and the ultimate cold cuts sandwich!
ingredients: 4 TJ’s Ciabatta Rolls, sliced in half
1 package TJ's Spicy Uncured Charcuterie Selection or Daniele® Gourmet Deli Selection with Calabrese Salami, Del Duca® Prosciutto, and Capocolla
1 TJ’s Red Bell Peppers, seeds removed and thinly sliced into strips

steps.text: To assemble sandwiches, place a leaf or two of gem lettuce on the bottom half of the roll. Top with two slices of each meat and mozzarella. Add a few slices of bell pepper, and top with a generous spoonful of the Parmesan Tapenade (don’t forget to add the oil at the bottom of the tub!). Finish with the top half of the roll to serve.
To gild the lily, skewer a few manzanilla olives on a toothpick and into the top of each sandwich.

the-italian-deli-meat-sandwich.title: The Italian Deli Meat Sandwich with Parmesan Tapenade

the-one-minute-lentil-salad.description:
Made for us by a small supplier in Normandy, France, Trader Joe’s Steamed Lentils are fully cooked and packed in a pouch that keeps them fresh and delicious. They heat quickly and easily in the microwave to make a hearty side dish, a great mix-in for rice bowls, and can even be enjoyed cold, right out of the pouch, especially in salads.

If you’re particularly pressed for time, this recipe is for you! It employs two additional TJ’s time-saving superstars, Bruschetta Sauce and Crumbled Feta. This salad comes together within minutes and can be served warm or cold. It’s ideal for as quick lunch or an easy side—at home, at work, and as part of a picnic at the park.
ingredients: A few sprigs TJ’s Fresh Basil, finely chopped or torn (optional)

steps.text: Add lentils to a medium-sized bowl. Add bruschetta sauce, reserving some of the oil in the tub. Toss to combine, adding the reserved oil, as needed, to coat the lentils. Top with feta and basil (if using) to serve.

the-one-minute-lentil-salad.title: The One Minute Lentil Salad

tikka-masala-burritos.description: A consistent member of the Trader Joe's Customer Choice Awards winners circle, Trader Joe's Tikka Masala boasts chunks of roasted Chicken (or soy protein in the Vegan version) served in a creamy, mildly spicy, tomato-based, curry flavored sauce. While either of these Indian entrées are incredible served as-is, they're cleverly complemented in the company of organic peas, creamy yogurt, tangy mango chutney, and freshly chopped cilantro. Wrap it all up in your favorite Trader Joe's tortilla, and it's Tasty City, population: you.
ingredients: 1 package TJ's Chicken Tikka Masala OR Vegan Tikka Masala
1/2 cup TJ's Organic Peas, heated according to package directions and drained

steps.text: Remove tikka masala tray from carton and puncture film 2 to 3 times. Microwave on high for 3 minutes. Carefully peel back film enough to gently stir sauce. Heat an additional 1 to 1 1/2 minutes to an internal temperature of 165°F. Carefully remove film; set aside.

Warm tortillas in a dry skillet or directly over flame. Remove from heat and lay tortillas on a clean work surface. Divide rice and tikka masala between tortillas. Top each with peas, a few dollops of yogurt and chutney, and cilantro.

To roll, pull half of the tortilla closest to you up to meet the top half, then pull the tortilla and fillings back toward you. Fold in the left and right sides of the tortilla, then roll tightly until closed. Enjoy!

tikka-masala-burritos.title: Tikka Masala Burritos

tjs-eton-mess.description:
A classic British dessert that celebrates the bounty of berry season, Eton Mess is composed of layers of freshly whipped cream, berries, and the delicate crunch of baked meringues.

Using Trader Joe’s Vanilla Meringues in this easy Eton Mess recipe cuts the assembly time down considerably without sacrificing flavor, making it ideal for spring and summertime entertaining (or for whenever a spontaneous sweet craving strikes). We’ve also incorporated a spot of tart Lemon Curd to complement the alluring vanilla aroma and sweetness of the Meringues.

steps.text: Add heavy whipping cream to the bowl of a stand mixer. Use the whisk attachment on medium power for 3-5 minutes until the cream forms soft peaks (when the cream only just begins to hold its shape when the whisk is lifted out of the bowl). Alternatively, use a hand whisk and whip cream for 5-8 minutes until soft peaks are achieved.

To assemble, add a large spoonful of cream to each glass or vessel. Measuring with your heart, follow with layers of lemon curd, lightly crushed meringues, and blackberries, repeating until the desired serving size is achieved.
Serve immediately.

tjs-eton-mess.title: TJ's Eton Mess

tofu-scramble-breakfast-tacos.description: It's breakfast time—and instead of breaking eggs, we're crumbing a block of tofu! It turns out crumbled Trader Joe's Organic Tofu possesses the same soft, curd-like texture of fluffy scrambled eggs. And when it's seasoned with garlic powder, onion powder, and TJ’s Nutritional Yeast (plus a pinch of turmeric for its characteristically sunny hue), then sautéed until piping hot, this Tofu scramble can be served like any traditional scramble: on its own, over toast, or in these breakfast tacos. Good morning, indeed!
ingredients: ½ heaping teaspoon TJ’s Organic Ground Turmeric
¼ teaspoon TJ’s California Garlic Powder
¼ teaspoon TJ’s California Onion Powder
2 tablespoons of your favorite TJ’s Olive Oil
8 TJ’s Organic Mini Flour Tortillas, warmed

steps.text: Remove the tofu from packaging and place on a towel to drain.
In a medium bowl, gently crumble tofu with a wooden spoon until it resembles scrambled eggs.
Add turmeric, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, pepper and nutritional yeast and stir to combine evenly.
Heat olive oil in a large, nonstick pan over medium-high heat.
When the oil shimmers, add the seasoned tofu, stirring occasionally until there are some dark golden spots, and the scramble is heated through, about 5-7 minutes.
Fill warmed flour tortillas with the scrambled tofu. Top with slices of avocado, pico de gallo, cilantro, and a lime wedge.

tofu-scramble-breakfast-tacos.title: Tofu Scramble Breakfast Tacos

tortellini-salad.description: If you’re able to resist snacking on a whole pack of Trader Joe’s Fresh Mozzarella Pearls, add them to this pasta salad and make it the jewel of your picnic spread. Do the prep and assembly ahead of time, then chill it until you’re ready to serve.
ingredients: TJ’s Cheese Tortellini, cooked according to package instructions and cooled
½ cup diced TJ’s Red Onion
2 TJ’s Green Bell Peppers, cored and diced
1 package of your favorite small TJ’s Tomato, sliced in half
1 cup of your favorite TJ’s Salami, diced
¼ - ½ cup TJ’s Organic Italian Dressing

steps.text: In a large bowl, combine cooled tortellini with diced onions, bell peppers, tomatoes, salami, and Fresh Mozzarella Pearls. Pour ¼ cup of dressing and toss to combine. Taste, season with salt, and add more dressing, if desired, to serve.

tortellini-salad.title: Tortellini Salad

toscano-cheese-board.description: Trader Joe's Toscano Cheese combines the robust, nutty characteristics of aged parmesan with a creamy farmstead Cheddar-a particular profile that allows for maximum fromage flavoring. One variation on our shelves is soaked in Syrah, imbuing the cheese with jammy blackberry and plum notes. Another version offers a generous coating of Black Pepper, for a nose-tingling aroma and pungent flavor. Both Cheeses are excellent on a serving board with honey, whole grain mustard, fresh grapes, and an array of your favorite crackers.
ingredients: TJ's Creamy Toscano Cheese Soaked in Syrah
TJ's Toscano Cheese with Black Pepper
TJ's Crisps (Fig & Olive or Raisin & Rosemary)
TJ's Prosciutto or TJ's Uncured Salame di Parma Mild Salami

steps.text: Remove cheese from fridge 30 minutes prior to serving. Set each wedge on opposite ends of a large cheese board or serving platter. (Try to build your board in the location where it will be enjoyed-the precarious piles of goodies may roll around when you move the board!)
Slice each cheese wedge and shingle slices along the length of the board. Place two small dipping dishes or ramekins on board; fill one with honey and fill the other with mustard.
Add a few piles of crisps to each side of the board. Fill the gaps on the board with haphazard piles of grapes, prosciutto, cornichons, and almonds. Enjoy!

toscano-cheese-board.title: Toscano Cheese Board

toscano-pizza.description: Inspired by all the shake-able extras you'd find at a pizza parlor (crushed red pepper, dried oregano, dehydrated garlic, etc.), Trader Joe's Pizza Seasoned Shredded Toscano Cheese starts with wheels of carefully aged, creamy Toscano that are hand-rubbed with a one-of-a-kind blend of dried herbs, spices & sea salt. The result? A shredded cheese that lends pizza pizzazz to anything you sprinkle it on—pastas, potatoes, burgers, salads, subs, actual pizzas, and so much more...
ingredients: TJ's Pizza Seasoned Shredded Toscano Cheese

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Slice baguette in half crosswise, then slice each half lengthwise so you have 4 "crusts."
Place crusts on a baking sheet and bake 5 minutes. Remove from oven, top with pizza sauce, plenty of cheese, and slices of pepperoni.
Return pizzas to oven and cook another 5-10 minutes, until cheese is melted. Remove from oven and let cool slightly before digging in.

toscano-pizza.title: Toscano Pizza

trailblazer-bites.description: Searching for a snack-on-the-go that will fuel your figurative furnace and satiate your sweet tooth, all at the same time? Look no further than these date & TJ's Raw Almond-based bites, amped up with savory almond butter, hearty oats & flax, and semi-sweet chocolate chips.
ingredients: 1 cup (10-12) TJ's Organic Pitted Medjool Dates
1/3 cup plus 2 tablespoons TJ's Creamy Salted Almond Butter
1/3 cup TJ's Semi-Sweet Chocolate Chips, chopped

steps.text: Combine almonds, flaxseed meal and pitted dates in a food processor or blender and pulse until ingredients are crumbled in an even consistency.
Spoon almond mixture into a medium sized bowl. Add almond butter, rolled oats and chocolate chips and stir until combined. Refrigerate mixture for 15 minutes.

Remove from refrigerator, then form mixture into your desired size (3/4-inch balls will yield 24 bites, and 1 1/2-inch balls will yield 12 bites). Enjoy immediately and store remaining bites in an airtight container in the freezer.

trailblazer-bites.title: Trailblazer Bites

triangoletti-carbonara.description:
Quite pasta-bly the most famous noodle in the world, spaghetti is traditionally known as a long, thin, thread-like pasta. Trader Joe’s Organic Spaghetti Triangoletti is made using methods that mimic old-world pasta-making by pushing the dough through a bronze die extruder—only, instead of a round opening, this extruder has a triangular opening! The result? Long, thin, triangular Spaghetti with superb sauce-sticking capabilities. 

These Triangoletti pair particularly well with this luscious egg-based carbonara. The eggs are cooked by the residual heat of the noodles, resulting in a silky sauce that envelops every side of these edible triangles. This recipe subs TJ’s Uncured Apple Smoked Bacon in place of traditional (yet hard to find) guanciale to deliver textural complexity and a pleasant note of smoke to the dish. 

Pro-tip: Toast your TJ’s Black Peppercorns! To really add a peppery oomph to this dish, remove a teaspoon of peppercorns from the jar and toast them in a hot pan until they become fragrant. After they’ve cooled, grind them into the dish as instructed below.
ingredients: 1/2 cup finely grated TJ’s Pecorino Romano Cheese, plus more for serving
3 whole TJ’s Large Eggs, plus 2 yolks
A few heavy cranks of TJ’s Black Peppercorns, plus more for serving
1 pound TJ’s Organic Spaghetti Triangoletti Pasta
½ package TJ’s Uncured Apple Smoked Bacon, chopped into thin strips and cooked until crispy (ensure this step is complete before the pasta water comes to a boil)

steps.text: Fill a large pot with water, and heat over high. While the water comes to a boil, prepare the sauce by adding grated cheese, eggs, yolks, and ground pepper to a large bowl, whisking to combine.
Once the water comes to a boil, cook until al dente, about 10-11 minutes. Before draining, reserve ½ cup pasta water.

Once the pasta has drained, immediately add it to the large bowl with the egg mixture and vigorously stir to coat the noodles while simultaneously cooking the sauce from the heat of the pasta. If the mixture is thick, add 1 tablespoon at a time of pasta water until the sauce becomes glossy. Add cooked bacon, top with cheese, and extra black pepper to serve.

triangoletti-carbonara.title: Triangoletti Carbonara

triple-garlic-gravy.description: This recipe falls firmly in the “more is more” school of thought when it comes to flavor extraction! We’ve garnered garlic flavors from Trader Joe’s Ground Fermented Black Garlic, Organic Garlic Flavored Extra Virgin Olive Oil, and raw Garlic. And, the interplay between balsamic vinegar (aka our Glaze) and the Black Garlic lends sweetly complex notes, not to mention a deep, dark brown hue, which adds a striking visual atop sliced turkey breast and fluffy mashed potatoes.
ingredients: 2 TJ’s Shallots, peeled and finely diced
2 TJ’s Garlic Cloves, peeled & finely minced
2 tablespoons TJ’s Organic Garlic Flavored Extra Virgin Olive Oil
1 tablespoon TJ’s Balsamic Glaze or your favorite TJ’s Balsamic Vinegar
TJ’s Sea Salt & Freshly Ground Black Pepper, to taste

steps.text: In a 1-quart sauce pan, over medium high heat, heat the garlic oil. Add the shallot and garlic and sauté until golden brown.
Add gravy and bring to a simmer.
Stir in the black garlic and the glaze and simmer a few minutes more. Season to taste with salt and pepper and serve.

triple-garlic-gravy.title: Triple Garlic Gravy

tropical-banana-bread.description:
If we were to rename Trader Joe's Banana Bread Mix, we'd call it the Best Banana Bread Mix, Maybe Ever. Because it is. The secret to its sweet banana goodness? No surprise—it's banana. Or to be more accurate, dehydrated banana flakes. The flake format makes mixing so much easier, and ensures rich, ripe, consistent banana flavor in each loaf.   

While it makes a classic loaf prepared per the package instructions, this veritably versatile, undoubtedly delicious Mix is amenable to all manner of mix-ins-walnuts, chocolate chips, dried fruit, more banana... In this decidedly more tropical take, on a banana bread recipe, we've added organic coconut and chopped candied ginger to the batter before baking.
ingredients: TJ's Coconut Oil Spray or Canola Oil Spray
1/2 cup TJ's Organic Unsweetened Flake Coconut
1/3 cup finely chopped TJ's Uncrystallized Candied Ginger Pieces
3/4 cup canned TJ's Organic Coconut Milk
TJ's Creamy Peanut Butter, melted (optional, for garnish)

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease a loaf pan with coconut oil spray, set aside.

Add banana bread mix, coconut and chopped ginger to a large bowl and stir to combine. Set aside. In a medium bowl, whisk eggs, coconut milk, banana and sunflower oil. Fold wet mixture into dry mixture just until combined. Pour batter into prepared pan and smooth top.
Bake on center rack of oven for 50 minutes, until loaf is dark golden brown and firm to the touch. Remove from oven and let cool before slicing.
Optional garnish: Slice an additional banana into coins and place on top of the batter in the loaf pan before baking.
After the banana bread is cooled, slightly heat creamy peanut butter and drizzle it over the slices.

tropical-banana-bread.title: Tropical Banana Bread

tropical-mimosa.description: The addition of banana purée in Trader Joe’s Organic Orange Strawberry Banana Juice lends a soft, creamy quality to this otherwise traditionally tangy-sweet brunch tipple.
ingredients: 3 parts TJ’s Blanc de Blancs French Sparkling Wine
1 part TJ’s Organic Orange Strawberry Banana Juice

steps.text: Add sparkling wine to a champagne flute. Top with juice. Sip, adjust juice to taste, and enjoy.

tropical-mimosa.title: Tropical Mimosa

tuna-salad-pita.description: The delicate, meaty flavor and firm, flaky texture of Trader Joe's Yellowfin Tuna in Olive Oil elevates the simple tuna salad sandwich to new heights.
ingredients: 1 can TJ's Tuna in Olive Oil, drained

steps.text: In a medium bowl, combine tuna, onion, cornichons and mayonnaise.
Cut each pita in half lengthwise creating a total of four pita pockets.
Stuff pita pockets with lettuce and tuna salad.

tuna-salad-pita.title: Tuna Salad Pita

turkey-pasta-primavera.description:
Studded with colorful carrots and aromatic leeks, this colorful pasta dish is light yet filling, thanks to Trader Joe's Ground Turkey. A fragrant, white wine-infused sauce spiked with a sprinkle of herbaceous, fresh thyme gently coats the delicate Capellini noodles and ties everything together.

Note: Capellini pasta cooks quickly and will stick together if overcooked—cook to al dente.
ingredients: ½ package TJ’s Capellini pasta, cook according to package instructions
1 pound TJ’s Carrots of Many Colors, thinly sliced on a bias
1 ½ cup TJ’s Grower’s Reserve Chardonnay, or your favorite dry white TJ’s wine

steps.text: In a large sauté pan, over medium-high heat, add 2 tablespoons oil. When hot, add ground turkey, and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Use a spatula to break up turkey into crumbles.
Use a slotted spoon to transfer cooked turkey to a small bowl, while leaving any drippings in the pan. Lower temperature to medium.
Add 2 tablespoons olive oil, then add leeks to pan. Sauté until soft, about 3 minutes, then add the carrots and cook another 5 minutes. Add the turkey back to the pan.
Add wine and use a spatula to scrape up the bits at the bottom of the pan. Cook until most of the liquid has reduced. Add thyme and season with salt and pepper.
To a serving bowl, add the cooked pasta, the sautéed vegetables and turkey , and remaining tablespoon of olive oil. Toss thoroughly to combine, then serve.

turkey-pasta-primavera.title: Turkey Pasta Primavera

turkey-pot-pie-with-buttermilk-biscuit-c.description: For some folks, the best part of the holiday meal is the leftovers-think turkey sandwiches, stuffing scrambles, and pot pie. (Yes, we are "some folks," and we imagine that if you're still reading, you are, too.) This pot pie recipe gets its comforting creaminess thanks to Trader Joe's Condensed Cream of Portabella Mushroom Soup, but eschews the classic butter crust in favor of ready-to-bake Trader Joe's Organic Biscuits. This means you can enjoy those leftover Turkey Day flavor favorites without breaking out the dough roller. Play it again, Joe!
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups TJ's Organic Foursome Vegetable Medley, thawed
1 container TJ's Condensed Cream of Portabella Mushroom Soup (seasonal)
1 1/4 cup TJ's Organic Turkey Bone Broth (seasonal) OR TJ's Organic Free Range Chicken Broth
2 cups chopped leftover cooked TJ's Turkey

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
In a 3.5-quart, oven-safe skillet over medium heat, add olive oil and mirepoix. Sauté 5 minutes. Add vegetables, condensed soup, stock and turkey and bring to a simmer for 5 minutes.
Turn off heat and stir in thyme, rosemary, and pepper.
Remove biscuits from packaging. Separate and arrange biscuits evenly atop pot pie filling.
Bake 16-18 minutes on center rack of oven, until biscuits are golden brown and filling is bubbling. Remove from oven and let cool slightly before serving.

turkey-pot-pie-with-buttermilk-biscuit-c.title: Turkey Pot Pie with Buttermilk Biscuit Crust

turkey-wild-rice-soup.description: Trader Joe's Holiday Vegetable Hash offers small dices of butternut squash, sweet potatoes, red onions, and celery, accompanied by a flavorful and fragrant herb-trio of parsley, sage, and rosemary. Grab one container for your stuffing recipe, and a second to use as a soup-starter, paired with leftover turkey and earthy mushrooms & wild rice.
ingredients: 2 packages TJ's Organic Turkey Bone Broth  (seasonal) OR TJ's Organic Free Range Chicken Broth

steps.text: Heat a large pot over medium heat, add 2 tablespoons olive oil.
When oil is hot, add hash and a generous pinch of salt. Sauté until onions are translucent, 3-5 minutes.
Add mushrooms and sauté another 5 minutes.
Add stock and rice to pot and bring to a simmer. Cover and simmer 30 minutes, stirring halfway through.
Remove lid, add turkey and continue to simmer another 15-20 minutes, until rice is cooked through.
Season to taste with sea salt & pepper. Ladle soup into large bowls and enjoy!

turkey-wild-rice-soup.title: Turkey & Wild Rice Soup

umami-dressing.description: Toss this dressing with bitter greens for delightfully contrasting texture & flavor.
ingredients: 1 package TJ's Anchovy Fillets in Olive Oil, drained and diced
3 small TJ's Premium Peeled Garlic Cloves, minced
2 teaspoons TJ's Dijon Mustard with White Wine
1/3 cup + 1 Tbsp TJ's Sicilian Selezione EVOO
1/4 teaspoon TJ's Sea Salt, or to taste
1/4 teaspoon TJ's Ground Black Pepper, or to taste

steps.text: In a medium bowl, mash the anchovies and garlic with a fork to form a paste. Add the lemon juice and mustard and stir until well incorporated. Slowly whisk in oil until it starts to emulsify. Taste and add salt and pepper as desired. Makes about 1 cup of dressing.
Serving ideas: over bitter greens (radicchio, kale, arugula, Belgian endives) with freshly grated parmesan, dress a Niçoise salad or as a dip for crusty bread

umami-dressing.title: Umami Dressing

umami-parm-popcorn.description: Zhuzhing up a bag of Trader Joe’s Organic Olive Oil Popcorn and warming it in the oven yields all the enticing aromas of freshly made popcorn without the added effort (and mess) of popping it yourself. The Trader Joe’s Mushroom & Company Multipurpose Umami Seasoning Blend-infused Clarified Butter delivers an ultra-savory flavor profile, further complemented by a generous coating of TJ’s Parmesan Cheese. Yummmmm!
ingredients: 1 tablespoon TJ’s Mushroom & Company Multipurpose Umami Seasoning Blend, plus more for sprinkling
½ bag TJ’s Organic Olive Oil Popcorn

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
In a small saucepan, melt clarified butter over medium heat. Add umami seasoning and swirl pan to incorporate. Remove from heat.
Add popcorn to baking dish. Pour clarified butter mixture over the popcorn and toss to evenly coat. Bake for 8-10 minutes.
Remove from oven, add parmesan cheese and sprinkle with a few shakes of umami seasoning. Toss to evenly coat, then serve!

umami-parm-popcorn.title: Umami Parm Popcorn

umami-shepherds-pie.description:
Though it’s technically a Cottage Pie (as it’s made with beef instead of lamb) our umami-rich Shepherd’s Pie recipe combines Ground Beef and Sliced Shiitake Mushrooms with Trader Joe’s Mushroom & Company Multipurpose Umami Seasoning Blend for super-savory, dynamic flavor. But the real secret to this Shepherd's Pie’s success? Trader Joe’s Mashed Potatoes! No peeling. No mashing. No, really! Our frozen Mashed Potatoes are prepped and impeccably seasoned (with just milk, butter, and salt) for your time-saving convenience. 

Note: The pie will be piping hot when it comes out of the oven, so be sure to let it cool before digging it. The cooling time will help the gravy thicken, too.
ingredients: 1 pound TJ’s Ground Beef 80% lean 20% fat
2 tablespoons TJ’s Unbleached Enriched All-Purpose Flour
3 tablespoons TJ’s Mushroom & Company Multipurpose Umami Seasoning Blend
1 package TJ’s Mashed Potatoes (frozen), prepared according to package instructions
TJ's Fresh Parsley, chopped for garnish

steps.text: Preheat oven to 375°F. Heat a 12-inch Dutch oven or deep oven-safe sauté pan over medium high heat, then add butter. When butter has melted, add mirepoix and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.

Add beef and use a wooden spoon to break it up as it cooks. After 5 minutes add mushrooms, and continue to cook for 3-5 more minutes until beef is cooked through. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Stir in tomato paste, then add flour and mix to combine. Add beef broth and umami seasoning and cook until thickened, about 5 minutes.
Add peas and mix to combine. Then top with prepared mashed potatoes.
Bake for 30 minutes. Remove from oven, and cool for 15 minutes. Top with chopped parsley to serve.

umami-shepherds-pie.title: Umami Shepherd's Pie

umami-turkey-burgers.description:
Umami is the word used to describe the fifth taste - in addition to sweet, salty, sour, and bitter. Taken from Japanese, the word translates to "pleasant savory taste," and really, it's just that. And Trader Joe's Mushroom & Company Multipurpose Umami Seasoning Blend is really just something you're going to want to put on... everything.     

To create this Umami Seasoning Blend, we began with kosher salt, and used a flavor base of porcini and white button mushrooms - earthy mushroom flavor really is the cornerstone of umami, which is why we named it Mushroom & Company. The ingredient list also includes onion, mustard seed, red & black pepper, and thyme. It's a boon mixed into turkey burgers, stirred into scrambled eggs, or used to elevate the flavors of... everything, really, a sprinkle at a time.
ingredients: 1 package (16 oz) TJ's All Natural Ground Turkey
2 teaspoons TJ's Mushroom & Company Multipurpose Umami Seasoning Blend
4 TJ's Ciabatta Rolls (halved lengthwise) or 4 TJ's Brioche Buns
4 slices TJ's Sliced Aged Swiss Cheese
TJ's Balsamic Glaze and/or Organic Yellow Mustard, whichever you prefer
Your favorite crunchy TJ's Salad Greens or Microgreens

steps.text: Add onion to a large bowl. Use your hands to break ground turkey into pieces and add to bowl. Sprinkle seasoning evenly over meat. Use your hands to gently mix until onion, turkey and seasoning are evenly combined. If using our pre-formed Ground Turkey Patties, season both sides of each patty generously and evenly. Cover and refrigerate 20 minutes.
Remove turkey from refrigerator. Use your hands to form the meat into 4 patties.

Pan-Fry: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add oil to coat the bottom of the skillet. When oil is hot, use a spatula to carefully transfer patties to skillet. Cook 6-8 minutes, undisturbed, until bottom is well-browned and releases easily from the pan. Flip patties, adding more oil to the pan if necessary, and cook another 6-8 minutes, until internal temperature reaches 165°F. Transfer to paper towel lined plate, set aside.

If you're in a rush, you can skip ahead to assembly. But if you want warmed rolls with melty cheese, turn broiler to high. Place roll halves on a baking sheet. Top half of the rolls with a slice of cheese. Broil for 1-2 minutes to melt cheese (watch carefully to ensure rolls don't burn!). Remove pan from broiler and let cool slightly.
Place burger on the bottom half of the roll with melted cheese, followed by salad greens. Generously spread glaze and mustard on top half of the roll, and place on burger.

Grill: Preheat grill to medium high. Place seasoned patties on grill and cook, covered, for 6 minutes. Flip burgers and cook, covered, about 6 more minutes or until internal temperature of patties reaches 165°F. Place a slice of cheese on each patty during the last 1-2 minutes of cooking to melt. Remove sand let cool slightly before serving.

umami-turkey-burgers.title: Umami Turkey Burgers

unexpected-cheddar-cheese-ball.description:
At first bite, Trader Joe's Unexpected Cheddar tastes like an aged Cheddar. And then something unexpected happens. The smooth creaminess of the Cheddar gives way to a tangy flavor and slightly crumbly texture, a subtle hint of salt crystallization is discovered, and it begins to taste like an aged Parmesan. Surprising, astonishing, and unanticipated. Unexpected indeed!     

This easy appetizer recipe imbues the classic holiday cheese ball with that same Unexpected spirit-it's a little spicy, very cheesy, and utterly irresistible.
ingredients: 1 package TJ's Unexpected Cheddar, broken into chunks
1/2 package TJ's Sweet & Spicy Pecans, chopped
TJ's Golden Rounds Crackers, for serving

steps.text: Add cheeses, chili pepper sauce, seasoning and lemon juice to food processor bowl. Pulse to bring mixture together, scraping down sides of bowl as needed. Continue to process until mixture is smooth, 1-2 minutes.

Lay a square of cling wrap large enough to cover cheese ball on work surface. Scoop cheese mixture into center of wrap, then gather wrap up on all sides, gently shaping the mixture into a ball. Twist the ends of the cling wrap tightly, and refrigerate cheese ball (2 hours minimum, but overnight really lets the flavors meld together!).

Before serving, remove cheese ball from fridge. Spread chopped pecans on work surface. Unwrap cheese ball and press into chopped pecans, gently reshaping as needed. Serve with a cheese spreader, surrounded by TJ's Golden Rounds Crackers.

unexpected-cheddar-cheese-ball.title: Unexpected Cheddar Cheese Ball

unexpected-cheddar-cheese-board.description: We’re adding an unexpected twist to the social media-celebrated butter board by swapping out butter for our equally celebrated Trader Joe’s Unexpected Cheddar Spread. This spread is a combo of our crumbly Unexpected Cheddar, salted butter, and whey that that brings a whole lot of complexity and downright deliciousness to this simple-to-assemble, showstopping appetizer. Follow the recipe or use it as a guide to craft your own cheesy creation.
ingredients: 1 tub TJ’s Unexpected Cheddar Cheese Spread
1 package TJ’s Sweet & Spicy Pecans, roughly chopped
Your favorite TJ’s Honey, for drizzling
1 TJ’s Organic French Baguette, sliced and toasted

steps.text: Remove cheese spread from refrigerator 30 minutes prior to assembly to help soften.

To a medium-sized cutting board, use a butter knife or spoon to spread the unexpected cheddar over the entire board, leaving a small outer rim exposed. Use your utensil to make swooping motions as you spread to help create nooks and crannies.
Top with chopped pecans, thyme leaves, and a drizzle of honey.
Serve with toasted baguette slices.

unexpected-cheddar-cheese-board.title: Unexpected Cheddar Cheese Board

unexpected-fig-bites.description:
Trader Joe’s Freeze Dried Fig Slices have a pink, seedy interior and crispy texture that deliver their expected figgy flavors with aplomb. These are great for snacking anytime, excellent in a bowl of cereal, and will liven up a cheese board on both the flavor and texture fronts, like they do here paired with TJ's Unexpected Cheddar Cheese and Fig Butter. 

Pro-tip: Got any Freeze Dried Fig bits left at the bottom of the bag? Turn this snacking trio upside-down and use the bits to top the cheesy base so you can enjoy every last crumb!
ingredients: 1 bag TJ’s Freeze Dried Fig Slices
¼ block TJ’s Unexpected Cheddar, sliced into bite-sized rectangles

steps.text: Lay fig slices on serving tray. Top with a square of Unexpected Cheddar and a small dollop of Fig Butter. Garnish each bite with a few thyme leaves to serve.

unexpected-fig-bites.title: Unexpected Fig Bites

unexpected-grilled-cheese-sandwich.description: Knowing the popularity of Trader Joe's Unexpected Cheddar and knowing that our Customers are always looking for more ways to enjoy it, we've made the bold (and perhaps unexpected!) move to offer it in handy, Shredded form. Use it in your favorite grilled cheese sandwich recipe, or follow our recipe featuring a garlic bread-style twist on the classic-an unexpected delight, indeed.
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon TJ's Organic Garlic Powder OR 1 clove TJ's Garlic, minced
8 slices TJ's Organic White Bread (or your favorite TJ's sandwich bread)
1 heaping cup TJ's Shredded Unexpected Cheddar, divided

steps.text: Add butter, parsley and garlic to a small bowl and stir. Butter each slice of bread.
Place 4 slices of bread butter side-down on a cold griddle or large skillet. Top each slice with about one-quarter cup cheese.
Heat griddle to medium-low. As cheese turns shiny and starts to melt, top with another slice of bread, butter side-up.
Cook 2-5 minutes until bread is golden brown, turn sandwich over, and continue cooking until the other side is golden brown and cheese has melted. Remove from heat.
Slice sandwiches on a diagonal and serve with a hot cup of tomato soup.

unexpected-grilled-cheese-sandwich.title: Unexpected Grilled Cheese Sandwich

unexpected-mac-cheese.description: Knowing the popularity of Trader Joe's Unexpected Cheddar and knowing that our Customers are always looking for more ways to enjoy it, we've made the bold (and perhaps unexpected!) move to offer it in handy, Shredded form. The eight-ounce package contains large shreds of Unexpected Cheddar, ready for use in salads, soups, quesadillas...or this weeknight-friendly, easy macaroni & cheese recipe. If you've got an extra 10 minutes, toast up some panko breadcrumbs to take it over the top!
ingredients: 1 cup TJ's Japanese Style Panko Breadcrumbs
1lb your favorite short cut of TJ's Pasta (Macaroni, Farfalle, Fusilli, etc.)
1 package (8 oz.) TJ's Cream Cheese, cubed
sliced TJ's Green Onions and crumbled TJ's Fully Cooked Bacon, for garnish

steps.text: Prepare the breadcrumbs (if desired): Melt 4 tablespoons butter in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add breadcrumbs and a pinch of salt and stir to coat. Cook 5 minutes or so, stirring frequently, until evenly toasted to a golden brown (don't take your eyes off the pan-the breadcrumbs can go from beautifully burnished to burnt in a flash!). Remove from heat and set aside.

Make the macaroni: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook pasta until barely al dente. Drain and set aside.

While pasta cooks, add milk to a large pot and bring to a simmer. Reduce heat to low and whisk in cream cheese and garlic powder until totally smooth.

Add cheese and butter and continue whisking until the cheese is fully melted.

Add cooked pasta to sauce and stir to coat. Cook a few minutes more, continuing to stir until sauce has thickened slightly. Remove from heat and stir in fresh ground pepper to taste.
Garnish & Serve: Serve in bowls, garnished with bread crumbs, green onions, and bacon. Dig in!

unexpected-mac-cheese.title: Unexpected Mac & Cheese

unexpected-potato-leek-galette.description:
This savory galette, or free form, single-crust pie, takes flavor inspiration from potato leek soup, and makes an impressive, sharable appetizer that requires less effort than you might think, thanks to time-saving ingredients like Trader Joe’s Trimmed Leeks, TJ’s Pie Crusts, and TJ’s Shredded Unexpected Cheddar.

Pro-tip: Thaw the Pie Crust in the refrigerator the night before you plan to assemble to save on prep time!
ingredients: 1 large TJ’s Yellow Potato, thinly sliced using a mandoline or knife
¼ cup of your favorite TJ’s Extra Virgin Olive Oil, divided
½ TJ’s Trimmed Leeks, cut into thin rounds
1 TJ’s Pie Crust, thawed according to package instructions

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Add potato slices in a medium-sized bowl. Add 2 tablespoons oil and season with 21 seasoning salute and salt.
In another medium bowl, add the leeks, remaining 2 tablespoons oil and season with salt.

Gently unroll pie crust. Note: if the crust has any cracks, pinch and smooth out the cracks with your hands or a rolling pin over the plastic liner. Then remove the plastic, and place on a parchment-lined sheet tray.
Sprinkle ¾ cup cheese over the pie crust, leaving a 2-inch border bare.
Next, layer with potato slices, shingling each slice over the other until all the cheese is covered. Then add the sliced leeks.
Gently lift and fold a portion of the exposed dough border up and onto the filling. Repeat in a circular motion, pleating the dough over itself as you go.
Whisk egg, then brush over crust. Sprinkle remaining cheese over the egg wash.
Bake for 40-45 minutes, or until crust is golden and potatoes are tender when pierced with a knife.
Let cool 5-10 minutes prior to serving.

unexpected-potato-leek-galette.title: Unexpected Potato Leek Galette

vanilla-bean-whipped-cream-frosting.description:
Trader Joe’s Bourbon Vanilla Bean Paste is thicker and richer in taste than your standard vanilla extract. It adds a well-rounded sweetness and deep, full-bodied vanilla flavor with visible flecks of vanilla bean throughout, making it ideal for recipes where you really want the vanilla to be front and center—like this whipped cream frosting! 

Thanks to a stability boost from TJ’s Mascarpone, the staying power of this fluffy yet sturdy frosting makes it fantastic for decorating cakes, topping pies, and sandwiching between two TJ’s Half Moon Cookies.
ingredients: 1 ½ cups TJ’s Heavy Whipping Cream
1/3-1/2 cup TJ’s Organic Powdered Cane Sugar
2 tablespoons TJ’s Bourbon Vanilla Bean Paste

steps.text: In the bowl of a stand or hand mixer, add heavy whipping cream, mascarpone, powdered sugar, and vanilla bean paste.
Using the whisk attachment, start on low speed for about 30 seconds to combine all ingredients and avoid the mixture splattering out of the bowl.
Increase the speed to medium-high, and continue to whisk for 3-5 minutes, until the beaters leave distinct lines in the cream.

vanilla-bean-whipped-cream-frosting.title: Vanilla Bean Whipped Cream Frosting

vegan-banana-bread-waffles.description: There’s no point in waffling on here—this brunch-ified take on our Vegan Banana Bread with Walnuts is unbelievably simple, and simply delicious.
ingredients: 1 loaf TJ’s Vegan Banana Bread, cut into 8 slices
2 ripe TJ’s Bananas, peeled and sliced into coins

steps.text: Heat waffle maker according to manufacturer’s instructions. (If your waffle make requires greasing, now's the time.)

Add 2 slices of banana bread to waffle maker. Close waffle maker (you may have to hold it closed until some of the moisture cooks out of the bread) and cook 4 minutes total (2 minutes per side, if your waffle maker flips!).
Use tongs to gently remove waffles from waffle maker (they’ll be slightly soft and will firm up as they sit). Repeat with remaining banana bread.
Plate waffles and top with sliced bananas, walnuts, and syrup. Enjoy immediately.

vegan-banana-bread-waffles.title: Vegan Banana Bread Waffles

vegan-caesar-salad.description: Trader Joe's Vegan Caesar Dressing uses an ingenious mix of plant-based ingredients, including tofu, capers, mustard, and miso to create a deliciously savory, enticingly peppery, and satisfyingly creamy Caesar Dressing while remaining totally vegan! This vegan Caesar salad recipe brings the restaurant classic to life, complete with a batch of savory, vegan "Parmesan cheese" and garbanzo bean croutons.
ingredients: 1 can TJ's Organic Garbanzo beans, drained

steps.text: Prepare garbanzo beans: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Spread drained garbanzo beans on a clean, lint-free towel or paper towels and pat dry. Transfer beans to a small bowl, add olive oil and stir to coat.
Spread beans on a rimmed baking sheet and roast on center rack of oven for 20-30 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside.

Prepare vegan "Parmesan cheese": While garbanzo beans are roasting, add cashew pieces, nutritional yeast, sea salt and garlic powder to a food processor. Pulse to a fine meal, stopping to scrape down the sides of the bowl as necessary. Set aside. (This recipe will yield enough ""cheese"" to sprinkle on salads, pasta dishes, omelettes...store the leftovers in an airtight container in the fridge and it will keep for a couple of weeks.)
Assemble salad: Arrange romaine salad on a serving platter or large shallow bowl. Drizzle with 3 tablespoons dressing and 1 tablespoon vegan Parmesan and toss to coat. Add more dressing if desired.
Top with roasted garbanzo beans, sprinkle with vegan Parmesan, and finish with a few grinds of black pepper. Serve with lemon wedges and more dressing on the side.

vegan-caesar-salad.title: Vegan Caesar Salad

vegan-coffee-meringues.description: Aquafaba is the liquid found in cans of Trader Joe’s Organic Garbanzo Beans. Although often discarded, it acts as an impressive alternative for egg whites, ideal for vegan recipes. With the assistance of a stand mixer, aquafaba whips wondrously to produce egg-free meringue cookies. Take note of the measurements used to flavor the meringues, though—while the amounts may seem insignificant, we’ve allowed for just enough to impart some delightful coffee flavor, without weighing down the delicate meringues.
ingredients: 1/4 cup aquafaba of TJ’s Organic Garbanzo Beans
1/2 teaspoon TJ’s Organic Pure Bourbon Vanilla Extract
¼ teaspoon TJ’s 100% Colombian Instant Coffee, plus more for dusting

steps.text: Preheat oven to 200°F. Line two large baking sheets with parchment paper.
Strain liquid from garbanzo beans into a measuring cup, until you have 1/4 cup of aquafaba. (Reserve garbanzo beans for another use—hummus, perhaps?)

Add all measured ingredients to the bowl of a stand-up mixer. On medium power, whisk for one minute until aquafaba becomes foamy. Scrape the bowl with a spatula to ensure all ingredients are fully incorporated. Increase the speed to high and whisk until stiff, glossy peaks form, 10 to 15 minutes. While mixing on high, intermittently, turn the power off and scrape the contents of the bowl.

To shape meringues, fill a pastry bag fitted with a piping tip with meringue batter (or a one-gallon plastic zip-top bag with a corner cut off), and pipe onto the prepared baking sheet. Alternatively, drop mounds of meringue batter using a spoon.
Very lightly dust meringues with extra instant coffee, using a fine mesh strainer. Do not over-dust, or meringues may collapse.

Bake in oven for two hours without opening the oven door. Remove from oven and let meringues cool completely before serving. Do not place meringues in refrigerator at any point; store meringues in an air-tight container if not serving immediately upon cooling. Enjoy!

vegan-coffee-meringues.title: Vegan Coffee Meringues

vegan-giant-bean-kale-penne.description:
If you’ve never liked baked beans, this may be your bridge to bean bliss! The dish is a riff on Tuscan white bean, kale, and sausage soup. Except... it’s not soup—it’s a hearty bowl of pasta. And, there’s no meat. Briefly roasting the Grape Tomatoes adds serious depth of flavor, and our Giant Baked Beans in Tomato Sauce really satisfy, with their dense, meaty texture and flavorful Mediterranean Herbs and Spices.

Tip: You won’t need the whole pound of Penne Rigate to match the proportions of the other ingredients, but you can pad the pot with more pasta if you’re feeding a group—or a few, really hungry people.
ingredients: 1 bag TJ’s Kale, larger stems removed
1 pkg. TJ’s Mini Pearl Grape Tomatoes
1 can TJ’s Giant Baked Beans in Tomato Sauce

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Fill a large pot with water, salt it, and bring it to a boil.

Rinse tomatoes, then dump in a medium-sized bowl. Drizzle with 2 tablespoons or more of olive oil and toss to coat. Add salt & pepper, then spread out on a baking tray, and roast in the oven at 400°F for about 20 minutes.

Meanwhile, peel and mince 4-5 large garlic cloves. Remove larger stems from kale leaves. In a large Dutch oven, sauté garlic and kale over medium heat, until kale starts to wilt. Cover pan and turn heat to low.
Once the water boils, add your pasta and give it a stir. Cook 6-8 minutes or until al dente.
Add roasted tomatoes (and any juices) to the garlic and kale. Then add one can of Giant Baked Beans in Tomato Sauce. Gently stir to incorporate. Add salt & pepper to taste.
When the pasta is done, drain it, and add one-half to three-quarters of the penne to the garlic, kale, and tomatoes, then mix and serve topped with grated Parmesan cheese.

vegan-giant-bean-kale-penne.title: Vegan Giant Bean & Kale Penne

vegan-mac-n-cheese.description: This surprisingly creamy, dairy-free mac 'n cheese gets an umami flavor boost from the addition of nutritional yeast. Eat it plain, or enjoy with hot sauce, chopped herbs, sliced vegan sausage, roasted broccoli, wilted greens...
ingredients: 1 package TJ's Organic Tricolor Radiatore Pasta

steps.text: Add cashews and almond milk to a blender pitcher or food processor. Cover and set aside for one hour to soak.
Purée soaked cashews and almond milk until smooth. Scrape down the sides of the pitcher. Add all remaining ingredients (except pasta) and purée to combine.
Prepare pasta according to package directions. Drain pasta and add back to warm pot.
Pour sauce mixture into pot and stir gently to combine. Turn heat to low and continue stirring for 2-3 minutes until sauce is warm (you may need to add more almond milk to maintain desired texture).
Scoop into serving bowls, drizzle with your favorite TJ's olive oil and dig in!

vegan-mac-n-cheese.title: Dairy Free Mac 'n Cheese

vegan-matcha-meringues.description: Aquafaba is the liquid found in cans of Trader Joe’s Organic Garbanzo Beans. Although often discarded, it acts as an impressive alternative for egg whites, ideal for vegan recipes. With the assistance of a stand mixer, aquafaba whips wondrously to produce egg-free meringue cookies. Take note of the measurements used to flavor the meringues, though—while the amounts may seem insignificant, we’ve allowed for just enough to impart some magnificent matcha flavor, without weighing down the delicate meringues.
ingredients: 1/4 cup aquafaba of TJ’s Organic Garbanzo Beans
1/2 teaspoon TJ’s Organic Pure Bourbon Vanilla Extract
1/8 teaspoon TJ’s Matcha Green Tea, plus more for dusting

steps.text: Preheat oven to 200°F. Line two large baking sheets with parchment paper.
Strain liquid from garbanzo beans into a measuring cup, until you have 1/4 cup of aquafaba. (Reserve garbanzo beans for another use—hummus, perhaps?)

Add all measured ingredients to the bowl of a stand-up mixer. On medium power, whisk for one minute until aquafaba becomes foamy. Scrape the bowl with a spatula to ensure all ingredients are fully incorporated. Increase the speed to high and whisk until stiff, glossy peaks form, 10 to 15 minutes. While mixing on high, intermittently, turn the power off and scrape the contents of the bowl.

To shape meringues, fill a pastry bag fitted with a piping tip with meringue batter (or a one-gallon plastic zip-top bag with a corner cut off), and pipe onto the prepared baking sheet. Alternatively, drop mounds of meringue batter using a spoon.
Very lightly dust meringues with extra matcha powder, using a fine mesh strainer. Do not over-dust, or meringues may collapse.

Bake in oven for two hours without opening the oven door. Remove from oven and let meringues cool completely before serving. Do not place meringues in refrigerator at any point; store meringues in an air-tight container if not serving immediately upon cooling. Enjoy!

vegan-matcha-meringues.title: Vegan Matcha Meringues

vegan-spinach-artichoke-pasta.description:
Trader Joe’s Organic Red Lentil Sedanini Pasta is a tube-shaped pasta made with red lentil flour instead of the customary wheat. In addition to the red lentil flour’s protein power (13 grams in each ¾ cup dry serving!), it creates a pasta that cooks up exactly al dente, ready to add toothsome texture to hot, cold, or room temperature dishes.

This particular recipe partners this powerful Pasta with a plant-based, spinach artichoke dip-inspired sauce, featuring our versatile Vegan Cream Cheese and Shredded Parmesan Cheese Alternative. Complete with a green salad and a toasted baguette, it’s a welcome addition to meatless Monday—or really any day you’re looking for creamy comfort food!
ingredients: 1 bag TJ’s Organic Red Lentil Sedanini, cooked according to package instructions and drained
1 jar TJ’s Marinated Artichoke Hearts, oil reserved
½ cup TJ’s Vegan Cream Cheese
TJ’s Shredded Parmesan Cheese Alternative, to serve

steps.text: In a large sauté pan over medium heat, add artichokes and 2 tablespoons of the reserved oil. Add garlic and sauté until aromatic, about 3 minutes. Add cream cheese and cook until completely melted. Add spinach to pan, a handful at a time, until it cooks down and is completely wilted. Taste and season with salt and drizzle with lemon juice.
To a large serving bowl, combine Sedanini pasta and the spinach artichoke sauce and toss to combine. Top with Shredded Parmesan Cheese Alternative to serve.

vegan-spinach-artichoke-pasta.title: Vegan Spinach Artichoke Pasta

vegetable-stir-fry.description: Just a teaspoon of Trader Joe's Organic Sesame Oil adds a whole new flavor dimension to your standby stir fry.
ingredients: 1 package TJ's Asian Stir Fry Veggies
1 package TJ's Firm Tofu, pressed and cubed
1 teaspoon TJ's Organic Toasted Sesame Oil

steps.text: Mix sesame oil, orange juice, soy sauce, honey and ginger. Add tofu and let marinate for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Cook stir fry veggies according to package directions. Add tofu to stir fry and cook for an additional 2 minutes. Add sauce to stir fry and heat through. Serve over rice noodles (or rice), if desired.

vegetable-stir-fry.title: Vegetable Stir Fry

veggie-biryani-burritos.description:
If you’re in the mood for a multicultural culinary mashup, this handy, flavorful, sammie substitute with a touch of Indian fare flair may be just the thing! Start with a simple homemade raita with Greek Nonfat Plain Yogurt, shredded Cucumber, diced Jalapeño, and spices. Then microwave the Vegetable Biryani for 2-3 minutes, and wrap a couple spoonfuls, along with a dollop of raita, in a large TJ’s Tortilla.

Tip: One package of Biryani can make 2-3 burritos. Be sure to evenly divide the dumplings between them.
ingredients: 5.3 oz. tub TJ’s Greek Nonfat Plain Yogurt
