steps.text: Make the cucumber raita: Peel and shred about a one-third to one-half of the cucumber. De-seed and dice the jalapeño.
Empty the yogurt into a medium bowl, add the cucumber and jalapeño, and mix well. Add salt & pepper to taste. You can also add a pinch of cumin and/or sugar, if you like.
Make the burrito: Cook the Biryani in the microwave on high for 2-3 minutes (as directed on the package).
Put a couple large spoonfuls of heated Biryani in the middle of a lightly warmed tortilla. Be sure to include some dumplings.
Add a dollop of your cucumber yogurt raita and some fresh cilantro (optional), then wrap it up, burrito style.

veggie-biryani-burritos.title: Veggie Biryani Burritos

veggie-chickpea-hash.description:
Inside each humble can of Trader Joe’s Greek Chickpeas with Parsley & Cumin you’ll find cooked chickpeas in soybean oil and lemon juice, seasoned with parsley, salt, cumin, garlic powder, and black pepper—that’s it! All dressed up and ready to eat, they’re as terrific a dinnertime side dish as they are eaten straight out of the can for an on-the-go lunch. You can even use them in this outdoor-friendly breakfast hash recipe that uses the seasoned oil in the can to cook the entire dish!

Pro-tip: Skip the on-site prep by slicing the peppers and onion ahead of time, packing in reusable containers, and storing in the cooler until it’s time to cook.
ingredients: 1 can TJ’s Greek Chickpeas with Parsley & Cumin
A few shakes of TJ’s 21 Seasoning Salute

steps.text: To a cast iron pan over medium heat, add chickpeas and all the oil in the can. When oil is hot, add onions and peppers, and sauté until the onions begin to brown and the peppers soften, about 5-10 minutes, depending on the strength of your heat source. Season with Smoked Paprika and 21 Seasoning Salute.

Use a spatula to create four individual pockets throughout the hash. Crack the eggs into each pocket. For eggs with a runny yolk, cook until egg whites have set, about 3-5 minutes. For a firmer yolk, cook a few more minutes.

veggie-chickpea-hash.title: Veggie Chickpea Hash

veggie-fajitas.description: Super-sweet and vibrantly colored, Trader Joe’s Organic Tri-Color Bell Peppers add sensational sizzle to thick slices of savorily seasoned Portabella Mushrooms in this meatless fajitas recipe. If you love the sound of that sizzle, use caution (and a trivet) to serve straight from the pan at the table. Alternatively, transfer the mushrooms, peppers, and onions to a platter to serve.
ingredients: 1 package TJ’s Organic Tri-Color Bell Peppers (or available colors), sliced into strips
1 TJ’s Red Onion, sliced into strips
2-3 TJ’s Portabella Mushroom, sliced into thick strips
1 tablespoon TJ’s Cuban Style Citrusy Garlic Seasoning Blend
¼ cup TJ’s Cilantro, roughly chopped

steps.text: To a plancha, grill pan, or large cast iron pan over medium-high heat, add oil. Once hot, add peppers and onions, and cook until softened and begin to brown, about 5 minutes. Add mushrooms and Cuban Style Seasoning Blend, and continue to cook until mushrooms are soft and begin to caramelize, about 7-10 minutes.
Remove from heat. Cautiously serve sizzling fajitas in the pan, or on a platter, alongside tortillas, avocado slices, cilantro, and lime.

veggie-fajitas.title: Veggie Fajitas

veggie-garden-pasta.description: With its light, herb-y profile and quick cooking time, this veggie-forward pasta is the perfect antidote to hot days and heavy BBQ dishes. Trader Joe's Hearts of Palm Pasta stands in for the real thing, with a mild flavor that gives the tender zucchini, tangy tomatoes, and sweet corn room to shine-pleasing to the carb-conscious and pasta appreciators alike.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons TJ's Organic Italian Extra Virgin Olive Oil (or your favorite TJ's Olive Oil)
Generous handful TJ's Fresh Basil, chopped (plus more for garnish)
1 cup TJ's Corn (fresh or thawed from frozen)
1 package TJ's Hearts of Palm Pasta
TJ's Sea Salt and Black Pepper

steps.text: Heat oil in a large nonstick pan. Add tomatoes, zucchini, garlic, basil, and a pinch of salt and stir. Cook 5 minutes. Stir in corn and cook another 5 minutes.
Stir in pasta and cook 5 minutes or until pasta is heated through. Remove from heat and season to taste with salt & pepper.
Plate hot pasta, top with goat cheese crumbles and fresh basil, and enjoy right away.

veggie-garden-pasta.title: Veggie Garden Pasta

very-cherry-vanilla-float.description:
Trader Joe’s Black Cherry Vanilla Sparkling Water is something special. Like our other sparkling waters, our Black Cherry Vanilla Sparkling Water is completely unsweetened, yet thanks to an infusion of natural Black Cherry and Vanilla flavors, it still manages to offer a timeless, cherry cream soda-esque sipping experience. At zero calories per can, it’s a great way to add some light, flavorful fizz to cocktails and mocktails, too. And combined with TJ’s Super Premium French Vanilla Ice Cream, it becomes a fantastic float! Serve it to your sweetheart (with two straws, perhaps) and watch them bubble over with excitement!

Pro-tip: As an alternative to defrosting in the microwave, thaw the cherry blend in the fridge the night before assembly.
ingredients: ¼ cup TJ’s Very Cherry Berry Blend
3 large scoops of TJ’s Super Premium French Vanilla Ice Cream
1/3 - 1/2 cup TJ’s Black Cherry Vanilla Sparkling Water

steps.text: To quickly thaw the Very Cherry Blend, remove from package and place in a microwave-safe container. Set to defrost mode for 30 second intervals until softened.
Add thawed cherry blend to a tall glass. Use a spoon or muddler to gently mash and release some of the juices.
Top with scoops of ice cream, then pour the Black Cherry Vanilla Sparkling Water over to serve.

very-cherry-vanilla-float.title: Very Cherry Vanilla Float

waffle-sandwich.description: Wake up your waffle routine with a swipe of blueberry-flecked cream cheese.
ingredients: 1 package (8 waffles) TJ's Frozen Toaster Waffles
1 package TJ's Blueberries, fresh or frozen

steps.text: Toast waffles according to directions on box.
While waffles are toasting, combine blueberries, cream cheese, sugar and a splash of vanilla in a food processor or blender and mix until smooth.
Spread the blended mixture between two waffles, sprinkle on a few whole blueberries, sandwich and enjoy.

waffle-sandwich.title: Waffle Sandwich

warm-cruciferous-cranberry-slaw.description: Sometimes, spending hours lovingly preparing a hot, nutritious meal is just the kitchen therapy you need. Other times, the very thought of laboring over lunch or dinner is more torturous than it is therapeutic. Our Warm Cruciferous Cranberry Slaw is for those other times. Ready in just 10 minutes and best served warm, this hearty, winter-inspired side is a cinch to make and guaranteed to wow-further proof that one needn't be nimble with a knife or a first-class flambé artist to create a delicious dish-just a bag of Trader Joe's Cruciferous Crunch and a few crunchy, savory toppings...  don't forget a generous sprinkle of TJ's Shaved Parmesan, Romano & Asiago Cheeses!
ingredients: 2 teaspoons TJ's Organic Extra Virgin Olive Oil
TJ's Shaved Parmesan, Romano & Asiago Cheese

steps.text: In a large skillet over medium-high heat, add olive oil. When heated, add cruciferous crunch and sauté 3 minutes until slightly wilted. Remove pan from heat and pour contents into a large bowl. Add salt and lemon juice and toss until coated. Divide greens among two plates and top with a handful of dried cranberries, almonds and shaved cheese. Serve warm.

warm-cruciferous-cranberry-slaw.title: Warm Cruciferous Cranberry Slaw

watermelonade.description: If summer were a drink, it would surely have to be lemonade. Sweet, refreshing, and delightfully tart, a cool, crisp glass of lemonade immediately evokes the very best aspects of the season, and like most juicy drinks, the more freshly squeezed, the better. This recipe doubles down on the freshness by combining Trader Joe’s Fresh Squeezed Lemonade with fresh juice from a ripe watermelon, another summer seasonal stunner.

steps.text: Slice a mini watermelon in half. Cut two thin slices from one half and set aside for garnish.

Cube the remaining watermelon. Add to a blender pitcher and blend on low for 30 seconds, stopping to agitate the blender contents as needed. Increase speed to high and blend one minute. Strain and discard the solids.
Combine watermelon juice and lemonade in a large pitcher and stir. Slice reserved watermelon into 8 triangles. Serve watermelonade over ice, garnished with sliced watermelon.

watermelonade.title: Watermelonade

wedge-salad-dip.description: The cool, velvety sour cream base of this dip contrasts with refreshing iceberg lettuce and packs plenty of umami flavor, thanks to crumbled blue cheese, tangy tomatoes, and chopped bacon. Pair it with crispy, sturdy tortilla chips for dipping, and a bold, intensely hoppy Boatswain Double I.P.A. to wash it all down.
ingredients: 1 tub (16 oz.) TJ's Organic Sour Cream
1 tablespoon plus 2 teaspoons TJ's 21 Seasoning Salute
2-3 TJ's Roma Tomatoes, chopped (discard juicy pulp)
3 slices of your favorite TJs Bacon, cooked & chopped
Handful chopped TJ's Fresh Chives, for garnish
TJ's Tortilla Chips for dipping (we especially like Quinoa & Black Bean Tortilla Chips here)

steps.text: Prepare the dip base: In a small serving dish, combine sour cream, seasoning, and salt. Cover and refrigerate 4 hours or overnight.
Garnish and serve: Remove dip from refrigerator and let sit 20 minutes. Top with iceberg, tomatoes, blue cheese, bacon, and chives. Serve with tortilla chips for dipping.

wedge-salad-dip.title: Wedge Salad Dip

what-to-do-tofu.description: With a few fridge basics and some simple prep, you're minutes away from tasty, meal-building blocks of savory tofu. Make a double batch and you'll have protein on hand for quick lunches all week long!
ingredients: 1 16 oz. package your favorite TJ's Tofu
1/3 cup TJ's Coconut Aminos or Soy Sauce

steps.text: Drain tofu and slice lengthwise into thirds. Press between 2 paper towels to soak up excess moisture. Cut the tofu slabs into 1-inch cubes.
Place tofu in a shallow dish and coat with coconut aminos. Marinate for at least 15 minutes, turning the cubes periodically.

Preheat oven to 375°F. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil. Arrange marinated tofu cubes in a single layer on baking sheet.  Place baking sheet on center rack of oven and bake 30 minutes, flipping tofu halfway through cooking. Remove from oven and let cool slightly before serving.
Add to salads, curries, soups, or anywhere you'd like the taste of tofu!

what-to-do-tofu.title: What to do? Tofu!

whipped-avocado-dip.description: We're the first to admit that we're gaga for guac, but for delicate dippers, sometimes a chunky guac is not the way to go. Enter this whipped avocado dip recipe: it's delightfully fluffy, with buttery avocado flavor, a tangy creaminess, and a superlight texture that won't leave you with a mess of broken chips in your dip bowl. Pair it with wafer-thin sweet potato chips or dollop it on enchiladas for savory avo bliss.
ingredients: 1 package (2 trays) TJ's Avocado's Number Guacamole
Juice of half a TJ's Lime

steps.text: Add all ingredients to a medium bowl. Use a hand mixer to beat 3 to 5 minutes until mixture is fluffy and no lumps remain, stopping to scrape down the sides of the bowl as needed. Taste and adjust salt if necessary, and serve.

whipped-avocado-dip.title: Whipped Avocado Dip

willies-sweet-potato-pie.description: This family recipe comes to us from a Crew Member kitchen. Serve it instead of traditional pumpkin pie, or try them both in a Thanksgiving taste-off!
ingredients: 1 TJ's Pie Crust, defrosted according to package instructions
2 bags TJ's Roasted & Mashed Sweet Potatoes (seasonally available), defrosted

steps.text: Preheat oven 350° F.
Unroll pie crust over a 9 inch pie pan, per "Using Crust"package instructions.

Mix together the sweet potatoes, 1/2 of the cream, 1/2 of sugar, butter, vanilla, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt, until smooth. Taste and adjust seasoning (add more cream if desired or if mixture is too dry).
In a separate small bowl, whip eggs with a whisk, and then fold into the sweet potato mixture.

Pour mixture into the pie crust. Place pie in oven and bake for 1 hour or until the center is firm and dry (use a tooth pick to test). It may be a little brown around the edges. Remove from oven and allow pie to cool on a rack before cutting and serving. Serve with a dollop of whipping cream (see package directions).

willies-sweet-potato-pie.title: Willie’s Sweet Potato Pie

yellow-curry-chickpeas.description: Trader Joe's Thai Style Yellow Curry Sauce is zesty and ginger-forward, bolstered by onion and garlic purées, and blended with a creamy coconut milk base. Pair this robust, velvety sauce with TJ's Organic Garbanzo Beans, quinoa, and veggies to create a hearty, meatless meal that comes together in under an hour.
ingredients: 1 package (12 ounces) TJ's Cherry Tomatoes on the Vine, vine removed
A few cranks of TJ's Sea Salt
1 cup dried TJ's Organic White Quinoa, prepared according to package instructions
1 bottle TJ's Thai Style Yellow Curry Sauce
1 cans TJ's Organic Garbanzo Beans, drained

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F. Spread tomatoes out into a single layer on a sheet pan. Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with salt. Roast for 20 minutes, until the tomatoes soften and the skins begin to wrinkle. While tomatoes are roasting, prepare quinoa according to package directions.

Warm the curry sauce in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add garbanzo beans and stir to combine. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes. Add tomatoes and spinach, and continue to cook until the spinach is wilted and tender, about 3-5 minutes. Serve curry atop a bed of cooked quinoa.

yellow-curry-chickpeas.title: Yellow Curry Chickpeas

yogurt-crunch-waffle.description: Skip the syrup and jazz up toaster waffles with tangy Greek yogurt & honey roasted almonds.
ingredients: 1 box (8 pieces) TJ's Toaster Waffles, heated
1 16oz container TJ's Strawberries, hulled and sliced top to bottom
1/2 cup TJ's Sliced Honey Roasted Almonds

steps.text: Dollop two tablespoons of Greek yogurt atop each waffle. Sprinkle strawberries, bananas and almonds over each waffle and serve immediately.

yogurt-crunch-waffle.title: Yogurt Crunch Waffle

zhuzhed-up-ramen-cup.description:
Trader Joe’s Miso Ramen Soup is not your typical instant ramen cup. Included alongside its impeccably crafted blend of seasonings is a packet of sunflower oil. Adding both to the noodles during preparation ensures not only a delightfully savory broth, rich with flavors of miso, garlic, notes of umami and seaweed, but a silky-smooth texture for your noodles—the days of dry-textured instant noodles are over!

This recipe bridges the gap between the convenience of instant ramen with the expansive flavors and aromas of a noodle shop Miso Ramen bowl, thanks to the addition of a few TJ’s products to offer an elevated eating experience with just 20 minutes of prep.
ingredients: 1 TJ’s Baby Bok Choy, sliced in half and roughly chopped

steps.text: Fill a small saucepan with water and bring to a boil over high heat. Carefully add the egg to the saucepan, lower heat to maintain a gentle simmer, and cook egg for 7 minutes.

While the egg is simmering, prepare an ice bath: fill a bowl with a cup of ice and cold water. After 7 minutes, remove the egg from the saucepan and into the ice bath while you prepare the rest of the ramen.

In a medium saucepan, add avocado oil and heat over medium-high heat. Sauté sliced shiitakes for 2-3 minutes, then add water and bring to a boil. Add included seasoning and oil packet from ramen cup and stir. Add ramen noodles and bok choy to pot. Lower heat to medium low, cover, and cook for 4 minutes, until both are tender.
Add the ramen to a serving bowl. Slice the soft-boiled egg in half and add it to the bowl. Top with green onion and a sprinkle of furikake to serve.

zhuzhed-up-ramen-cup.title: Zhuzhed Up Ramen Cup

zucchini-ricotta-rolls.description:
Inspired by the comforting components of a classic lasagna, this version is decidedly lighter and well suited to warmer weather. Pasta sheets are swapped out for thinly sliced zucchini that are rolled, not layered, with a creamy ricotta cheese filling, enhanced with fresh basil and bright lemon zest. The zucchini rolls are bathed in Trader Joe’s Caro Sugo Italian Tomato Basil Pasta Sauce and topped with TJ’s Shredded Mozzarella Cheese amd then baked until bubbling. A delicious vegetarian entrée, this dish is an equally suitable side dish as part of a larger Sunday supper spread.

Pro-tip: Don’t skip the zucchini salting step! Salting extracts water from zucchini, making the slices more flexible and easier to roll. Plus, it will decrease the amount of water released during baking, ensuring the sauce remains thick and flavorful..
ingredients: 4-5 TJ’s Zucchini, stems removed and sliced lengthwise into thin planks
½ cup TJ’s Grated Pecorino Romano & Parmesan Cheese Blend
½ cup chopped TJ’s Fresh Basil
1 jar (24.3 ounces) TJ’s Caro Sugo Italian Tomato Basil Pasta Sauce

steps.text: Preheat oven to 425°F.

Place zucchini planks on a kitchen towel-lined baking sheet and lightly salt each side. Let sit for 10-15 minutes, allowing the water to be drawn out. Thoroughly pat the zucchini dry with a dry towel.
In a medium-sized bowl, add ricotta, grated cheese, basil, and lemon zest, and stir to combine.
Pour the tomato sauce in a medium-to-large baking dish with tall sides.

To assemble the rolls, lay a zucchini plank on a cutting board. Spoon on a few tablespoons of ricotta filling, then use the back of your spoon to evenly spread it over the surface of the zucchini. Roll the zucchini into a coil, and place in the baking dish so you can see the swirl. Repeat, until the dish is tightly filled with zucchini. The sauce should cover at least half of the height (and up to ¾) of the zucchini rolls.
Top each roll with mozzarella, then bake for 30 minutes, until the cheese has browned, and the sauce is bubbling. Cool for 5-10 minutes before serving.

zucchini-ricotta-rolls.title: Zucchini & Ricotta Rolls
